source: Aff?! Sem munição? Quem abastece essas coisas?
target: Ugh, no ammo? Who stocks these things?

source: Affûter une compétence est une quête de toute une vie. Peut-être atteindrons-nous les sommets ensemble.
target: To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.

source: Agora apresentando um poema de encerramento.
target: Now presenting, a poem of finale.

source: Agora começa a história do cavaleiro!
Agora consigo ver mais... Então isso era o que me incomodava o tempo todo.
target: I can see more now... So that's what was troubling me all along.

source: Agora eu tenho energia para trabalhar nos meus pedidos.
target: Now I've got the energy to work on my commissions.

source: Agora posso alcançar coisas ainda maiores com o Metalmorfo. Há algo em particular que você deseja? Por favor, deixe-me oferecer minha nova criação como um presente. Ela não existiria sem você.
target: I can now achieve even greater things with Metalmorph. Is there a particular thing you desire? Please let me offer my new creation as a gift. It wouldn't exist without you.

source: Agora posso alternar entre qualquer tipo de névoa como eu quiser. Muito obrigado, amigo! Se precisar de algo, é só pedir. Farei o meu melhor para atender!
target: Now I can switch between any kind of mist as I please. Much appreciated, bud! If you need anything, just ask away. I'll do my best to oblige!

source: Agora posso caminhar ao seu lado.
target: Now, I can walk beside you.

source: Agora que me acostumei, este poder parece robusto e flexível. Tem algo em comum com meu Leihuangquan.
target: Now that I've gotten used to it, this power feels robust and flexible. It does have something in common with my Leihuangquan.

source: Agora que minha lâmina está mais rápida, devo ser capaz de fazer cortes mais limpos.
target: Now that my blade is faster, I should be able to make cleaner cuts.

source: Agora tenho um controle mais refinado sobre a Ipsicorda. Todo o crédito é seu.
target: I have finer control over Zapstring now. It's all credit to you.

source: Agora é a hora de florescer... Eu não percebi que estava prendendo a respiração. Olhe. É tão bonito!
target: Now is the time to bloom... I didn't realize I was holding my breath. Look. It's so beautiful!

source: Agora, hora de marcar o próximo ponto de partida...
target: Now, time to mark the next starting point...

source: Agora, tenho certeza de que não vou deixar você sofrer o menor dano.
target: Now, I am confident to not let you get harmed in the slightest.

source:
Agora, um voluntário da plateia...
Quer que eu te derrube? Bem, já que você pediu com educação... Hehe.
target:
Now, a volunteer from the audience...
Want me put you down? Well, since you asked nicely… Hehe.

source: Agradeço sua orientação. Percebo o crescimento da minha força e habilidades de liderança, e parece que você me ensinou mais do que apenas técnicas de esgrima; me ensinou também lições de vida valiosas.
target: Thank you for your guidance. I have seen growth in my strength and leadership abilities, and it seems you have taught me more than just swordsmanship; you've taught me valuable life lessons.

source: Ah ... Ich freue mich auf unser Spiel.
target: Hehe... I'm looking forward to our game.

source: Ah, ce gadget a été amélioré !
target: Oh, this gadget has seen some upgrades.

source: Ah, cuánto poder... Perfecto. Ahora puedo ser el escudo que proteja a más personas.
target: Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people.

source: Ah, esse aparelho teve algumas melhorias.
target: Oh, this gadget has seen some upgrades.

source: Ah, esse poder... Perfeito. Agora posso ser o Escudo que protege mais pessoas.
target: Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people.

source: Ah, eu gosto de lugares altos.

Ah, la leche de soja agria... Cuando era un niño pequeño, mi madre una vez me convenció de probarla. Aunque la mayoría de mis recuerdos de la infancia son felices, ese sabor en particular fue abrumador para mí.
target: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.

source: Ah, o Leite de Soja Azedo... Quando eu era criança, minha mãe uma vez me convenceu a experimentar. Embora a maioria das minhas memórias de infância sejam alegres, aquele sabor em particular foi avassalador para o meu jovem paladar.
target: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.

source: Ah, quelle puissance... Parfait. Je peux maintenant être le bouclier qui protège davantage de personnes.
target: Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people.

source: Ah, você teve sorte de me encontra, a indiscutível mestre da avaliação de antiguidades! Agora, o que temos aqui? Entregue suas preciosidades e darei uma olhada!
target: Huh, you're lucky to have come across me—the undisputed master of antique appraisal! Now, what do we have here? Hand over your goodies and I'll take a look!

source: Ah, welch eine Kraft … Perfekt. Jetzt kann ich der Schild sein, der viele Leute beschützt.
target: Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people.

source: Ah... Como uma correnteza feroz varrendo o abismo, fazendo o próprio mar tremer.
target: Ah... Like a fierce undertow sweeping through the abyss, causing the sea itself to tremble.

source: Ah... Eu adormeci? Hehe, acho que sua presença me fez sentir muito mais à vontade. Você também deveria descansar mais, Rover. Ficar sem dormir faz o cabelo cair.
target: Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss.

source: Aha ! Maintenant, j'ai plein de trésors aux yeux, et j'ai la force pour les garder aussi !
target: Aha! Now I'm up to my eyes in goodies, and I've got the strength to keep 'em safe too!

source: Aha! Agora estou cheio de tesouros, e tenho a força para garantir a segurança deles!
target: Aha! Now I'm up to my eyes in goodies, and I've got the strength to keep 'em safe too!

source: Aha! Jetzt stecke ich bis über beide Ohren in Leckereien und habe auch noch die Kraft, sie sicher zu beschützen!
target: Aha! Now I'm up to my eyes in goodies, and I've got the strength to keep 'em safe too!

source: Ahem... "Dá o nome do alvo logo."
Ahh... Adoro... O poder correndo pelas minhas veias...!
target: Ahh... I love it... The power surging through my veins...!

source: Ahh... Ich liebe es... Die Kraft, die durch meine Adern strömt...!
target: Ahh... I love it... The power surging through my veins...!

source: Ahh... J'adore ça... La puissance qui pulse dans mes veines... !
target: Ahh... I love it... The power surging through my veins...!

source: Ahh... Me encanta... ¡El poder fluyendo por mis venas...!
target: Ahh... I love it... The power surging through my veins...!

source: Ahora es el momento de florecer... No me di cuenta de que estaba conteniendo la respiración. Mira. ¡Es tan hermoso!
target: Now is the time to bloom... I didn't realize I was holding my breath. Look. It's so beautiful!

source: Ahora mi Forte puede remodelar aún más. Tus esfuerzos han dado sus frutos.
target: Now, my Forte can reshape even more. Your labour has truly borne fruit.

source: Ahora puedo cambiar entre cualquier tipo de niebla como me plazca. ¡Muy agradecido, amigo! Si necesitas algo, solo pregunta. ¡Haré lo posible para complacerte!
target: Now I can switch between any kind of mist as I please. Much appreciated, bud! If you need anything, just ask away. I'll do my best to oblige!

source: Ahora puedo caminar a tu lado.
target: Now, I can walk beside you.

source: Ahora puedo lograr cosas aún más grandes con Metalmorfo. ¿Hay algo en particular que desees? Por favor, permíteme ofrecerte mi nueva creación como regalo. No existiría sin ti.
target: I can now achieve even greater things with Metalmorph. Is there a particular thing you desire? Please let me offer my new creation as a gift. It wouldn't exist without you.

source: Ahora que me he acostumbrado, este poder se siente robusto y flexible. Tiene algo en común con mi Leihuangquan.
target: Now that I've gotten used to it, this power feels robust and flexible. It does have something in common with my Leihuangquan.

source: Ahora tengo la energía para trabajar en mis encargos.
target: Now I've got the energy to work on my commissions.

source: Ahora tengo muchos amigos, pero a veces en mis sueños, todavía estoy completamente solo. Mamá ya no está conmigo, y dicen que Cosmos y Cloudy son solo mis amigos imaginarios... Ehm. ¿P-puedes abrazarme un poco?
target: I've got lots of friends now, but sometimes in my dreams, I'm still all alone. Mommy's not with me anymore, and they say Cosmos and Cloudy are just my imaginary friends… Erm. C-can you hug me a little?

source: Ahora tengo un control más fino sobre la Cuerda. Todo es gracias a ti.
target: I have finer control over Zapstring now. It's all credit to you.

source: Ahora veo más... así que eso era lo que me molestaba todo este tiempo.
target: I can see more now... So that's what was troubling me all along.

source: Ahora, eso es una verdadera ganga.
Ahora, estoy seguro de no dejarte sufrir el más mínimo daño.
target: Now, I am confident to not let you get harmed in the slightest.

source: Ahora, haz lo que te digo.

Ahora, un voluntario de entre el público...

¿Quieres que te baje? Bueno, como me lo pediste amablemente... Je, je.
target:
Now, a volunteer from the audience...
Want me put you down? Well, since you asked nicely… Hehe.

source: Ai-je ce qu'il faut pour combattre les forces des ténèbres ?
target: Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness?

source: Ainda há tempo... antes dos fios se romperem.
target: There's still time… before the threads snap.

source: Ainda não foi entregue?... Vamos lá...
Ainda preciso de mais tempo para me familiarizar com este mundo desconhecido.
target: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.

source: Ainda temos uma longa jornada pela frente. Vamos continuar.
target: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.

source: Ainda temos uma longa viagem pela frente. Vamos continuar.
target: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.

source: Ainda tenho muitos dados de experimentos para processar...
target: I still have much experiment data to process...

source: Aja, me gustan los lugares altos.
Al fin, algo que vale la pena.
Al fin, el ciclo vuelve a empezar
target: At Last, the Cycle Begins Again

source: Al final de un espectáculo, todos gritan "¡Encore!" muy fuerte, luego se abren las cortinas y tocan otra canción. Eso es súper genial, ¿verdad? Entonces... Si eres amigo de Encore, ¡tu historia nunca llegará a su fin!
target: At the end of a show, everybody yells "Encore!" really loud, then the curtains open, and they play another song. That's super cool, right? So... If you're friends with Encore, your story will never come to an end!

source: Al navegar por los mares, lo primero es fijar el rumbo, y luego... ¡improvisar!
target: When sailing the seas, always remember to set your course first, and then... adapt to whatever comes your way!

source: Al parecer, la combinación de mis gestos exagerados y mi estoico semblante resulta desternillante para la gente. ¿Lo ves? Justo así. ¿Oh, te he hecho reír de verdad? Entonces supongo que mantendré el mismo estilo.
target: Apparently, the mix of my over-the-top gestures and stoic face is hilarious to people. See? Just like that. Oh, did I actually get a chuckle out of you? Guess I'll keep this style going, then.
At First, She Closed Her Eyes
Does anything here catch your interest?
Any new tricks? Do impress me.
New goodies to see? I'm in!

source: Algumas pessoas são boas em ouvir, enquanto outras são boas em aconselhar. Yangyang é boa em ambos. Com ela, você pode simplesmente ser você mesmo.
target: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.

source: Algunas personas son buenas escuchando, mientras que otras son buenas aconsejando a los demás. Yangyang es buena en ambas. Con ella, puedes ser simplemente tú mismo.
target: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.

source: Alguns dizem que o contador de histórias acabará fazendo parte da história também.
target: Some say, the storyteller will end up being part of the story as well.

source: Alguém ainda... está esperando por mim...
Alguém comentou no meu post? Hmm? O quê?! Não acredita em mim? Ah, que teimoso...
target: Someone commented on my post? Hmm? What?! Don't believe me? Ah, so stubborn...

source: Alkohol ist nichts für mich. Warum genau ... das kann ich nicht sagen. Er lässt mich einfach ... unbehaglich fühlen.
target: I don't like boozy stuff. Why? ...I don't know. It just makes me... uncomfortable.

source: Alle Seelen vereinen sich. Die Welt zerbricht.
target: All souls converge. The world ruptures.

source: Alle auf einmal. Ich mache keine Überstunden.
target: All of you at once. I don't do overtime.

source:
Allein gehen mag schneller sein, aber gemeinsam kommen wir weiter.
In Zukunft werde ich an der Seite meiner Gefährten stehen ... Ich werde an deiner Seite stehen, um gemeinsam der Zukunft entgegenzutreten.
target:
Walking alone may lead to a faster pace, but a group can cover greater distances.
Moving forward, I will stand by my companions… and I will stand by you as we face whatever the future holds, together.

source: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag! Probier das, ich habe diese Maocai-Schleife ganz alleine gemacht, mit extra Scharfer Soße des Champions nur für dich. Iss, solange es noch dampft! Mach dir keine Sorgen um die Schärfe, es ist ein gutes Omen!
target: Happy Birthday! Try this, I made this bow of Maocai all by myself, with extra Victor Savor added just for you. Eat up while it's still steamin'! Don't worry about the spiciness, it's a good omen!

source: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag, Rover! Ich habe diesen Drachenbartkuchen so lang wie der Schnurrbart des großen Hütenden gemacht. Man sagt, wenn man an seinem Geburtstag etwas Langes isst, lebt man lang und prosperiert. Guten Appetit!
target: Happy Birthday, Rover! I made these Loong Whiskers Crisps to be as long as those of our great Sentinel. They say eating something long on your birthday makes you live long and prosper. Enjoy!

source: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag. Gibt es jemanden oder etwas, das dich stört? An diesem besonderen Tag kann ich meine Dienste zu einem reduzierten Preis anbieten, um dich von deinen Problemen zu befreien.
target: Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.
A world... of black and white...

source: Alles, was das Sonnenlicht berührt, führt uns zum Sieg.
target: All the sun touches is ours to fight for.

source: Alles, was langweilig ist. Nicht aus Hass … es löst eben etwas aus in mir. Nimmt der Welt für eine Weile jede Farbe. Darum lautet mein Motto für alles: Sei mutig, knallig und niemals öde.
target: Anything bland. It's not hate, it's just... a trigger of some bad times. Washes the world out for a minute. So my motto stands, for everything: Go bold. Go bright. Never be boring.

Come on!
Stars, light up tomorrow.

source: Allez, il me faut un autre danseur.
target: Come now. I could use another dancer.

source: Allez, je dois cogner quelque chose !
Allez, on va casser des tronches !
Allons ensemble vers des destinations plus lointaines.

target:
Up we go, Pero.
PERO: Haah!

source: Almas cantam em harmonia. À vitória do salvador!
target: Souls sing in harmony. To the savior's victory!

source: Almas rotas, cruzad al otro lado.
Alors, c'est moi l'élève, cette fois ?
target: So it's my turn to be the student this time?

source: Alors, les chooms, ça vous plaît ?
target: You chooms like this stuff, huh?

source: Alors, qu'est-ce qu'on a ici ? Hélas, ne caches pas !
target: Now, what do we have here? Ya can't hide from me!

source:
Alors, un volontaire dans le public…
Tu veux que je te pose ? C'est si gentiment demandé… Héhé.
target:
Now, a volunteer from the audience...
Want me put you down? Well, since you asked nicely… Hehe.

source: Als Wahrheitssucher messen wir das Universum aus einer Nussschale heraus. Ich würde gerne deine Einsichten hören.
target: As truthseekers, we gauge the universe from within a nutshell. I'd love to hear your insights.

source: Als ich Yangyang gerade erst kennengelernt habe, habe ich mich immer gefragt, wie jemand immer so ein Schatz sein kann. Später habe ich endlich gelernt, dass Sanftheit mit Grenzen eine eigene, starke Kraft hat.
target: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.

source: Als ich klein war, hatte ich wirklich Angst vor der Dunkelheit, aber "Fiamma" war immer rechtzeitig da, um sie zu vertreiben. Jetzt, da ich erwachsen bin, habe ich keine Angst mehr. Ich kann meine eigene Fackel sein!
target: I was really scared of the dark when I was little, but "Fiamma" would always arrive in time to drive it away. Now that I'm all grown up, I'm not scared anymore. I can be my own torch!

source: Also hast du dich diesmal für eine vorsichtige Strategie entschieden. Nächstes Mal könnten wir vielleicht etwas Unkonventionelleres in Betracht ziehen.
target: So you have opted for a prudent strategy this time. Next time, maybe we can consider something more unconventional.

source: Also machen wir gemeinsame Sache? Gut, obwohl ich es gewohnt bin, alleine zu kämpfen.
target: So we're teaming up? Fine, though I'm more used to fighting alone.

source: Also sagst du, ich bin schon eine Spitzen-Navigatorin? Wirklich? … Nein, nein, werd bloß nicht überheblich, Lumi! Es ist noch ein langer Weg, also weitermachen!
target: So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up!

source: Also, mach dich auf den Weg
Also, was steht ganz oben auf unserer Prioritätenliste?
target: Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?

source: Also, wohin gehen wir als Nächstes?
target: Alright, where are we off to next?

source: Além da névoa exuberante, a chuva marcha.
target: Beyond lush haze, the rainfall marches.

source: Além de mim mesma. Além de cada começo e fim escrito da história. Até reescrevermos nosso destino.
target: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.

source: Am Ende einer Show rufen alle ganz laut "Encore!" und dann öffnet sich der Vorhang und sie spielen ein weiteres Lied. Das ist super cool, oder? Also... wenn du mit Encore befreundet bist, wird deine Geschichte nie zu Ende gehen!
target: At the end of a show, everybody yells "Encore!" really loud, then the curtains open, and they play another song. That's super cool, right? So... If you're friends with Encore, your story will never come to an end!

source: Amigos em Jinzhou me disseram que Mortefi faz um monte de dispositivos e engenhocas divertidas! Isso é tão legal! Hmm, será que deveria pedir a ele uma ovelha saltitante da próxima vez...?
target: Friends in Jinzhou told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time…

source: An deiner Seite kämpfen? Okay, das ist mal was Neues.
target: Fighting alongside you? Okay, that's new.

source: Andere zu schützen … ist meine Pflicht!

target: At First, She Closed Her Eyes

source: Angestellte der Familie Montelli schwören auf Espresso – schwarz, ohne Zucker und Milch – um immer hellwach zu bleiben. Aber für mich ist die Arbeit schon hart genug … Ich gönne mir lieber etwas Süßes.
target: Employees of the Montelli family swear by espresso—straight, no sugar or milk—to keep themselves energized. But as for me, work is already hard enough... I'd rather treat myself to something sweet.

source: Anhelo entender el ciclo de la vida, experimentándolo una y otra vez.
target: I wish to comprehend the cycle of life by experiencing it over and over again.

source: Anidado entre las fronteras, Jinzhou está sujeto a un clima en constante cambio. Mantener el pescado seco que he estado haciendo para Mimi ha sido una tarea difícil... Hmm, supongo que una solución se me ocurrirá a su debido tiempo.
target: Nestled between the borders, Jinzhou is subject to ever-changing weather. Sustaining the dried fish I've been making for Mimi has been a difficult task... Hmm, I suppose a solution will come to me in due time.

source: Anoto todas as paisagens, pessoas e eventos interessantes no meu diário de viagem. Quando as palavras não bastam, eu faço um esboço. Já enchi tantos diários desde que entrei na Logística Lollo!
target: I jot down all the interesting sights, people, and events in my travel journal. If words don't cut it, I sketch it out. I've filled up so many journals since joining Lollo Logistics!

source: Anoto todos los lugares interesantes, las personas y los eventos en mi diario de viaje. Si las palabras no son suficientes, hago un boceto. ¡He llenado tantos diarios desde que me uní a Logística Lollo!
target: I jot down all the interesting sights, people, and events in my travel journal. If words don't cut it, I sketch it out. I've filled up so many journals since joining Lollo Logistics!

source: Antes, me aterrorizaba el poder que hay en mi interior. Me preguntaba en qué monstruosidad me convertiría si me consumía... Pero esos miedos han empezado a desaparecer teniéndote a mi lado.
target: The power within me once terrified me. I wondered how monstrous I'd become if it consumed me... But such terrors have started to fade, with you by my side.

source: Ao longo dos anos, minha estimada professora Changli me ensinou muito... No entanto, seus olhos sorridentes ainda guardam mistérios que ainda não consigo compreender.
target: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.

source: Ao navegar pelos mares, sempre se lembre de definir seu rumo primeiro. Depois... é só se adaptar ao que vier pela frente!
target: When sailing the seas, always remember to set your course first, and then... adapt to whatever comes your way!

source: Apenas algo de qi oscuro. *Tch*. Pero algo es algo.
target: Barely any Nether Qi. Tch. Lucky find.

source: Apenas um arranhão na minha lâmina.
target: A mere scratch upon my blade.

source: Apesar de alimentos fritos serem deliciosos, é melhor apreciá-los com moderação, devido aos seus potenciais riscos à saúde.
target: Though fried foods can be delicious, it's best to enjoy them in moderation, due to their potential health risks.

source: Apostando minha vida? Pode contar com isso.
target: Betting my life? Counting on it.

source: Apparemment, la combinaison de ma gestuelle exagérée et de mon visage impassible est hilarante. Tu vois ? Comme ça. Oh, j'ai réussi à te faire rire ? Je vais continuer comme ça, dans ce cas.
target: Apparently, the mix of my over-the-top gestures and stoic face is hilarious to people. See? Just like that. Oh, did I actually get a chuckle out of you? Guess I'll keep this style going, then.

source: Appelons ça… La Grande moisson Chevaleresque.
target: Let's call it... A Knight's Great Harvest.

source: Aprecia el regalo que no se da a la ligera.
target: Cherish the gift not given lightly.

source: Aprender a través de la experiencia.
Après assez d'échecs, la corde s'efface, et avec elle, le fardeau de l'inquiétude.
target: After enough failures, the sting fades, and with it, the burden of worry.

source: Après un bon entraînement, venez prendre une tasse de thé chaud. Le goût frais et délicat du thé éveille toujours l'esprit. Vous devriez l'essayer.
target: A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.

source: Após tantos fracassos, a dor se dissipa e, com ela, o fardo da preocupação.
target: After enough failures, the sting fades, and with it, the burden of worry.

source: Aquecimento concluído. Pronto para o palco!
Aquela garota, a Taoísta? Ela é divertida de assistir. Ela segue as normas entediantes da sociedade humana, mas seu espírito indomável ainda brilha de vez em quando.
target: That girl, the Taoist? She's a fun one to watch. She may seem to follow human society's boring norms, but her untamed spirit still shines through every now and then.

source: Aquela garota, acho que o nome é Yangyang. Ouço ela cantarolando de vez em quando. Surpreendentemente, suas melodias sempre trazem paz à minha mente.
target: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.

source: Aquelas florezinhas estão crescendo lá dentro?
target: Are those little flowers growing inside?

source: Aquele Xiangli Yao... Um dia eu vou superá-lo e criar invenções ainda melhores!
target: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!

source: Aquele dançarino do leão... Lingyang? Tenho certeza de que ele sabe como fazer essas Saudações. Elas são bem legais. Quase tão legais quanto os meus poemas, preciso admitir!
target: That liondancer... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!

source: Aqui vamos nós — serviço de desempacotamento!
Aqui, um pouco de força vital.

Aquí tenemos... la cadenza final. Oh, le has dado un cambio sorprendente... Ya que así están las cosas, ¿por qué no te sientas y escuchas mientras toco la composición completa hasta el final? ¿Tienes tiempo ahora?
target: This is... the final flourish. You've given it an unexpected change... Since that's the case, why not sit and listen as I play the full composition to its end? Do you have time now?
I never miss out on a good deal.

source: Argh, agora tenho que escrever um relatório.
target: Ugh, now I have a report to write.

source: Argh. Une erreur de ma part...

target: Exostrider Armament: Warning, insufficient power supply.

source:
Armamento Exotitán: Alasdeluz activadas.

Aemeath: ¡Las estrellas brillan esta noche!
target:
Exostrider Armament: Lightwings activated.
Aemeath: Stars shine tonight!

source:
Armamento Exotitán: Ejecutando autodiagnóstico.
Aemeath: *Mmm*, todos los sistemas en verde.
target:
Exostrider Armament: Running self-diagnosis.
Aemeath: Mm, all systems green.

source: Armamento Exotitán: El sistema de apuntado no responde.
Armamento Exotitán: Fuente de energía agotada.
Armamento Exotitán: Integración del sistema completa.

Armamento Exotitán: Límite corporal desbloqueado.

Aemeath: ¡Llega la salvación!
target:
Exostrider Armament: Body limit unlocked.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source:
Armamento Exotitán: Multicañón listo.

Aemeath: ¡Llega la salvación!
target:
Exostrider Armament: Cluster cannon ready.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source: Armamento Exotitán: Munición del cañón cargada.

target: Exostrider Armament: Main system to be rebooted.

source:
Armamento Exotitã: Asas de luz ativadas.
Aemeath: As estrelas brilham esta noite!
target:
Exostrider Armament: Lightwings activated.
Aemeath: Stars shine tonight!

source: Armamento Exotitã: Aviso, fonte de energia insuficiente.
target: Exostrider Armament: Warning, insufficient power supply.

source:
Armamento Exotitã: Canhão cluster pronto.
Aemeath: O salvador se ergue!
target:
Exostrider Armament: Cluster cannon ready.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source:
Armamento Exotitã: Executando autodiagnóstico.
Aemeath: Mm, todos os sistemas operacionais.
target:
Exostrider Armament: Running self-diagnosis.
Aemeath: Mm, all systems green.

source: Armamento Exotitã: Fonte de energia desligada.
Armamento Exotitã: Integração do sistema concluída.

Armamento Exotitã: Limite corporal desbloqueado.
Aemeath: O salvador se ergue!
target:
Exostrider Armament: Body limit unlocked.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source: Armamento Exotitã: Sistema de mira sem resposta.
Armamento Exotitã: Sistema principal será reinicializado.
target: Exostrider Armament: Main system to be rebooted.

source: Armamento Exotitã: munição do canhão carregada.
Arrastrándome fuera de mi laboratorio por esto... *Bostezo* Mejor que tengas una buena razón.
target: Dragging me out of my lab for this...*Yawn* You better have a good reason.

source: Arrependam-se, pois o silêncio os chama.
Arrepiéntete, pues el silencio te llama.
Artesanato, costura e... matemática. Sim, diria que sou bem boa nessas áreas.
target: Handcrafting, tailoring, plus... mathematics. Yes, I'd say I'm quite good at these.

source: As Correntes estão convergindo, vindo de todos os lados, e eu estou no meio delas esperando a chegada do vento.
target: Streams are converging from all sides, and I stand in their midst, expecting the wind's arrival.

source: As Correntes estão se intensificando. O que elas têm para me contar?
target: The Streams are getting louder. What do they have to tell me?

source: As Correntes me guiaram até você. Tenho a sensação de que seremos companheiros por muitas luas.
target: The Streams have guided me to you. I have a feeling we'll be companions for many moons to come.

source: As Dramas de heróis no Teatro de Jinzhou são o máximo! Especialmente durante o Ano Novo, todos se reuniam para aproveitar as dramas, divertindo-se muito.
target: The hero plays at Jinzhou Theater are the bee's knees! Especially during New Years, everyone would gather around to enjoy the plays, havin' a whale of a time.
The souls... They look clearer to me.

source: As cortinas se abrem e estou aqui para arrancar risadas! Brant, ao seu dispor. É um prazer conhecer você.
target: The curtains pull back and I'm here to hunt for every laugh! Brant, at your service. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

source: As dinâmicas de um jogo de Weiqi espelham as complexidades do nosso mundo, sempre em um estado de constante mudança e transformação... Fascinante, não é?
target: The dynamics of a Weiqi game mirror the complexities of our world, always in a state of constant flux and transformation... Fascinating, isn't it?

source: As estrelas descansam em silêncio, aguardando sua jornada destinada.
target: The stars rest in silence, awaiting their fated journey.

source: As ondas se erguem - o julgamento ataca!
As pessoas dizem que família é ajudar e confortar uns aos outros. Eu me sinto segura e aquecida ao seu redor... Então, talvez você seja da família...!
target: People say family is about helping and comforting each other. I feel safe and warm around you... So, maybe you count as family after all?

source: As pessoas me chamam de "Taoísta Caça-Espíritos" porque têm medo das Dissonâncias Transgressoras e das coisas assombradas desconhecidas. Mas no dia em que a Buling tornar esse nome des-bu-lingável... isso significa que fiz um bom trabalho.
target: People call me "Spiritchaser Taoist" because they're afraid of the Tacet Discords and spooky unknowns. But the day Buling makes that name un-be-lingable… that means I did good.

source: As pessoas oravam para o Sentinela não por fraqueza, mas porque não tinham alternativa. Como líder, guiarei meu povo rumo a um futuro onde a humanidade assuma o controle do próprio destino.
target: People prayed to the Sentinel not out of weakness, but because they had no other recourse. As leader, I will guide my people towards a future where humanity takes control of our own destiny.
The runes will be our guide.

source: As terras de Jinzhou estão cheias de riquezas.
target: The lands of Jinzhou are filled with riches.
Anything you need me to deal with?

source: Asegúrate de que nadie lo vea.
target: Make sure no one sees it.

source: Así que esto es a lo que se refieren con "Más allá de la montaña se encuentra un mundo más amplio"... ¡Gracias, Errante! No podría haber llegado tan lejos sin ti. Ahora estoy listo para desafiar a los postes más altos.
target: So this is what they mean by "Beyond the mountain lies a broader world"... Thank you, Rover! I couldn't have made it this far without you. Now I'm ready to challenge higher Plum Blossom Poles.

source: Así que has optado por una estrategia prudente esta vez. La próxima vez, quizás podamos considerar algo más inconvencional.
target: So you have opted for a prudent strategy this time. Next time, maybe we can consider something more unconventional.

source: Así que... este es el final.
Ataca sin descanso. Una y otra vez... Cada batalla reforja mi espada. Su auténtica fortaleza no proviene del acero, sino de la voluntad que la domina.
target: Strike relentlessly. Again, and again... Each battle reforges my blade. Its true strength lies not in the steel, but in the will that commands it.

source: Atado por el qi oscuro, perseguido por los espíritus... suena a un verdadero engorro, pero ya estoy acostumbrado. Y como ahora obedecen mis órdenes, supongo que no está tan mal.
target: Bound by Nether Qi, followed by spirits... sounds like a real hassle. But I'm used to it. And since they listen to my commands now, I suppose it's not so bad.

source: Ataque sem parar. Repetidas vezes... Cada batalha reforja minha espada. Sua verdadeira força não está no aço, mas na vontade que a comanda.
target: Strike relentlessly. Again, and again... Each battle reforges my blade. Its true strength lies not in the steel, but in the will that commands it.

source: Atme tief durch, ich bin hier.
target: Take a breath, I'm right here.

source: Atravesar la tormenta en el mar
Attention, le fantôme est là. Bouh…
Até a árvore mais rígida... racha...
Até as estrelas caem às vezes...

target: As far as the eye can see.

source: Até que... a escuridão se espalhe.

Au cours de mes études au séminaire, j'ai compris que pour faire respecter la justice, je devais d'abord travailler dur et faire bien plus de sacrifices que les autres pour surmonter les ombres qui la menaçaient.
target: During my studies at the seminary, I knew that to uphold justice, I would need to work harder and sacrifice more than others to overcome the shadows that sought to destroy it.

source: Au début, elle ferma les yeux
target: At First, She Closed Her Eyes

source: Au fil des années, ma vénérable enseignante Changli m'a beaucoup appris... Pourtant, ses yeux souriants cachent encore des mystères que je ne peux pas encore comprendre.
target: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.

source: Au milieu des perturbations, trouvons notre chemin vers la bonne voie.
target: Amidst disruptions, let's find our way to the right path.

source: Au milieu des souffles des Courants du vent toujours plus intenses, j'entends le murmure constant du titre « Dévote de la voix ». Fait-il référence à moi ? Ou bien… ?
target: In the surging currents of the Streams, I hear the constant whispering of the name—"Votary of the Voice." Does it refer to me? Or...?
In the Name of the Montellis
In the name of the Montellis.

source: Au-delà de la brume verdoyante, la pluie poursuit sa marche.
target: Beyond lush haze, the rainfall marches.

source: Au-delà de la fin de l'été
Au-delà de la valeur de la vie
Au-delà des rivières et des montagnes
Auf geht’s, ganz nach oben auf den Arasaka Tower
target: Let's Go, All the Way To the Top of Arasaka Tower

source: Auf welche Frage suchst du heute eine Antwort, Boss?
target: Boss, what matter do you seek answers for today?

source: Aufgeblasen und träge... wohin wird der Wind dich tragen?
target: Buoyant and languid... where will the wind take you?

source: Aufwärmen ist vorbei. Bereit für die Bühne!
Aunque el camino no tenga fin
target: Even Should the Path Have No End

source: Aunque los alimentos fritos pueden ser deliciosos, es mejor disfrutarlos con moderación, debido a sus posibles riesgos para la salud.
target: Though fried foods can be delicious, it's best to enjoy them in moderation, due to their potential health risks.

source: Aunque no he hablado mucho con él, se nota que Mortefi es una persona de cultura. ¡Ojalá algún día se convierta en mi cliente!
target: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!

source: Aussi loin que l'œil peut voir.
target: As far as the eye can see.

source: Aussi éphémère que la rosée. Disparais.
Auuu... Leão Acima! A vitória é minha no Torneio de Colheita de Verduras deste ano!
target: Awoo—Lion up! Victory is mine at this year's Greens-plucking Tournament!

source: Avant, je rêvais d'aller sur la lune. J'espérais fuir loin de Night City et tout laisser derrière moi. Ce rêve s'est réalisé… mais pas du tout de la manière que je désirais.
target: Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.

source: Avec ce pouvoir, je suis à nouveau entière... Maintenant nous pouvons vraiment jouer à égalité. Après tout, ce n'est pas seulement ce que tu joues... mais avec qui tu joues. Tu ne trouves pas ?
target: With this power, I am whole again... Now we can truly play as equals. After all, it's not just what you play... but who you play with. Don't you agree?

source: Avec incertitude, avec danger, avec défaite
target: With Uncertainty, With Danger, With Defeat

source: Avec plus de pouvoir vient plus de responsabilité... Je ne veux vraiment pas plus de travail, mais si c'est toi qui le demandez... Je peux faire des heures supplémentaires. Un peu.
target: With more power comes more responsibility... I really don't want more work, but if it's you asking... I can do some overtime. Just a little.

source: Avec ta force, cette vague massive n'est qu'une éclaboussure sur notre grand spectacle ! Qu'elle vienne !
target: With your strength, this massive wave is just a splash in our show! Bring it on!

source: Avec ton aide ... Je ne peux pas me relâcher ! Je dois m'entraîner encore plus dur.
target: No more slacking off now that you're here to help! I should practice harder.

source: Avec tout ce qui est si imprévisible dans ce monde, il faut qu'on soit joyeux pour garder l'esprit, non ? Quand tu te trouves ennuyeux, appelez-moi. Je vous remettrai sur pied, sans aucune condition.
target: With everything in this world so unpredictable, why sweat yourself all the time? When you're feeling gloomy, just hit me up. I'll get you straightened out, no strings attached.

source: Avec une telle force, je vais protéger plus de souhaits.
target: With this strength, I shall safeguard more wishes.

source: Avec vous à mes côtés, je peux me battre sans souci... Même si la brume cramoisie obscurcit momentanément ma vue, vous serez là pour m'aider à m'en libérer, n'est-ce pas ?
target: With you by my side, I can fight without worry... Even if the crimson haze momentarily clouds my sight, you'll be there to help me break free from it, right?

source: Avec ça, tout est prêt pour une grande ouverture. Diminuez la voilure !
target: With this, the stage is set for a grand opening. Come on, trim the sails!

source: Aventuras inesquecíveis? Por onde começar? Que tal uma provação ancestral que durou mais de um século?
target: Unforgettable adventures? Where to start? How about an ancient trial that spanned over a century?

source: Avoir des dettes, c'est pas mon truc. Alors considère mon arsenal technomagique comme à ta disposition. En gros : je te couvre.
target: Not in the biz of owin' favors, so consider my arsenal of tech wizardry at your disposal. In other words... I got your back.

source: Awoo - Löwe auf! Der Sieg beim diesjährigen Grünrupfturnier gehört mir!
target: Awoo—Lion up! Victory is mine at this year's Greens-plucking Tournament!

source: Awooo... Levez le lion ! Nous ne pouvons pas perdre le concours de cueillette de cette année !
target: Awoo—Lion up! Victory is mine at this year's Greens-plucking Tournament!

source: Azul Forajido, Naranja Apolo, Amarillo Peligro, Verde Ácido... ¿Adivinas qué color elegiré?
target: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?

source: Azul-fora-da-lei, laranja-apollo, amarelo-perigo, verde-acido... Quer adivinhar qual é a próxima cor que vou escolher?
target: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?

source: Aïe ! Fais attention où tu vas !
Aún hay tiempo... antes de que los hilos se rompan.
target: There's still time… before the threads snap.

source: Aún no he terminado de luchar...
Baignez-vous dans la lumière des étoiles.
Baignée… dans la palette de la nature.
Baila con elegancia aun a pesar de sus grilletes. Una auténtica Montelli, y más que eso. ¿Adónde llevará a su familia? Estoy ansiosa por ver cómo aparecerá ante mí en nuestro próximo encuentro.
target: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true Montelli, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.

source: Baizhi, elle ne parle pas beaucoup... Mais tu vois, elle n'est pas froide ! Si tu passes plus de temps avec elle, tu comprends qu'elle a sa propre façon d'exprimer sa passion.
target: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.

source: Bang. El blanco se ha teñido de rojo.
target: Bang. The white has been dyed red.

source: Bang. O branco se tingiu de vermelho.
target: Bang. The white has been dyed red.

source: Barden sind die Kuriere der Heldengeschichten. Ich brauche keinen Applaus und keine Blumen. Ich bin nur eine Geschichtenerzählerin. Schön, dich kennenzulernen, großer Held. Du kannst mich Ciaccona nennen.
target: Bards are the couriers of heroes' tales. No need for applause or flowers. I'm just a storyteller like any other. Nice to meet you, great hero. You can call me Ciaccona.

source: Batida forte, leve embora a má sorte!
Battons en retraite pour regagner du terrain.
Battre le tambour, le lion se lève !
target: Beat the drum. Ready to prance!

source: Baús do tesouro! Ahh, a experiência essencial de RPG —
target: Treasure chests! Ahh, the essential RPG experience—

source: Beaucoup pensent que le « talent » est une bénédiction, mais ignorent la malédiction qui l'accompagne : un jour, le destin pourrait le reprendre, en silence. Ne prends pas ton talent pour acquis, utilisez-le au maximum avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.
target: Many believe having "talent" is a blessing, but ignore the curse that comes along: someday fate might take it away, quietly. Don't take your talent for granted—make the most of it, before it's too late.

source: Beaucoup portent des masques pour s'intégrer, mais pas elle. Quel que soit son passé, quels que soient les rôles qu'elle a joués, elle est ici maintenant, fidèle à elle-même.
target: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.

source: Beaucoup trébuchent dans la vie sans direction, sans jamais trouver de but. Baizhi fait partie des rares personnes qui ont trouvé leur vocation. Elle est prête à consacrer sa vie à la vérité.
target: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

source: Begrüßung zu Beginn - Böse Geister verschwinden, alles ist sicher und gesund!
target: Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!

source: Bei Montelli sagt man: „Eine Klinge bleibt nur scharf, wenn sie regelmäßig benutzt wird.“ Auch wenn es nur für die Arbeit ist, Übung muss sein.
target: As the Montelli saying goes, "A blade only stays sharp if it's regularly honed." Even if it's just for work, exercise is necessary.

source: Bem, eu já sou superforte, mas... Valeu pelo reforço extra!
target: Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!

source: Bem, meu Poder de Ressonância pode se remodelar ainda mais. Seu trabalho realmente deu frutos.
target: Now, my Forte can reshape even more. Your labour has truly borne fruit.

source: Bem, os efeitos colaterais não são tão ruins agora, mas eu daria qualquer coisa para o Alefe-1 parar de murmurar besteiras na minha cabeça.
target: Well, the side effects aren't as bad now, but I'd give anything for Aleph-1 to just stop mumbling nonsense in my head.

source: Bem... Eu só quero manter a estabilidade que atualmente tenho e talvez manter minha cidade natal segura, se eu conseguir, haha.
target: Well... I just want to maintain the stability I currently enjoy, and maybe keep my hometown safe, if I get the luxury to, haha.

source: Bem... Por favor, não me decepcione.
Bemerkenswerte Strategie. Deine Einsicht bietet mir einzigartige und erfrischende Perspektiven, die ich zuvor nicht in Betracht gezogen habe.
target: Remarkable strategy. Your insight provides me with unique and refreshing perspectives that I have not considered before.

source: Berechnungsergebnisse … Tut mir leid, ich bin unterwegs.
target: Calculation results... Sorry, I'm on my way.
Everyone's safe and sound? Looks like I didn't practice for nothing, then!

source: Besoin d'un médecin ? Par chance, j'ai du temps libre.
target: Need a doctor? I happen to be free.

source: Besoin d'une netrunner ?ALT: On garde l'objectif en tête.
Besoin de contacter Aalto ? Voici son contact. Mentionnez mon nom pour une réduction de vingt pour cent.
target: Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.

source: Beweisen wir uns gegenseitig, was wir aneinander haben.
target: Let's prove our value to each other.

source: Beziehst du dich auf das kleine Mädchen, das immer an Aaltos Seite gesehen wird? Ich habe sie einmal getroffen. Sie und Aalto ergänzen sich perfekt, was die Persönlichkeit angeht.
target: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.
Hmph... Quite good at hiding, aren't you?

source: Bien que les aliments frits soient délicieux, il est préférable de les consommer avec modération en raison de leurs risques potentiels pour la santé.
target: Though fried foods can be delicious, it's best to enjoy them in moderation, due to their potential health risks.
Good. There's no time to waste.
Alright, where are we off to next?

source: Bien. Eso me hizo más fuerte... ¿Debería empezar a pensar en cómo devolverte el favor?
target: Good. That did make me stronger... Should I start thinking about how to repay you?

source: Bien. No hay tiempo que perder.
target: Good. There's no time to waste.

source: Bienvenido a Jinzhou, estimado visitante de lejos. Mis disculpas por cualquier fallo en mi hospitalidad, mi agenda está bastante llena. Si hay un asunto que requiera mi atención, no dudes en buscarme en el Ayuntamiento.
target: Welcome to Jinzhou, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall.

source: Bienvenue à Jinzhou, honorable invité venu de loin. Je m'excuse pour toute lacune dans mon hospitalité, mon emploi du temps est assez chargé. Si vous avez besoin de mon attention, n'hésitez pas à me trouver à l'Hôtel de ville.
target: Welcome to Jinzhou, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall.

source: Bin ich den Mächten der Dunkelheit wirklich gewachsen?
target: Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness?

source: Bin ich diesmal also die Studentin?
target: So it's my turn to be the student this time?

source: Bin ich zu aufgeregt? … Ich bin tatsächlich ziemlich aufgeregt. Am liebsten würde ich einfach weiter mit dir trainieren.
target: Do I look overexcited? Because in truth, I am. All I want is to keep sparring with you.

source: Bin nun endlich ich an der Reihe?
Biscoitos queimados, macarrão encharcado, sobremesas onde alguém confundiu açúcar com sal... Se eles fizeram para mim, eu amo.
target: Burnt cookies, soggy instant noodles, desserts where someone confused salt with sugar... If they made it for me, I love it.

source: Bist du bereit, das Abenteuer gemeinsam zu wagen?
Bist du dir sicher? Du gibst meinem Eigensinn nach? Nur damit du es weißt, wenn wir so weitermachen, landen wir vielleicht … in einer unbekannten Zukunft, die unheimlicher ist als das Chaos!
target: Are you sure about this? Indulging my willfulness? Just so you know, if we keep this up, we might... fall into an unknown future scarier than Chaos!

source: Bitte bleib nicht zu weit von mir entfernt.
target: Please don't stay too far away from me.

source:
Bitte lächeln!
Funken, entzündet die Welt.
Bleu rebelle, orange Apollon, jaune périlleux, vert acide… Devine quelle couleur vient ensuite !
target: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?

source: Boa escolha! Você não vai se arrepender de escolher o serviço do Aalto.
target: Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.

source: Boas-vindas a Jinzhou, prezado hóspede. Minhas desculpas por qualquer falha em minha hospitalidade; minha agenda está bastante cheia. Se houver um assunto que exija minha atenção, por favor não hesite em me procurar na Prefeitura.
target: Welcome to Jinzhou, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall.

source: Bom dia. O que nosso cliente fiel deseja perguntar hoje?
target: G'day. What does our loyal client wish to inquire about today?

source: Bom. Isso realmente me deixou mais forte... Devo começar a pensar em como te retribuir?
target: Good. That did make me stronger... Should I start thinking about how to repay you?

source: Bom. Não há tempo a perder.
target: Good. There's no time to waste.

source: Bon choix ! Tu ne regrette pas d'avoir choisi le service d'Aalto.
target: Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.

source: Bon, c'est toujours mieux que rien.
Bon, il est temps de me dégourdir les jambes. Parfait, je n'ai pas perdu la main.
target: Heh. Time to shake off the rust... Good. Still got it.
Alright, where are we off to next?

source: Bon, quelle est la première tâche sur la liste d'aujourd'hui ?
target: Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?
Hey, little one... There you go!

source: Bon, une amélioration devrait faire l'affaire pour le moment.
target: All right, a tune-up should do the trick for now.

source: Bon. Ça fait partie du travail, j'imagine.
target: Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.

source: Bonjour ! Ici Lumi ! Un colis à envoyer ? Navigatrice professionnelle de Loulou Logistique à votre service !
target: Greetings! Lumi here! Need to send some mail? I've got you covered as Lollo Logistics' professional navigator!

source: Bonjour, comment allez-vous ? Je suis Encore du Littoral Noir ! Prêt pour une aventure de moutons noirs et blancs avec Encore ?
target: Hee-hee. Hi, there! I'm Encore from the Black Shores! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies?

source: Bonjour, je m'appelle Yuanwu, je dirige une salle de boxe. Ce n'est pas une grande salle, mais je m'occupe de chaque client avec soin. Vous êtes le bienvenu à venir.
target: Hello. I am Yuanwu, and I run a boxing gym. It's not a big place, but we make sure every customer is treated with finesse. You're welcome to visit any time.

source: Bonjour, vous êtes venu aujourd'hui pour entraîner ou pour détendre ? Bien sûr, on peut parler. Attendez, je vais vous préparer une tasse de thé.
target: Hello there. What will it be for today? Are you here to put in some extra work, or maybe just to loosen up a bit? Of couse, you're welcome for a chat, too. One moment, I'll go make some tea for you.

source: Bonjour. Que souhaite notre fidèle client se renseigner aujourd'hui ?
target: G'day. What does our loyal client wish to inquire about today?

source: Brauchst du einen Arzt? Ich habe gerade zufällig Zeit.
target: Need a doctor? I happen to be free.

source: Brilhar ou morrer? Apenas dois lados da mesma moeda.
target: To shine or to die? Merely two sides of the same coin.

source: Briller ou mourir ? Simplement les deux faces d'une même médaille.
target: To shine or to die? Merely two sides of the same coin.

source: Brindemos por un viaje seguro por delante.
target: Here's to a safe journey ahead.

source: Buen día. ¿Qué desea preguntar nuestro leal cliente hoy?
target: G'day. What does our loyal client wish to inquire about today?

source: Buen sueño, buena comida y... buenos amigos. Todos los días.
target: Good sleep, good food, and... good friends together. Every single day.

source: Buena pieza. Quien la encuentra, se la queda.
Bueno, por ahora los efectos secundarios no son tan malos, pero daría cualquier cosa para que Aleph-1 dejara de murmurar tonterías en mi cabeza.
target: Well, the side effects aren't as bad now, but I'd give anything for Aleph-1 to just stop mumbling nonsense in my head.

source: Bueno, ya que has hecho tanto por mí... Adelante, dime las invenciones más locas que se te ocurran, y mírame hacerlas realidad para ti.
target: Fine, since you've done this much for me... Go ahead, tell me the wildest inventions you can think of, and watch me make them happen for you.

source: Bueno... Por favor, no me decepciones.
Bueno... Solo quiero mantener la estabilidad que actualmente disfruto, y tal vez mantener a salvo mi ciudad natal, si tengo el lujo de hacerlo, jaja.
target: Well... I just want to maintain the stability I currently enjoy, and maybe keep my hometown safe, if I get the luxury to, haha.

source: Buling la taoïste de Mengzhou… Exorcisme, divination de talisman, cartomancie… je fais tout ce que tu veux !
target: Mengzhou Taoist Buling here. Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it!

source: Buling นักพรตเต๋าแห่งเมิ่งโจว ไม่เพียงแต่ทำนายดวงชะตาได้แม่นยำ ยังขับภูตผี อวยพรให้โชคดี ตีความลายมือ เขียนอักษรวิเศษ อาวุธวิเศษและยันษ์...ทุกอย่างล้วนแม่นยำ!
target: Mengzhou Taoist Buling here. Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it!

source: Buling อยู่ที่นี่ ทุกอย่างย่อมแม่นยำ!
Buling, Buling, todo va bien, todo a cien.
Buling, Taoísta de Mengzhou aqui. Exorcismo, adivinhação com talismãs, leitura da sorte... o que precisar, eu "brilho" com isso!
target: Mengzhou Taoist Buling here. Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it!

source: Buling, taoísta de Mengzhou. Exorcismo, adivinación con talismanes, lectura de la fortuna... lo que sea, ¡con el toque Buling!
target: Mengzhou Taoist Buling here. Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it!

source: Busca, resgate, transporte, reconhecimento, combate em grupo... Cães são leais e habilidosos de muitas maneiras. Eu? Não tenho cães. É muito perigoso... para os cães, quero dizer.
target: Search, rescue, transportation, recon, group combat... Dogs are loyal and skilled in many ways. Me? I don't keep dogs. It's too dangerous... for the dogs, that is.

source: Bâille. Je suis sur les rotules.
Búsqueda, rescate, transporte, reconocimiento, combate en grupo... Los perros son leales y hábiles en muchos aspectos. ¿Yo? No tengo perros. Es demasiado peligroso... para los perros, eso es.
target: Search, rescue, transportation, recon, group combat... Dogs are loyal and skilled in many ways. Me? I don't keep dogs. It's too dangerous... for the dogs, that is.
Knew it! You can't do without Encore! Off we go!

source: C'est beaucoup plus rapide comme ça !
C'est bien, cela valait le déplacement.
C'est ce qui s'appelle de la précision.

target: I believe it's this one? ...How nice.

source: C'est comme les coffres aux trésors dans les contes !
target: Just like the treasure chests from the stories!

source: C'est de la qualité... ça ira.
C'est dommage que tu ne te souviennes pas de ton passé, il doit y avoir beaucoup de souvenirs précieux. Mais ne t'inquiète pas, nous pouvons en créer de nouveaux. Toi et moi, ensemble !
target: It sucks that you can't remember your past, there must've been a lot of unforgettable memories. But no worries, we can create new ones. You and I, together!

source: C'est donc ça le sens de « Au-delà de la montagne, on trouve un monde plus grand »... Merci, Nomade ! Je n'aurais pas pu aller aussi loin sans toi. Maintenant, je suis prêt à défier des poteaux plus hauts !
target: So this is what they mean by "Beyond the mountain lies a broader world"... Thank you, Rover! I couldn't have made it this far without you. Now I'm ready to challenge higher Plum Blossom Poles.

source: C'est donc ça, Encore va bien écrire ça dans les histoires... Quand tu as le temps, Encore va te le lire.
target: Woah, so that's how you did it! Encore's making it part of the story... You'll hear it when you've got the time.

source: C'est ici que tu te caches, hein ?
C'est incroyable, comme dans les histoires d'autrefois... Encore peut même vaincre les dragons maléfiques !
target: This is wicked cool! It's just like in the stories... So Encore can beat up a bad dragon now?! Yay!

source: C'est intéressant. Tes commentaires me rappellent les textes que j'ai trouvés dans les Ruines de la Cour de Savantae. Leur idéologie est fascinante et énigmatique, presque comme si elle venait des étoiles de l'univers.
target: It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.

source: C'est juste une petite blessure, ne t'inquiète pas.
C'est l'alarme... Bon, il est temps de se mettre au travail.
target: Is that the alarm... Alright, time to work.

source: C'est l'heure de faire une petite sieste… Ce n'était qu'un rêve…
target: Time for a little nap... It's... It's just a dream...

source: C'est l'heure de l'exploration aérienne d'Encore !
C'est l'heure de partir ! Mon brouillard peux t'escorter.
target: It's go time! You'll have my mist for escort.

source: C'est l'heure de s'y mettre, les amis !
C'est l'heure de travailler ? Alors, il faut qu'on revienne de la lune.
target: Time to work? *chuckle* No more lazing around, then.

source: C'est la place où la terre s'arrête est où l'océan commence. Notre voyage est loin d'être terminé.
target: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

source: C'est le moment de faire une empreinte !
C'est le moment de fleurir... Je ne me rendais pas compte que je retenais ma respiration. Regardez. C'est si beau !
target: Now is the time to bloom... I didn't realize I was holding my breath. Look. It's so beautiful!

source: C'est le résultat de notre effort.
target: This is the answer to our endeavor.

source: C'est mon devoir... de protéger les autres !
C'est mon lien avec ce monde, témoignant de tout ce que j'ai vécu.
target: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.

source: C'est parti… le service de déballage est là !
C'est pas des eddies ordinaires, ça…
C'est pas très digne, tout ça…
C'est remarquable. Ton perspicacité me fournit des perspectives uniques et rafraîchissantes que je n'avais pas envisagées auparavant.
target: Remarkable strategy. Your insight provides me with unique and refreshing perspectives that I have not considered before.

source: C'est sûrement à cause de mon visage impassible. Beaucoup de gens pensent que je suis « difficile à approcher ». Ce n'est pas que je n'aime personne. Je ne sais tout simplement pas... comment aborder les gens naturellement.
target: It's probably my lack of facial expressions. A lot of people think I'm "difficult to approach." It's not that I dislike anyone. I just don't know... how to approach people in a natural way.

source: C'est tellement brillant... C'est le trésor du dragon !
target: Ooh, shiny! It's gotta be a dragon's treasure!

source:
C'est ton anniversaire ? Aujourd'hui, dis-tu ? Oh
...
Si tu attends un cadeau ou qu'un de tes souhaits se réalise, alors attends ici. Une longue attente peut être un cadeau en soi.
target:
Your birthday? Today, you say? Oh.
…
Well, if you're expecting a present or some kind wishes, then simply wait here. A long wait can be considered a gift in itself.

source: C'est tout ce que t'as dans le ventre ?
C'est tout ce que tu as ?
target: Is that the best you got?

source: C'est tout ce que tu as dans le ventre ?
target: Is that the best you can do?

source: C'est tout à fait standard, je vois.

target: Nice. Let's go check it out.

source: C'est un cadeau de la nature ! Prenons-en soin.
target: It's nature's gift! Let's keep it well.

source: C'est un exercice vocal. Tu veux essayer avec moi ?
target: It's a type of vocal exercise. Want to join me?

source: C'est un témoignage de ma connexion avec le monde qui m'entoure, et c'est lui qui enregistre tout ce que j'ai vécu lors de ce voyage.
target: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.

source: C'est un véritable plaisir de travailler avec toi, et je ne dis pas cela simplement pour être polie. Je savoure réellement chaque moment que nous passons ensemble.
target: I've come to find a genuine pleasure working with you—truly, I do not say this out of formality. Whether it's business or not, I truly cherish every moment we share.

source: C'est une blessure légère, ne t'en fais pas.

C'est votre anniversaire aujourd'hui. Tu dois prendre un repos. Faisons une sieste ensemble, d'accord ? J'ai le matériel de sommeil le plus confortable juste pour toi. Faites de beaux rêves, et joyeux anniversaire, Nomade.
target: It's your birthday today. You should take a well-deserved rest. Let's nap together, shall we? I've got the comfiest sleep gear just for you. Sweet dreams, and happy birthday, dear.

source: C'est vraiment accablant quand tant de gens comptent sur vous. Je connais trop bien ce sentiment... Ne t'inquiète pas. Tu peux détendre un peu plus quand tu es avec moi.
target: It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me.

source: C'est à cette hauteur qu'on s'amuse vraiment.
C'était... ça en valait la peine...
Cada desafio que enfrentamos, cada obstáculo que superamos, e cada memória que compartilhamos... Tudo isso se tornou minha força.
target: Every challenge we've faced, every obstacle we've overcome, and every memory we've shared... All of it has become my strength.

source: Cada desafío que hemos afrontado, cada obstáculo superado y cada recuerdo compartido... todo eso es parte de mi fuerza.
target: Every challenge we've faced, every obstacle we've overcome, and every memory we've shared... All of it has become my strength.

source: Cada vez que veo el desastre que dejan esos borrachuzos... ¡Puaj! Tiraría todo el alcohol al mar.
target: Every time I see the mess those drunkards leave behind... Ugh, I just want to dump all the booze into the ocean.

source: Calcharo หัวหน้ากลุ่มทหารรับจ้างสุนัขล่าวิญญาณ คงเคยได้ยินมาบ้างสินะว่าพวกเราทำอะไร ไม่ต้องห่วง ในฐานะลูกค้าของฉัน ขอรับประกันความปลอดภัยของคุณจนกว่างานจะเสร็จ
target: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.

source: Calcharo, Anführer der Söldnergruppe der Geisterhunde. Ich nehme an, du hast von dem gehört, was wir tun. Keine Sorge, deine Sicherheit als mein Kunde wird garantiert, bis der Job erledigt ist.
target: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.

source: Calcharo, chef des Chasseurs Fantômes. Je suppose que vous avez entendu parler de ce que nous faisons. Ne vous inquiétez pas, votre sécurité en tant que mon client sera garantie jusqu'à ce que le travail soit terminé.
target: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.

source: Calcharo, líder del Grupo Mercenario de los Sabuesos Fantasmas. Supongo que has oído hablar de lo que hacemos. No te preocupes, tu seguridad como mi cliente estará garantizada hasta que el trabajo esté terminado.
target: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.

source: Calcharo, líder do grupo mercenário os Sabujos Fantasmas. Suponho que você já tenha ouvido falar sobre o que fazemos. Não se preocupe, sua segurança como meu cliente será garantida até que o trabalho esteja concluído.
target: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.

source: Calma aí. Você quer um também? Hmm? Haha.
target: Take it easy. Do you want one too? Hmm? Haha.

source: Camellya ผู้ครองผกาแห่งแบล็กชอร์ ยินดีที่ได้พบกันอีกครั้งนะ! เมล็ดพันธุ์แห่งโชคชะตา... ที่รักของฉัน
target: Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.

source: Camellya, Porteuse de Fleur du Littoral noir. Heureuse de te revoir ! Ma précieuse...graine du destin.
target: Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.

source: Camellya, die Blütenträgerin der Schwarzen Küsten. Wie schön, dich wiederzusehen! Mein geliebter ... Samen des Schicksals.
target: Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.

source: Camellya, uma Portadora de Flor da Costa Negra. Feliz em vê-la novamente! Minha adorada... semente do destino.
target: Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.

source: Camellya, una Portadora de Flor de Costa Negra. ¡Qué alegría verte de nuevo! Mi amada... semilla del destino.
target: Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.

source:
Caminar solo puede llevar a un ritmo más rápido, pero un grupo puede recorrer distancias mayores.
Avanzando, estaré junto a mis compañeros... estaré junto a ti mientras enfrentamos juntos lo que el futuro nos depare.
target:
Walking alone may lead to a faster pace, but a group can cover greater distances.
Moving forward, I will stand by my companions… and I will stand by you as we face whatever the future holds, together.

source:
Caminhar sozinho pode levar a um ritmo mais rápido, mas um grupo pode cobrir distâncias maiores.
Avançando, estarei ao lado dos meus companheiros... e estarei juntos ao seu lado enquanto enfrentamos o que o futuro nos reserva.
target:
Walking alone may lead to a faster pace, but a group can cover greater distances.
Moving forward, I will stand by my companions… and I will stand by you as we face whatever the future holds, together.
Let us walk together once more.

source: Caminho pelos degraus estelares, do Yin ao Yang. O pulso da terra e o sopro do céu agora estão comigo.
target: I walk the star steps, from Yin to Yang. The pulse of earth and the breath of heaven are now with me.

source: Camino siguiendo los pasos estelares, del Yin al Yang. El latido de la tierra y el aliento del cielo me acompañan.
target: I walk the star steps, from Yin to Yang. The pulse of earth and the breath of heaven are now with me.

source: Canções são pensamentos ressonantes do fundo do nosso coração. Elas representam os sentimentos mais verdadeiros de uma pessoa.
target: Songs are resonating thoughts from the bottom of our hearts. They represent a person's truest feelings.

source: Capítulo II: A la deriva en el viento y la nieve
target: Chapter II: Adrift in Wind and Snow

source: Capítulo II: À Deriva sob Vento e Neve
target: Chapter II: Adrift in Wind and Snow
Chapter III: Dream of No Return
Chapter III: Dream of No Return

source: Capítulo IV: Jornada pelos Rios sob o Luar
target: Chapter IV: River, Moon, and Farewell

source: Capítulo IV: Surcando los ríos bajo la luna
target: Chapter IV: River, Moon, and Farewell

source: Ce Danseur de lion... Lingyang, je crois ? Il sait vraiment comment trouver ces paroles de bénédiction. Ça sonne bien. Presque aussi bon que mes poèmes, je dois avouer !
target: That liondancer... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!

source: Ce bracelet était un cadeau de ta part. Je me souviens qu'il est censé surveiller ma fréquence. Ainsi, en cas de problème, tu peux me trouver. Pratique, non ? Il est cassé depuis des années maintenant, cependant...
target: This bracelet was a gift from you. I remember it's meant to monitor my frequency. Then in case I'm in trouble, you can find me. Convenient, right? It's been broken for years now, though...

source: Ce chemin… je ne le foulerai plus.
target: This path... I'll walk no further.

source: Ce gars qui s'appelle Xiangli Yao... Un jour, je le surpasserai et je créerai une invention encore plus grande !
target: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!

source: Ce long voyage a dû t'épuiser. Viens t'asseoir pour te reposer. Un peu de poésie ou de musique te ferait du bien. Qu'est-ce qui te ferait plaisir aujourd'hui ? Une épopée héroïque, ou une histoire joyeuse de la vie rurale ?
target: You must be exhausted from your long journey. Well, time to sit down, take a break, and enjoy some poetry and music. What do you have in mind today? A heroic epic, or a simple jolly tale of rural life?

source: Ce médaillon était un cadeau de mon père. J'ai toujours pensé qu'il avait coulé avec le navire marchand, mais il est de nouveau dans mes mains. C'est déjà un miracle en soi... Je ne peux rien demander de plus.
target: This locket was a gift from my father. I always thought it had sunk with that merchant ship, but here it is again in my hands. This itself is already a miracle... I cannot ask for more.

source: Ce n'est pas le moment de chuter.
Ce n'était ni un hasard, ni une coïncidence. Il y a une ouverture dans l'impasse. Nous nous battrons côte à côte… comme avant.
target: This wasn't by chance, nor was it coincidental. The deadlock has cracked. We'll fight alongside each other... just like before.

source: Ce pouvoir… est-il à moi maintenant ?
Ce qu'elle craint, ce qu'elle redoute
target: What She Fears, What She Dreads

source: Ce que je n'aime pas ? Eh bien… Je ne suis pas difficile. Mais au final… je trouve que manger seul rend même le plat le plus savoureux un peu fade.
target: Food I dislike? Hm... I'm not a picky eater. But when it comes down to it... eating alone makes the heartiest meal taste bland.

source: Ce que le vent a dit
Ce qui dort entre les bambous…
Ce qui est aussi impressionnant que son talent, c'est sa bonne humeur. Je n'ai jamais vu de colère de sa part, peu importe la demande, il peut toujours la satisfaire.
target: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

source: Ce qui n'a pas été dit
Ce sang… Laisse-le couler dans ta paume. Voilà. Notre « pacte » est scellé.
target: This blood... let it drip into your palm. There. Now our "pact" is sealed.

source: Ceci ? C'est Zapstring. C'est quelque chose de basique que les marionnettistes utilisent pour s'entraîner, mais je l'ai modifiée pour le combat. Il est vieux, mais c'est la plus facile à utiliser.
target: This puppet? I call it Zapstring. It used to be a basic puppet made by some novice, but I've revamped it for battle. It hasn't let me down yet, despite its wear and tear.
This should suffice for a while.

source: Celui qui se connaît est éclairé... Hmm ?
Celui qui élimine son désir a le cœur en paix, celui qui purifie son cœur a l'esprit clair.
target: Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.

source: Certaines personnes sont de bons auditeurs, d'autres sont de bons conseillers, Yangyang est les deux. Avec elle, vous n'avez pas besoin d'être réservé, vous pouvez simplement être vous-même.
target: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.

source: Certifique-se de que ninguém veja isso.
target: Make sure no one sees it.

source: Certo, vou te entreter um pouco, já que hoje eu tô me sentindo bem!
target: Alright, I'll humor you for a bit, since I'm feeling good today!

source: Ces ailes voleront dans le ciel, traverseront les terres sauvages, toucheront des côtes jamais foulées… et jetteront un pont qui reliera toutes les voix du monde.
target: These wings will soar across the skies and the wilds, reach shores no one has set foot on before... and build a bridge that channels all voices of the world.

source: Cet ensemble… est plutôt intéressant, je trouve.
target: This ensemble... rather interesting, I must say.

source: Cette fillette, la taoïste ? C'est un plaisir de la regarder. Elle peut sembler suivre les normes ennuyeuses de la société humaine, mais son esprit indompté brille de temps en temps.
target: That girl, the Taoist? She's a fun one to watch. She may seem to follow human society's boring norms, but her untamed spirit still shines through every now and then.

source: Cette fleur est pour vous. J'espère qu'elle vous rendra heureux !
target: This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!

source: Cette fois, c'est... la mue du cicada !
target: Phew. In the nick of time.

source: Cette fois, je vais certainement trouver quelque chose de bien !
target: Ohhh... please have something good this time!

source: Cette force est...compliquée, mais elle me rassure.
target: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.

source: Cette force est...compliquée. Mais elle me rassure.
target: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.

source: Cette force mystérieuse... Si je pouvais l'utiliser dans la recherche sur les Tacéites, je pourrais faire de grands progrès...
target: Such mystical power... If applied to Tacetite research, our progress will be remarkable.

source: Cette lance a été modelée d'après l'arme du Capitaine Beiwang, symbolisant la répression du chaos et la défense contre les menaces.
target: This spear was modeled after the weapon of Captain Beiwang, bearing the significance of quelling chaos and warding off external threats.

source: Cette petite fille avec une grande boîte qui joue avec des feux d'artifice ? Elle a une âme si intéressante. Je me demande si l'avoir dans ce château l'éclairera un peu, Détends-toi, je plaisante juste.
target: The little girl with a giant box who plays with fireworks? A fascinating child. I wonder if bringing her into this castle would liven it up a little. Oh relax, I'm only teasing.

source: Cette vision... est à la fois un miracle et une malédiction. Si je pouvais m'en débarrasser... Non, ce n'est pas possible. Si je dois l'endurer toute ma vie, alors je la transformerai en une arme à mon service.
target: This vision... is both a miracle and a curse. If I could ever get rid of it… No, there is no such possibility. If I must endure it for life, then I will turn it into a weapon for my use.
This sword shall follow your will.

source: Cette épée… ne sera pas brisée !
target: This sword... shall not be shattered!

source: Chant du rouge et du noir
Chapitre II : À la dérive dans le vent et la neige
target: Chapter II: Adrift in Wind and Snow

source: Chapitre III : Le rêve sans retour
target: Chapter III: Dream of No Return

source: Chapitre IV : Au fil des rivières, sous la lune
target: Chapter IV: River, Moon, and Farewell

source: Chaque hiver, ma queue devient une véritable génératrice d'électricité statique… C'est très agaçant quand je la peigne…
target: Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...

source: Check das mal! Du hast jetzt ’ne voll aufgeladene Rebecca! Bleib im nächsten Kampf einfach in meiner Nähe. Ich geb dir Deckung!
target: Check the specs! Got yourself a fully-loaded Rebecca now! Next fight, just cozy up by me. I got your back!

source: Chefe, sobre que assunto busca respostas hoje?
target: Boss, what matter do you seek answers for today?

Chimera : Aah, une friandise toute fraîche…

Galbrena: Back off.

source: Chixia ? Ah, c'est ma principale rivale ! Je ne la laisserai plus me surpasser... Et pourquoi tu me demandes ? Eh bien, nous nous battons pour voir qui peut aider le plus de gens !
target: Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!

source: Chixia est une bonne amie d'Encore, elle est vraiment gentille ! Si tu te perds, va la chercher, elle n'a pas peur de faire des heures supplémentaires.
target: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.

source: Chixia สหายแห่งความยุติธรรม มาแล้วจ้า! คุณหรือเปล่าที่กำลังต้องการฮีโร่น่ะ
target: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?

source: Chixia เหรอ อ๋อ หมายถึงคู่แข่งอันดับหนึ่งของฉันสินะ ฉันไม่ยอมให้เธอเด่นกว่าฉันอีกแน่... ทำไมน่ะเหรอ ก็เรากำลังแข่งกันอยู่น่ะสิ ว่าใครจะช่วยเหลือผู้คนได้มากกว่ากัน!
target: Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!

source: Chixia, Alliée de la Justice, à votre service ! Tu es celui qui a besoin d'un héros ?
target: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?

source: Chixia, Verbündete der Gerechtigkeit, zu deinen Diensten! Bist du derjenige, der einen Helden braucht?
target: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?

source: Chixia, aliada da justiça, ao seu serviço! É você que precisa de um herói?
target: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?

source: Chixia? Ah, você quer dizer minha maior rival! Não vou deixá-la me supere novamente... E por que, você pergunta? Bem, estamos competindo para ver quem ajuda mais pessoas!
