source: Ein Verein voller Verrückter. Klingt schroff? Macht es aber nicht weniger wahr. Ich bin fertig mit denen. Ich hoffe wirklich, dass ich nie wieder mit denen zu tun haben werde.
target: An organization full of crazies. Too harsh? Doesn't make it less true. I'm done with them. Really hope I won't have to deal with them ever again.

source: Ein Wunsch für die Zukunft … hm. Hätte nie gedacht, dass ich so einen mal haben würde. Also, wenn ich nur mehr Tage wie den heutigen haben könnte … Jep. Das würde mir reichen.
target: A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.

source: Ein kleines Taschengeld? Da sag ich nicht nein.
Ein lebhafter Seestern und ein weicher Seehase … Aber eigentlich kann ich sie nicht auseinanderhalten.
target: A lively Starfish and a gentle Sea Bunny... But I must admit, I can't tell them apart.
Some Loong Whiskers Crisps would be great…

source: Ein spontaner Nachmittag in der Taverne
target: An Improvised Afternoon at the Tavern

source: Ein unerschütterlicher Glaube wird mit gleichgesinnten Seelen resonieren.
target: An unwavering faith will resonate with like-minded souls.
I'll take it as my overtime fee.

source: Ein unerwartetes Geschenk? Das Schicksal kann manchmal großzügig sein.
target: A windfall? Fate can be rather generous sometimes.

source: Ein ungewöhnlicher Weg, um stärker zu werden … Danke.
target: An unusual way to gain strength... thanks.

source: Ein weiterer Tag, ein weiterer heldenhafter Ich!
Ein zufriedener Geist ist ein ewiges Fest.
target: A contented mind is a perpetual feast.

source: Eine Belohnung für das Lösen des Rätsels.
target: A reward for solving a riddle.

source: Eine Klinge wird geschärft, um zuzuschlagen.
target: A blade is honed to strike.

source: Eine Saltimbocca aus frischem Fleisch. Wennʼs ums Essen geht, bin ich ein Fan der traditionellen Küche von Septimont. Ein bisschen scharfe Soße ist okay, aber keine saure Sahne. Man muss den Bewohnern von Ragunna ja nicht alles nachmachen!
target: A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the Ragunnesi!

source: Eine dampfende Tasse Tee ist ein hervorragendes Mittel gegen Muskelkater nach einem intensiven Training. Es ist ziemlich effektiv, du solltest es mal ausprobieren.
target: A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.

source: Eine einzelne Existenz. Ein lebendiger Zweck. Ein Bezugspunkt … Heh, wenn man es so betrachtet, ist es nicht sogar beruhigend, sich einzugestehen, dass er und ich einander für unsere eigenen Zwecke benutzen?
target: A singular existence. A living purpose. A point of reference... Heh, given all this, isn't it comforting to openly acknowledge that he and I are both using each other for our own ends?

source: Eine gewährte Chance ist eine neu geschriebene Zukunft.
target: A chance given is a future rewritten.

source: Eine interessante neue Perspektive. Danke. Jetzt sollte ich in der Lage sein, die Energieleistung meines Prothesenarms weiter zu verbessern.
target: An interesting new perspective. Thank you. Now I should be able to further improve my prosthetic arm's energy output.

source: Eine neue Geschichte, ein neues Abenteuer
target: A New Story, A New Adventure

source: Eine neue Reise wartet? Voll mit neuen Klängen, Geschichten und ... fragmentierten Erinnerungen.
target: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.

source: Eine neue Seite in meinem Tagebuch!
target: A new page in my journal!

source: Eine schwache Kraft … aber dennoch eine, die Aufmerksamkeit erfordert.
target: A faint power... but still, one that commands attention.

source: Eine solche Kraft sollte es mir ermöglichen, alle Antiquitäten der Welt zu schützen... Dank dir kämpfe ich nicht mehr allein... Ähm! Nein. Das ist zu peinlich, um es laut auszusprechen!
target: Such power should allow me to protect all the antiques in the world... Thanks to you, I'm no longer fighting alone... Ack! Nope. This is too embarrassing to say out loud!

source: Einen Bericht alleine zu schreiben, nach Abschluss der Forschung, ist befriedigend. Meine verstreuten Gedanken und Inspirationen kommen in dieser Zeit zusammen, werden klar und organisiert.
target: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.

source: Eines Tages wird unsere Truppe jeden Fleck der Erde bereiten und jede Welle wird unsere gemeinsamen Abenteuer besingen … die Geschichte der Narren!
target: One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of the Fools!

source: Eingebettet zwischen den Grenzlanden ist Jinzhou ständig wechselndem Wetter ausgesetzt. Es ist eine schwierige Aufgabe, den getrockneten Fisch, den ich für Mimi mache, haltbar zu halten … Hm, ich denke, mir fällt rechtzeitig eine Lösung ein.
target: Nestled between the borders, Jinzhou is subject to ever-changing weather. Sustaining the dried fish I've been making for Mimi has been a difficult task... Hmm, I suppose a solution will come to me in due time.

source:
Eins. Zwei. Drei. Vier … Vielleicht ein bisschen aus dem Takt?
Fü-Fünf! Nein!
target:
One. Two. Three. Four… A bit off, maybe?
Fi-five! No!

source: El Yin y el Yang... separados para siempre.
El agua se encuentra con el cielo.
El aliento de la primavera canta.
El ataque es la mejor defensa.
El botín que encontramos no es parte de mi paga. Todo es tuyo.
target: The loot we find is not part of my pay. It's all yours.

source: El brillo de los ópalos brilla con más intensidad... Parece que se obtiene mayor placer elaborando las gemas que observándolas.
target: The opal shines even more brightly… It seems you find greater pleasure in the crafting process itself than in the finished gems.

source: El calentamiento ha terminado. ¡Listo para el escenario!

El camino de venganza que busco está destinado a estar lleno de oscuridad y peligro, como caminar solo a través de una noche interminable. Afortunadamente, con tu presencia, no me perderé tan fácilmente.
target: The path of vengeance that I seek is destined to be filled with darkness and peril, like trudging alone through an endless night. Fortunately, with you around, I won't lose myself so easily.

source: El camino por delante no está claro. Quédate cerca.
target: The road ahead is unclear. Stay close.

source: El campo de batalla es dinámico. No bajes la guardia.
target: The battlefield is dynamic. Do not let your guard down.

source: El canto de la alondra está a punto de sonar.
target: The skylark's song is about to sound.

source: El cazador encuentra a su presa.
El clima es perfecto para un paseo hoy... Hmm, tal vez no...
target: Perfect weather for a walk today... Hmm, maybe not...

source: El conocimiento se encuentra en la búsqueda incansable.
El crucial y potente cuarto movimiento trae consigo un estimulante himno de batalla. Transportado por los rápidos, surge a través de una tierra sin fin, arrasando todo a su paso.
target: The decisive and powerful fourth movement brings forth a rousing battle hymn. Carried by the rapids, it surges across an endless land, sweeping all before it.

source: El cultivo requiere tiempo. Practica a diario y el progreso llegará.
target: Cultivation takes time. Practice daily, and progress will follow.

source: El cálido aliento del mundo, ante mis ojos.
target: World's warm breath, in my sight.

source: El cálido pero agridulce primer movimiento se oculta entre la noche oscura, solo y abandonado. Ahora, esos inquietantes y fantasmales lamentos han comenzado a desvanecerse.
target: The warm yet bittersweet first movement is hidden in the dark night, alone and forlorn. Now, those haunting, ghostly cries have begun to fade away.

source: El del Grupo Danza del León... ¿Lingyang, creo? Sabe cómo inventar esos saludos de la Suerte. Suenan bastante bien. ¡Casi tan bien como mis poemas, se lo reconozco!
target: That liondancer... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!

source: El dulce sonar del mundo... quería más.
target: The world's sweet noise... I wanted more.

source: El encantador olor de todas mis presas~
target: The lovely smell of all my prey...
Karma has caught up to me...

source: El lugar donde la tierra termina es donde comienza el océano. Nuestro viaje está lejos de terminar.
target: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

source: El mar centelleante no conoce límites.
target: The sparkling sea knows no bounds.

source: El mar está en calma. Ahora iremos... ¡todo a estribor!
target: We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside!

source: El mar... ha engullido la corona de vientos. Dime, ¿eres tú quien ha invocado esta espada?
target: The crown of winds... has been engulfed by the sea. Tell me, are you the one who summoned this blade?

source: El mundo a mi alrededor... Ahora puedo escucharlo más claramente.
target: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.

source: El mundo de Santu se agita, fundiendo el alba y el polvo.
target: World of Santu stirs. Dawn and dust merge.

source: El mundo entero es un escenario y nosotros somos meros actores.
target: All the world's a stage, and we are mere players.

source: El océano es un espejo; sus infinitas olas reflejan el alma.
target: The sea is a mirror. It reflects the shape of your soul in its tides.

source: El resplandeciente y animado tercer movimiento porta el aire caprichoso de la fantasía. Incluso suspendido sobre la falsedad y la inquietud, obliga a las notas a seguir danzando hacia delante.
target: The bright and lively third movement carries the whimsical air of fantasy. Even suspended above falsehood and unease, it compels the notes to keep dancing forward.

source: El sendero que camino se extiende hacia el futuro. Los deseos puestos sobre mí... quizás algún día, finalmente pueda hacerlos realidad.
target: The path I walk stretches into the future. The wishes laid upon me… perhaps one day, I can finally make them...

source: El sombrío y doloroso segundo movimiento oculta desasosiego y terror. ¿No sientes miedo? Alzará su daga con fuerza, desgarrando el velo entre la vida y la muerte.
target: The shadowed, sorrowful second movement conceals unease and terror. Are you not afraid? It will raise its dagger with force, tearing through the veil between life and death.

source: El sonido del agua... lo escucho. No de los arroyos o de la lluvia que cae, sino de un lugar mucho más profundo. Una resonancia que se filtra desde el núcleo de cada ser viviente, despertando lagos y ríos, uno por uno.
target: The sound of water... I hear it. Not from the streams, or the falling rain, but from somewhere far deeper. A resonance that seeps from the core of every living thing, waking the hills, waking the waters, one by one.

source: El tiempo puede engañar, pero la sabiduría perdura. ¡Aquí llega la maestra Youhu, la gran tasadora de antigüedades!
target: Time may deceive, but wisdom takes hold. Here comes Master Youhu, the great antique appraiser!

source: El verano en que la historia comenzó
target: The Summer Where the Story Began

source: El viaje de un espíritu libre
El viento llama, las olas responden.
El ícor se está agitando. Quema un poco, pero es tolerable. Está bien. El dolor es el lenguaje de la medicina. Me recuerda por qué asumí este deber, y hacia dónde debo ir.
target: ...The Ichor's stirring. It burns a bit, but still tolerable. It's fine. Pain is the doctor's language. It reminds me why I took on this duty, and where I must go.

source: Ela escondeu isso tão bem, por tanto tempo. Isso só me faz sentir mais culpado e meu coração doer ainda mais por ela.
target: She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more.

source: Ela monta guarda, fora de todas as leis, todos os padrões... Mas o desapego total do mundo nem sempre é algo bom. Isso não é minha adivinhação, não consigo lê-la. Mas eu vejo, claro como cristal.
target: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

source: Ela sempre me viu como tchum, como parte da equipe. Mas, em todo nosso tempo juntas, eu nunca me abri com ela. Só depois que ela se foi que eu percebi... o quanto deixei por dizer.
target: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

source: Ela é da Ordem das Profundezas. Não a conheço muito bem, mas... ela foi a primeira acólita a tocar a caixa sem ser mordida pela Pero.
target: She's from the Order of the Deep. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first Acolyte to touch the box without getting bitten by Pero.

source: Eles costumavam me chamar de Sol Alegre na minha aldeia. Mas eu prefiro Lumi! O sol se põe à noite, mas estou sempre pronta para iluminar o caminho de alguém para casa!
target: They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!

source: Elevándose sobre las aguas, vi un resplandor dorado... tu sabiduría y tu gracia son mi evangelio, y siempre los conservaré con amor.
target: Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear.

source: Ella hace guardia al margen de la ley y de toda norma... pero el desapego total al mundo no siempre es algo bueno. No es que tenga un mal futuro, de hecho, no puedo adivinárselo... pero lo veo, intenso y claro.
target: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

source: Elle a vraiment bien caché son jeu tout ce temps. Je me sens coupable, et du coup ça me fait d'autant plus de peine pour elle.
target: She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more.

source: Elle fait partie de l'Ordre des Profondeurs. Je ne la connais pas très bien, mais... elle a été la première acolyte à toucher la boîte sans se faire mordre par Pero.
target: She's from the Order of the Deep. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first Acolyte to touch the box without getting bitten by Pero.

source: Elle monte la garde, au-delà de toutes lois, de tous schémas… Mais être totalement coupé du monde n'est pas toujours bon. Ce ne sont pas mes divinations qui me le disent. Je ne peux pas lire en elle, mais je le vois, très clairement.
target: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

source: Em apenas alguns dias, uma camada de poeira se acumulou na minha mesa. Limpar não é um desafio, mas a consistência é.
target: In just a few days, a thin layer of dust has collected on my desk. Cleaning is not a challenge, but consistency is.

source: Em meio a perturbações, vamos encontrar nosso caminho para a direção certa.
target: Amidst disruptions, let's find our way to the right path.

source: Em meio às correntezas, eu vi um brilho dourado... Sua sabedoria e graça se tornaram um evangelho que eu guardarei para sempre no coração.
target: Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear.
In the name of the Montellis.
In the Name of the Montellis

source: Em todos esses anos, eu nunca provei a derrota. Ser cego não me enfraqueceu. Na verdade, isso aguça meu foco na esgrima. Se surgir a oportunidade, seria uma honra duelar com você.
target: For all these years, I've never tasted defeat. Being blind hasn't dulled me. In fact, it sharpens my focus on swordplay. If the opportunity arises, I'd welcome a duel with you.

source: Embora eu não tenha conversado muito com ele, posso dizer que aquele tal de Mortefi é um homem de cultura. Tomara que um dia ele vire meu cliente!
target: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!

source: Empiezo a entender qué hay detrás de estas mejoras. Tu mundo tiene sus ventajas.
target: Startin' to understand what's behind these upgrades. Your world sure has its perks.

source: En avant ! Que mes vers éclairent ton chemin !
target: Off we go! May my poems light the way on your path ahead!

Up we go, Pero.
PERO: Haah!

source: En cas de danger, réfugiez derrière moi.
target: When danger arises, take cover behind me.

source: En el flujo turbulento de las Corrientes, escucho el susurro constante del nombre... «Devota de la Voz». ¿Se refiere a mí, o...?
target: In the surging currents of the Streams, I hear the constant whispering of the name—"Votary of the Voice." Does it refer to me? Or...?

source: En el nombre de los Montelli.
target: In the name of the Montellis.

source: En este mundo, solo existen las cosas que aún no se conocen, no las que no se pueden conocer. Parece que estoy un paso más cerca de la verdad que busco.
target: In this world, there are only those things which are not yet known, not those which cannot be known. I seem to be one step closer to the truth I seek.

source: En fait, je rencontre rarement Mademoiselle Zhezhi en personne... Elle est noctambule, à peine dehors pendant la journée. Donc, je dépose ses peintures et son papier à sa porte.
target: Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door.

source: En grandissant, même ma respiration semble plus légère...
target: As I grow, even my breaths feel lighter...

source: En invierno, se me acumula mucha electricidad estática en la cola. Tener que cepillarla así es muy molesto.
target: Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...

source: En la lejana y deslumbrante luz
En lo alto de la colina
En medio de disrupciones, encontremos nuestro camino hacia la senda correcta.
target: Amidst disruptions, let's find our way to the right path.
In the Name of the Montellis

source: En quelques jours seulement, une couche de poussière s'est accumulée sur mon bureau. Le nettoyage n'est pas un défi, mais la régularité l'est.
target: In just a few days, a thin layer of dust has collected on my desk. Cleaning is not a challenge, but consistency is.

source: En realidad, rara vez tengo la oportunidad de ver a la señorita Zhezhi en persona... Es una noctámbula y casi nunca sale durante el día. Así que he estado dejando sus pinturas y papel en la puerta de su casa.
target: Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door.

source: En solo unos pocos días, una fina capa de polvo se ha acumulado en mi escritorio. Limpiar no es un desafío, pero la constancia sí.
target: In just a few days, a thin layer of dust has collected on my desk. Cleaning is not a challenge, but consistency is.

source: En tant que chercheur de vérité, nous jaugeons l'univers depuis une coque de noix. J'aimerais savoir ce que tu penses.
target: As truthseekers, we gauge the universe from within a nutshell. I'd love to hear your insights.

source: En tant que voyageur solitaire, tu as dû être exploité à plusieurs reprises, sans pouvoir riposter sur le moment. Si tu te retrouves à nouveau dans une telle situation... n'hésite pas à m'emmener avec toi.
target: As a lone traveler, there must've been times when you were taken advantage of, but couldn't retaliate on the spot. If you ever find yourself in such a situation again... do not hesitate to bring me along.

source: En un abrir y cerrar de ojos.
target: In the blink of an eye.
In the blink of an eye.

source: Encham eles de chumbo pelos dois lados!
Encontrou alguma coisa? Fique com ela como quiser.
target: Found something you like? Keep them as you will.

source: Encontrou o que estava procurando? Ótimo.
target: Found what you're looking for? Good.

source: Encore ... Ah, dieses Mädchen, das so sehr Geschichten liebt! Ich hoffe, sie kann zu einer starken Gegnerin heranwachsen. Dann werden wir sicherlich viel Spaß miteinander haben.
target: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.

source: Encore ... อ้อ เด็กสาวคนที่ชอบเรื่องราว! ฉันหวังว่าเธอจะเติบโตเป็นคู่ต่อสู้ที่แข็งแกร่งในสักวันหนึ่ง เราจะได้สนุกไปด้วยกันได้อย่างเต็มที่
target: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.

source: Encore ... โกรธแล้วนะ!
Encore gastou muito, muito tempo nisso! Quer dar uma mordida? Hehe!
target: Encore spent a long, long time on this! Wanna have a bite? Hehe!

source: Encore hat lange, lange Zeit daran gearbeitet! Willst du ein Stück probieren? Hihi!
target: Encore spent a long, long time on this! Wanna have a bite? Hehe!

source: Encore ใช้เวลาทำนี่ตั้งนานเลยนะ อยากลองชิมสักคำไหม อิอิ!
target: Encore spent a long, long time on this! Wanna have a bite? Hehe!

source: Encore... Ah, cette fille qui aime les histoires ! J'espère qu'elle deviendra un jour une adversaire forte. Ensemble, nous nous amuserons !
target: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.

source: Encore… Ah, aquela garota que ama histórias! Espero que ela amadureça e se torne uma oponente forte um dia, então nos divertiremos muito juntas.
target: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.

source: Encore… Ah, ¡esa chica que ama las historias! Espero que se convierta en una oponente fuerte en el futuro con la que pueda divertirme.
target: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.
Is this as far as I go…?
At Last, the Cycle Begins Again

source: Endlich habe ich diesen Zug vollständig gemeistert. Heute ist alles so gut gelaufen. Danke, dass du mit mir gekämpft hast!
target: Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!

source: Endlich was, das meine Zeit wert ist.
Energéticos contam? Um mergulho profundo na Rede te esgota rápido, no corpo e na mente. Um energético é um reabastecimento rápido e eficiente. Criei o hábito de abrir um depois de cada banho de gelo.
target: Do energy drinks count? A deep dive into the Net saps you fast, in body and mind. Glug down one of those, it's a fast and efficient refuel. Got in the habit of crackin' one open after every ice bath.
At Last, the Cycle Begins Again
At Last, the Cycle Begins Again

source: Enfréntate a mí... A todo mi ser.
Englouti par le venin de la mer.
Ensuite, je frapperai encore plus vite.
Entendida. Estou aqui para servir à sua vontade.
target: Understood. I am here to serve your will.

source: Entendida. Estoy aquí para hacer lo que necesites.
target: Understood. I am here to serve your will.

source: Entonces, vamos a demostrar lo que valemos.
target: Let's prove our value to each other.

source: Entraîner ou reposer, vous pouvez me chercher si vous avez besoin de quelque chose.
target: Whether you need help with working out or maintaining your health, feel free to come by my gym. We welcome all visitors.

source: Entre el cielo y la tierra resuenan claramente los auténticos sonidos. ¡A partir de ahora, mis hechizos pegarán aún más fuerte!
target: Between heaven and earth, true sounds ring clear. From now on, my spells will hit even harder!

source: Entre les cieux et la terre, le véritable son vibre avec clarté. À partir de maintenant, mes sorts frapperont encore plus forts !
target: Between heaven and earth, true sounds ring clear. From now on, my spells will hit even harder!

source: Entre o céu e a terra, os sons verdadeiros ecoam claros. De agora em diante, meus feitiços vão acertar ainda mais forte!
target: Between heaven and earth, true sounds ring clear. From now on, my spells will hit even harder!

source: Entspann dich, ich kann mich an die Regeln halten.
target: Relax, I can play by the rules.

source: Entspann dich, ich kümmere mich darum.
Então desta vez é minha vez de ser a aluna?
target: So it's my turn to be the student this time?

source: Então vamos nos unir? Tudo bem, embora eu esteja mais acostumado a lutar sozinha.
target: So we're teaming up? Fine, though I'm more used to fighting alone.

source: Então você optou por uma estratégia prudente desta vez. Na próxima vez, talvez possamos considerar algo mais incomum.
target: So you have opted for a prudent strategy this time. Next time, maybe we can consider something more unconventional.

source: Então você só precisa de mais poder? Entendo... Mas pegar emprestado o meu poder? Isso é arriscado demais.
target: So you just need more power? I see... But to borrow my power? That's far too risky.

source: Então é isso que querem dizer com "Além da montanha há um mundo mais amplo”... Valeu, Rover! Eu não poderia ter chegado tão longe sem você. Agora estou pronto para desafiar Postes Altos com maior altura.
target: So this is what they mean by "Beyond the mountain lies a broader world"... Thank you, Rover! I couldn't have made it this far without you. Now I'm ready to challenge higher Plum Blossom Poles.

source: Então, você está dizendo que eu já sou uma navegante de primeira? Sério?... Não, não, nada de se acomodar demais, Lumi! Ainda há um longo caminho a percorrer, tenho que continuar assim!
target: So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up!

Fly high!
Truth, reach the cosmos.

source: Envuelto, por el veneno del mar.
Equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal
Eres un luchador experimentado, puedo verlo. ¿Tendremos un combate pronto, verdad? El combate es mi pasión, y no puedo dejar pasar la oportunidad de luchar contra alguien como tú.
target: You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!

source: Erlebe die wahre Form der Kunst!
Errante. Me uní a tu lado por órdenes de mi señora, y continuaré contigo en los días por venir... No tiene nada que ver con mis deberes ahora. Hago este voto por mi propia voluntad, solo por ti.
target: Rover. I joined your side because of my lady's orders, and I will continue to stay with you for the days to come... It has nothing to do with my duties now. I make this vow of my own volition, just for you.

source: Erre dans les flammes, et contemple la neige.
target: Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.

source: Erstelle Realitätsmodell für akkumulierte Theorien. Keine Sorge, darin bin ich ziemlich geübt.
target: Constructing reality mapping for accumulated theories. Rest assured, I'm quite proficient at this.

source: Erwachsene wie er müssen die ganze Zeit ein langes Gesicht machen, weißt du. Siehst du? Erwachsen zu sein ist wirklich hart!
target: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!

source: Es agradable tomar un descanso de vez en cuando.
target: It's nice to take a break once in a while.

source: Es como hackear en modo fácil.
Es el momento de marcar el próximo punto de partida...
target: Now, time to mark the next starting point...

source: Es gefällt mir äußerst gut, mir dir zu arbeiten – Wirklich, das sage ich nicht aus Höflichkeit. Egal, ob wir zusammen arbeiten oder uns so treffen, ich genieße wirklich jeden Moment mit dir.
target: I've come to find a genuine pleasure working with you—truly, I do not say this out of formality. Whether it's business or not, I truly cherish every moment we share.

source: Es geht los! Du wirst meine Nebel als Begleitung haben.
target: It's go time! You'll have my mist for escort.
There is... much to be done...

source: Es gibt nie genug Zeit! Pakete liefern, neue Routen planen, Freunde treffen, mein Tagebuch führen ... Oh, ich wünschte, ich könnte an Millionen Orten gleichzeitig sein!
target: There's never enough time! Delivering packages, planning new routes, catching up with friends, keeping my journal... Oh I wish I could be in a million places at once！

source: Es heißt, eine Meisterin müsse ihre Schüler nicht in den Schatten stellen. Und doch habe ich von dir weit mehr gelernt, als ich dir je beigebracht habe. Sag mir, mein Schüler … wie kann ich mich bei dir revanchieren?
target: They say a master need not outshine their student. Even so, I've learned far more from you than I ever taught. Tell me, my disciple... how shall I make it up to you?

source: Es hora de acabar con esto.
Es hora de echarnos unas risas.
Es hora de sacar lo mejor de mí.
target: Time to bring out my A-game.

source: Es hora de terminar esta historia, el relato de todas nuestras aventuras. Y ahí se lee el título del capítulo final: «Continuará».
target: Time to end this story, the tale of all our adventures together. And there it is, the title of the final chapter: "To be Continued."

source: Es hora de tomar un descanso…

Es hora de trabajar un poco con el público.
PERRI: ¡Perri! ¡Roarrr!
target:
Time for some crowd work.
PERO: Pero! Rawrrr!

source: Es hora de un breve descanso...
Es hora de una retirada táctica.

Es importante tomarse el tiempo para saborear las comidas preparadas con devoción y cuidado, pero nunca esos alimentos instantáneos de fabricación descuidada; consumirlos es solo un desprecio para mis músculos de la masticación.
target: It's important to take time savoring meals prepared with devotion and care, but never those shoddily manufactured instant foods; consuming them is only a disservice to my chewing muscles.

source: Es interesante. Tus comentarios me recuerdan a los textos que encontré en las Ruinas de la Corte Jiting. Su ideología es fascinante y enigmática, casi como si viniera de las estrellas en el espacio exterior.
target: It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.

source: Es ist ein Geschenk der Natur! Lass uns es gut aufbewahren.
target: It's nature's gift! Let's keep it well.

source: Es ist noch Zeit … bevor die Fäden reißen.
target: There's still time… before the threads snap.

source: Es ist schade, dass du dich nicht an deine Vergangenheit erinnern kannst, es muss viele unvergessliche Erinnerungen gegeben haben. Aber keine Sorge, wir können neue schaffen. Du und ich, zusammen!
target: It sucks that you can't remember your past, there must've been a lot of unforgettable memories. But no worries, we can create new ones. You and I, together!

source: Es ist schön, ab und zu eine Pause zu machen.
target: It's nice to take a break once in a while.

source: Es ist wichtig, sich Zeit zu nehmen, um Mahlzeiten zu genießen, die mit Hingabe und Sorgfalt zubereitet wurden, aber niemals diese schlampig hergestellten Fertiggerichte; sie zu konsumieren ist nur ein Missdienst für meine Kaumuskulatur.
target: It's important to take time savoring meals prepared with devotion and care, but never those shoddily manufactured instant foods; consuming them is only a disservice to my chewing muscles.

source: Es kann schon überwältigend sein, wenn so viele Menschen auf dich zählen. Ich kenne das Gefühl nur zu gut... Keine Sorge. Du kannst dich ein bisschen mehr entspannen, wenn du bei mir bist.
target: It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me.

source: Es liegt wahrscheinlich an meiner mangelnden Mimik. Viele Leute finden mich „unnahbar“. Es ist aber nicht so, dass ich jemanden nicht mag. Ich weiß einfach nicht … wie ich auf andere Menschen auf natürliche Weise zugehen soll.
target: It's probably my lack of facial expressions. A lot of people think I'm "difficult to approach." It's not that I dislike anyone. I just don't know... how to approach people in a natural way.

source: Es lo que llamo el final.

target: There has to be more. Right?

source: Es más rápido volar con espada.
Es natural sentirse aterrador de lo desconocido, sin embargo... hay momentos en que lo desconocido alberga esperanza, como cómo nunca puedo saber qué más puede ofrecer este poder.
target: It is natural to feel dreadful of the unknown, yet... there are times when the unknown harbors hope, like how I can never know what else this power has to offer.

source: Es pan comido... un agarre suave...
Es realmente mi gran suerte encontrar un digno oponente como tú en este vasto mundo...
target:
Eons of time on this vast land, all encapsulated in a humble game...
I am fortunate to have you as my opponent.

source: Es schadet nicht, besser vorbereitet zu sein.
target: Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.

source: Es scheint so, als ob die Dinge, die man sich wünscht, immer einen Weg finden, einen zu erreichen.
target: What we want has a way of appearing when least expected.

source: Es tu cumpleaños hoy. Deberías tomar un merecido descanso. ¿Vamos a tomar una siesta juntos, te parece? Tengo el equipo de sueño más cómodo solo para ti. Dulces sueños y feliz cumpleaños, querido.
target: It's your birthday today. You should take a well-deserved rest. Let's nap together, shall we? I've got the comfiest sleep gear just for you. Sweet dreams, and happy birthday, dear.

source: Es tut mir leid … Ich konnte nicht …
Es un tipo de ejercicio vocal. ¿Quieres unirte a mí?
target: It's a type of vocal exercise. Want to join me?

source: Es una lástima que no puedas recordar tu pasado, debe haber habido muchos recuerdos inolvidables. Pero no te preocupes, podemos crear nuevos. ¡Tú y yo, juntos!
target: It sucks that you can't remember your past, there must've been a lot of unforgettable memories. But no worries, we can create new ones. You and I, together!

source: Es wird nie wieder eine andere geben …
Esa chica, creo que su nombre es Yangyang. La escucho tararear de vez en cuando. Sorprendentemente, sus melodías siempre me traen paz a la mente.
target: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.

source: Escrever um relatório sozinho, após concluir a pesquisa, é gratificante. Meus pensamentos dispersos e inspirações se juntam durante esse tempo, tornando-se claros e organizados.
target: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.

source: Escribir un informe solo, después de completar la investigación, es satisfactorio. Mis pensamientos e inspiraciones dispersos se unen durante este tiempo, volviéndose claros y organizados.
target: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.

source: Escuchas el claro sonido de mi espada, ¿no es así? Es el canto de mi convicción de cumplir tus deseos. Cualquiera de ellos.
target: You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.

source: Ese Xiangli Yao... Un día lo superaré, y crearé inventos aún mejores!
target: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!

source: Eso no ha estado nada bien.
Espelhada pela água, tingida de azul.
target: Mirrored by water, tinted in blue.

source: Espero que meus caras não estejam causando muitos problemas na base...
target: Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...

source: Espero que mi paciencia de frutos esta vez.
target: Hopefully my patience will pay off this time.

source: Espero que minha paciência valha a pena desta vez.
target: Hopefully my patience will pay off this time.

source: Espero que mis chicos no estén causando demasiados problemas en la base...
target: Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...

source: Espero ser forte o suficiente para caminhar ao seu lado agora. É bom ter alguém para seguir e em quem confiar, mas eu quero mais que isso. Assim como você me protegeu uma vez... agora é minha vez de proteger você.
target: I hope I'm strong enough to walk beside you now. It's good to have someone to follow and rely on, but I want more than that. Just like you once protected me… it's my turn to protect you.

source: Espero ser lo suficientemente fuerte para caminar a tu lado ahora. Es bueno tener a alguien a quien seguir y en quien confiar, pero quiero más que eso. Una vez me protegiste. Ahora, es mi turno de protegerte.
target: I hope I'm strong enough to walk beside you now. It's good to have someone to follow and rely on, but I want more than that. Just like you once protected me… it's my turn to protect you.

source: Espero... que um dia, eu possa passar todo o meu tempo pintando o que realmente quero, deixando um pedaço do meu verdadeiro eu neste mundo.
target: I hope… that one day, I can spend all my time painting what I truly want, leaving a piece of the real me in this world.

source: Espero... que un día, pueda dedicar todo mi tiempo a pintar lo que realmente quiero, dejando una parte de mi verdadero yo en este mundo.
target: I hope… that one day, I can spend all my time painting what I truly want, leaving a piece of the real me in this world.

source: Essa sensação não me é estranha...
target: I'm no stranger to this sensation...

source: Essaie de ne pas cligner des yeux.
Essas asas vão voar pelos céus e pelas terras selvagens, alcançar costas onde ninguém pisou antes... e construir uma ponte que canaliza todas as vozes do mundo.
target: These wings will soar across the skies and the wilds, reach shores no one has set foot on before... and build a bridge that channels all voices of the world.

source: Essen, das ich nicht mag? Hm … Ich bin beim Essen eigentlich nicht wählerisch. Aber letzten Endes … schmeckt selbst das herzhafteste Essen fade, wenn man es alleine isst.
target: Food I dislike? Hm... I'm not a picky eater. But when it comes down to it... eating alone makes the heartiest meal taste bland.

source: Essen, das ich nicht mag? Hmm … Nö, da fällt mir nix ein!
target: Food I won't eat...? Hmm... Nope, never heard of it!

source: Est-ce moi, ou l'ampoule sur ma queue est-elle plus lumineuse qu'avant ?
target: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?

source: Est-ce que cela suffirait à vos besoins ? Dites-moi s'il vous faut autre chose.
target: Would these be enough for your needs? Tell me if there is anything else you want.

source: Est-ce que de petites fleurs poussent à l'intérieur ?
target: Are those little flowers growing inside?

source: Est-ce que je… pleure ? Je n'aurais jamais imaginé toucher les Vrais sens elles-mêmes. Elles sont magnifiques, éclatantes… Avoir tant parcouru et vu tant de choses… Merci, {PlayerName}.
target: Am I... crying? I-I never imagined I would touch the True Names themselves. They're beautiful, dazzling... To come this far and see so much... Thank you, Senior.

source: Est-ce que... c'est la fin... pour moi...
Esta Intenção de Espada nos uniu. Que esta força fique com você, em retribuição por tudo o que você me deu.
target: This Sword Intent has bound us together. Let this strength stay with you, in return for all you have given me.

source: Esta es la respuesta a nuestro esfuerzo.
target: This is the answer to our endeavor.
This sword shall follow your will.
This sword shall follow your will.
This sword... shall not be shattered!
This sword... shall not be shattered!

source: Esta flor es para ti. ¡Espero que te haga feliz!
target: This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!

source: Esta flor é para você. Espero que te faça feliz!
target: This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!

source: Esta lanza fue modelada a partir del arma del Capitán Beiwang, llevando el significado de aplacar el caos y proteger de las amenazas externas.
target: This spear was modeled after the weapon of Captain Beiwang, bearing the significance of quelling chaos and warding off external threats.

source: Esta lança foi modelada com base na arma do Capitão Beiwang, carregando o significado de acalmar o caos e afastar ameaças externas.
target: This spear was modeled after the weapon of Captain Beiwang, bearing the significance of quelling chaos and warding off external threats.

source: Esta prueba aún no ha terminado.
Esta pulseira foi presente seu. Sei que é para monitorar minha frequência. Então, caso eu esteja em apuros, você pode me encontrar. Conveniente, não é? Mas está quebrada há anos...
target: This bracelet was a gift from you. I remember it's meant to monitor my frequency. Then in case I'm in trouble, you can find me. Convenient, right? It's been broken for years now, though...

source: Esta visión... es tanto un milagro como una maldición. Si pudiera deshacerme de ella... No, no hay tal posibilidad. Si debo soportarla de por vida, entonces la convertiré en un arma para mi uso.
target: This vision... is both a miracle and a curse. If I could ever get rid of it… No, there is no such possibility. If I must endure it for life, then I will turn it into a weapon for my use.

source: Esta visão... é tanto um milagre quanto uma maldição. Se eu pudesse me livrar dela... Não, não há tal possibilidade. Se devo conviver com ela pelo resto da vida, então a transformarei em uma arma para meu uso.
target: This vision... is both a miracle and a curse. If I could ever get rid of it… No, there is no such possibility. If I must endure it for life, then I will turn it into a weapon for my use.

source: Esta é a resposta para nosso esforço.
target: This is the answer to our endeavor.

source: Estamos navegando tranquilamente agora. Para a próxima parada... Todo a bombordo!
target: We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside!

source: Estaré allí para todos... Mientras nos dirigimos hacia nuestro futuro compartido, dejando el pasado atrás.
target: I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: Estaré allí para todos... Mientras nos dirigimos hacia nuestro futuro compartido, dejando el pasado atrás.
target: Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: Estas alas volarán a través de cielos y páramos, alcanzarán costas donde nadie ha puesto pie antes... y construirán un puente que canalice todas las voces del mundo.
target: These wings will soar across the skies and the wilds, reach shores no one has set foot on before... and build a bridge that channels all voices of the world.

source: Este Propósito de la Espada nos ha unido. Que esta fuerza te acompañe, en pago por todo lo que me has dado.
target: This Sword Intent has bound us together. Let this strength stay with you, in return for all you have given me.

source: Este brazalete fue un regalo tuyo. Recuerdo que está diseñado para monitorear mi frecuencia. Así, en caso de que esté en problemas, puedes encontrarme. Conveniente, ¿verdad? Sin embargo, lleva años roto...
target: This bracelet was a gift from you. I remember it's meant to monitor my frequency. Then in case I'm in trouble, you can find me. Convenient, right? It's been broken for years now, though...
This path... I'll walk no further.

source: Este camino... no lo recorreré más.
target: This path... I'll walk no further.

source: Este conjunto... bastante interessante, devo dizer.
target: This ensemble... rather interesting, I must say.

source: Este conjunto... es bastante interesante, debo decir.
target: This ensemble... rather interesting, I must say.

source: Este guardapelo fue un regalo de mi padre. Siempre pensé que se había hundido con ese barco mercante, pero de nuevo lo tengo entre mis manos. Esto sí que es un milagro... No puedo pedir más.
target: This locket was a gift from my father. I always thought it had sunk with that merchant ship, but here it is again in my hands. This itself is already a miracle... I cannot ask for more.

source: Este marionete? Eu chamo de Ipsicorda. Ele costumava ser um marionete básico feito por algum iniciante, mas eu o reformulei para a batalha. Nunca me decepcionou, apesar do desgaste.
target: This puppet? I call it Zapstring. It used to be a basic puppet made by some novice, but I've revamped it for battle. It hasn't let me down yet, despite its wear and tear.

source: Este medalhão foi um presente do meu pai. Sempre pensei que tinha sido levado para as profundezas junto com aquele navio mercante, mas aqui está novamente em minhas mãos. Isso por si só já é um milagre... Não posso pedir mais.
target: This locket was a gift from my father. I always thought it had sunk with that merchant ship, but here it is again in my hands. This itself is already a miracle... I cannot ask for more.

source: Este poder que me acabas de dar... ¿Siempre confías en los demás tan fácilmente?
target: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?

source: Este poder que você acabou de me dar... Você sempre confia nos outros tão facilmente?
target: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?

source: Este poder é misterioso, mas tranquilizador também.
target: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.

source: Este poder... es misterioso, pero a la vez tranquilizador.
target: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.

source: Este poder... é misterioso, mas ainda assim reconfortante.
target: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.

source: Este preciso momento en mano, este preciso momento es el mejor de nuestras vidas.
target: The moment at hand... This very moment is the best of our lives.

source: Este sangue... deixe pingar na sua palma. Pronto. Agora nosso "pacto" está selado.
target: This blood... let it drip into your palm. There. Now our "pact" is sealed.

source: Este é um testemunho da minha conexão com o mundo ao meu redor e agora é minha companhia, testemunhando tudo o que experimentei nesta jornada.
target: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.

source: Este é... o floreio final. Você trouxe uma mudança inesperada para ele... Sendo assim, por que não sentar e escutar enquanto eu toco a composição completa até o fim? Você tem tempo agora?
target: This is... the final flourish. You've given it an unexpected change... Since that's the case, why not sit and listen as I play the full composition to its end? Do you have time now?

source: Esteluz sobre os mares. Queime através do Vazio!
target: Starlight over the seas. Scorch through the Void!

source: Esto debería ser suficiente por un tiempo.
target: This should suffice for a while.

source: Esto es un testimonio de mi conexión con el mundo que me rodea, y es muy mi compañero ahora, dando testimonio de todo lo que he experimentado en este viaje.
target: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
This is far from the finale…

source: Esto no ha sido una casualidad, ni coincidencia. Hay una abertura en el punto muerto. Lucharemos juntos, como antes.
target: This wasn't by chance, nor was it coincidental. The deadlock has cracked. We'll fight alongside each other... just like before.

source: Esto... lo anotaré en mi registro.
target: That... I'll mark on my ledger.

source: Estou me sentindo tão bem agora, diria até melhor do que quando acabei de tirar uma licença de sete dias. Agradeço a sua ajuda, Rover.
target: I feel so good right now, I'd say even better than when I just took a seven-day leave. Thank you for your help, Rover.

source: Estou sempre em movimento, coletando tesouros, ajudando meus amigos, fazendo fantasias e reparando adereços de palco... É uma rotina agitada, mas ver todos sorrindo faz tudo valer a pena.
target: I'm always on the go, collecting treasures, helping my friends, making costumes, and repairing stage props... It's a busy routine, but seeing everyone smiling makes it all worth it.

source: Estou... chorando? E-eu nunca imaginei que tocaria os Nomes Verdadeiros. Eles são belos, deslumbrantes... Chegar tão longe e ver tanto... Obrigada, Sênior.
target: Am I... crying? I-I never imagined I would touch the True Names themselves. They're beautiful, dazzling... To come this far and see so much... Thank you, Senior.
I'm off duty, it's your turn.

source: Estoy tan impaciente… por este juego solo entre tú y yo.
target: Hehe... I'm looking forward to our game.

source: Estrategia notable. Tu perspicacia me proporciona perspectivas únicas y refrescantes que no había considerado antes.
target: Remarkable strategy. Your insight provides me with unique and refreshing perspectives that I have not considered before.

source: Estratégia notável. Sua percepção me proporciona perspectivas únicas e refrescantes que eu não havia considerado antes.
target: Remarkable strategy. Your insight provides me with unique and refreshing perspectives that I have not considered before.

source: Está tudo bem. Eu estou bem.
Et je ne me suis même pas donné à fond.
target: And that was me holding back.
Now presenting, a poem of finale.

source: Et voici... le dernier acte. Tu lui as apporté une modification étonnante... Alors, pourquoi ne pas t'asseoir et m'écouter jouer la composition entière jusqu'au bout ? As-tu le temps ?
target: This is... the final flourish. You've given it an unexpected change... Since that's the case, why not sit and listen as I play the full composition to its end? Do you have time now?
Does anything here catch your interest?

source: Eu a conheci. Um prodígio no campo da botânica em uma idade tão tenra... Impressionante.
target: I met her once. A prodigy in the field of botany at such a young age... Impressive.

source: Eu adoro coisas fáceis de comer, tipo um mingau bem cremoso e saboroso. Você pode me ajudar com esta colherada? Está um pouco quente demais para a minha língua.
target: I'm all about the easy-to-eat stuff. Give me some creamy, savory porridge any day. Can you help me out with this spoonful? It's a little bit too hot for my tongue.

source: Eu ainda preciso de mais tempo para me familiarizar com este mundo desconhecido.
target: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.

source: Eu amo meu trabalho! Sério. Não é brincadeira. Eu estava sorrindo? Não? Então você entendeu.
target: I love my job! Really. No joke. Was I smiling? No? Then you get the idea.

source: Eu amo todos os alimentos de café da manhã. Prefiro dormir e acordar cedo em vez de ficar acordado até tarde e consumir cafeína. Comer porções consistentes no café da manhã energiza minha mente rapidamente.
target: I love all breakfast foods. I prefer to sleep and wake up early instead of staying up late and consuming caffeine. Eating consistent breakfast portions energizes my mind quickly.

source: Eu consigo sentir esse calor, como o toque suave da luz solar percorrendo o mar.
target: I can feel that warmth, just like the caress of sunlight tracing the sea.

source: Eu costumava lutar apenas com minhas chamas, mas agora tenho essas pistolas. Vou segurar firme qualquer arma que eu puder ter para que eu possa proteger todos!
target: I used to fight with nothing more than my flames, but now I have these pistols. I'll hold on tight to whatever weapon I can have, so I can protect everyone!

source: Eu costumava sonhar em ir pra Lua. Eu pensava em fugir pra lá e deixar tudo pra trás. Esse sonho se realizou... só que de uma forma que eu jamais desejei.
target: Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.

source: Eu cuidarei do seu pedido, sozinho.
Eu destruo tudo que busca destruição.
target: I destroy all that seeks destruction.

source: Eu deveria tentar sorrir mais, o que acha? Assim? Não? Talvez assim? Hmm... Talvez eu tenha exagerado. Esqueça.
Eu deveria tentar sorrir mais, o que acha? Assim? Não? Talvez assim? Hmm... Talvez eu tenha exagerado. Esqueça.
target: I should try to smile more, you say? ...Like this? No? ...Maybe like this? Hmm... I may have overdone it. Forget about it.

source: Eu devo... dar o meu melhor...
target: I should... Give it my all...

source: Eu eliminarei qualquer ameaça em seu caminho.
target: I will cut down any threat in your way.

source: Eu estou bem. Não está doendo...
Eu já me diverti o suficiente.
Eu me juntarei à sua batalha.
Eu me movo como a lâmina.
Eu me pergunto como estão crescendo...
Eu me tornei uma tocha humana! Eu sou chama! Com este poder, agora posso proteger todos, mesmo alguém tão forte quanto você!
target: I've become a Human Torch! I am flame! With this power, I can now protect everyone, including someone as strong as you!

source: Eu não estava procrastinando, sério. Eu só precisava recarregar um pouco... Ah, você não acredita em mim? Não diga isso. Vou ficar tão triste.
target: I wasn't slacking off, really. I just needed to recharge a little... Aww, you don't believe me? Don't say that. I'll be so hurt.

source: Eu não fui confiável o suficiente...
Eu não gosto de bebida alcoólica. Por quê? ...Não sei. Simplesmente me deixa... desconfortável.
target: I don't like boozy stuff. Why? ...I don't know. It just makes me... uncomfortable.

source: Eu não sou muito fã de pratos grandes e gordurosos, como bifes... Não é que eles não sejam saborosos, eu só odeio a ideia de deixar comida ir para o lixo se eu não conseguir terminar. Não me sinto bem com isso.
target: I'm not a big fan of big, greasy dishes—like steaks... It's not that they aren't tasty, I just hate the idea of letting food go to waste if I can't finish it. It doesn't sit right with me...

source: Eu não vou quebrar. Sou o osso que resiste às tempestades, a lâmpada incandescente sobre a mesa cirúrgica. Eu queimo, mas meu bisturi jamais vacila.
target: I won't break. I am the bone that endures blizzards, the white-hot lamp over a surgical table. I burn, but my scalpel never falters.
I don't... want to disappoint you...

source: Eu passei tempo demais nas profundezas do mar. Às vezes, desejo respirar um ar puro na superfície.
target: I've spent too much time in the depths of the sea. At times, I wish for a breath of fresh air above the surface.

source: Eu posso sentir em meu coração que ambos temos algo que defenderemos ferozmente, uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar... E não vamos recuar, não importa o que custe.
target: I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes.

source: Eu posso usar um pouco de fertilizante.

Eu realmente, realmente amo as músicas da Frota Neve Fofa! Mas na última vez que ela fez um encontro de fãs, eu estava em um estudo de campo nas terras geladas... E-eu espero ter outra chance de participar! Adoraria vê-la!
target: I really, really love Fleet Snowfluff's songs! But the last time she held a fan meeting, I was out on a frostlands field study... I-I hope I'll get another chance to attend! I would love to see her!

source: Eu sabia! Você não pode ficar sem Encore! Vamos lá!
target: Knew it! You can't do without Encore! Off we go!

source: Eu sei... o sonho tinha que acabar.
target: I know... the dream had to end.

source: Eu sempre desejei criar uma poção como nenhuma outra. Um nascida da minha alma, para libertar os sonhos enterrados nas profundezas e deixá-los voar, cantando pelo mundo desperto.
target: I've longed to craft a potion like no other. One born of my soul, to free the dreams buried deep below, and let them soar, singing through the waking world.

source: Eu sou Baizhi, um pesquisador na Academia Huaxu. Deixe-me testemunhar aonde este encontro nos levará.
target: I am Baizhi, a researcher at the Huaxu Academy. Let me witness where this encounter will take us.

source: Eu sou Hiyuki, a última Miko da Sakura Flamejante. Se você busca eliminar os Trenodianos, minha lâmina e eu estamos ao seu dispor.
target: I am Hiyuki, the last Miko of Flaming Sakura. Should you seek to slay the Threnodians, my blade and I stand at your service.

source: Eu sou Mornye, engenheira do Instituto de Pesquisa do Coletivo da Jornada Espacial e professora na Academia Tochestrela. Por favor, me avise quando minha experiência for útil.
target: I am Mornye, Research Institute engineer and professor at Startorch Academy. Please, let me know when my expertise can be of service.

source: Eu sou San-hua, guarda-costas da Magistrada Jinhsi. Se planeja visitar áreas perigosas, certifique-se de me levar junto. Eu garantirei sua segurança.
target: I am Sanhua, the bodyguard of Magistrate Jinhsi. If you plan to visit dangerous areas, please be sure to bring me along. I will ensure your safety.

source: Eu sou Zani. Trabalho para a família Montelli. Hã? Ah, isso não é sombra de olho. É prova do meu trabalho duro, uma medalha de honra pela minha dedicação. Ah, se eu continuar dizendo isso, talvez realmente comece a acreditar nisso.
target: I am Zani. I work for the Montelli family. Hmm? Oh, that's not eyeshadow. It's proof of my hard work, a badge of honor for my dedication. Ha, if I keep saying that, I might actually start believing it myself.

source: Eu sou Zhezhi... Eu faço pinturas por encomenda. Hum, o que mais...? Ah, Também aceito pedidos! Ofereço preços justos, posso me adaptar a qualquer estilo que você precisar, e faço revisões também. E nunca perco um prazo!
target: I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!

source: Eu sou a lua que nunca cai, aqui para reescrever o final.
target: I am the moon that never falls, here to rewrite the ending.

source: Eu sou uma formiguinha. Coisas doces sempre me dão mais energia!
target: I have a sweet tooth. Sweet things always give me more energy!

source: Eu te Ofereço a Amargura de uma Contempladora da Lua
target: I Offer You the Bitterness of a Moongazer

source: Eu tenho a chave para resolver esta questão.
target: I have the key to solving this question.

source: Eu tinha muito medo do escuro quando era pequeno, mas “Fiamma” sempre chegava a tempo para afastá-lo. Agora que estou crescido, não tenho mais medo. Posso ser minha própria tocha!
target: I was really scared of the dark when I was little, but "Fiamma" would always arrive in time to drive it away. Now that I'm all grown up, I'm not scared anymore. I can be my own torch!

source: Eu vejo chamas frias além dos limites da razão. Eu vejo a perfeição surgindo do fim despedaçado. Eu vejo o Caos. Eu vejo ilusões. Eu vejo verdades. Eu vejo... você, aquele que capturou a lua.
target: I see cold flames beyond the edge of reason. I see perfection rising from the shattered end. I see Chaos. I see illusions. I see truths. I see... you, the one who captured the moon.

source: Eu vi do que você é capaz; numa luta justa, não me preocupo com você. Dito isso, nem todos jogam limpo. Apenas fique alerta... não quero que te peguem de surpresa.
target: I've seen what you're capable of, so I'm not worried about you in a fair fight. That being said, not everyone plays fair. Just watch your back out there... wouldn't want you to get caught off your game.

source: Eu vou fazer companhia para você.
Eu vou onde o vento vai.
Eu vou retribuir dez vezes mais.
Eu vou retribuir sua confiança... em outra vida.
target: I'll repay your trust... in another life.

source: Eu vou te dar em dobro.
Eu... eu tenho medo de altura!!
Eu... já sabia que isso ia acontecer...

Ewigkeiten der Zeit auf diesem weiten Land, alle zusammengefasst in einem bescheidenen Spiel ...
Ich bin glücklich, dich als meinen Gegner zu haben.
target:
Eons of time on this vast land, all encapsulated in a humble game...
I am fortunate to have you as my opponent.

source: Exatamente como os baús de tesouro das histórias!
target: Just like the treasure chests from the stories!
Let slip the dogs of war!
Hey, little one... There you go!

source: Faire la sieste au soleil un après-midi chaud est si confortable, il suffit de trouver un endroit calme. Dormir dans la chaleur, niché parmi les branches et les feuilles...
target: Napping in the sun on a warm afternoon is so cozy, I just need to find a quiet place. Sleeping in the warmth, nestled among branches and leaves...

source: Faire équipe ? C'est possible, même si je suis habitué à me battre seul.
target: So we're teaming up? Fine, though I'm more used to fighting alone.

source: Fais ce que je te dis.
Fais en sorte que personne ne le voie.
target: Make sure no one sees it.

source: Fais un sourire… Trois, deux, un…
target: Smile for the camera... Three, two, one...

source: Faisons vite, mon expérience n'est pas encore terminée.
target: Make this quick. I have experiments underway.
I trust you can use it to the full.

source: Fala sério! Quero meter a porrada!

Falando de Baizhi, ela não é do tipo falante. Não me entenda mal, ela não é uma Miss Antipatia, não! Ela apenas tem suas próprias maneiras de expressar emoções. Você vai entender depois de passar tempo suficiente com ela.
target: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.

source: Falar não serve para nada, comprove os resultados através da ação.
target: Talk is cheap. Show me the action.

source: Farei bom uso deste poder e lutarei ao seu lado... Enfrentaremos o mal, onde quer que ele esteja.
target: I will make good use of this power and fight by your side... We'll confront evil, wherever it lies.

source: Farei o meu melhor para ajudar todos.
target: I will do my best to help everyone.

source: Faça rápido. Tenho experimentos em andamento.
target: Make this quick. I have experiments underway.

source: Feliz Aniversário! Experimente isso, eu fiz esta tigela de Maocai sozinho, com Molho Campeão extra só para você. Coma enquanto ainda está super quente! Não se preocupe com a picância, é um bom presságio!
target: Happy Birthday! Try this, I made this bow of Maocai all by myself, with extra Victor Savor added just for you. Eat up while it's still steamin'! Don't worry about the spiciness, it's a good omen!

source: Feliz aniversário, Rover! Fiz esta barba de dragão para ser tão longa quanto a do nosso grande Sentinela. Dizem que comer algo longo no seu aniversário dá prosperidade. Aproveite!
target: Happy Birthday, Rover! I made these Loong Whiskers Crisps to be as long as those of our great Sentinel. They say eating something long on your birthday makes you live long and prosper. Enjoy!

source: Feliz aniversário, nobre navegante! Tem algum plano para hoje? Que tal escaparmos juntos para uma pequena aventura? Até deixo você assumir o comando. Aqui, segure firme — juntos, navegaremos até o horizonte distante!
target: Happy birthday, my dear friend! Got any plans today? How about slipping away with me for a little adventure? I'll even let you take the helm. Here, hold on tight—together, we'll sail into the far horizon!

source: Feliz aniversário. Tem alguém ou algo te incomodando? Neste dia especial, posso oferecer meus serviços com desconto para ajudar a se livrar de seus problemas.
target: Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.

source: Feliz cumpleaños. ¿Hay alguien o algo que te moleste? En este día especial, puedo ofrecer mis servicios a un precio reducido para ayudarte a deshacerte de tus problemas.
target: Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.

source: Fico feliz que você os achou úteis.
Fin de l'échauffement, prêt à entrer en jeu à tout moment !
Finalmente, dominei completamente este movimento. Tudo correu tão bem hoje. Obrigado por treinar comigo!
target: Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!

source: Finalmente, he dominado completamente este movimiento. Todo ha ido tan bien hoy. ¡Gracias por hacer un combate de práctica conmigo!
target: Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!

source: Finalmente. Algo que vale meu tempo.

Fischnudeln in Streifen sind wirklich lecker! Gib gekochte Nudeln in die Brühe und füge dann Fischstreifen hinzu. Mmm, echt lecker! Das ist eine Spezialität aus Mengzhou. Probier unbedingt mal eine Schüssel!
target: Shredded fish noodles are a really tasty one! Put boiled noodles in the broth, then add shredded fish on top. Mmm, so good la! It's a Mengzhou specialty. You must give a bowl a try!

source:
Flieg in die Höhe!
Wahrheit, erreiche den Kosmos.
target:
Fly high!
Truth, reach the cosmos.

source: Flocos Estelares são bonitos, mas é um problema mantê-los frescos. Uma vez, eu enchi uma bolsa com eles para aproveitar enquanto estava na selva e eles rapidamente ficaram encharcados e perderam a crocância.
target: Star Flakes are pretty, but they're a pain to keep fresh. I once packed a pouchful of them to enjoy while I was out in the wild, and they quickly turned soggy and lost their crunch.

source: Flota con los copos de nieve.
Flotante y lánguido... ¿a dónde te llevará el viento?
target: Buoyant and languid... where will the wind take you?

source: Flottant et languissant... où le vent t'emportera-t-il ?
target: Buoyant and languid... where will the wind take you?

source: Flutuante e lânguido... para onde o vento te levará?
target: Buoyant and languid... where will the wind take you?

source: Flutue com os flocos de neve.
Folge meinen Schritten, wenn du kannst.
target: Follow my moves, if you can.

source: Folge unseren Regeln und verrate uns niemals. Solange ich lebe, sollte der Name "Geisterhunde" genug Respekt gebieten, um dir freie Hand auf dem Kontinent zu gewähren.
target: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.

source: Fonce plus vite que la lumière.
Forscherin Baizhis Pakete wiegen eine Tonne! Meistens Stapel von Büchern, Dickes, und eine Menge anderer seltsamer Sachen. Sie sagte, die seien für Forschungszwecke ...
target: Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes...
There's no stopping good luck once it's on your side!

source: Forças sombrias se aproximam, fique alerta.
target: Dark forces approach, be on guard.

source: Franchement, les blagues et les memes qui circulent sur le campus, ça va trop vite, j'arrive plus à suivre…
target: I swear, the new jokes and memes around campus are evolving faster than I can keep up...

source: Frappe sans cesse. Encore et encore… Chaque combat reforge ma lame. Ce n'est pas son acier qui fait sa force, mais la détermination de celle qui la manie.
target: Strike relentlessly. Again, and again... Each battle reforges my blade. Its true strength lies not in the steel, but in the will that commands it.

source: Frei wie der Nebel leben und das Leben genießen, solange es dauert. Klingt wunderbar, nicht wahr?
target: To live free as the mist and enjoy life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?

source: Freunde in Jinzhou haben mir erzählt, dass Mortefi viele lustige Geräte und Gizmos herstellt! Das ist so cool! Hmm, sollte ich ihn nächstes Mal nach einem hüpfenden Schaf fragen ...
target: Friends in Jinzhou told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time…

source: Freust du dich auf das, was drin ist? Hehe, bist du nicht süß.
target: Excited for what's inside? Hehe, aren't you adorable.

source: Freut mich, dass du sie nützlich fandest.
Frischer Fruchtsaft, roh und leicht säuerlich. Seine zarte Süße schmeichelt dem Gaumen ... Möchtest du einen Schluck?
target: Fruit juice. Fresh, raw, and tangy. That gentle sweetness lingers... You want some?

source: Fräulein Chixia hat mir einmal einen Löffel ihrer Scharfen Soße des Champions gegeben... I-Ich konnte nicht glauben, wie scharf sie war! Was für eine Art von Pfeffer war das? Au, mein Mund brennt immer noch, wenn ich nur daran denke.
target: Miss Chixia once fed me a spoonful of her Victor Savor... I-I couldn't believe how spicy it was! What kind of pepper was that? Ow, my mouth still burns just thinking about it.

source: Fräulein Chixia ist eine weitere beste Freundin von Encore! Sie kann manchmal ein bisschen streng sein, aber auf eine gute Art! Du kannst sie anrufen, wenn du in der Stadt verloren bist, sie stört die zusätzliche Arbeit nicht.
target: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.

source: Früher kämpfte ich nur mit meinen Flammen, aber jetzt habe ich diese Pistolen. Ich werde jede Waffe, die ich bekommen kann, festhalten, um alle zu schützen!
target: I used to fight with nothing more than my flames, but now I have these pistols. I'll hold on tight to whatever weapon I can have, so I can protect everyone!

source: Früher nannte man mich Jolly Sun in meinem Dorf. Aber ich bevorzuge Lumi! Die Sonne geht abends unter, aber ich bin immer bereit, jemandem den Weg nach Hause zu erleuchten!
target: They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!

source: Früher oder später wird dich das Schicksal zu mir führen, und ich unterbreite dir mein bestes Angebot einfach bereits im Voraus ... Das würdest du mir doch nicht abschlagen, oder?
target: Fate has led you to me, and considering the terms I'm offering… You wouldn't refuse me, would you?

source: Früher war es mein Traum, zum Mond zu fliegen. Ich wollte einfach fliehen und alles hinter mir lassen. Der Traum wurde wahr … aber nicht so, wie ich es mir gewünscht hatte.
target: Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.
Run. I'll erase you at the finish line.

source: Funcionários da família Montelli juram que o expresso — puro, sem açúcar ou leite — é a chave para se manterem energizados. Mas quanto a mim, meu trabalho já é difícil o suficiente... Prefiro me presentear com algo doce.
target: Employees of the Montelli family swear by espresso—straight, no sugar or milk—to keep themselves energized. But as for me, work is already hard enough... I'd rather treat myself to something sweet.

source: Fábricas de tornados, lámparas deformadimensiones... Si te interesa, tengo todo tipo de accesorios.
target: Tornado makers, dimension-warping lamps... I've got all kinds of props if you're interested.

source: Fábricas de tornados, lâmpadas interdimensionais... Tenho todos os tipos de adereços que você possa querer.
target: Tornado makers, dimension-warping lamps... I've got all kinds of props if you're interested.

source:
Fábricas de tornados.
PERO: Vummm... vummmm...
Fünf Donner haben gesprochen. Dämonen, geht zugrunde!
target: Five Thunders have spoken. Demons, perish!

source: Für all die ausgesprochenen Wünsche biete ich dieses Gefäß dar.
target: For all wishes spoken, this vessel I offer.

source: Für die Geschichten soll sie singen
target: For the Stories, She Shall Sing

source: Für sich selbst soll sie singen
Für uns Undercover-Agenten sind Kampffähigkeiten nur das absolute Minimum. Der Schlüssel zum Erfolg ist ein unerschütterlicher Wille.
target: For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.

target: Galbrena. The Fiend of Ever-burning Flame. The Discord Slayer. Call me what you want. Just point me to the monsters.

target: Galbrena. The Fiend of Ever-burning Flame. The Discord Slayer. Call me what you want. Just point me to the monsters.

target: Galbrena. The Fiend of Ever-burning Flame. The Discord Slayer. Call me what you want. Just point me to the monsters.
