target: Lucy. When I was takin' gigs as an edgerunner, my specialty was netrunning. If this is just biz, that's all you need to know.

source: Lucy. Quand je bossais comme edgerunner, mon truc, c'était le netrunning. Si c'est pour du taf, alors t'as pas besoin d'en savoir plus.
target: Lucy. When I was takin' gigs as an edgerunner, my specialty was netrunning. If this is just biz, that's all you need to know.

source: Lucy. Quando eu fazia trabalhos como mercenária, minha especialidade era trilhar redes. Se é só pelo trampo, o resto é irrelevante.
target: Lucy. When I was takin' gigs as an edgerunner, my specialty was netrunning. If this is just biz, that's all you need to know.

source: Lupa กลาดิเอเตอร์จากเซปติมอนต์ อย่าไปสนใครอื่น คู่หู ชัยชนะอันหอมหวานนี้เป็นของเรา!
target: Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!

source: Lupa, Gladiatorin aus Septimont. Lass die anderen links liegen, Krieger. Dieser Sieg gehört uns!
target: Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!

source: Lupa, gladiadora de Septimont. Ignore a atenção, guerreiro. Esta vitória é nossa para saborear!
target: Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!

source: Lupa, gladiadora de Septimont. Tú ignora la atención, guerrero. ¡Esta victoria es nuestra y la saborearemos!
target: Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!

source: Lupa, gladiatrice de Septimont. Ignore toute cette attention, camarade guerrier. Cette victoire est à nous, profitons-en !
target: Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!

source: Lutar ao seu lado? Tá, isso é novidade.
target: Fighting alongside you? Okay, that's new.

source: Lutar... nunca foi meu ponto forte. Mas, eu entendo o que você está me pedindo. Não vou desistir facilmente, não importa contra quem ou o que eu esteja lutando!
target: Fighting… has never been my strong suit. But, I understand what you're asking of me. I won't give up easily, no matter who or what I'm up against!

source: Luuk Herssen จากหน่วยพยาบาลเรโซเนเตอร์ ฉันยอมมาที่นี่ตามคำขอของคุณเป็นกรณีพิเศษเลยนะ เรียกฉันว่า Luuk ก็พอ
target: Dr. Luuk Herssen, from the Resonator Nursing Unit. A rare exception that we meet outside my office. Oh, you can just call me Luuk.

source: Luz Fria, conduza e purifique todo o reino.
Luz estelar sobre los mares. ¡Abrasa el vacío!
target: Starlight over the seas. Scorch through the Void!

source: Lynae est comme le vent, toujours à droite, à gauche. Partout où elle passe, elle laisse derrière elle ces couleurs éclatantes. Ce sont ses énigmes, et le sourire qu'elle affiche est la solution.
target: Lynae always comes and goes like the wind. Wherever she passes, she leaves behind these dazzling colors. Those colors are her riddles, and the smile on her face? That's always the answer.

source: Lynae kommt und geht wie der Wind. Wo immer sie hinkommt, lässt sie diese schillernden Farben zurück. Diese Farben sind ihre Rätsel, und das Lächeln auf ihrem Gesicht? Das ist immer die Antwort.
target: Lynae always comes and goes like the wind. Wherever she passes, she leaves behind these dazzling colors. Those colors are her riddles, and the smile on her face? That's always the answer.

source: Lynae va y viene como el viento. Por dondequiera que pase, deja colores deslumbrantes. Esos colores son sus acertijos, y la sonrisa en su rostro... es la respuesta.
target: Lynae always comes and goes like the wind. Wherever she passes, she leaves behind these dazzling colors. Those colors are her riddles, and the smile on her face? That's always the answer.

source: Là où coule la rivière claire, la source attend.
target: Where clear streams flow, there spring awaits.

source: Lächle mal in die Kamera … Drei, zwei, eins …
target: Smile for the camera... Three, two, one...

source: Ma chance semble meilleure avec vous.
target: My luck seems better with you around.

source: Ma colère... n'est pas encore éteinte...
Ma lame fend la nuit. Périls, goûtez à la lumière purgatrice !
target: Blade cleaves the night. Perils, purged in light!

source: Ma lame sépare la vie de la mort.ALT : Lame dégainée, vie et mort sont liées !
target: My blade cleaves life from death.

source: Ma lampe ne guide aucune âme qui vive.ALT : Lampe levée, qu'aucune âme ne suive !
target: My lamp guides no living souls.

source: Macarrão com peixe desfiado é muito gostoso! Coloca o macarrão cozido no caldo, depois adiciona o peixe desfiado por cima. Mmm, delicioso! É uma especialidade de Mengzhou. Você tem que experimentar uma tigela!
target: Shredded fish noodles are a really tasty one! Put boiled noodles in the broth, then add shredded fish on top. Mmm, so good la! It's a Mengzhou specialty. You must give a bowl a try!

source: Macarrão de arroz é o meu favorito absoluto! Coloque um pouco de pimenta, um toque de vinagre e polvilhe cebolinha... delicioso! Da próxima vez que você estiver em Yuezhou, eu te convido!
target: Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you!

source: Mach dir keine Sorgen um mich.
Mach dir keine Sorgen. Ich habe das im Griff!
Machen Sie das schnell. Ich habe laufende Experimente.
target: Make this quick. I have experiments underway.

source:
Machine à tornades.
PERO : Fiouuu... Fiouuu...
Mademoiselle Chixia m'a fait goûter une cuillère de sa sauce Piment Champion... C'était tellement épicé ! Quel type de piment était-ce ? Hélas, ma bouche brûle encore rien qu'à y penser.
target: Miss Chixia once fed me a spoonful of her Victor Savor... I-I couldn't believe how spicy it was! What kind of pepper was that? Ow, my mouth still burns just thinking about it.

source: Maintenant, j'ai l'énergie pour travailler sur mes commandes.
target: Now I've got the energy to work on my commissions.

source: Maintenant, je peux passer d'un type de brouillard à un autre à ma guise. Merci beaucoup, mon pote ! Si tu as besoin de quelque chose, n'hésitez pas à demander. Je ferai de mon mieux pour satisfaire !
target: Now I can switch between any kind of mist as I please. Much appreciated, bud! If you need anything, just ask away. I'll do my best to oblige!

source: Maintenant, je suis confiant de ne pas vous laisser subir le moindre préjudice.
target: Now, I am confident to not let you get harmed in the slightest.

source: Mais força... Agora estamos à prova de tempestades e somos imparáveis! Vamos lá, velocidade máxima!
target: More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead!

source: Mais papelada? Vamos ver... *sorriso satisfeito* Tudo pronto. Agora, o que devo jantar?
target: More paperwork? Let's see... *satisfied smile* All set. Now, what should I have for dinner?

source: Mais um sonho longo e sombrio.
Mais... Eu quero mais... Mais uma rodada, guerreiro! Quero uma revanche!
target: More... Get me more... One more round, Warrior! I want a rematch!

source: Mal sehen, ob sich die Anstrengung lohnt.
target: Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.

source: Mama... wirst du in meinen Träumen sein?
target: Mommy... will you be there in my dreams?

source: Maman... seras-tu là dans mes rêves ?
target: Mommy... will you be there in my dreams?

source: Mamant disait toujours que le lait m'aiderait à grandir, comme les plantes ont besoin d'engrais. Et chaque fois que je le bois, je me sens chaleureux et confortable. Peut-être que c'est ce que le bonheur ressent.
target: My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.
Mommy... will you be there in my dreams?

source: Mamãe... você estará nos meus sonhos?
target: Mommy... will you be there in my dreams?

source: Man ist nie zu alt zum Lernen!
Man kann nie etwas falsch machen, wenn man verlorene Kinder zu Chixia bringt. Während mich manche Kinder vielleicht gruselig finden, würden sie sich nie vor ihr fürchten.
target: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.

source: Man könnte sagen, dass Chixia eine jüngere Kollegin von mir ist. Sie ist eine natürliche Wahl für die Position des Patrouilleurs. Mit Zeit und Erfahrung wird sie in ihrer Rolle sicherlich glänzen.
target: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

source: Manche Menschen sind gut im Zuhören, während andere gut im Beraten sind. Yangyang ist gut in beidem. Bei ihr kannst du einfach du selbst sein.
target: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.

source: Manche sagen, der Geschichtenerzähler wird am Ende selbst Teil der Geschichte.
target: Some say, the storyteller will end up being part of the story as well.

source: Manchmal ist es wohl in Ordnung, zu fliegen.
target: It's okay to fly sometimes, I guess.

source: Manchmal stelle ich mir vor, ich wäre eine Wolke am Himmel... Einfach vorbeiziehen als ein weicher und flauschiger Haufen, ohne jegliche Sorge.
target: Sometimes I pretend I was a cloud in the sky... Just drifting by as a soft and fluffy pile, without any worry.

source: Manchmal verliere ich mich ein wenig in den Kämpfen... Ich habe dich nicht erschreckt, oder?
target: Sometimes I get a little carried away in battles... I didn't startle you, did I?

source: Manualidades, confección, matemáticas... Sí, diría que soy bastante buena en esas cosas.
target: Handcrafting, tailoring, plus... mathematics. Yes, I'd say I'm quite good at these.

source: Maravillas y tragedias van de la mano.
Marche em direção à vitória destinada.

Marcher seul peut mener à un rythme plus rapide, mais un groupe peut couvrir de plus grandes distances.
À l'avenir, je resterai aux côtés de mes compagnons... Je resterai à tes côtés pour affronter ensemble ce que l'avenir nous réserve.
target:
Walking alone may lead to a faster pace, but a group can cover greater distances.
Moving forward, I will stand by my companions… and I will stand by you as we face whatever the future holds, together.

source: Marchitarse... es natural en la vida...

target: Let us walk together once more.

source: Marschiert der erste Wandernde Ritter gen Freiheit
target: The Wandering Knight Marches To Freedom

source: Maçãs imersas em veneno por tempo demais. Tornam-se enjoativamente doces. Nem mesmo a casca açucarada e reluzente consegue mascarar o cheiro de podridão por baixo.
target: Apples soaked in poison for too long. They become sickeningly sweet. Even the glossy sugar shell cannot mask the scent of decay beneath.

source: Me alegra que los hayas encontrado útiles.
Me cuesta entender a la gente de aquí. ¿Una conversación amistosa y ya sois colegas? ¿Una pelea y ya confías en que te cubran las espaldas? En Night City no duraríais ni un día.
target: Don't really understand the peeps here. One friendly convo makes someone a choom? One fight, and you trust 'em to watch your back? Can't imagine any of you survivin' a day in Night City.

source: Me diga, o que você acha que vai no famoso elixir da família Fisalia? Uma erva rara, cultivada em segredo? Almas atormentadas fervendo em caldeirões invisíveis? Hehe... Ou talvez a carne delicada de jovens donzelas?
target: Tell me, what do you suppose goes into the Fisalia family's famed elixir? A rare herb, grown in secret? Tormented souls simmering in unseen cauldrons? Hehe... Or perhaps the delicate flesh of young girls?

source: Me diz que não vai envolver muito suor.
target: Tell me there's no sweating involved.

source: Me donner de la force... ? Toujours faire confiance aux gens si facilement ?
target: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?

source: Me encanta comer Pasta Nuvola, pero lo que más me gusta aún es compartirla. ¿Tal vez... sea la troupe, lo que hace que sepan mejor?
target: Spaghetti Bolognese is great on its own, but it's even better when shared. Maybe... it's the company that makes it taste better?

source: Me encanta ir a los baños de Septimont tras una sesión de entrenamiento. El agua caliente ayuda mucho a reducir el cansancio. Deberías probarlo.
target: I love going to the Septimont baths after a training session. The warm water does wonders for easing weariness. You should give it a try.

source: Me encantan las cosas fáciles de comer. Dame un poco de porridge cremoso y sabroso cualquier día. ¿Puedes ayudarme con esta cucharada? Está un poco demasiado caliente para mi lengua.
target: I'm all about the easy-to-eat stuff. Give me some creamy, savory porridge any day. Can you help me out with this spoonful? It's a little bit too hot for my tongue.

source: Me encantan todos los alimentos del desayuno. Prefiero dormir y despertarme temprano en lugar de trasnochar y consumir cafeína. Comer porciones consistentes de desayuno energiza mi mente rápidamente.
target: I love all breakfast foods. I prefer to sleep and wake up early instead of staying up late and consuming caffeine. Eating consistent breakfast portions energizes my mind quickly.

source: Me enfrente... Todo o meu ser.
Me enseñaste bien, pero he añadido algunos giros creativos a tu técnica. ¡Es el momento perfecto para probarla!
target: You taught me well, but I've added a few creative twists to your technique. Now's the perfect time to test it out!
And that was me holding back.

source: Me faire sortir du laboratoire... Ne me déçois pas.
target: Dragging me out of my lab for this...*Yawn* You better have a good reason.

source: Me gusta convertir las cosas que colecciono en atrezo. Puede que no parezcan gran cosa, pero todas tienen su propia historia especial. En el escenario, lo ordinario se vuelve extraordinario, y eso vale un valer.
target: I like turning the things I collect into stage props. They might not look fancy at first, but each one has its own special story. On stage, the ordinary becomes extraordinary, and I think that's worth something.

source: Me gusta la forma en que me miras. Reflejado en tus ojos claros, hasta el mar más oscuro se vuelve cristalino. Cuando estoy contigo ya no soy «la Veleno», sino yo misma.
target: I like the way you look at me. In your eyes, even the darkest depths of the sea are made transparent. With you, I am no longer "The Bane." I am simply myself.

source: Me gusta pensar que soy bastante tolerante con cómo cada departamento gestiona sus cosas. Pero, ¿cómo decirlo...? A veces pienso que la comida enlatada de la cafetería deja bastante que desear.
target: I like to think I'm quite open-minded about how each department runs things. But, how shall I put this... Sometimes I do feel the cafeteria's canned foods are a bit of a letdown.

source: Me has ayudado a obtener un nivel de poder previamente desconocido; a cambio, utilizaré este poder en su máxima extensión para ti.
target: You have helped me gain a previously unknown level of power; in return, I will use this power to its fullest extent for you.

source: Me llamo Rebecca. Edgerunner de Night City, igual que Lucy. Me muero por meterme en líos contigo.
target: Name's Rebecca. Edgerunner from Night City, just like Lucy. Look forward to rollin' with ya.

source: Me siento tan bien ahora, diría que incluso mejor que cuando acabo de tomar un permiso de siete días. Gracias por tu ayuda, Errante.
target: I feel so good right now, I'd say even better than when I just took a seven-day leave. Thank you for your help, Rover.

source: Me tirou do meu laboratório para isso...*Bocejo* É melhor você ter um bom motivo.
target: Dragging me out of my lab for this...*Yawn* You better have a good reason.

source: Me uniré a ti en combate.
Me vas a amargar el día.
Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Attention : alimentation en énergie insuffisante.
target: Exostrider Armament: Warning, insufficient power supply.

source:
Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Canon à fragmentation paré.
Aemeath : La salvatrice s'élève !
target:
Exostrider Armament: Cluster cannon ready.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source: Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Intégration du système terminée.

Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : J'effectue un auto-diagnostic.
Hmm, tous les voyants sont au vert.
target:
Exostrider Armament: Running self-diagnosis.
Aemeath: Mm, all systems green.

source: Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Le système de visée ne répond plus.

Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Limite corporelle déverrouillée.
Aemeath : La salvatrice s'élève !
target:
Exostrider Armament: Body limit unlocked.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source:
Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Mode Aile de lumière activé.
Aemeath : Ce soir, les étoiles brillent !
target:
Exostrider Armament: Lightwings activated.
Aemeath: Stars shine tonight!

source: Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Mode mécha désactivé.
Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Munitions du canon chargées.
Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Redémarrage du système principal nécessaire.
target: Exostrider Armament: Main system to be rebooted.

source: Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Source d'énergie HS.
Mecha de l'Exoarpenteur : Unité ennemie détectée.

Mecha-Modus: Clusterkanone bereit.
Aemeath: Die Retterrin erhebt sich!
target:
Exostrider Armament: Cluster cannon ready.
Aemeath: The savior rises!
Exostrider Armament: Main system to be rebooted.

source:
Mecha-Modus: Körperliche Grenze aufgehoben.
Aemeath: Auf in den digitalen Raum!
target:
Exostrider Armament: Body limit unlocked.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source:
Mecha-Modus: Lichtflügel aktiviert.
Aemeath: Die Sterne leuchten heute Nacht!
target:
Exostrider Armament: Lightwings activated.
Aemeath: Stars shine tonight!

source:
Mecha-Modus: Selbstdiagnose läuft.
Aemeath: Mm, alle Systeme im grünen Bereich.
target:
Exostrider Armament: Running self-diagnosis.
Aemeath: Mm, all systems green.
Exostrider Armament: Warning, insufficient power supply.

source: Mehr hast du nicht zu bieten?
target: Is that the best you can do?

source: Mehr, mehr … Jetzt kann uns kein Sturm und niemand mehr aufhalten! Los, volle Kraft voraus!
target: More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead!

source: Mein Bewusstsein nimmt Form an … Dank dir kann ich meiner inneren Dämonin ohne Angst begegnen.
target: My Heart Lake has grown clearer... With you beside me, I no longer fear the tangled shadows of my own heart.

source: Mein Glück scheint wie immer gut zu sein.
target: My luck seems good like always.

source: Mein Herz schlägt schneller, und ich kann mein Blut rauschen hören... Diese neu entdeckte Stärke macht mich ein bisschen unruhig. Vielleicht sollte ich ein bisschen schlafen gehen.
target: My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep.

source: Mein Kristall scheint heller zu strahlen. Ich spüre deine Wärme auf meiner Haut, die von deiner Berührung ausgeht und tief in meine Brust eindringt.
target: My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest.

source: Mein Körper reagiert … mit einer so subtilen Frequenz, dass sie fast unhörbar ist. Wie der stille Moment, in dem eine Klinge endlich perfekt geschliffen ist. Mm, fühlt sich gut an. Präzise, wie eine Verlängerung meines Arms.
target: My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm.

source: Mein Leben aufs Spiel setzen? Jederzeit.
target: Betting my life? Counting on it.

source: Mein Lieblingsrestaurant ist die Trattoria Margherita. Nichts füllt meinen Magen und beruhigt meine Seele wie eine frisch gebackene Pizza von Signorina Margherita nach einem langen Arbeitstag.
target: My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work.

source: Mein Name ist Yinlin. Was ich mache... Shhh, darüber sprechen wir nicht in der Öffentlichkeit.
target: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.

source: Mein Schild hält mehr aus als das.
target: My shield can withstand more than that.

source: Mein Skalpell … ritzt deine Grabinschrift ein.
Mein Traum ist heute einfach, mitanzusehen, wie die Träume all meiner Studierenden wahr werden.
target: My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true.

source: Mein ganzer Wille in einem Schlag.
target: All my will, in one strike.

source: Mein lebenslanger Wunsch ist es, jemandes „Komplize“ zu sein. Gemeinsam werden wir sie … direkt zurück in die Hölle schicken.
target: My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send them straight back to hell.

source: Mein ritterliches Bauchgefühl sagt … hier lang!
target: My knightly instinct says... this way!

source: Meine Gedanken fühlen sich jetzt schärfer an... Warte, das könnte ein interessantes Konzept sein. Ich sollte das aufschreiben.
target: My thoughts feel sharper now... Wait, that could be an interesting concept. I should jot it down.

source: Meine Gedanken klären sich und meine Resonanz mit You'tan wird stärker … Das ist alles deine Hilfe, oder?
target: My thoughts are clearing up, and my resonance with You'tan is getting stronger… This is all because of your help, isn't it?

source: Meine Karmesinroten Klingen halten länger, und mein ganzer Körper fühlt sich so leicht an... Ich wusste nicht, dass dieses Schwert so leicht in meinen Händen fühlen könnte.
target: My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands.

source: Meine Klinge trennt Leben von Tod.
target: My blade cleaves life from death.

source: Meine Laterne weist keinen lebenden Seelen den Weg.
target: My lamp guides no living souls.

source: Meine Macht manifestiert sich wie meine Emotionen, Erinnerungen und Verbindungen … Du bist ziemlich geschickt mit dem Anker geworden, nicht wahr?
target: My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?

source: Meine Mutter hat immer gesagt, dass Milch mir helfen würde, größer zu werden, so wie Pflanzen Dünger brauchen. Und jedes Mal, wenn ich sie trinke, fühle ich mich warm und gemütlich. Vielleicht fühlt sich so Glück an.
target: My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.

source: Meine Resonanzkraft breitet sich weiter aus … Keine Sorge, ich kann sie kontrollieren.
target: My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.

source: Meine Schwertkünste sind so trefflich wie nie zuvor!
target: My swordsmanship has reached new heights!

source: Meine Sorgen …? Das Geld regelt die meisten davon ganz ordentlich – zum Glück. Bis auf eine: Was soll ich jetzt tun, da meine Schwester erwachsen geworden ist? Argh … wann hat sie beschlossen, dass ich ihr nicht mehr die Hand halten muss?
target: My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore?

source: Mejor empieza a correr. ¿Oh? Ya veo que has huido. Un punto para ti.
target: Better start running. Oh? You actually got away. Hmph, lucky for you.

source: Melhor começar a correr. Oh? Você realmente conseguiu escapar. Hmph, sorte sua.
target: Better start running. Oh? You actually got away. Hmph, lucky for you.

source: Menschen oder Tacet‑Dissonanzen, ich werde jede Gefahr für die Geisterhunde auslöschen. Es ist meine einzige Aufgabe, meine Leute zu schützen und jede Form von momentaner Ruhe zu sichern, wenn ich kann.
target: Humans or Tacet Discords, I'll eradicate any danger to the Ghost Hounds. It is my sole focus to protect my people, and secure any form of momentary respite when I can.

source: Merci pour le coup de main… Je commence à m'y habituer.
target: 'Preciate the assist... I'm startin' to get used to this.

source: Merci pour ta guidance. J'ai vu une croissance dans ma force et mes capacités de leadership, et il semble que tu m'aies appris plus que le maniement de l'épée ; tu m'as aussi appris de précieuses leçons de vie.
target: Thank you for your guidance. I have seen growth in my strength and leadership abilities, and it seems you have taught me more than just swordsmanship; you've taught me valuable life lessons.

source: Merci, choom ! Ça, c'est du tuning en règle !
target: Thanks, choom! Now that's what I call a solid tune-up!

source: Mes Lames écarlates durent plus longtemps, et mon corps entier se sent si léger... Je ne savais pas que cette épée pouvait se sentir si légère dans mes mains.
target: My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands.

source: Mes instincts chevaleresques me disent… par ici !
target: My knightly instinct says... this way!

source: Mes pensées s'éclaircissent, et ma résonance avec Youtan se renforce... C'est grâce à votre aide, n'est-ce pas ?
target: My thoughts are clearing up, and my resonance with You'tan is getting stronger… This is all because of your help, isn't it?

source: Mes pensées sont devenues plus claires. Attendez, je dois noter ceci...
target: My thoughts feel sharper now... Wait, that could be an interesting concept. I should jot it down.

source: Mes soucis ? L'argent, ça les règle plutôt bien, heureusement. Tous sauf un, en fait : qu'est-ce que je fais, maintenant que ma sœur est grande ? Argh… Depuis quand elle n'a plus besoin que je lui tienne la main ?
target: My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore?

source: Mes talents d'épéiste atteignent de nouveaux sommets !
target: My swordsmanship has reached new heights!

source: Mesmo acorrentada, ela dança com elegância — uma verdadeira Montelli, e ainda mais do que isso. Para onde suas escolhas conduzirão sua família? É encantador imaginar como ela poderá se apresentar quando nos encontrarmos novamente.
target: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true Montelli, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.

source: Mesmo que o Caminho Não Tenha Fim
target: Even Should the Path Have No End

source: Mettre ma vie en jeu ? Ça me va.
target: Betting my life? Counting on it.

source: Meu Escudo aguenta mais que isso.
target: My shield can withstand more than that.

source: Meu caminho é só meu. É longo. Perigoso. Sem luz. Sem companhia. Nem sempre estarei por perto... E o "demônio" vai querer o que te é devido. Por um pacto tão injusto... Tem certeza de que pode aceitar isso?
target: My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the "devil" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it?

source: Meu coração está batendo mais rápido, posso ouvir meu sangue correndo... Esta nova força está me agitando. Talvez eu devesse dormir um pouco.
target: My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep.

source: Meu corpo está respondendo... com uma frequência tão sutil, quase inaudível. Como o instante silencioso quando uma lâmina é finalmente afiada à perfeição. Mm, é uma boa sensação. Precisa, como uma extensão do meu braço.
target: My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm.

source: Meu cristal parece brilhar mais. Sinto seu calor na minha pele, fluindo do seu toque, alcançando profundamente dentro do meu peito.
target: My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest.

source: Meu desejo de toda a vida é ser a "parceira no crime" de alguém. Juntos, vamos mandar eles de volta direto para o inferno.
target: My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send them straight back to hell.

source: Meu instinto de cavaleiro diz... por aqui!
target: My knightly instinct says... this way!

source: Meu nome é Rebecca. Mercenária de Night City, igual à Lucy. Tô doida pra andar junto contigo.
target: Name's Rebecca. Edgerunner from Night City, just like Lucy. Look forward to rollin' with ya.

source: Meu nome é Yinlin. Quanto ao que eu faço... Shhh, não vamos falar sobre isso em público.
target: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.

source: Meu restaurante preferido é a Trattoria Margherita. Depois de um longo dia de trabalho, nada preenche mais meu estômago e acalma minha alma como uma fatia de pizza fresquinha assada pela Signorina Margherita.
target: My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work.

source: Meu sonho agora é apenas ver todos os sonhos dos meus alunos se realizarem.
target: My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true.

source: Meus pensamentos estão cada vez mais claros, e minha ressonância com You'tan está ficando cada vez mais forte... Isso tudo é por causa da sua ajuda, não é?
target: My thoughts are clearing up, and my resonance with You'tan is getting stronger… This is all because of your help, isn't it?

source: Meus pensamentos estão mais aguçados agora... Espere, isso pode ser um conceito interessante. Devo anotá-lo.
target: My thoughts feel sharper now... Wait, that could be an interesting concept. I should jot it down.

source: Meus poderes continuam se manifestando como minhas emoções, memórias e conexões... Você se tornou bem hábil neste trabalho de âncora, não é?
target: My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?

source: Mi camino me pertenece solo a mí. Es largo, peligroso, sin luz y en soledad. No siempre estaré cerca... Y el «diablo» exigirá su parte de un pacto injusto. ¿Seguro que puedes aceptarlo?
target: My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the "devil" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it?

source: Mi candil no guía almas vivas.
target: My lamp guides no living souls.

source: Mi corazón está latiendo más rápido, y puedo oír mi sangre correr... Esta nueva fuerza me está haciendo sentir un poco inquieta. Quizás debería ir a dormir un poco.
target: My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep.

source: Mi cristal parece brillar más. Siento tu calidez en mi piel, desde tu toque hasta el fondo de mi pecho.
target: My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest.

source: Mi cuerpo responde... con una frecuencia tan sutil, casi inaudible. Como el instante silencioso cuando una hoja finalmente se afila a la perfección. *Mmm*, qué bien se siente. Preciso, como una extensión de mi brazo.
target: My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm.

source: Mi cuerpo se siente tan ligero.
Mi deseo de toda la vida es ser «compañero» de alguien. Juntos, los enviaremos... directos al infierno.
target: My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send them straight back to hell.

source: Mi energía de resonancia continúa expandiéndose. No te preocupes, puedo controlarla.
target: My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.

source: Mi escudo puede soportar más que eso.
target: My shield can withstand more than that.

source: Mi espada separa la vida de la muerte.
target: My blade cleaves life from death.

source: Mi instinto de caballera me dice que... ¡por aquí!
target: My knightly instinct says... this way!

source: Mi madre siempre decía que la leche me ayudaría a crecer más alto, como las plantas necesitan fertilizante. Y cada vez que la bebo, me siento cálido y acogedor. Quizás eso es lo que se siente la felicidad.
target: My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.

source: Mi paisaje interior se vuelve más claro. Gracias a ti, puedo enfrentarme a mi demonio interior sin pavor.
target: My Heart Lake has grown clearer... With you beside me, I no longer fear the tangled shadows of my own heart.

source: Mi poder sigue manifestándose como mis emociones, recuerdos y conexiones... Te has vuelto bastante hábil como ancla, ¿no?
target: My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?

source: Mi restaurante favorito es la Trattoria Margherita. Nada apacigua mi hambre y mi alma tanto como una pizza recién horneada por la signora Margherita tras un largo día de trabajo.
target: My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work.

source: Mi suerte parece mejorar contigo cerca.
target: My luck seems better with you around.

source: Mi suerte parece ser buena como siempre.
target: My luck seems good like always.

source: Mi sueño ahora no es otro que ver los sueños de todos mis alumnos hacerse realidad.
target: My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true.

source: Mich für sowas aus meinem Labor zu ziehen...*Gähn* Du hast hoffentlich einen guten Grund.
target: Dragging me out of my lab for this...*Yawn* You better have a good reason.
A Thousand Times Has the Moon Fallen

source: Mil veces ha caído la luna
target: A Thousand Times Has the Moon Fallen

source: Mingting a des yeux partout. Lorsque la guerre a éclaté à Jinzhou, ton profil a été envoyé à la Grande bibliothèque. Les rapports m'étaient parvenus dans l'heure. Hein ? Comment je les lis ? Simplement grâce à la synthèse vocale.
target: Mingting's eyes are everywhere. When war broke out in Jinzhou, your profile was submitted to the Grand Library. Within the hour, the briefs reached me. Hm? How do I read these? It's simple: text-to-speech.

source: Mingting tem uma certa... bebida. Esverdeada-acinzentada, com um cheiro que você não esquece. Acredite, você não quer descobrir o gosto que tem...
target: Mingting has a certain... drink. Greenish-gray, with a smell you don't forget. Trust me, you don't want to find out how it tastes...

source: Mingting tiene cierta... bebida, de color gris verdoso, con un olor inolvidable. Créeme, no quieres saber cómo sabe...
target: Mingting has a certain... drink. Greenish-gray, with a smell you don't forget. Trust me, you don't want to find out how it tastes...

source: Mingtings Augen sind überall. Als der Krieg in Jinzhou ausbrach, wurde dein Profil an die Große Bibliothek geschickt. Binnen einer Stunde erreichte mich die Mitteilung. Hm? Wie ich das hier lese? Ganz einfach: mit der Vorlesefunktion.
target: Mingting's eyes are everywhere. When war broke out in Jinzhou, your profile was submitted to the Grand Library. Within the hour, the briefs reached me. Hm? How do I read these? It's simple: text-to-speech.

source: Minha energia de Ressonância continua se expandindo... Não se preocupe, consigo controlá-la.
target: My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.
My swordsmanship has reached new heights!

source: Minha espada será ainda mais rápida.
Minha lâmina separa a vida da morte.
target: My blade cleaves life from death.

source: Minha lâmpada não guia almas vivas.
target: My lamp guides no living souls.

source: Minha mãe sempre disse que o leite me ajudaria a crescer, assim como as plantas precisam de fertilizante. E toda vez que eu bebo, me sinto aquecida e confortável. Talvez a felicidade seja isso.
target: My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.

source: Minha sorte está boa como sempre.
target: My luck seems good like always.

source: Minha sorte parece melhor com você por perto.
target: My luck seems better with you around.

source: Minhas Lâminas Carmesim estão durando mais e meu corpo todo parece tão leve... Nunca imaginei que esta espada poderia ficar tão leve em minhas mãos.
target: My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands.

source: Minhas preocupações...? O dinheiro resolve a maioria delas de forma bem organizada, graças a Sentinelas. Todos menos um: o que fazer agora que minha irmã cresceu? Argh... quando foi que ela decidiu que não precisava mais que eu segurasse sua mão?
target: My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore?

source: Mir ist dieses Gefühl nicht fremd ...
target: I'm no stranger to this sensation...

source: Mir schmeckt es immer. Komm schon, denk nicht zu viel nach! Wenn du Hunger hast, schmeckt alles gut!
target: For me, any food's fair game. C'mon, don't overthink it! When you're hungry enough, everything tastes amazing!

source: Mira a quién tenemos aquí. Un visitante poco común. Por suerte, ya terminé mi trabajo de hoy. ¿Te gustaría unirte a mí en una partida de Weiqi, si no tienes prisa por marcharte?
target: Ah, look who we have here. A rare visitor. Luckily, I've finished my work for today. Would you like to join me in a game of Weiqi, if you're not in a rush to leave?

source: Mira atentamente, Dumpling. ¿Lo ves? Bastante realista, ¿no te parece?
target: Watch closely, Dumpling... See? Quite lifelike, isn't it?

source: Miragem em névoa, névoa em osso... Retirada.
target: Mirage into mist, mist into bone... Withdraw.

source: Miroitant dans l'eau, teintée de bleu.
target: Mirrored by water, tinted in blue.

source: Mis Espadas Carmesí duran más tiempo, y todo mi cuerpo se siente tan ligero... Nunca supe que esta espada podría sentirse tan ligera en mis manos.
target: My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands.

source: Mis pensamientos se están aclarando, y mi resonancia con You'tan se está fortaleciendo... ¿Todo esto es gracias a tu ayuda, verdad?
target: My thoughts are clearing up, and my resonance with You'tan is getting stronger… This is all because of your help, isn't it?

source: Mis pensamientos se sienten más agudos ahora... Espera, eso podría ser un concepto interesante. Debería anotarlo.
target: My thoughts feel sharper now... Wait, that could be an interesting concept. I should jot it down.

source: Mistérios demais para um médico... Mas como colega, as habilidades dele falam por si mesmas. E é nisso que eu confio.
target: He's got just a few too many mysteries for a doctor... But as a colleague, his skills speak for themselves. And that's what I trust.

source: Mit Mäßigung und Disziplin werden meine Flammen im Zaum gehalten.
target: With temperance and discipline, my flames will be kept in check.

source: Mit Mäßigung und Disziplin werden meine Flammen unter Kontrolle gehalten.
target: As a lone traveler, there must've been times when you were taken advantage of, but couldn't retaliate on the spot. If you ever find yourself in such a situation again... do not hesitate to bring me along.
Tie a bow and call that my signature!

source: Mit Unsicherheit, mit Gefahr, mit Niederlage
target: With Uncertainty, With Danger, With Defeat

source: Mit deinem kühnen Plan hat mein Qingloong auf dem Schlachtfeld an Schwung gewonnen. Ich schätze deine Unterstützung.
target: With your bold plan, my Qingloong has gained more momentum on the battlefield. I appreciate your assistance.

source: Mit dieser Kraft fühle ich mich wieder vollständig ... Jetzt können wir endlich auf Augenhöhe miteinander spielen. Denn es kommt nicht nur darauf an, was du spielst, sondern auch mit wem. Siehst du das nicht auch so?
target: With this power, I am whole again... Now we can truly play as equals. After all, it's not just what you play... but who you play with. Don't you agree?

source: Mit dieser Kraft werde ich noch mehr Wünsche erfüllen.
target: With this strength, I shall safeguard more wishes.

source: Mit dir an meiner Seite kann ich ohne Sorge kämpfen... Selbst wenn der karmesinrote Dunst meine Sicht vorübergehend trübt, wirst du da sein, um mir zu helfen, mich davon zu befreien, nicht wahr?
target: The path of vengeance that I seek is destined to be filled with darkness and peril, like trudging alone through an endless night. Fortunately, with you around, I won't lose myself so easily.

source: Mit dir an meiner Seite kann ich sorgenfrei kämpfen ... Selbst wenn der purpurne Dunst meine Sicht für einen Moment trübt, wirst du da sein und mir helfen, mich daraus zu befreien, oder?
target: With you by my side, I can fight without worry... Even if the crimson haze momentarily clouds my sight, you'll be there to help me break free from it, right?

source: Mit dir scheint mein Glück besser zu sein.
target: My luck seems better with you around.

source: Mit jedem Treffen... kommt der unvermeidliche Abschied. Lassen wir das nicht auf uns wirken.
target: With every meeting... comes the inevitable parting. Let's not dwell on it.

source: Mit mehr Macht kommt mehr Verantwortung... Ich will wirklich nicht mehr arbeiten, aber wenn du es bist, der fragt... Ich kann ein bisschen Überstunden machen. Nur ein bisschen.
target: With more power comes more responsibility... I really don't want more work, but if it's you asking... I can do some overtime. Just a little.

source: Mmh, no creo que la comida sea un problema. Los alimentos orgánicos en Night City están carísimos, así que en comparación, este lugar gana en todo, sabor y precio. No me quejo.
target: Hm, can't say there's anything I won't eat. 'Ganic foods in Night City are crazy overpriced, so by comparison this place has it beat in both taste and cost. No complaints here.

source: Mmh... ¿Eh? ¡Oh, aquí estás! ¿Quién es el buen chico?
target: Hm... Eh? Oh, there you are! Who's a good boy...

source: Mmm, que requinte... Como uma tempestade se chocando contra um mar calmo, despertando-o à vida com ondas que alcançam o céu.
target: Mmm, how exquisite... Like a storm crashing into a still sea, stirring it to life with waves that reach for the sky.

source: Mmm... Como una implacable resaca que barre el abismo y hace retumbar el océano.
target: Ah... Like a fierce undertow sweeping through the abyss, causing the sea itself to tremble.

source: Mmm... Justo como a mí me gusta.
Molho Campeão! Esse molho é tão bom que você poderia comer um sapato velho com ele.
target: Victor Savor! That sauce is so good, you'll munch an old shoe with it.

source: Mon bouclier peut résister à bien plus que ça.
target: My shield can withstand more than that.

source: Mon chemin m'appartient qu'à moi. Il est long. Périlleux. Sans lumière. Sans compagnie. Je ne serai pas toujours là… Et le « diable » voudra son tribut. Es-tu prêt à accepter un pacte aussi injuste ?
target: My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the "devil" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it?

source: Mon corps répond… avec une fréquence si subtile qu'elle en est presque inaudible. Comme le bref silence qui suit l'affûtage parfait d'une lame. Hm, ergonomique. Précise, comme une prolongation de mon bras.
target: My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm.

source: Mon cristal semble briller plus fort. Je sens ta chaleur sur ma peau, émanant de ton toucher, atteignant profondément ma poitrine.
target: My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest.

source: Mon cœur bat plus vite, et je peux entendre mon sang qui coule... Cette nouvelle force me rend un peu agité. Peut-être que je devrais aller dormir.
target: My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep.

source: Mon passé est bien plus incisif…
Mon pouvoir ne cesse de se manifester, comme mes émotions, mes souvenirs et mes liens… Tu es de plus en plus doué avec l'ancrage, hein ?
target: My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?

source: Mon restaurant préféré est la Trattoria Margherita. Il n'y a rien de tel qu'une part de pizza fraîchement préparée par Signorina Margherita après une longue journée de travail pour à la fois remplir mon estomac et apaiser mon âme.
target: My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work.

source: Mon rêve ? Bah… que tout le monde ait droit à une vie décente, genre ? Je sais pas trop, choom. Je suis trop occupée à chercher la prochaine dinguerie à faire !
target: A dream? I guess... just makin' sure everyone gets to live a decent life? I dunno, choom. Too busy thinkin' about the next stunt we're gonna pull!

source: Mon rêve d'enfance est de devenir la complicité avec un être. Ensemble, nous renverrons ces ordures… au plus profond de l'enfer.
target: My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send them straight back to hell.

source: Mon rêve est...un jour, on n'a plus besoin d'un général qui stationne à la frontière.
target: If one day, the borderlands no longer need a general, I suppose my wish will have come true.

source: Mon seul rêve maintenant, c'est de voir les rêves de mes étudiants se réaliser.
target: My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true.

source: Mon énergie résonatrice continue de grandir… Ne t'inquiète pas, je peux la contrôler.
target: My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.

source: Mortefi est souvent perçu comme arrogant et inaccessible. Pourtant, il est en effet une personne facile à aborder. Soyez direct avec lui, car trop de politesse peut causer des malentendus.
target: Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.

source: Mortefi, Forscher in der Sicherheitsabteilung der Huaxu‑Akademie. Bei Anfragen zu Tacetit‑Waffen können Sie mein Labor besuchen. Stellen Sie jedoch sicher, dass Sie wissen, wovon Sie sprechen, bevor Sie an meine Tür klopfen.
target: Mortefi, researcher at Department of Safety, Huaxu Academy. For inquiries about Tacetite weapons, you may visit my lab. Make sure you know what you're talking about, though, before knocking at my door.

source: Mortefi, chercheur au Département de sécurité, Académie de Huaxu. Pour toute question sur les armes Tacéites, tu peux visiter mon laboratoire. Mais, réfléchissez bien si la demande est raisonnable avant de frapper à ma porte.
target: Mortefi, researcher at Department of Safety, Huaxu Academy. For inquiries about Tacetite weapons, you may visit my lab. Make sure you know what you're talking about, though, before knocking at my door.

source: Mortefi, investigador del Departamento de Seguridad, Academia Huaxu. Para consultas sobre armas de Tacetita, puedes visitar mi laboratorio. Asegúrate de saber de qué estás hablando, sin embargo, antes de llamar a mi puerta.
target: Mortefi, researcher at Department of Safety, Huaxu Academy. For inquiries about Tacetite weapons, you may visit my lab. Make sure you know what you're talking about, though, before knocking at my door.

source: Mortefi, pesquisador do Departamento de Segurança, Academia Huaxu. Caso queira saber mais sobre as armas de Tacetita, visite o meu laboratório. Mas pelo menos saiba do que está falando antes de bater na minha porta.
target: Mortefi, researcher at Department of Safety, Huaxu Academy. For inquiries about Tacetite weapons, you may visit my lab. Make sure you know what you're talking about, though, before knocking at my door.

source: Muchos creen que tener "talento" es una bendición, pero ignoran la maldición que viene con ello: algún día el destino podría quitártelo, silenciosamente. No des por sentado tu talento, aprovéchalo al máximo, antes de que sea demasiado tarde.
target: Many believe having "talent" is a blessing, but ignore the curse that comes along: someday fate might take it away, quietly. Don't take your talent for granted—make the most of it, before it's too late.

source: Muchos tropiezan en la vida sin dirección, sin encontrar nunca un propósito. Baizhi es una de las pocas que ha encontrado su vocación, y está dispuesta a renunciar a cualquier cosa por la verdad que persigue.
target: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

source: Muchos usan máscaras para encajar, pero ella no. Cualquiera que sea su pasado o los papeles que haya interpretado, ella es fiel a sí misma.
target: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.

source: Muito bem. Concederei a você a iluminação.
target: Very well. I shall grant you enlightenment.

source: Muitos acreditam que ter "talento" é uma bênção, mas ignoram a maldição que vem junto: algum dia o destino pode tirá-lo, silenciosamente. Não tome seu talento como garantido, aproveite-o ao máximo, antes que seja tarde demais.
target: Many believe having "talent" is a blessing, but ignore the curse that comes along: someday fate might take it away, quietly. Don't take your talent for granted—make the most of it, before it's too late.

source: Muitos vagam pela vida sem direção, sem nunca encontrar um propósito. Baizhi está entre os poucos que encontraram sua vocação e está disposta a desistir de qualquer coisa pela verdade que busca.
target: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

source: Muitos vestem máscaras para se encaixar, mas ela não. Seja qual for seu passado, sejam quais forem os papéis que interpretou, ela está aqui agora, sendo fiel a si mesma.
target: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.

source: Murchar... é natural para a vida...
Muy bien, un pequeño ajuste debería bastar.
target: All right, a tune-up should do the trick for now.

source: Muy bien, ¿cuál es el premio gordo?
Muy bien, ¿qué es la primera cosa de tu lista para hoy?
target: Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?

source: Muy bien. Te concederé la iluminación.
target: Very well. I shall grant you enlightenment.

source: Más allá de la bruma exuberante, la lluvia avanza.
target: Beyond lush haze, the rainfall marches.

source: Más allá de la espera infinita
Más allá de mí misma. Más allá de cada comienzo y final escrito de la historia. Hasta que reescribamos nuestro destino.
target: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.

source: Más allá del fin del verano
Más allá del valor de la vida
Más suministros. Esto nos durará unos días.
target: New supplies… This'll last us a few more days.

source: Mäh mäh! Es ist ein Schatz!
Même avec des chaînes, elle danse élégamment, une vraie Montelli, mais plus que cela. Où mènera-t-elle sa famille ? Je me demande comment elle apparaîtra devant moi lors de notre prochaine rencontre.
target: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true Montelli, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.

source: Même si je n'ai pas beaucoup parlé avec lui, je peux dire que ce Mortefi est un homme de culture. Croisons les doigts pour qu'il devienne mon client un jour !
target: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!

source: Même si la voie n'a pas de fin
target: Even Should the Path Have No End

source: Möchtest du Aalto erreichen? Hier ist sein Kontakt. Erwähne meinen Namen und du bekommst einen Rabatt von zwanzig Prozent.
target: Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.

source: Möchtest du dir das nicht ansehen?
Möge das Hütende alle führen, die verloren sind.
target: May the Sentinel guide those who are lost.

source: Möge das Mondlicht meinen standhaften Willen bezeugen.
target: May the moonlight attest my steadfast will.

source: Möge deine Liebe ewig währen und nie schwinden.
target: May Thy love endure forever, never ceasing.

source: Möge die Sakura verglühen. Lass dieses Selbst verbrennen.
target: May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.

source: Möge die Sonne bezeugen, wie der Ruhm sich vor uns verneigt.
target: With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us.

source: Möge diese Kraft dem Exoschreiter helfen, Lahai-Roi für alle Zeiten zu bewachen.
target: May this strength help the Exostrider keep watch over Lahai-Roi for ages to come.

source: Möge dieses Gold zu deiner zuverlässigsten Klinge werden.
target: May this gold become your most reliable blade.

source: Möge uns diese Reise näher zur Wahrheit führen.
target: May this journey bring us closer to the truth.

source: Mögen Frieden und Wohlstand dieses Land auf ewig segnen.
target: May peace and plenty bless this land for good.

source: N'aie pas peur de la douleur.
N'est-ce pas merveilleux, les miracles que peuvent accomplir les mots et la musique ?
target: Isn't it amazing what miracles words and music can bring?

source: N'est-ce pas étrange qu'il n'y ait qu'une seule bonne réponse à chaque question ? Même les Woolies dans ma boîte ne sont pas tous les mêmes. Ils ne sont pas tous mignons et câlins. Certains ont même des dents pointues ! « Baa! » ...Tu vois ?
target: Isn't weird that there's only one right answer to every question? I mean, even the Woolies in my box aren't all the same. They're not all cute and cuddly. Some may even have pointy teeth! "Baa!" ...You see?

source: N'importe quel détail en cours de route pourrait devenir un renseignement précieux.
target: Any detail along the way could become valuable intel.
Please don't stay too far away from me.

source: Na gut, ein kleines Feintuning sollte fürs Erste genügen.
target: All right, a tune-up should do the trick for now.

source: Na gut, ich werde dich ein wenig unterhalten, da ich heute gute Laune habe!
target: Alright, I'll humor you for a bit, since I'm feeling good today!

source: Na gut. Gehört wohl zum Job.
target: Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.

source: Na gut... Zeig, was du kannst!
Na ja, die Nebenwirkungen sind jetzt nicht mehr so schlimm, aber ich würde alles dafür geben, dass Aleph-1 einfach aufhört, diesen Unsinn in meinem Kopf zu murmeln.
target: Well, the side effects aren't as bad now, but I'd give anything for Aleph-1 to just stop mumbling nonsense in my head.

source: Na los! Friss Blei, du Loser!
Na natureza, preferências alimentares não importam. Eu só me preocupo com o que é comestível.
target: ...Out in the wild, food preferences don't matter. I only care about what's edible.

source: Na so was – auch du hast ein Auge für Inspiration.
target: Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.

source: Na verdade, raramente encontro a Srta. Zhezhi pessoalmente... Ela é tipo uma coruja, mal sai durante o dia. Então, deixo as tintas e papéis na porta de sua casa.
target: Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door.

source: Na verdade, sou melhor destrancando fechaduras digitais.
target: Actually, I'm better at popping digital locks.

source: Na … das ist doch schon besser.
Na, sieh mal einer an! Leicht verdientes Geld.
target: Well, would you look at that! Easy money.

source: Nach dem Räuchern oder Braten schmeckt Fleisch irgendwie wie … ach, vergessen wir das.
target: After meat is smoked or roasted, its taste is similar to... Never mind.

source: Nach dem Training gehe ich gern ins Septimont-Bad. Das warme Wasser wirkt Wunder gegen Müdigkeit. Probierʼs mal aus.
target: I love going to the Septimont baths after a training session. The warm water does wonders for easing weariness. You should give it a try.

source: Nach genug Misserfolgen verblasst der Schmerz und mit ihm die Sorgen.
target: After enough failures, the sting fades, and with it, the burden of worry.
What form do you look for?

source: Nací del agua, al agua debo volver.
Nada de preguiça, agora que você está aqui para ajudar! Devo praticar mais intensamente.
target: No more slacking off now that you're here to help! I should practice harder.

source: Nada mal. É bom tirar a ferrugem.
target: Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

source: Nada motiva mais que uma pequena recompensa.
target: Nothing motivates like a little reward.

source: Nada motiva más que una pequeña recompensa.
target: Nothing motivates like a little reward.

source: Nadie nace siendo bueno en algo. Como Magistrada de Jinzhou, debo aprender e mejorar constantemente.
target: No one is born good at anything. As the Magistrate of Jinzhou, I must constantly learn and improve.

source: Naja, was haben wir denn hier?
target: Well, well. What do we have here?

source: Nas cordas do qin cantam as eras, a paz eterna minha lâmina trará.
target: On the qin strings do eons sing, eternal peace my blade shall bring.

source: Nas correntes crescentes das correntes, ouço o sussurro constante do nome — "Devota da Voz". Refere-se a mim? Ou será que...?
target: In the surging currents of the Streams, I hear the constant whispering of the name—"Votary of the Voice." Does it refer to me? Or...?

source: Natürlich eine Geburtstagstorte. Eine mit jeder Menge frischem Obst und viel zu viel Schlagsahne. Und natürlich mit Kerzen drauf … Warum? Weil ich noch nie eine gegessen habe.
target: A birthday cake, of course. The kind with tons of fresh fruit and way too much whipped cream. And candles on top, for sure... Why? Because I've never actually had one before.

source: Ne cligne pas des yeux ou tu vas tout rater !
target: Don't blink... you'll miss the best part!

source: Ne fuyez pas, continuez la danse !
target: Don't run, keep the dance going!

source: Ne pense pas à maltraiter les amis d'Encore !
target: No one picks on Encore's friends!

source: Ne restez pas bouche bée ! Héhé... Waaahhh !
target: Don't let your jaws drop yet! Hehe... Waaahhh!

source: Ne t'embête pas à m'impressionner avec tes connaissances d'antiquités, car presque personne ne les connaît mieux que moi ! *reniflement satisfait* Ce que je veux chez un ami, c'est simplement du respect pour les artefacts anciens.
target: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.

source: Ne t'en fais pas pour moi.
Ne t'en fais pas, je m'en occupe.
target: Don't worry. Leave it to me.

source: Ne t'inquiète pas ! Vas-y, ouvre-le ! Grande Maîtresse Youhu est là pour toi !
target: Worry not! Go ahead and open it! This master is here for ya!

source: Ne t'inquiète pas, c'est juste un leurre.
target: Don't worry... Just a trick of the eye...

source: Ne t'inquiète pas. Je suis disponible 24h/24.
Ne te laisses pas berner par l'âge de notre second ; si tu as besoin de conseils pour une performance, c'est à elle qu'il faut s'adresser. De plus, c'est aussi une excellente scénographe !
target: Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer!

source: Ne touchez pas à mes camarades.
Ne touchez pas... à mes trésors...
Ne verse pas de larme pour moi.
Ne vous inquiétez pas, ma lumière vous protège !
target: Don't worry, my light's got you!

source: Necesitaré más tiempo para aprender y familiarizarme con este mundo desconocido.
target: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.

source: Necesitaré más tiempo para familiarizarme con este mundo desconocido.
target: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.

source: Nein … Ich muss noch an mir arbeiten …
target: No… I've still got work to do...

source: Nein, Pero. Die sind nicht für dich.
target: No, Pero. That's not for you.

source: Nein. Solange es Essen ist, mag ich es. Obwohl … ich eigentlich gar nichts mehr essen muss, haha.
target: Nope. As long as it's food, me likey. Though… I don't really need to eat anymore, haha.

source: Nenhuma força traça o meu caminho.
Nenne das Ziel. Ich kümmere mich um den Rest.
target: Name the target. I'll take care of the rest.

source: Nennen wir es … Der Ritterin reicher Hort.
target: Let's call it... A Knight's Great Harvest.

source: Nesse ritmo, toda a Cidade de Jinzhou... Não, espere. Todo Huanglong conhecerá o nome de Chixia!
target: At this rate, the entire Jinzhou City... No wait. The entirety of Huanglong shall be known to the heroic Chixia's name!

source: Neste mundo, só existem coisas ainda desconhecidas, não coisas que não podem ser conhecidas. Parece que eu estou um passo mais perto da verdade que procuro.
target: In this world, there are only those things which are not yet known, not those which cannot be known. I seem to be one step closer to the truth I seek.

source: Neue Investitionen, neue Verträge … Ich verspreche dir, du wirst nicht enttäuscht sein.
target: New investments, new deals… I promise you won't be disappointed.

source: Neue Sachen zum Anschauen? Ich bin dabei!
target: New goodies to see? I'm in!

source: Neue Vorräte … Die reichen für ein paar Tage.
target: New supplies… This'll last us a few more days.

source: Nicht blinzeln … sonst verpasst du das Beste!
target: Don't blink... you'll miss the best part!

source: Nicht schlecht. Damit lässt sich arbeiten.
Nicht schlecht. Hast du etwas Brauchbares gefunden?
Nicht schlecht. Manchmal muss man den Rost abschütteln.
target: Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

source: Nicht schlecht. Wer’s findet, darf’s behalten.
Nichts als ein Kratzer auf meiner Klinge.
target: A mere scratch upon my blade.

source: Nichts spornt so an wie eine kleine Belohnung.
target: Nothing motivates like a little reward.

source: Niemand wird als Experte geboren. Als Magistratin von Jinzhou muss ich ständig lernen und mich verbessern.
target: No one is born good at anything. As the Magistrate of Jinzhou, I must constantly learn and improve.
No one picks on Encore's friends!

source: Night City es una jaula, sí... Pero mientras huía de mi pasado, me mantuvo oculta y a salvo. Y justo cuando empezaba a sentirme cómoda, me lo arrebató todo. De vuelta al punto de partida.
target: Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.

source: Night City est une cage, c'est vrai… Mais quand je fuyais mon passé, elle m'a cachée, elle m'a protégée. Et juste quand j'ai cru pouvoir baisser ma garde, elle m'a tout arraché… Retour à la case départ.
target: Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.

source: Night City ist ein Käfig, ja … Aber auf der Flucht vor meiner Vergangenheit hat die Stadt mir ein Versteck und Sicherheit gegeben. Aber als ich mich gerade eingelebt hatte, fiel alles auseinander … und ich musste wieder von vorn anfangen.
target: Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.

source: Night City é uma gaiola, sim... Mas enquanto eu fugia do meu passado, ela me manteve escondida, em segurança. E justo quando comecei a relaxar, eu perdi tudo... De volta à estaca zero.
target: Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.

source: Nimm dieses Teleskop und schau selbst … Selbst die höchsten Wolken wirken zum Greifen nah, oder? Mit diesem Hilfsmittel entgeht dir kein Detail auf der Bühne und keine „neue Welt“, die dich auf dem Meer erwartet.
target: Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea.

source: Nimm es. Du wirst schon eine Verwendung dafür finden.
target: Take it. You will find a use for it.

source: Nimm sie bitte. Ich hoffe, sie sind nützlich.
target: Please have them. I hope they will prove useful.

source: Ninguém mexe com os amigos de Encore!
target: No one picks on Encore's friends!

source: Ninguém nasce sabendo tudo. Como Magistrada de Jinzhou, preciso aprender e me aperfeiçoar constantemente.
target: No one is born good at anything. As the Magistrate of Jinzhou, I must constantly learn and improve.

source: No Início, Ela Fechou os Olhos
target: At First, She Closed Her Eyes

source: No cejaré mi empeño... La caída de mi ciudad natal reveló la verdad: que solo el sol ardiente acorrala a la oscuridad.
target: I will not stop here... My hometown's fall revealed the truth: only with the everblazing sun can darkness have nowhere to hide.

source: No es algo desconocido para mí...
target: I'm no stranger to this sensation...

source: No es más que un traspiés.
No es nada, solo un rasguño.
No estaba holgazaneando, de verdad. Solo necesitaba recargar un poco... ¿Aww, no me crees? No digas eso. Me dolerá mucho.
target: I wasn't slacking off, really. I just needed to recharge a little... Aww, you don't believe me? Don't say that. I'll be so hurt.

source: No estaría de más estar más preparado.
target: Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.

source: No estuve a la altura de... las expectativas...
target: Couldn't live up to... those expectations...

source: No está mal. Es bueno quitarse el óxido.
target: Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

source: No está mal. ¿Has encontrado algo que valga la pena?
No fim das contas... sempre tarde demais...

No final de um show, todo mundo grita “Encore!” bem alto, então as cortinas se abrem e eles tocam outra música. Isso é super legal, certo? Então... Se você for amido de Encore, sua história nunca vai terminar!
target: At the end of a show, everybody yells "Encore!" really loud, then the curtains open, and they play another song. That's super cool, right? So... If you're friends with Encore, your story will never come to an end!

source: No hablas mucho, pero eres muy fuerte en la batalla. Hay un buen viejo dicho de Huanglong, «Un gato que atrapa ratones no maúlla». Te queda perfecto, ¿no es así?
target: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old Huanglong saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?

source: No hay necesidad de apresurarse. Todo se resolverá a su debido tiempo.
target: No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time.

source: No hay necesidad de obsesionarse con ello.
target: No need to dwell on it.

source: No importa lo que suceda, no importa lo que haya pasado, este colgante de jade siempre se mantendrá claro y brillante.
target: No matter what happens, no matter what I've been through, this jade pendant will forever stay clear and bright.

source: No me gusta deber favores, así que mi arsenal de magia tecnológica está a tu disposición. En otras palabras, te cubro las espaldas.
target: Not in the biz of owin' favors, so consider my arsenal of tech wizardry at your disposal. In other words... I got your back.

source: No me gusta el alcohol. ¿Por qué? ...No lo sé. Simplemente me hace... sentir incómoda.
target: I don't like boozy stuff. Why? ...I don't know. It just makes me... uncomfortable.

source: No me romperé. Soy el hueso que soporta ventiscas, la lámpara al rojo vivo de una mesa quirúrgica. Ardo, pero mi bisturí nunca vacila.
target: I won't break. I am the bone that endures blizzards, the white-hot lamp over a surgical table. I burn, but my scalpel never falters.

source: No necesito esperar una noche estrellada, ni inclinar mi mirada para buscar el cielo, pues lo he puesto a mi espalda, en mis manos y sobre mis párpados.
target: I need not wait for a starry night, nor tilt my gaze to seek the sky. For I have placed it at my back, in my hands, and upon my eyelids.
Don't blink... you'll miss the best part!

source: No pensé que pudiera conseguir una mejora tan grande... ¡No te contengas conmigo ahora!
target: Didn't think I could get this big of an upgrade... Don't hold back on me now!

source: No pierdas de vista el objetivo.

target: I don't... want to disappoint you...

source: No se parece a ninguna mejora que haya instalado, ni de hardware ni de software. Es como si... todo mi sistema vibrara.
target: Not like any upgrade I've ever had, hardware or soft. It's like... my whole system's hummin'.

source: No soy un gran fan de los alimentos que son difíciles de masticar... Oh, no tiene nada que ver con mis dientes. Simplemente no me gusta la sensación de picor de la pegajosidad en mi boca.
target: I'm not a big fan of foods that are hard to chew… Oh, it's got nothing to do with my teeth. I'm just not fond of the prickling sensation of stickiness in my mouth.

source: No soy un gran fan de los platos grandes y grasosos, como los bistecs... No es que no sean sabrosos, simplemente odio la idea de desperdiciar comida si no puedo terminarla. No me siento bien con eso...
target: I'm not a big fan of big, greasy dishes—like steaks... It's not that they aren't tasty, I just hate the idea of letting food go to waste if I can't finish it. It doesn't sit right with me...

source: No suelo condimentar la comida, pues casi he olvidado los sabores de la mayoría de los ingredientes.
target: Food, stripped of extravagant "seasonings." I can scarcely recall the natural taste of most foods.

source: No te dejes engañar por la edad de nuestra Primera Oficial: es una fuente inagotable de consejos de navegación. ¡Además, también es una excelente escenógrafa!
target: Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer!

source: No te lo voy a poner fácil.

No te molestes en impresionar con tu conocimiento sobre antigüedades, ¡porque dudo que haya alguien que lo sepa mejor que yo! *sonrisa satisfecha* Lo que realmente busco en un amigo es simplemente respeto por los artefactos antiguos.
target: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.

source: No te preocupes, ¡mi luz te protege!
target: Don't worry, my light's got you!

source: No te preocupes. Yo me encargo.
target: Don't worry. Leave it to me.

source: No te preocupes... Solo es un truco de la vista...
target: Don't worry... Just a trick of the eye...

source: No temas. Estoy de guardia a todas horas.
No temas... solo necesito un momento.
target: Worry not... Just need a moment.

source: No, Perri. Eso no es para ti.
target: No, Pero. That's not for you.

source: No. Mientras sea comida, me gusta. Aunque... ya no necesito comer realmente, ¡juas!
target: Nope. As long as it's food, me likey. Though… I don't really need to eat anymore, haha.

source: No... aún tengo trabajo que hacer...
target: No… I've still got work to do...

source: Noch eine Exkursion? Ich bin bereit.

Nomade. J'ai rejoint votre côté à cause des ordres de madame, et je continuerai à rester avec vous pour les jours à venir... Cela n'a rien à voir avec mes devoirs actuels. Je fais ce serment de mon propre gré, juste pour vous.
target: Rover. I joined your side because of my lady's orders, and I will continue to stay with you for the days to come... It has nothing to do with my duties now. I make this vow of my own volition, just for you.

source: Nombra el objetivo y yo me encargaré del resto.
target: Name the target. I'll take care of the rest.

source: Nomeie o alvo. Eu cuido do resto.
target: Name the target. I'll take care of the rest.

source: Non, Pero, ce n'est pas pour toi.
target: No, Pero. That's not for you.

source: Non, non, on ne triche pas !
Non. Tant que c'est comestible, tout me va. Enfin… ce n'est plus comme si j'avais besoin de manger, héhé.
target: Nope. As long as it's food, me likey. Though… I don't really need to eat anymore, haha.

source: Non... J'ai encore du travail à accomplir...
target: No… I've still got work to do...

source: Nossa, você vai me dar tudo isso mesmo? Legal!
target: Geez, you're actually giving me all of these? Good call!

source: Nourrissez mes fleurs, vous qui vous trompez vous-mêmes !
Nous devrions pouvoir acheter de nouvelles provisions.
target: This should afford us more provisions.

source: Nous le voulons, et nous le trouvons.
target: We desire, and so we find.

source: Nous naviguons en douceur maintenant. La prochaine étape est... notre escale !
target: We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside!

source: Nous nous battrons pour tout ce que la lumière touche.
target: All the sun touches is ours to fight for.

source: Nous revoilà en pleine action ensemble !
Nous sommes dans le même bateau !

target: A New Story, A New Adventure

source: Novos investimentos, novos negócios... Prometo que você não se desapontará.
target: New investments, new deals… I promise you won't be disappointed.

source: Novos suprimentos... Isso vai durar mais alguns dias.
target: New supplies… This'll last us a few more days.

source: Nuestro trabajo en equipo está mejorando.
Nuevas inversiones, nuevos negocios… te prometo que no te defraudaré.
target: New investments, new deals… I promise you won't be disappointed.

source: Nul destin ne guide mes pas.

target: In the blink of an eye.

source: Nun komm schon. Ich könnte noch einen Tanzpartner gebrauchen.
target: Come now. I could use another dancer.
Now presenting, a poem of finale.

source: Nun, ich bin schon super stark, aber... Danke für deinen extra Buff!
target: Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!

source: Nun, mit meiner Kraft kann ich noch mehr umformen. Deine Mühen haben sich wirklich bezahlt gemacht.
target: Now, my Forte can reshape even more. Your labour has truly borne fruit.

source: Nun... Ich möchte einfach die Stabilität, die ich derzeit genieße, aufrechterhalten und vielleicht meine Heimatstadt sicher halten, wenn ich das Luxus habe, haha.
target: Well... I just want to maintain the stability I currently enjoy, and maybe keep my hometown safe, if I get the luxury to, haha.

source: Nunca dejo pasar una buena oferta.
Nunca he lamentado desafiar la larga noche.
target: I have never regretted braving the long night.

source: Nunca he sentido tanta fuerza en mí. Todo es gracias a ti, ¿verdad? Estoy eternamente agradecido, Errante, por todo lo que has hecho por mí.
target: I've never felt such strength in me. It's all thanks to you, isn't it? I am forever grateful, Rover, for everything you've done for me.

source: Nunca he sido buena luchando, ya sabes... ¿Puedo simplemente no hacer nada?
target: I'm not much of a fighter... Can I just slack off?

source: Nunca há tempo suficiente! Entregando pacotes, planejando novas rotas, encontrando amigos, mantendo meu diário... Ah, eu gostaria de poder estar em um milhão de lugares ao mesmo tempo!
target: There's never enough time! Delivering packages, planning new routes, catching up with friends, keeping my journal... Oh I wish I could be in a million places at once！

source: Nunca me arrependi de desafiar a longa noite.
target: I have never regretted braving the long night.

source: Nunca pensei que poderia aprimorar ainda mais minhas habilidades. Sua orientação tem sido inestimável e eu deveria ajudar de alguma forma em troca. Então... Há algo que eu possa fazer por você?
target: I never thought I could further refine my abilities. Your guidance has been invaluable, and I ought to help you in some way in return. So… Anything I can do for you?

source: Nunca pensé que podría perfeccionar aún más mis habilidades. Tu guía ha sido inestimable y debo ayudarte de alguna manera en agradecimiento. Entonces... ¿Hay algo en lo que pueda ayudarte?
target: I never thought I could further refine my abilities. Your guidance has been invaluable, and I ought to help you in some way in return. So… Anything I can do for you?
I never miss out on a good deal.

source: Nunca senti tanta força em mim. E tudo graças a você, não é? Minha gratidão é eterna por tudo que você fez por mim, Rover.
target: I've never felt such strength in me. It's all thanks to you, isn't it? I am forever grateful, Rover, for everything you've done for me.

source: Nunca te equivocas al llevar a los niños perdidos a Chixia. Aunque algunos niños pueden encontrarme aterrador, nunca tendrían miedo de ella.
target: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.

source: Nunca é tarde demais para aprender!
Nur hier oben macht’s richtig Spaß.
Nuvens ao lar, bancos de areia ao luar.

target: Couldn't live up to... those expectations...

source: Não costumo dever favores, então meu arsenal de magia tecnológica ficará à sua disposição. Em outras palavras... Tô contigo.
target: Not in the biz of owin' favors, so consider my arsenal of tech wizardry at your disposal. In other words... I got your back.

source: Não deixem seus queixos caírem ainda! Hehe... Uáááá!
target: Don't let your jaws drop yet! Hehe... Waaahhh!

source: Não deveríamos valorizar toda a comida e não deixar nenhuma ir para o lixo? Bem, se estiver realmente mal feita, aí então... uhm...
