target: Shouldn't we cherish all food and not let any go to waste? Oh... Well, if it's truly badly cooked, then.. uhm...

source: Não entendo esse pessoal daqui. Troca duas palavras amigáveis e já vira tchum? Uma briga e já confiam a própria vida? Não imagino nenhum de vocês sobrevivendo um dia sequer em Night City.
target: Don't really understand the peeps here. One friendly convo makes someone a choom? One fight, and you trust 'em to watch your back? Can't imagine any of you survivin' a day in Night City.
Don't run, keep the dance going!

source: Não há como parar a boa sorte quando ela está do seu lado!
target: There's no stopping good luck once it's on your side!

source: Não há necessidade de pressa. Tudo vai se resolver a seu tempo.
target: No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time.

source: Não há necessidade de se preocupar com isso.
target: No need to dwell on it.

source: Não importa aonde isso leve... Esta batalha, vou dar tudo de mim.
target: No matter where this leads… This battle, I'm all in.

source: Não importa o que aconteça, não importa o que eu tenha passado, este pingente de jade sempre se manterá claro e brilhante.
target: No matter what happens, no matter what I've been through, this jade pendant will forever stay clear and bright.

source: Não pensei que pudesse ter uma melhoria tão grande... Não pegue leve comigo agora!
target: Didn't think I could get this big of an upgrade... Don't hold back on me now!

source: Não pisca... Você vai perder a melhor parte!
target: Don't blink... you'll miss the best part!

source: Não podemos resolver isso com uma conversa?
target: Can't we just talk this out?

source: Não preciso esperar por uma noite estrelada nem inclinar meu olhar pra buscar o céu. Pois eu o coloquei nas minhas costas, nas minhas mãos e sobre minhas pálpebras.
target: I need not wait for a starry night, nor tilt my gaze to seek the sky. For I have placed it at my back, in my hands, and upon my eyelids.

source: Não se deixe enganar pela idade da nossa Imediata — se você precisar de conselhos sobre atuação, ela é a pessoa certa. Além disso, ela também é uma excelente cenógrafa de palco!
target: Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer!

source: Não se importem se eu pegar isso.
target: Don't mind if I take these.

source: Não se parece com nenhuma atualização que já tive, de hardware e software. Sinto que... todo meu sistema está vibrando.
target: Not like any upgrade I've ever had, hardware or soft. It's like... my whole system's hummin'.

source: Não se preocupa! Pode abrir! A mestre tá aqui com você!
target: Worry not! Go ahead and open it! This master is here for ya!

source: Não se preocupe em me impressionar com seu conhecimento de avaliação de antiguidades, já que dificilmente alguém sabe mais do que eu! *risadinha* O que priorizo em uma amizade é apenas respeito pelos artefatos antigos.
target: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.

source: Não se preocupe, minha luz está com você!
target: Don't worry, my light's got you!

source: Não se preocupe, só preciso ajustar minha respiração por um instante.
target: Worry not... Just need a moment.

source: Não se preocupe, é apenas uma ilusão de ótica.
target: Don't worry... Just a trick of the eye...

source: Não se preocupe. Estou de plantão 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana.
Não se preocupe. Eu cuido delas.
target: Don't worry. Leave it to me.

source: Não se preocupe. Eu cuido disso!
Não se preocupe. Eu tenho tudo sob controle.
target: Please don't worry. I've got it in check.

source: Não seria nada mal estar mais preparado.
target: Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.

source: Não sinto essa sensação de formigamento percorrendo minhas veias há um tempo... Então, isso é tudo obra sua? *risada* Vou precisar de um tempo para me acostumar.
target: I haven't felt this tingling sensation swimming across my veins in a while... So this is all your doing? *chuckle* Looks like this is going to take some time getting used to.

source: Não sou muito de lutar... Posso só relaxar?
target: I'm not much of a fighter... Can I just slack off?

source: Não sou muito fã de alimentos difíceis de mastigar... Oh, isso não tem nada a ver com meus dentes. Simplesmente não gosto da sensação de formigamento na boca.
target: I'm not a big fan of foods that are hard to chew… Oh, it's got nothing to do with my teeth. I'm just not fond of the prickling sensation of stickiness in my mouth.

source: Não tem como se esconder de mim.
Não vou parar aqui... A queda da minha cidade revelou a verdade: apenas com o sol eternamente ardente a escuridão não terá onde se esconder.
target: I will not stop here... My hometown's fall revealed the truth: only with the everblazing sun can darkness have nowhere to hide.

source: Não é estranho que haja apenas uma resposta certa para cada pergunta? Quero dizer, nem todos os Lanosos da minha caixa são iguais. Eles não são todos fofinhos. Alguns podem até ter dentes pontiagudos! “Baa!”...Viu?
target: Isn't weird that there's only one right answer to every question? I mean, even the Woolies in my box aren't all the same. They're not all cute and cuddly. Some may even have pointy teeth! "Baa!" ...You see?

source: Não é incrível os milagres que as palavras e a música podem trazer?
target: Isn't it amazing what miracles words and music can bring?

source: Não é nada, só um arranhão.
Não, Pero. Isso não é para você.
target: No, Pero. That's not for you.

source: Não. Desde que seja comida, eu gosto. Embora... eu não precise mais comer, haha.
target: Nope. As long as it's food, me likey. Though… I don't really need to eat anymore, haha.

source: Não... ainda tenho trabalho para fazer...
target: No… I've still got work to do...
We desire, and so we find.

source: Núvola Pasta é ótima por si só, mas é ainda melhor quando compartilhada. Será... que é a companhia que a deixa mais saborosa?
target: Spaghetti Bolognese is great on its own, but it's even better when shared. Maybe... it's the company that makes it taste better?

source: O Gefallene, nehmt euer Ende hin.
O Mundo de Santu se agita. Amanhecer e poeira se fundem.
target: World of Santu stirs. Dawn and dust merge.

source: O Passatempo de Guardiã da Costa
O Passatempo de Guardiã da Costa
O Primeiro Cavaleiro Errante Marcha para a Liberdade
target: The Wandering Knight Marches To Freedom

source: O Qi do Inframundo desafia os céus.
O Que Ela Teme, O Que Ela Receia
target: What She Fears, What She Dreads

source: O Vale da Glória me aguarda?
target: Does the Vale of Glory await me?

source: O Verão em que a História Começou
target: The Summer Where the Story Began

source: O Voo sobre a Espada é mais rápido.
O ataque é a melhor defesa.
O caminho de vingança que busco está destinado a ser cheio de escuridão e perigo, como caminhar sozinho por uma noite sem fim. Felizmente, com você por perto, não me perderei tão facilmente.
target: The path of vengeance that I seek is destined to be filled with darkness and peril, like trudging alone through an endless night. Fortunately, with you around, I won't lose myself so easily.

source: O caminho que trilho se estende ao futuro. Os desejos depositados em mim... talvez um dia, eu possa finalmente realizá-los...
target: The path I walk stretches into the future. The wishes laid upon me… perhaps one day, I can finally make them...

source: O caminho à frente é incerto, não se afaste muito de mim.
target: The road ahead is unclear. Stay close.

source: O campo de batalha é dinâmico. Não baixe a guarda.
target: The battlefield is dynamic. Do not let your guard down.
Karma has caught up to me...

source: O cheiro adorável de todas as minhas presas...
target: The lovely smell of all my prey...

source: O cultivo leva tempo. Pratique diariamente e o progresso virá.
target: Cultivation takes time. Practice daily, and progress will follow.

source: O curso está definido. Hora de zarpar!
target: The course is determined. Time to set sail!

source: O céu ordena. Expulse todo o vício!
O destino trouxe você até mim e, considerando as condições que ofereço... você não me recusaria, certo?
target: Fate has led you to me, and considering the terms I'm offering… You wouldn't refuse me, would you?

source: O doce barulho do mundo... eu queria mais.
target: The world's sweet noise... I wanted more.

source: O espectro que estou vendo ficou muito mais claro...!
target: The spectrum I'm seeing got a whole lot clearer...!

source: O fogo está ficando mais quente e bonito! Podemos compartilhá-lo com outras pessoas? Encore quer ser ajudante!
target: The fire's getting warmer and prettier! Can we share it with other people? Encore wanna be a helper!

source: O fundo do mar... me chama...
O hálito caloroso do mundo, diante dos meus olhos.
target: World's warm breath, in my sight.

source: O lugar onde a terra termina é onde o oceano começa. Nossa jornada está longe de acabar.
target: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

source: O mandato chama, o julgamento cai.

target: The sparkling sea knows no bounds.

source: O mar é um espelho. Ele reflete a forma da sua alma em suas marés.
target: The sea is a mirror. It reflects the shape of your soul in its tides.

source: O meu Lago de Coração ficou mais límpido... Com você ao meu lado, não temo mais as sombras emaranhadas do meu próprio coração.
target: My Heart Lake has grown clearer... With you beside me, I no longer fear the tangled shadows of my own heart.

source: O momento presente... Este exato momento é o melhor de nossas vidas.
target: The moment at hand... This very moment is the best of our lives.

source: O mundo ao meu redor... Eu consigo ouvi-lo com mais clareza agora.
target: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.

source: O mundo ao meu redor... Ouço-o mais claramente agora.
target: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.

source:
O mundo inteiro é um palco.
PERO: Pero! Humpf!
target:
All the world's a stage.
PERO: Pero! Hmph!

source: O mundo todo é um palco, onde somos meros atores.
target: All the world's a stage, and we are mere players.

source: O pesquisador internacional de cabelos vermelhos da Academia? Ouvi dizer que ele tem muito jeito ao lidar com clientes difíceis. Na verdade... estava pensando em pedir algumas dicas a ele.
target: The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.

source: O poder que habitava em mim já me causou medo. Eu me perguntava quão monstruosa eu me tornaria se ele me dominasse... Mas esses terrores começaram a se dissipar com você ao meu lado.
target: The power within me once terrified me. I wondered how monstrous I'd become if it consumed me... But such terrors have started to fade, with you by my side.

source: O primeiro movimento, quente e agridoce, está oculto na noite escura, solitário e desolado. Agora, aqueles gritos assombrosos e fantasmagóricos começaram a se dissipar.
target: The warm yet bittersweet first movement is hidden in the dark night, alone and forlorn. Now, those haunting, ghostly cries have begun to fade away.

source: O quarto movimento, decisivo e poderoso, traz à tona um hino de batalha arrebatador. Levado pelas corredeiras, avança por uma terra sem fim, arrastando tudo no caminho.
target: The decisive and powerful fourth movement brings forth a rousing battle hymn. Carried by the rapids, it surges across an endless land, sweeping all before it.

source: O que dorme dentro do bambu.
O que ela aprendeu com o vento
O que eu devo fazer com isso... Hmm... U-uau! Ufa...
target: What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...

source: O que eu não como? Hmm... Nada, eu não sou fresca.
target: Food I won't eat...? Hmm... Nope, never heard of it!

source: O que eu penso de você? Seu sorriso parece caloroso.
target: What do I think of you? Your smile... It looks warm.

source: O que há para ser exigente? Gosto de qualquer comida, desde que encha minha barriga.
target: What's there to be picky about? I'm good with any food, as long as it fills my tummy.

source: O que queremos tem o jeito de aparecer quando menos esperamos.
target: What we want has a way of appearing when least expected.

source: O que tem na Hulu dele?
O que tem naquele espelho que ela carrega, você quer saber? Ai, ai, nem te conto! É um segredo dos GRANES. Não é para os seus ouvidos!
target: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!
What is it you wish for?

source: O que você fez hoje? Se divertiu? Viu algo legal? Vamos, conte tudo! Encore adora histórias! E os sentimentos que as pessoas compartilham... são como uma história após a outra!
target: What have you been up to today? Did you have fun? Saw anything cool? C'mon, spill the beans! Encore loves stories! And the feelings people share... they're like one story after another!

source: O que vou aprender com esta luta?
target: What will I learn from this fight?

source: O sabor das groselhas vermelhas... a única coisa que deixou uma marca em mim. Seu gosto azedo e amargo, talvez? Na verdade, acho bastante tolerável. Talvez eu simplesmente tenha me acostumado a ele...
target: The taste of redcurrants... the only thing that has left an impression on me. Its sour and bitter taste, perhaps? I find it quite tolerable actually. Maybe I've simply grown used to it...

source: O saque que encontrarmos não fará parte do meu pagamento. Será todo seu.
target: The loot we find is not part of my pay. It's all yours.

source: O segundo movimento, sombrio e pesaroso, oculta a inquietação e o terror. Você não tem medo? Ele erguerá o punhal com força, rasgando o véu entre a vida e a morte.
target: The shadowed, sorrowful second movement conceals unease and terror. Are you not afraid? It will raise its dagger with force, tearing through the veil between life and death.

source: O som da água... eu ouço. Não dos córregos, ou da chuva caindo, mas de algum lugar muito mais profundo. Uma ressonância que vaza do núcleo de cada ser vivo, despertando as colinas, despertando as águas, uma por uma.
target: The sound of water... I hear it. Not from the streams, or the falling rain, but from somewhere far deeper. A resonance that seeps from the core of every living thing, waking the hills, waking the waters, one by one.

source: O tempo pode enganar, mas a sabedoria prevalece. Aqui vem a Mestre Youhu, a grande avaliadora de antiguidades!
target: Time may deceive, but wisdom takes hold. Here comes Master Youhu, the great antique appraiser!

source: O terceiro movimento, brilhante e animado, carrega o ar caprichoso da fantasia. Mesmo suspenso sobre a falsidade e a inquietação, obriga as notas a continuarem dançando.
target: The bright and lively third movement carries the whimsical air of fantasy. Even suspended above falsehood and unease, it compels the notes to keep dancing forward.

source: O trovão celestial desperta. Fantasmas, desapareçam!
O vento chama, as ondas seguem.
O vento uiva - livre de amarras!
Ob du Hilfe beim Training brauchst oder deine Gesundheit erhalten willst, komm gerne in mein Fitnessstudio. Wir begrüßen alle Besucher.
target: Whether you need help with working out or maintaining your health, feel free to come by my gym. We welcome all visitors.

source: Observe bem, Bolinho... Vê? Bem realista, não é?
target: Watch closely, Dumpling... See? Quite lifelike, isn't it?

source: Obwohl frittierte Lebensmittel köstlich sein können, ist es am besten, sie in Maßen zu genießen, aufgrund ihrer potenziellen Gesundheitsrisiken.
target: Though fried foods can be delicious, it's best to enjoy them in moderation, due to their potential health risks.

source: Obwohl ich noch nicht viel mit ihm geplaudert habe, kann ich sagen, dass dieser Mortefi-Typ ein Mann von Kultur ist. Ich drücke die Daumen, dass er eines Tages mein Kunde wird!
target: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!

source: Obwohl, ich muss zugeben, dass ich bis mindestens zu unserer zehnten Zusammenarbeit gebraucht habe, um endlich ihren Namen zu lernen... Peinlich, nicht wahr?
target:
The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze.
Though, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so.

source: Ocorreu um erro. Entre em contato com o SAC.
target: An error occurred. Please contact Customer Service for assistance

source: Odeio comer qualquer coisa crua! Especialmente aquela carne fatiada chique servida numa bandeja.
target: I hate eating anything raw! Especially that fancy sliced meat on a platter.

source: Oh ? Cette sensation de pouvoir qui parcourt mes veines... Elle est différente de celle d'avant. S'il te plaît, faites un autre round d'entraînement avec moi.
target: Oh? This feeling of power coursing through my veins... It feels different from before. Please, do spar with me for another round.
Hm... Eh? Oh, there you are! Who's a good boy...

source: Oh, die saure Sojamilch... Als ich ein Kleinkind war, überzeugte mich meine Mutter einmal, sie zu probieren. Während die meisten meiner Kindheitserinnerungen fröhlich sind, war dieser spezielle Geschmack für meinen jungen Gaumen überwältigend.
target: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.

source: Oh, dieses Gerät hat ein paar Upgrades bekommen.
target: Oh, this gadget has seen some upgrades.

source: Oh, es ist, als würde ich Gewicht verlieren.

target: Oh, this gadget has seen some upgrades.

source: Oh, glänzend! Das muss ein Drachenschatz sein!
target: Ooh, shiny! It's gotta be a dragon's treasure!

source: Oh, las grosellas... su sabor único me ha dejado una extraña sensación. ¿Será su sabor ácido y amargo? A día de hoy, podría incluso decir que me gustan. Quizás solo me haya acostumbrado...
target: The taste of redcurrants... the only thing that has left an impression on me. Its sour and bitter taste, perhaps? I find it quite tolerable actually. Maybe I've simply grown used to it...

source: Oh, le lait de soja aigre… Quand j'étais petit, ma mère m'a convaincu d'essayer. Bien que la plupart de mes souvenirs d'enfance soient joyeux, ce goût particulier était accablant pour mon jeune palais.
target: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.
Oh, is a new match calling?

source: Oh, uma nova partida me chama?
target: Oh, is a new match calling?
Oh, is a new match calling?

source: Oh, ¿me está llamando un torneo nuevo?
target: Oh, is a new match calling?

source: Oh. O que você fará sem mim?
target: Oh. What will you do without me?
Oh. What will you do without me?

source: Oh. Was wirst du ohne mich tun?
target: Oh. What will you do without me?
Oh. What will you do without me?

source: Oh... Je me suis endormi ? ...Hehe, je suppose que ta présence me fait me sentir plus à l'aise. Tu dois te reposer plus, Nomade. Dormir trop tard pourrait entraîner la perte de cheveux.
target: Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss.

source: Oh... bin ich eingeschlafen? ...Hehe, ich schätze, deine Anwesenheit hat mich einfach beruhigt. Du solltest auch mehr Ruhe bekommen, Rover. Zu viel Nachtschichten könnten zu Haarausfall führen.
target: Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss.

source: Oh... ¿Me quedé dormido? ...Jeje, supongo que tu presencia simplemente me hizo sentir mucho más a gusto. Deberías descansar más también, Errante. Quedarse despierto hasta tarde demasiado a menudo podría provocar la pérdida de cabello.
target: Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss.

source: Oh? *kichert*... Hast du den getrockneten Fisch gerochen, den ich habe?
target: Oh? *chuckles*... Did you smell the dried fish I have?

source: Oh? *risos*... Você sentiu o cheiro do peixe seco que eu tenho?
target: Oh? *chuckles*... Did you smell the dried fish I have?

source: Oh? Dieses Gefühl der Macht, das durch meine Adern fließt ... Es fühlt sich anders an als zuvor. Bitte, fechte noch eine Runde mit mir.
target: Oh? This feeling of power coursing through my veins... It feels different from before. Please, do spar with me for another round.

source: Oh? Esta sensação de poder correndo pelas minhas veias... Parece diferente de antes. Por favor, lute comigo por mais uma rodada.
target: Oh? This feeling of power coursing through my veins... It feels different from before. Please, do spar with me for another round.

source: Oh? O que está escondido aqui dentro?
Oha … So eine hohe Punktzahl sehe ich zum ersten Mal.
target: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.

source: Ohhh... bitte lass es diesmal etwas Gutes sein!
target: Ohhh... please have something good this time!

source: Ohhh... por favor, tenha algo bom desta vez!
target: Ohhh... please have something good this time!

source: Ohhh... ¡por favor, que haya algo bueno esta vez!
target: Ohhh... please have something good this time!

source: Oi, eu sou Lingyang. Você já deve ter me visto como o dançarino do leão por aí, certo? Vamos nos ver uma outra hora! Quero que conheça o meu verdadeiro eu, sem a cabeça da dança do leão!
target: Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head!

source: Oi, eu sou a Sigrika! Quer entender o significado das runas? Precisa de ajuda com alguma coisa? Então é comigo mesmo que você tem que falar!
target: Hi, I'm Sigrika! Want to understand the meaning of runes? Need a hand with something? Then I'm the one to ask!

source: Oi, sou Taoqi, responsável pela defesa fronteiriça no Ministério do Desenvolvimento. Se precisar da minha ajuda, me mande uma mensagem a qualquer momento. Vou responder durante o horário de trabalho.
target: Hi there, I'm Taoqi, in charge of border defense at the Ministry of Development. If you need my help, shoot me a message any time. I'll get back to you during work hours.

source: Olha essas especificações. Agora você tem uma Rebecca totalmente equipada! Na próxima briga, cola em mim. Eu te cubro!
target: Check the specs! Got yourself a fully-loaded Rebecca now! Next fight, just cozy up by me. I got your back!

source: Olha quem temos aqui. Um visitante raro. Felizmente, terminei meu trabalho por hoje. Gostaria de se juntar a mim em um jogo de weiqi, se não estiver com pressa de ir embora?
target: Ah, look who we have here. A rare visitor. Luckily, I've finished my work for today. Would you like to join me in a game of Weiqi, if you're not in a rush to leave?

source: Olhe, está dando pequenos frutos! Outro milagre, mas a jornada de uma planta não termina aqui.
target: Look, it's bearing tiny fruits! Another miracle, but the journey of a plant doesn't end here.

source: Olá! Sou Aalto, seu corretor de informações. Tenho todas as informações que você precisa a preços justos. Conhecimento sobre diferentes lugares é a chave para se manter à frente de tudo. De olho em alguma coisa?
target: Howdy! I'm Aalto, your go-to information broker. I've got all the info you need at fair prices. Knowledge about different places is key to staying ahead while you're out and about. Interested in a quote?

source: Olá. Eu sou Yuanwu, administro uma academia de boxe. Não é grande, mas garantimos que cada cliente seja tratado com atenção. Você pode nos visitar a qualquer momento.
target: Hello. I am Yuanwu, and I run a boxing gym. It's not a big place, but we make sure every customer is treated with finesse. You're welcome to visit any time.

source: Olá. O que tem para hoje? Você está aqui para fazer trabalho extra, ou apenas para relaxar um pouco? Claro, você também é bem-vindo para uma conversa. Um momento, vou preparar um chá para você.
target: Hello there. What will it be for today? Are you here to put in some extra work, or maybe just to loosen up a bit? Of couse, you're welcome for a chat, too. One moment, I'll go make some tea for you.

source: On a à peu près le même âge, mais Danjin est bien plus grande que moi... Le jade qu'elle porte est si joli ! *soupir*... C'est dommage que je ne puisse pas ressentir une seule fréquence joyeuse venant d'elle...
target: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...

source: On dirait qu'on a trouvé quelque chose.
On dirait que j'ai de la chance, hein ?
target: Seems the scales tipped my way, hm?

source: On dirait que j'arrive à contrôler plus de matière du néant. Hmm… C'est toujours positif de gagner en force, non ?
target: It feels like I can control more Voidmatter now. Hmm... Getting stronger is always a good thing, right?

source: On dirait, tu dégages une vibe antique... Hum ! Je suis pro sur ça ! Tes fréquences ! Certaines semblent récentes, mais d'autres viennent de temps anciens. C'est... spécial...
target: Somehow you've been giving off antique vibes... Ahem! I'm being professional here! Your frequencies! Some of them feel recent, but some feel like they're from ancient times. It's... special...

source: On dit qu'un maître n'a pas à éclipser son disciple. Pourtant, j'ai appris bien plus de toi que je n'ai pu t'enseigner. Alors, dis-moi, disciple… Comment est-ce que je peux te remercier ?
target: They say a master need not outshine their student. Even so, I've learned far more from you than I ever taught. Tell me, my disciple... how shall I make it up to you?

source: On dit que le conteur finit toujours par faire partie de son histoire.
target: Some say, the storyteller will end up being part of the story as well.

source: On est loin du grand final...
target: This is far from the finale…

source: On les prend en tenaille et BAM !
On n'est jamais trop vieux pour apprendre !
On ne naît pas expert en quelque chose. En tant que Magistrate de Jinzhou, je suis constamment dans une démarche d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement.
target: No one is born good at anything. As the Magistrate of Jinzhou, I must constantly learn and improve.

source: On ne peut jamais se tromper en emmenant les enfants perdus à Chixia. Alors que certains enfants peuvent me trouver effrayant, ils ne seraient jamais effrayés par elle.
target: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.

source: On ne sait pas grand-chose de lui en tant que docteur, mais comme collègue, son talent n'est plus à prouver. Et c'est ce qui compte pour nous.
target: He's got just a few too many mysteries for a doctor... But as a colleague, his skills speak for themselves. And that's what I trust.

source: On passe à la vitesse supérieure !

On peut dire que Chixia est une collègue plus jeune que moi. Elle est naturellement adaptée à sa vie en tant qu'une patrouilleuse. Avec le temps et l'expérience, elle excellera sûrement dans son rôle.
target: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

source: On se fait une photo pour l'album ?
On va jouer à un jeu d'exploration ensemble !
Onde a terra termina é onde o oceano começa. Nossa viagem está longe de acabar.
target: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

source: Onde córregos límpidos fluem, lá a primavera aguarda.
target: Where clear streams flow, there spring awaits.

source: Onde estão vocês, minhas adoráveis sementes?
target: Where are you, my lovely seeds?

source: Onde quer que eu vá, juro derrotar o mal, seja à luz do dia ou na escuridão.
target: Wherever I go, I swear to vanquish evil, whether it's out in the daylight or hiding in the dark.

source: Ooh, wo kommst du denn her? Na, bist du ’n braves Hündchen?! Ja, bist du! Braves Hündchen! Mach’s gut, wir sehen uns!
target: Aww, where'd you come from? Who's a good baby?! Yes, you are! You're a good baby! Look how cute he is. Good boy, good boy. Aren't you cute. Buh-bye, see ya 'round!

source: Ooh... Fais attention ! Les fantômes des aliments que tu n'as pas finis sortiront de ton ventre et te donneront de mauvais rêves... Bouh ! Je t'ai eu !
target: Ooh… Watch out! The ghosts of food you didn't finish will crawl out of your tummy and give you bad dreams... Boo! Gotcha!

source: Ooh... Pass auf! Die Geister von Essen, das du nicht aufgegessen hast, werden aus deinem Bauch kriechen und dir schlechte Träume bescheren... Buh! Hab ich dich erwischt!
target: Ooh… Watch out! The ghosts of food you didn't finish will crawl out of your tummy and give you bad dreams... Boo! Gotcha!

source: Oooh, d'où tu sors, toi ? C'est qui, le beau bébé ? Ouais, c'est toi ! C'est toi, le beau bébé ! Ciao-ciao, à la prochaine !
target: Aww, where'd you come from? Who's a good baby?! Yes, you are! You're a good baby! Look how cute he is. Good boy, good boy. Aren't you cute. Buh-bye, see ya 'round!

source: Ops, cuidado com os meus espinhos. Não vá furar os dedos. Hmm... pensando bem, não há muito que possa te machucar.
target: Oops, watch out for my thorns. Don't get your fingers pierced. Hmm... on second thought, not much can harm you anyway.

source: Ora, o que temos aqui? Você não pode se esconder de mim!
target: Now, what do we have here? Ya can't hide from me!

source: Ora, ora. O que temos aqui?
target: Well, well. What do we have here?

source: Ora, ora... Acho que nunca vi uma pontuação tão alta.
target: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.
Well, would you look at that! Easy money.

source: Os "mantimentos." Oh, significa comida preparada exclusivamente por Ecos sem interferência humana. Todos os "mantimentos" têm um gosto bem sem graça... Será que os Ecos de Septimont são contra os temperos?
target: The "vittles." Oh, it means food cooked exclusively by Echoes sans human input. All "vittles" taste very bland... Do Septimont Echoes hate seasoning?

source: Os Cinco Trovões falaram. Demônios, pereçam!
target: Five Thunders have spoken. Demons, perish!

source: Os Patrulheiros da Meia-noite são fonte de consolo para muitos, enquanto eu os vejo como um bisturi, com o dever de erradicar males. Eu? Sou a mão que guia este bisturi, suponho.
target: The Midnight Rangers are a source of solace for many, while I see them as a scalpel, with the duty of eradicating maladies. Me? I am the hand that guides this scalpel, I suppose.

source: Os adultos como ele têm que ficar com uma cara amarrada o tempo todo. Viu? Ser adulto é realmente difícil!
target: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!

source: Os bardos são os mensageiros dos contos dos heróis. Não precisa de aplausos nem flores. Sou apenas uma contadora de histórias como qualquer outra. Prazer em conhecê-lo, grande herói. Pode me chamar de Ciaccona.
target: Bards are the couriers of heroes' tales. No need for applause or flowers. I'm just a storyteller like any other. Nice to meet you, great hero. You can call me Ciaccona.

source: Os espectros se rendem... não há o que temer da ilusão.
target: Spirits kneel at my feet. Illusory dread can't take hold of me.
You chooms like this stuff, huh?

source: Os legumes servidos frios são menos propensos à perda umidade e têm um sabor mais doce. Recomendo salada de Alfavaca gelada se você também gosta de legumes.
target: Vegetables served cold are less prone to moisture loss, and they have a sweeter taste. I recommend iced Perilla salad if you enjoy vegetables, too.

source: Os olhos de Mingting estão em todos os lugares. Quando a guerra eclodiu em Jinzhou, seu Perfil foi enviado para a Grande Biblioteca. Em uma hora, os relatórios chegaram até mim. Hm? Como eu leio isso? É simples: texto para fala.
target: Mingting's eyes are everywhere. When war broke out in Jinzhou, your profile was submitted to the Grand Library. Within the hour, the briefs reached me. Hm? How do I read these? It's simple: text-to-speech.

source: Os outros frequentemente percebem Mortefi como arrogante e inacessível, mas, na verdade, ele não é tão difícil de se conversar. Lembre-se de ser direto com ele, pois tentar ser excessivamente educado e sutil pode levar a mal-entendidos.
target: Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.

source: Os pacotes da Youhu sempre vêm com seguro, cheios de antiguidades caras. Eu não entendo muito dessas coisas, mas pela maneira como ela as manuseia, dá para ver que são seus tesouros.
target: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.

source: Os pacotes do pesquisador Baizhi pesam uma tonelada! Geralmente são pilhas de livros grossos e um monte de outras coisas estranhas. Diz que são para fins de pesquisa...
target: Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes...

source: Os parâmetros do cyberware continuam subindo... Que tipo de arquitetura tá controlando isso?
target: Cyberware benchmarks keep climbin'... What kinda architecture's driving this?
The poems will be sung again…

source: Os sons que se aproximam serão... belos o suficiente?
target: Will the approaching sounds be... beautiful enough?

source: Ossos sagrados apodrecem. Os céus se afogam na escuridão.
target: Sacred bones rot. Heavens drown in dark.

source: Otra... Otra más... ¡Otra ronda más, guerrero! ¡Quiero la revancha!
target: More... Get me more... One more round, Warrior! I want a rematch!

source: Ouais, j'ai besoin de me changer les idées.
target: Yeah, could use a little unwind.

source: Ouf, je peux produire plus de brouillard maintenant. Merci, je t'offrirai quelque chose de plus la prochaine fois.
target: Whew—I can make more mist now. Thanks, I'll offer you something extra next time.

source: Ouf. Ce n'est pas un mimique des légendes, cette fois-ci.
target: Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time.

source: Ouh ! Je sens l'effet du boost de puissance !
target: Woo! Can feel that juice kickin' in!

source: Oui, je suis là. Bien sûr, allez-y comme prévu. Au revoir.
target: ...Yes, I'm here. Of course. Proceed as planned. Bye-bye.

source: Oui… juste là. Encore une petite goutte… Parfait !
target: Yeah... right there. A little more drip... Perfect.

source: Oups, attention à mes épines. Ne te pique pas les doigts. Hmm... en y réfléchissant, pas grand chose ne peut te blesser de toute façon.
target: Oops, watch out for my thorns. Don't get your fingers pierced. Hmm... on second thought, not much can harm you anyway.
You dare test me? The insolence.

source: Ouviu isso? Uma estrela cintilante acabou de tilintar no chão!
target: Hear that? A twinkling star just tinkled to the ground!

source: Ouça, a presa está se escondendo.
Own, de onde você veio? Cadê o nenê?! É, você é um nenê! Que cachorrinho mais fofo! Tchauzinho.
target: Aww, where'd you come from? Who's a good baby?! Yes, you are! You're a good baby! Look how cute he is. Good boy, good boy. Aren't you cute. Buh-bye, see ya 'round!

source: Oye, tómatelo con calma. ¿Quieres uno también? ¿*Mmm*? Ja, ja.
target: Take it easy. Do you want one too? Hmm? Haha.

source: Oye, ¿estás libre el próximo fin de semana? ¿Te apetece venir al Bosque Bjartr conmigo? ¡Conozco un lugar secreto con mucha miel del atardecer! ¡Ñam!
target: Hey, are you free next weekend? Want to come with me to Bjartr Woods? I know a secret spot there with lots of Dusk Honeypots!

source: Où allons-nous ? Je peux vous guider.
target: Where to? I can lead the way for you.

source: Où que j'aille, je jure de vaincre le mal, qu'il soit à la lumière du jour ou caché dans l'obscurité.
target: Wherever I go, I swear to vanquish evil, whether it's out in the daylight or hiding in the dark.
Where are you, my lovely seeds?

source: Pagaré tu confianza... en otra vida.
target: I'll repay your trust... in another life.

source: Par le pouvoir de la Sentinelle.
Para mim, qualquer comida serve. Vamos lá, não complique! O melhor tempero é a fome!
target: For me, any food's fair game. C'mon, don't overthink it! When you're hungry enough, everything tastes amazing!

source: Para nosotros, los agentes encubiertos, las habilidades de lucha son solo lo mínimo. La clave del éxito es tener una voluntad inquebrantable.
target: For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.

source: Para nós, agentes secretos, habilidades de combate são apenas o mínimo necessário. A chave para o sucesso é ter uma vontade inabalável.
target: For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.

source: Para onde? Posso ir à sua frente.
target: Where to? I can lead the way for you.

source: Para todos los deseos formulados, ofrezco este recipiente.
target: For all wishes spoken, this vessel I offer.

source: Parabéns pra você, nesta data querida... Muitas felicidades, muitos anos de vida... É claro que esta música é especialmente para você.
target: Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... As always, this song is specially for you.

source: Paramètres variables, données empiriques, probabilités… Je vais m'appuyer sur l'ensemble de ces éléments afin d'optimiser notre efficacité.
target: Variable parameters, empirical data, potential probabilities... I'll take all of these into consideration to improve our efficiency.

source: Pardon, je ne peux rien faire…
Pare de conversa fiada. Diga-me o que você precisa e eu farei para você, desde que suas descrições sejam coerentes.
target: Quit the chit-chat. Tell me what you need and I'll make it for you, provided your descriptions are reasonable.

source: Parece que a mistura dos meus gestos exagerados e rosto impassível é hilária para as pessoas. Viu? Assim mesmo. Ah, eu consegui arrancar uma risada de você? Acho que vou continuar com esse estilo, então.
target: Apparently, the mix of my over-the-top gestures and stoic face is hilarious to people. See? Just like that. Oh, did I actually get a chuckle out of you? Guess I'll keep this style going, then.

source: Parece que a sorte está do meu lado hoje, hm?
target: Seems the scales tipped my way, hm?

source: Parece que consigo controlar mais Matéria do Vazio agora. Hmm... Ficar mais forte sempre é bom, né?
target: It feels like I can control more Voidmatter now. Hmm... Getting stronger is always a good thing, right?

source: Parece que hay una nueva pista.
Parece que hoy es mi día de suerte, ¿eh?
target: Seems the scales tipped my way, hm?

source: Parece que temos uma nova pista.
Parecia um supressor padrão, mas não tem nada a ver.
target: Looked like a standard immunoblocker, but this stuff feels totally different.

source: Parecía un inhibidor estándar, pero esta cosa entra diferente.
target: Looked like a standard immunoblocker, but this stuff feels totally different.

source: Pareço animada demais? Porque na verdade, estou. Tudo o que quero é continuar treinando com você.
target: Do I look overexcited? Because in truth, I am. All I want is to keep sparring with you.

source: Parfait. Les prothèses sont chargées à bloc.
Parfois, je me dis que tu devrais donner des cours. Avec tout ton savoir, tu captiverais sans aucun doute les étudiants.
target: ...Sometimes I think you could stand up there and teach the class yourself. With what you know, you'd own that classroom.

source: Parfois, je me laisse un peu emporter par les combats... Je ne vous ai pas effrayé, n'est-ce pas ?
target: Sometimes I get a little carried away in battles... I didn't startle you, did I?

source: Parfois, je prétends être un nuage dans le ciel... Juste à dériver comme un tas doux et moelleux, sans aucun souci.
target: Sometimes I pretend I was a cloud in the sky... Just drifting by as a soft and fluffy pile, without any worry.

source: Parfois, on a le droit de voler.
target: It's okay to fly sometimes, I guess.

source: Parler ne sert à rien, vérifions les résultats par l'action.
target: Talk is cheap. Show me the action.

source: Parlons calmement, pas besoin de violence.
target: Can't we just talk this out?

source: Parámetros variables, datos empíricos, probabilidades potenciales... Tomaré todo esto en consideración para mejorar nuestra eficiencia.
target: Variable parameters, empirical data, potential probabilities... I'll take all of these into consideration to improve our efficiency.

source: Parâmetros variáveis, dados empíricos, probabilidades potenciais... Levarei tudo isso em consideração pra melhorar nossa eficiência.
target: Variable parameters, empirical data, potential probabilities... I'll take all of these into consideration to improve our efficiency.

source: Pas besoin de retenir tes coups.
Pas besoin de se précipiter. Tout se passera en temps voulu.
target: No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time.
Worry not... Just need a moment.

source: Pas de bavardage. Tant que le besoin est raisonnable, donnez-le moi, je vous aiderai à le réaliser.
target: Quit the chit-chat. Tell me what you need and I'll make it for you, provided your descriptions are reasonable.

source: Pas de chasse digne de ce nom sans trésor !
target: A hunt isn't complete without a prize.

source: Pas de munitions, sérieux ? C'est qui qui s'occupe des réserves ?
target: Ugh, no ammo? Who stocks these things?

source: Pas de précipitation, il y aura toujours des ennemis qui ne pourront pas se retenir et qui se présenteront à la porte.
target: No rush. The impatient ones will fall right into our lap.

source: Pas mal, je suis devenu plus fort... Peut-être que je devrais réfléchir à la façon de te remercier ?
target: Good. That did make me stronger... Should I start thinking about how to repay you?

source: Pas mal. Il faut pas perdre la main.
target: Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

source: Pas un seul coup ne manque !
Pass auf, dass es keiner sieht.
target: Make sure no one sees it.

source: Patrouilleurin, Chixia. Du kannst dich immer auf mich verlassen, wenn du dich mal in einer Zwickmühle befindest!
target: Jinzhou Patroller, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!

source: Patrulha de Jinzhou, Chixia. Sempre me chame se você estiver numa enrascada!
target: Jinzhou Patroller, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!

source: Patrulheiro, Danjin. Não se preocupe, minha Lâmina Carmesim não te fará mal, desde que você não tenha feito nada de errado.
target: Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad.

source: Patrullera de Jinzhou, Chixia. ¡Siempre puedes contar conmigo si te encuentras en un apuro!
target: Jinzhou Patroller, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!

source: Pegue este telescópio e veja com seus próprios olhos... Até as nuvens mais altas parecem estar ao alcance das mãos, não é? Com este aparelho, você vai capturar toda a emoção do palco e cada "novo mundo" que nos espera no mar.
target: Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea.

source: Pegue. Você encontrará uma utilidade para isso.
target: Take it. You will find a use for it.
For the Stories, She Shall Sing

source: Perdido en la niebla del tiempo.
target: Lost in the mist of time.
Lost in the mist of time.

source: Perguntando sobre meu cyberware? Imagino que não tenha um scanner. Foi mal, mas não tenho interesse em falar sobre mim nem sobre minhas especificações... Prefiro mudar de assunto.
target: ...Askin' about my cyberware? Guess you're not sportin' a scanner. Sorry, but I ain't interested in talking about me or my specs... Rather change the subject.

source: Permaneçam firmes diante do sol eterno!
target: Stand tall before the eternal sun!

source: Pero disse estar grata por chegar tão longe, graças a você... Aham. Desculpe, risque isso. Pero nunca disse nada disso. Quem disse foi eu, Roccia. Era isso que eu queria te dizer.
target: Pero said she's grateful for how far she's come, thanks to you... Ahem. Sorry, scratch that. Pero never actually said any of that. It's all me, Roccia. Those are the things I've been wanting to tell you.

source: Pero disse que está se sentindo bem. Prepare-se para a dança da alegria dela!
target: Pero said she's feeling good. Get ready for her happy dance!

source: Pero disse que finalmente tem o poder de proteger todos que ama.
target: Pero said she finally has the power to protect everyone she cares about.

source: Pero disse que gosta ainda mais de você agora. Parece que sua força e confiança estão crescendo rapidamente.
target: Pero said she likes you even more now. Seems her strength and confidence are growing fast.

source: Pero disse que é capaz de derrotar cem inimigos com um soco!
target: Pero said she's feeling like she can take out a hundred foes with one punch!

source: Pero dit qu'elle est de bonne humeur. Prépare-toi à voir sa danse de la joie !
target: Pero said she's feeling good. Get ready for her happy dance!

source: Pero dit qu'elle est enfin suffisamment forte pour protéger toutes celles et tous ceux qui comptent pour elle.
target: Pero said she finally has the power to protect everyone she cares about.

source: Pero dit qu'elle est reconnaissante pour tous les progrès qu'elle a accomplis grâce à toi... Ahem. Non, oublie ça. Pero n'a rien dit du tout. C'est moi, Roccia. Ce sont toutes les choses que je voulais te dire.
target: Pero said she's grateful for how far she's come, thanks to you... Ahem. Sorry, scratch that. Pero never actually said any of that. It's all me, Roccia. Those are the things I've been wanting to tell you.

source: Pero dit qu'elle se sent capable d'éliminer cent adversaires d'un seul coup de poing !
target: Pero said she's feeling like she can take out a hundred foes with one punch!

source: Pero dit qu'elle t'apprécie encore plus, maintenant. On dirait que sa force et son assurance se développent rapidement.
target: Pero said she likes you even more now. Seems her strength and confidence are growing fast.

source: Pero knurrt der Magen. Gib mir Inspirationen, na los!
target: Pero's tummy is rumbling. Inspiration, don't be shy!

source: Pero sagt, sie danke dir für deinen positiven Einfluss auf ihre Entwicklung … Ähm. Sorry, vergiss das wieder. Pero hat das alles nie gesagt. Das kommt von mir, Roccia. Ich wollte dir diese Dinge sagen.
target: Pero said she's grateful for how far she's come, thanks to you... Ahem. Sorry, scratch that. Pero never actually said any of that. It's all me, Roccia. Those are the things I've been wanting to tell you.

source: Pero sagt, sie fühlt sich wohl. Gleich tanzt sie vor Freude!
target: Pero said she's feeling good. Get ready for her happy dance!

source: Pero sagt, sie habe das Gefühl, dass sie hundert Gegner mit einem Schlag erledigen kann!
target: Pero said she's feeling like she can take out a hundred foes with one punch!

source: Pero sagt, sie habe endlich die Kraft, ihre Liebsten zu beschützen.
target: Pero said she finally has the power to protect everyone she cares about.

source: Pero sagt, sie würde dich jetzt noch mehr mögen. Sie wird scheinbar immer stärker und selbstbewusster.
target: Pero said she likes you even more now. Seems her strength and confidence are growing fast.

source: Peros Koffer ist mehr als nur eine Schatzkiste. Ich liege darin auch zum Entspannen. Er ist größer als er aussieht und ich verwahre all meine nützlichen Hilfsmittel darin. Willst du mal sehen? Klopf, klopf – Mach auf, Pero.
target: Pero's box is more than just a treasure trove. It's my private lounge as well. It's bigger than you might think, and I've stashed all my nifty gadgets inside. Would you like a tour? Knock, knock—open up, Pero.

source: Peroท้องร้องแล้ว แรงบันดาลใจจ๋า ไม่ต้องเขินนะ!
target: Pero's tummy is rumbling. Inspiration, don't be shy!

source: Peroบอกว่าตอนนี้เธอมีพลังพอที่จะปกป้องทุกคนที่เธอห่วงใยแล้ว
target: Pero said she finally has the power to protect everyone she cares about.

source: Peroบอกว่าเธอกำลังอารมณ์ดี เตรียมรับชมการเต้นแสนสุขของเธอได้เลย!
target: Pero said she's feeling good. Get ready for her happy dance!

source: Peroบอกว่าเธอชอบคุณยิ่งกว่าเดิมอีกนะ เธอดูเหมือนจะแข็งแกร่งและมั่นใจยิ่งขึ้นอย่างรวดเร็วเลยล่ะ
target: Pero said she likes you even more now. Seems her strength and confidence are growing fast.

source: Peroบอกว่าเธอซาบซึ้งมากที่เธอมาถึงจุดนี้ได้ ต้องขอบคุณคุณจริงๆ... อะแฮ่ม ขอโทษที ช่วยลืมๆ ไปก่อนนะ เพราะ Pero ไม่ได้พูดอะไรแบบนั้นหรอก แต่เป็นฉันเอง Roccia ที่พูดไปเมื่อกี้คือสิ่งที่ฉันอยากบอกคุณมาโดยตลอด
target: Pero said she's grateful for how far she's come, thanks to you... Ahem. Sorry, scratch that. Pero never actually said any of that. It's all me, Roccia. Those are the things I've been wanting to tell you.

source: Peroบอกว่าเธอรู้สึกแกร่งพอที่จะกำจัดศัตรูนับร้อยด้วยหมัดเดียวเลย!
target: Pero said she's feeling like she can take out a hundred foes with one punch!

source: Perri dice que ahora le gustas aún más. Parece que su fuerza y confianza están creciendo como la espuma.
target: Pero said she likes you even more now. Seems her strength and confidence are growing fast.

source: Perri dice que al fin tiene la fuerza para proteger a todos los que le importan.
target: Pero said she finally has the power to protect everyone she cares about.

source: Perri dice que está agradecida por lo lejos que ha llegado, gracias a ti... Ejem. Lo siento, borra eso. Perri nunca dijo nada de eso. Todo eso son cosas mías. Son todas las cosas que yo quería decirte.
target: Pero said she's grateful for how far she's come, thanks to you... Ahem. Sorry, scratch that. Pero never actually said any of that. It's all me, Roccia. Those are the things I've been wanting to tell you.

source: Perri dice que se siente bien. ¡Prepárate para su baile feliz!
target: Pero said she's feeling good. Get ready for her happy dance!

source: Perri tiene un hambre tremenda. ¡Inspiración, no te tardes!
target: Pero's tummy is rumbling. Inspiration, don't be shy!

source: Peu importe où cela mène… cette fois, je suis partante à 100 %.
target: No matter where this leads… This battle, I'm all in.

source: Peu peu peu!! PÁ PÁ PÁ! Hahaha!
Peut-être qu'un jour, Encore ira partout dans le monde et sera aussi un héros. Hehe, mais d'abord, qu'est-ce qu'il y a pour le petit déjeuner demain ?
target: Maybe one day, Encore will go everywhere in the world and be a hero too. Hehe, but first, what's for breakfast tomorrow?

source: Pff … Das ist noch gar nichts.
target: Tch… You haven't seen anything yet.

source: Pff … Das war ein Server-Lag. Das zählt nicht.
target: Pff... That was server lag. Doesn't count.

source: Pff... Eso fue lag del servidor. No cuenta.
target: Pff... That was server lag. Doesn't count.

source: Pff... Isso foi lag do servidor. Não conta.
target: Pff... That was server lag. Doesn't count.

source: Pfff, maintenant il faut que je rédige un rapport.
target: Ugh, now I have a report to write.

source: Pfft, du hast Glück, dass du mich getroffen hast - die unbestrittene Meisterin der Antiquitätenbewertung! Was haben wir denn hier? Gib mir deine Schätze und ich schaue sie mir an!
target: Huh, you're lucky to have come across me—the undisputed master of antique appraisal! Now, what do we have here? Hand over your goodies and I'll take a look!

source: Pfft, tu as de la chance de m'avoir croisée, maître incontesté de l'expertise d'antiquités ! Alors, que nous avons-nous là ? Donne-moi tes trésors et je vais jeter un œil !
target: Huh, you're lucky to have come across me—the undisputed master of antique appraisal! Now, what do we have here? Hand over your goodies and I'll take a look!

source: Pff… C'était à cause du lag. Ça compte pas.
target: Pff... That was server lag. Doesn't count.

source: Pfiou, c'est en faisant chaque jour un petit pas qu'on parcourt un long chemin.
target: ...Phew, a long journey starts with a single step.

source: Piment Champion ! Cette sauce est si bonne, tu pourrais manger une vieille chaussure avec.
target: Victor Savor! That sauce is so good, you'll munch an old shoe with it.

source: Piou piou piou ! Bang bang bang ! Ahaha !
Pizza ist das Beste. Billig, einfach und vor allem guter Partystoff. Perfekt zum Teilen, wenn man mit seiner Crew abhängt.
target: Pizza is peak. Cheap, easy and, most importantly, it's great party fuel. Perfect for sharin' while kickin' it with the crew.

source: Pizza é o máximo. Barata, fácil e, mais importante, é combustível pras festas. Ótima pra dividir enquanto relaxa com a equipe.
target: Pizza is peak. Cheap, easy and, most importantly, it's great party fuel. Perfect for sharin' while kickin' it with the crew.

source: Plane mit Konventionen, dann besiege durch Einfallsreichtum.
target: Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.

source: Planeje com convenção, depois conquiste com engenho.
target: Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.

source: Planifica con convención, luego conquista con ingenio.
target: Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.

source: Planifiez avec convention, puis conquérez par ingéniosité.
target: Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.

source: Plonge dans les enfers, une dernière fois.
target: Take your final dive, into Naraka.

source: Plus de paperasse ? Voyons voir... *sourire satisfait* Tout est prêt. Maintenant, que dois-je prendre pour le dîner ?
target: More paperwork? Let's see... *satisfied smile* All set. Now, what should I have for dinner?

source: Plus de puissance... Avec ça, nous sommes à l'épreuve des tempêtes ! Allons-y, à toute vitesse !
target: More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead!

source: Plus loin que moi. Plus loin que chaque début et chaque fin de l'histoire. Jusqu'à ce que nous réécrivions notre destin.
target: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.

source: Plus… Toujours plus… Encore une manche, camarade guerrier ! Je veux ma revanche !
target: More... Get me more... One more round, Warrior! I want a rematch!

source: Pode ser avassalador com tantas pessoas contando com você. Eu conheço bem esse sentimento... Não se preocupe. Você pode relaxar um pouco mais quando está comigo.
target: It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me.

source: Poder celestial, dissipe todas as sombras!
Por Ela Mesma, Ela Deve Cantar
Por favor, fique com eles. Espero que sejam úteis.
target: Please have them. I hope they will prove useful.

source: Por favor, llévatelo. Espero que te sirva.
target: Please have them. I hope they will prove useful.

source: Por favor, no te alejes demasiado de mí.
target: Please don't stay too far away from me.

source: Por favor, no te preocupes. Lo tengo bajo control.
target: Please don't worry. I've got it in check.

source: Por favor, não fique muito longe de mim.
target: Please don't stay too far away from me.

source: Por favor, não... olhe para mim.
Por favor, não... tenha pena de mim.

target: For the Stories, She Shall Sing

source: Por que hesitar, se você sabe o que quer?
target: Why hesitate, if you know what you want?

source: Por que não saborear isso, hm?
Por todos os desejos pronunciados, ofereço este recipiente.
target: For all wishes spoken, this vessel I offer.

source: Por trás daquele sorriso encantador há puro aço. Só de ouvir a voz dela já me sinto inspirado — Heh, viu? Você é um professor melhor do que eu!
target: Behind that lovely smile is pure steel. I feel inspired just hearing her voice—Heh, see? You're a better teacher than I am!

source: Por uma jornada segura à frente.
target: Here's to a safe journey ahead.

source: Porté par les rapides, j'ai vu une lueur dorée... Ta sagesse et ta grâce sont devenues un évangile que je chérirai à jamais.
target: Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear.
Anything I can help you with?
Can I keep going like this?

source: Posso fazer isso o dia todo!
target: I can do this all day!

source: Posso orar por algo específico para você? Seria uma honra para mim... Tenho certeza de que seus desejos se tornarão realidade.
target: May I pray for anything specific for you? It would be my honor… I'm sure your wishes will come true.

source: Posso preparar um jarro de suco de Violaca para você? Ele acalma os nervos e alivia a fadiga. Você precisa aprender a relaxar. Não pode ajudar os outros se não cuidar de si mesmo, sabe.
target: Can I mix you a jug of Violaca juice? It soothes nerves and eases fatigue. You must learn to relax. You can't help others if you don't take care of yourself, you know.

source: Posso sentir um aumento na minha força. Suponho que você também seja experiente na arte do treinamento, não é?
target: I can sense an improvement in my strength. I suppose you are well-versed in the art of training, too?

source: Posso separar uns minutos para um pouco de pancadaria.
target: I can spare a minute to knock some heads around.

source: Posso ter qualquer outra coisa que eu queira além de poder? Pense bem antes de responder. Uma vez que você disser, não vou parar até conseguir.
target: Can I have anything else I want other than power? Think carefully before you answer. Once you say it, I won't stop until I get it.
Can I trade these for desserts?

source: Pouah, le thé nature est si amer ! Qui aime ça ? Je trouverai bien une occasion de le verser dans la tasse celui qui m'embête. Hé hé !
target: Ugh, plain tea is so bitter! Who even likes that? I'll just find a chance to dump it in the cup of whoever bothers me next time. Hehe!

source: Pour bâtir en grand, il faut commencer petit.

Pour elle, j'ai toujours été une choom, un membre de la bande. Pourtant, malgré tout le temps passé ensemble, je me suis jamais ouverte à elle. C'est seulement après qu'elle soit partie que j'ai réalisé… tout ce que j'avais manqué de lui dire.
target: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

source: Pour info, je demande peu pour évaluer les antiquités, mais combattre aura un prix différent !
target: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!
For the Stories, She Shall Sing

source: Pour moi, n'importe quel plat fait l'affaire. Bon, ne te prends pas la tête ! Quand on a vraiment faim, tout est délicieux !
target: For me, any food's fair game. C'mon, don't overthink it! When you're hungry enough, everything tastes amazing!

source: Pour tracer de nouvelles routes pour Loulou Logistique, l'entraînement physique est indispensable.
target: To chart new routes for Lollo Logistics, physical training is a must.

source: Pour un agent infiltré, la force est la base pour accomplir la mission, mais le plus important est un esprit robuste.
target: For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.

source: Pour être prêt à tout moment.
Pourquoi hésiter si l'on connaît bien ce qu'on cherche ?
target: Why hesitate, if you know what you want?

source: Pourquoi ne pas savourer cela, hm?
Precisa de um médico? Por acaso eu estou livre.
target: Need a doctor? I happen to be free.

source: Precisa falar com Aalto? Aqui está o contato dele. Mencione meu nome para um desconto de vinte por cento.
target: Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.

source: Precisión, elegancia y armonía... Estas son las hermosas paralelas entre la música clásica y la ciencia.
target: Precision, elegance, and harmony... These are the beautiful parallels between classical music and science.

source: Precisão, elegância e harmonia... Estas são as belas semelhanças entre a música clássica e a ciência.
target: Precision, elegance, and harmony... These are the beautiful parallels between classical music and science.

source: Prendre le temps pour se détendre de temps en temps permet de mieux resonner avec le monde.
Prendre un peu de temps pour soi n'est pas une mauvaise idée.
target: It's nice to take a break once in a while.

source: Prends ça, c'est dédicacé par moi !
target: Tie a bow and call that my signature!

source: Prends ça. Tu auras l'occasion de l'utiliser.
target: Take it. You will find a use for it.
Please have them. I hope they will prove useful.

source: Prenez-le, le don de la civilisation.
Presentamos un poema y su final.
target: Now presenting, a poem of finale.

source: Preso pelo Qi sombrio, seguido por espíritos... parece um incômodo e tanto. Mas já estou acostumado. E como agora eles obedecem aos meus comandos, acho que não é tão ruim.
target: Bound by Nether Qi, followed by spirits... sounds like a real hassle. But I'm used to it. And since they listen to my commands now, I suppose it's not so bad.

source: Presque pas de qi sombre. Tss. Coup de bol.
target: Barely any Nether Qi. Tch. Lucky find.

source: Prise de contrôle structurelle en cours.
Prise en charge du contrôle principal.
Probablemente sea por mi falta de expresividad. Mucha gente piensa que soy «difícil de abordar». No es que la gente no me guste, es que no sé cómo hacerlo natural.
target: It's probably my lack of facial expressions. A lot of people think I'm "difficult to approach." It's not that I dislike anyone. I just don't know... how to approach people in a natural way.

source: Problemas? No Palácio de Éforo, não é raro encontrar desafios, mas contanto que alguém esteja disposto a "lutar", tudo se resolverá com o tempo através da determinação. Heh, problemas que podem ser superados não são problemas de verdade.
target: Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.

source: Probleme? Im Palast des Ephors sind Herausforderungen nicht ungewöhnlich, aber solange man bereit zu kämpfen ist, lässt sich alles lösen. Hehe, lösbare Probleme sind keine echten Probleme.
target: Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.

source: Proteger a los demás... ¡es mi deber!
Proteger os outros... é meu dever!
Prouve-moi ta valeur, et je te rendrai la pareille.
target: Let's prove our value to each other.

source: Provavelmente é pela minha falta de expressões faciais. Muita gente acha que sou "difícil de abordar". Não é que eu não goste de ninguém. É só que não sei... como me aproximar das pessoas de forma natural.
target: It's probably my lack of facial expressions. A lot of people think I'm "difficult to approach." It's not that I dislike anyone. I just don't know... how to approach people in a natural way.

source: Prudence. Je le ressens. Aleph-1… est encore là.
target: Be careful. I can feel it, Aleph-1... It never really left.

source: Präzision, Eleganz und Harmonie... Das sind die schönen Parallelen zwischen klassischer Musik und Wissenschaft.
target: Precision, elegance, and harmony... These are the beautiful parallels between classical music and science.

source: Précision, élégance, harmonie, c'est la beauté commune de la musique classique et de la science.
target: Precision, elegance, and harmony... These are the beautiful parallels between classical music and science.

source: Prévoir à l'avance, être prêt à tout.
target: Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.

source: Prêt à partir à tout moment !
Pssst. Willst du ein Geheimnis hören? Dieser seltsame große Kerl, mit dem Aalto gearbeitet hat, ist eigentlich... ein Hunde-Mensch! Deshalb ist er ein großer Hund in Encores Geschichten!
target: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!

source: Pssst. ¿Quieres oír un secreto? ¡Ese extraño tipo grande con el que Aalto ha estado trabajando es en realidad... una persona perruna! ¡Por eso es un gran perrito en las historias de Encore!
target: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!

source: Psst … Das bleibt unter uns, okay?
target: Shh... Keep this between us, will you?

source: Psst. Quer ouvir um segredo? Aquele cara estranho e grande com quem Aalto tem trabalhado é na verdade... uma pessoa canina! É por isso que ele é um grande cachorro nas histórias de Encore!
target: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!

source: Psst. Tu veux entendre un secret ? Ce grand gars étrange avec qui Aalto travaille est en fait... un amoureux des chiens ! C'est pourquoi il est un grand chien dans les histoires d'Encore !
target: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!

source: Psst … was macht ihr alle hier? Ah, tut mir leid, {PlayerName}, wollte dich nicht stören. Ich wollte dich nur besuchen. Hätte nicht gedacht, dass alle mitkommen …
target: Shhh.... how come you're all here? Ah, sorry {PlayerName}, didn't mean to disturb you. I just wanted to pay you a visit. Didn't expect these guys to tag along...

source: Pst … Wenn du dich wehrst, tut es nur noch mehr weh.
target: Shh... Struggling only pains you more.

source: Puede que no recuerdes poder, pero siempre puedes extraer poder de los recuerdos.
target: You may not have memories of power, but you can always draw strength from memories.

source: Puede ser abrumador con tantas personas contando contigo. Conozco esa sensación demasiado bien... No te preocupes. Puedes relajarte un poco más cuando estás conmigo.
target: It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me.

source: Puedes confiar en mí para mantenerte a salvo.
target: You can trust me to keep you safe.

source: Puedo percibir un aura peligrosa en la forma de luchar de Danjin... Me preocupa que pueda tener demasiado peso en sus hombros a tan temprana edad.
target: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.

source: Puedo sentir una mejora en mi fuerza. ¿Supongo que también estás bien versado en el arte de la formación, verdad?
target: I can sense an improvement in my strength. I suppose you are well-versed in the art of training, too?

source: Puedo sentirlo en mi corazón, ambos tenemos algo que defenderemos ferozmente, una causa por la que vale la pena luchar... Y no nos rendiremos, sin importar lo que cueste.
target: I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes.
Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time.
Phew. In the nick of time.

source: Puh—Ich kann jetzt mehr Nebel erzeugen. Danke, nächstes Mal gebe ich dir etwas extra.
target: Whew—I can make more mist now. Thanks, I'll offer you something extra next time.

source: Puis-je avoir autre chose que le pouvoir ? Réfléchis bien avant de répondre. Dès que tu l'auras dit, je ne m'arrêterai pas avant de l'avoir obtenu.
target: Can I have anything else I want other than power? Think carefully before you answer. Once you say it, I won't stop until I get it.

source: Puis-je faire un vœu spécifique pour toi ? Ce serait un honneur… Je suis sûr que tes souhaits se réaliseront.
target: May I pray for anything specific for you? It would be my honor… I'm sure your wishes will come true.

source: Puis-je te préparer un pichet de jus de Violaca ? Il apaise les nerfs et soulage la fatigue. Tu dois apprendre à te détendre. N'oublie pas de prendre soin de toi pendant que tu t'occupes des autres.
target: Can I mix you a jug of Violaca juice? It soothes nerves and eases fatigue. You must learn to relax. You can't help others if you don't take care of yourself, you know.

source: Puisque tu as fait tout cela... Dites-moi, peu importe à quel point ton rêve est irréalisable, je le réaliserai.
target: Fine, since you've done this much for me... Go ahead, tell me the wildest inventions you can think of, and watch me make them happen for you.

source: Puisque tu as parcouru tout ce chemin, pourquoi ne pas mettre ta force à l'épreuve face à des adversaires plus puissants ?
target: Since you've come this far, why not cross blades with mightier foes and test your mettle?

source: Puisse cet or devenir ton épée la plus fidèle.
target: May this gold become your most reliable blade.

source: Qingxiao จอมอัศวินรักษ์เสวียนฟาง ผู้ฝึกบำเพ็ญที่รักสันโดษ "กาลผันผ่านเนิ่นนาน เมื่อได้กลับมาพบพาน ณ ที่นี้ จงถือกระบี่ร่วมเดินทางกันเถิด"
target: Xuan Paragon, Qingxiao, a seeker of the Way. Time's endless flow has brought you back to me. Take up your blade, and let us walk this path together.

source: Qingxiao, Xuan-Meisterin, Suchende des Weges. Der endlose Fluss der Zeit hat dich zu mir zurückgebracht. Nimm dein Schwert und lass uns diesen Weg gemeinsam gehen.
target: Xuan Paragon, Qingxiao, a seeker of the Way. Time's endless flow has brought you back to me. Take up your blade, and let us walk this path together.

source: Qingxiao, cavalière de Xuan, en quête de la Voie. Le temps, dans son courant infini, t'a ramenée jusqu'à moi. Prends ta lame, et marchons ensemble sur cette voie.
target: Xuan Paragon, Qingxiao, a seeker of the Way. Time's endless flow has brought you back to me. Take up your blade, and let us walk this path together.

source: Qingxiao, la Parangón Xuan, una seguidora del Camino. El eterno flujo del tiempo te ha devuelto a mí. Empuña tu espada y acompáñame por este sendero.
target: Xuan Paragon, Qingxiao, a seeker of the Way. Time's endless flow has brought you back to me. Take up your blade, and let us walk this path together.

source: Qiuyuan จงใช้งานฉันประหนึ่งศัสตราคู่กาย จะชี้คมไปทางใดก็สุดแต่ใจบัญชา
target: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

source: Qiuyuan, eine Klinge, die auf deinen Befehl gezogen wird. Führe mich, wie es dir beliebt.
target: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

source: Qiuyuan, uma lâmina desembainhada à sua palavra. Empunhe-me como desejar.
target: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

source: Qiuyuan, una hoja desenvainada a tu servicio. Úsame como quieras.
target: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

source: Qu'as-tu fait aujourd'hui ? T'es-tu amusé ? As-tu vu quelque chose de cool ? Allez, dis-moi tout ! Encore adore les histoires ! Et les sentiments que les gens partagent... c'est comme une histoire après l'autre !
target: What have you been up to today? Did you have fun? Saw anything cool? C'mon, spill the beans! Encore loves stories! And the feelings people share... they're like one story after another!
What is it you wish for?

source: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a à être difficile ? Je suis content avec n'importe quel plat, tant qu'il remplit mon estomac.
target: What's there to be picky about? I'm good with any food, as long as it fills my tummy.
Hmm. What's it gonna be this time?

source: Qualquer coisa que dê muito trabalho pra comer... é inconveniente.
target: Anything that takes too much work to eat... simply because it's a hassle.

source: Qualquer coisa sem graça. Não é ódio, é só... um gatilho de tempos ruins. Apaga o mundo por um instante. Então meu lema permanece, para tudo: Vá com ousadia. Vá com brilho. Seja interessante.
target: Anything bland. It's not hate, it's just... a trigger of some bad times. Washes the world out for a minute. So my motto stands, for everything: Go bold. Go bright. Never be boring.

source: Qualquer detalhe ao longo do caminho pode se tornar uma informação valiosa.
target: Any detail along the way could become valuable intel.

source: Quand il n'est plus possible de raisonner avec les méchants, il faut laisser parler les armes ! C'est pourquoi je travaille sur de nouvelles batteries de rayons laser !
target: When you can't reason with the bad guys, let your weapons do the talking! That's why I've been working on new laser beam arrays!

source: Quand j'ai rencontré Yangyang pour la première fois, je me demandais comment quelqu'un pouvait toujours être si doux. Plus tard, j'ai finalement compris comment la douceur avec des limites pouvait avoir une force puissante.
target: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.

source: Quand je cuisine, j'ai l'impression que les saveurs ne se mélangent jamais, comme si les ingrédients et les assaisonnements étaient en désaccord... Est-ce que ça te dirait d'y goûter ? Euh, je devrais m'entraîner davantage avant que tu n'essaies…
target: When I cook, it feels like the flavors never blend, like the ingredients and seasonings are at odds… Are-are you interested in tasting it? Um, I'll have to practice more before you try it…

source: Quand je me transforme en Fleurdelys pour combattre, je dois constamment me rappeler qui je suis. Mes manières, mon ton… Tout doit être serein et solennel… Ah ! C'est très dur, tu sais ? Je te jure !
target: ...Whenever I transform into Fleurdelys for battle, I have to constantly remind myself—My manners, my tone... everything has to be composed and solemn... Ah! It's actually really hard, you know? Truly!

source: Quand je vois le bazar que ces ivrognes laissent derrière eux... Hmph, j'ai juste envie de balancer tout l'alcool du monde dans l'océan.
target: Every time I see the mess those drunkards leave behind... Ugh, I just want to dump all the booze into the ocean.

source: Quand la viande est fumée ou rôtie, elle a le goût de... Laisse tomber.
target: After meat is smoked or roasted, its taste is similar to... Never mind.

source: Quand le vrai sens est dévoilé, les runes s'illuminent.
target: When the True Name is unveiled, the rune illuminates.

source: Quand les ailes se déploient, le silence résonne !

Quand on enchaîne les combats, est-ce que tu te sens fatigué ? Je veux devenir plus forte, plus sage et meilleure. Je veux que tu puisses compter sur moi et que je sois ta plus fidèle camarade guerrière.
target: As we advance from one battle to the next, do you ever feel tired? I want to become stronger, wiser, and better. I want to be someone who's got your back, to be your... most trusted Fellow Warrior.

source: Quand on veut, on se sert.
Quand tu deviens un adulte, tu dois avoir un visage sérieux tous les jours, tu le sais ? Les adultes ont beaucoup de mal !
target: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!

source: Quand vous avez le temps, que diraiz-vous de faire une promenade ensemble ? Le monde a une toute autre allure quand vous n'avez pas de destination précise en tête. Essayez-le, peut-être ?
target: When you have the time, how about we take a walk together? The world is going to look very different when you don't have a particular destination in mind. Want to give it a try?

source: Quando conheci Yangyang, fiquei curioso sobre como alguém poderia ser sempre tão amável. Mais tarde, aprendi que a gentileza com limites possui uma força poderosa em si mesma.
target: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.

source: Quando eu cozinho, parece que os sabores nunca se misturam, como se os ingredientes e temperos estivessem em dissonância... Vo-você está interessado em provar? Hum, vou ter que praticar mais antes de você experimentar...
target: When I cook, it feels like the flavors never blend, like the ingredients and seasonings are at odds… Are-are you interested in tasting it? Um, I'll have to practice more before you try it…

source: Quando o Nome Verdadeiro é revelado, a runa se ilumina.
target: When the True Name is unveiled, the rune illuminates.

source: Quando você não consegue conversar com os vilões, deixe suas armas falarem! Por isso tenho trabalhado em novos conjuntos de raios laser!
target: When you can't reason with the bad guys, let your weapons do the talking! That's why I've been working on new laser beam arrays!

source: Quando você tiver tempo, que tal darmos um passeio juntos? O mundo vai parecer muito diferente quando você não tem um destino específico em mente. Quer tentar?
target: When you have the time, how about we take a walk together? The world is going to look very different when you don't have a particular destination in mind. Want to give it a try?

source: Quase nada de Qi sombrio. Tsc. Um achado de sorte.
target: Barely any Nether Qi. Tch. Lucky find.

source: Que Su amor perdure por siempre y nunca cese.
target: May Thy love endure forever, never ceasing.

source: Que Teu amor perdure para sempre, sem jamais cessar.
target: May Thy love endure forever, never ceasing.

source: Que Votre amour dure à jamais.
target: May Thy love endure forever, never ceasing.

source: Que a tempestade ataque com mais força!
Que as cerejeiras se incinerem. Queime este meu ser.
target: May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.

source: Que as riquezas cheguem, que as festas se multipliquem!
Que bênçãos alegres a Divindade traz.
Que dis-tu d'une petite mélodie avant de partir ?
target: How about a melody before we depart?

source: Que el Centinela guíe a los perdidos.
target: May the Sentinel guide those who are lost.

source: Que el sol sea testigo mientras la gloria nos rinde homenaje.
target: With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us.

source: Que essa força ajude Exotitã a proteger Lahai-Roi por eras vindouras.
target: May this strength help the Exostrider keep watch over Lahai-Roi for ages to come.
