source: Que esta fuerza ayude al Exotitán a vigilar Lahai-Roi por las eras venideras.
target: May this strength help the Exostrider keep watch over Lahai-Roi for ages to come.

source: Que esta jornada nos aproxime da verdade.
target: May this journey bring us closer to the truth.

source: Que este oro se convierta en tu arma más fiable.
target: May this gold become your most reliable blade.

source: Que este ouro se torne sua lâmina mais confiável.
target: May this gold become your most reliable blade.

source: Que este viaje nos acerque más a la verdad.
target: May this journey bring us closer to the truth.

source: Que expressão é essa no seu rosto? Surpreso em me ver?
target: What's that look on your face? Surprised to see me?
What form do you look for?

source: Que l'histoire de la Chevaleresse commence !
Que la lumière de la lune témoigne de ma volonté inébranlable.
target: May the moonlight attest my steadfast will.

source: Que la luz de la luna atestigüe mi voluntad inquebrantable.
target: May the moonlight attest my steadfast will.

source: Que la paix et la richesse bénissent cette terre pour de bon.
target: May peace and plenty bless this land for good.

source: Que la paz y la prosperidad bendigan esta tierra para siempre.
target: May peace and plenty bless this land for good.

source: Que la sakura se incinere. Abrasa a este ser.
target: May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.

source: Que la tempête frappe plus fort !
Que le monde soit mon fil.
Que le vent soit mon épée.
Que les sakuras réduisent tout en cendres. Qu'ils brûlent ce moi.
target: May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.

source: Que luzes radiantes! Espero que brilhem em cada sombra e não deixem sobrar escuridão para se esconder.
target: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.

source: Que momento perfeito, a sorte está do nosso lado!
Que nem hackear no modo fácil.
Que o Sentinela guie aqueles que estão perdidos.
target: May the Sentinel guide those who are lost.

source: Que o luar ateste minha vontade firme.
target: May the moonlight attest my steadfast will.

source: Que paz e abundância abençoem esta terra para sempre.
target: May peace and plenty bless this land for good.

source: Que pena. Apenas um passo em falso.
Que pense-je de vous ? Votre sourire... me semble chaleureux.
target: What do I think of you? Your smile... It looks warm.

source: Que penses-tu qu'il y a dans la « potion secrète » de la famille Fisalia ? Une herbe rare, cultivée en secret ? Des âmes perdues tourmentées par les murmures rancuniers dans ces halls ? Ou peut-être la chair délicate de jeunes filles ? Hé hé...
target: Tell me, what do you suppose goes into the Fisalia family's famed elixir? A rare herb, grown in secret? Tormented souls simmering in unseen cauldrons? Hehe... Or perhaps the delicate flesh of young girls?

source: Que poder místico... Se aplicado à pesquisa de Tacetita, nosso progresso será notável.
target: Such mystical power... If applied to Tacetite research, our progress will be remarkable.

source: Que significado você dará a eles?
target: What significance will you grant them?

source: Que tal esse truque de mágica?
target: How's that for a magic trick?

source: Que tal uma melodia antes de partirmos?
target: How about a melody before we depart?

source: Que tipo de história Encore vai ouvir hoje?
target: What kinda story will Encore hear today?

source: Que toutes les formes soient brisées !
Que... piada... de mau gosto...ALT: Você tá de sacanagem...

target: What significance will you grant them?

source: Quelle beauté… Elle doit périr, elle aussi.
target: Such beauty... so too must it end.
What form do you look for?

source: Quelle histoire vas-tu me raconter aujourd'hui ?
target: What kinda story will Encore hear today?

source: Quelqu'un a commenté mon poste ? Hum ? Quoi ?! Tu ne me crois pas ? Ah, tu es si têtu…
target: Someone commented on my post? Hmm? What?! Don't believe me? Ah, so stubborn...
Does anything here catch your interest?

source: Quem diria? Mais alguém com faro pra inspiração.
target: Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.

source: Quem estará sentado do outro lado do tabuleiro desta vez?
target: Who will be sitting on the other side of the board this time?

source: Quem vai afundar nas profundezas comigo?
target: Who will sink into the depths with me?

source: Quem é o pássaro enjaulado agora?
target: Who is the caged bird now?

source: Quer saber o que tem dentro? Hehe, você é adorável.
target: Excited for what's inside? Hehe, aren't you adorable.

source:
Quer tentar? Assim. Aqui.
Voou tão longe! Impressionante!
target:
Give it a try? Like this. Here.
It flew so far! Impressive!

source: Quero fazer o máximo que puder por todos que precisem, mas se eu assumir mais do que posso lidar só causaria problemas para aqueles que recebem minha ajuda e me sobrecarregaria ainda mais.
target: I want to do as much as I can for everyone in need, but if I take on more than I can handle... I guess it would only trouble those on the receiving end of my help, and burden me further.

source: Quero ficar ao lado de todos vocês... Do passado ao amanhã, seguindo juntos.
target: I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: Quero ficar ao lado de todos vocês... Do passado ao amanhã, seguindo juntos.
target: Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: Quero riqueza que não conheça fronteiras. Quero que as mercadorias encontrem seu caminho, que as pessoas encontrem seu lugar. Quero a luz calorosa de cada lar queimando, sempre queimando, para sempre.
target: I want wealth that knows no border. I want goods to find their way, people to find their place. I want the warm light of every home burning, always burning, forever.

source: Quero ser como você — me tornar o salvador.
target: I want to be like you—to become the savior.

source: Qui est l'oiseau en cage maintenant ?
target: Who is the caged bird now?

source: Qui sera assis de l'autre côté de la planche cette fois-ci ?
target: Who will be sitting on the other side of the board this time?

source: Qui va sombrer dans les profondeurs avec moi ?
target: Who will sink into the depths with me?

source: Qui veut aller loin ménage sa monture.
Qui vous a permis de vous approcher?
Quiero hacer todo lo que pueda por todos los que lo necesiten, pero si asumo más de lo que puedo manejar... Supongo que solo molestaría a aquellos que reciben mi ayuda, y me cargaría aún más.
target: I want to do as much as I can for everyone in need, but if I take on more than I can handle... I guess it would only trouble those on the receiving end of my help, and burden me further.

source: Quiero ser como tú y convertirme en la salvadora.
target: I want to be like you—to become the savior.

source: Quiero una riqueza sin fronteras. Quiero que los bienes encuentren su camino, que la gente encuentre su lugar. Quiero que la luz cálida de cada hogar siga ardiendo, siempre y para siempre.
target: I want wealth that knows no border. I want goods to find their way, people to find their place. I want the warm light of every home burning, always burning, forever.

source:
Quimera: *Aaah*, un manjar fresco...
Galbrena: Aléjate.
target:
Chimera: Ah, a fresh delicacy...
Galbrena: Back off.

source:
Quimera: Ah, uma iguaria fresca...
Galbrena: Fique longe.
target:
Chimera: Ah, a fresh delicacy...
Galbrena: Back off.

source: Quizás un día, Encore recorrerá todo el mundo y también será un héroe. Jeje, pero primero, ¿qué hay para el desayuno mañana?
target: Maybe one day, Encore will go everywhere in the world and be a hero too. Hehe, but first, what's for breakfast tomorrow?

source: Quoi qu'il arrive, quoi que j'aie vécu, ce pendentif de jade restera à jamais clair et lumineux.
target: No matter what happens, no matter what I've been through, this jade pendant will forever stay clear and bright.

source: Qué luces tan radiantes... que caigan sobre las sombras y no dejen oscuridad donde esconderse.
target: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.

source: Qué pena. Solo un paso en falso.
Qué poder... ¡Ya no habrá tormenta que pueda detenernos! ¡Adelante, a toda vela!
target: More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead!

source: RAWRRR! Hab dich erwischt, oder? Haha!
Rache ist nicht sinnloses Töten. Es geht darum, die Wurzel des Übels zu identifizieren und dort zu treffen, wo es wirklich wehtut. Danke, der Zug, den du mir beigebracht hast, war sehr nützlich.
target: Vengeance is not mindless killing. It is about identifying the root of malice, and hitting where it truly hurts. Thank you, the move you've taught me has been very useful.

source: Ranger, Danjin. Keine Sorge, meine Karmesinrote Klinge wird dir nicht schaden, solange du nichts Schlechtes getan hast.
target: Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad.

source: Ranger, Danjin. Ne t'inquiète pas, ma Lame écarlate ne te fera pas de mal tant que tu n'as rien fait de mal.
target: Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad.

source: Ranger, Danjin. No te preocupes, mi Espada Carmesí no te hará daño siempre que no hayas hecho nada malo.
target: Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad.

source: Rassurez-moi, on va pas suer, hein ?
target: Tell me there's no sweating involved.

source: Rayos, ahora tendré que hacer un informe.
target: Ugh, now I have a report to write.

source: Rebellenblau, Apolloorange, Warngelb, Säuregrün … Willst du raten, welche Farbe meine nächste Wahl ist?
target: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?

source: Recherche, sauvetage, transport, reconnaissance, combat de groupe... Les chiens sont loyaux et doués de nombreuses compétences. Moi ? Je n'ai pas de chiens. C'est trop dangereux... pour les chiens, c'est-à-dire.
target: Search, rescue, transportation, recon, group combat... Dogs are loyal and skilled in many ways. Me? I don't keep dogs. It's too dangerous... for the dogs, that is.

source: Recuerdo haber conocido al señor Calcharo cuando estaba recogiendo datos en la naturaleza. Al principio, no parecía muy accesible... pero luego me dio algunas semillas de flores, todas de especies súper raras. Es increíble.
target: I remember meeting Mr. Calcharo when I was out collecting data in the wild. At first, he didn't seem very approachable... but then he gave me some flower seeds, all super rare species. He's so awesome.

source: Reden ist Silber, Handeln ist Gold.
target: Talk is cheap. Show me the action.

source: Refinar as próprias habilidades é uma busca para toda a vida. Talvez possamos alcançar patamares ainda maiores juntos.
target: To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.

source: Refinar la propia habilidad es una búsqueda de por vida. Quizás podamos alcanzar mayores alturas juntos.
target: To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.

source: Regarde bien, Ravioli… Tu vois ? Réaliste, hein ?
target: Watch closely, Dumpling... See? Quite lifelike, isn't it?

source: Regarde par cette longue-vue... Même les nuages les plus hauts semblent à portée de main, n'est-ce pas ? Avec ce gadget, chaque frisson sur scène et chaque « nouveau monde » attendant au large.
target: Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea.

source: Regarde qui est là. Un visiteur rare. Heureusement, j'ai terminé mon travail pour aujourd'hui. Aimerais-tu me rejoindre pour une partie de Weiqi, si tu n'es pas pressé de partir ?
target: Ah, look who we have here. A rare visitor. Luckily, I've finished my work for today. Would you like to join me in a game of Weiqi, if you're not in a rush to leave?

source: Regarde-moi ce matos ! Ta Rebecca est armée jusqu'aux chicots maintenant ! Au prochain combat, pose-toi tranquille à côté de moi. Je te couvre !
target: Check the specs! Got yourself a fully-loaded Rebecca now! Next fight, just cozy up by me. I got your back!

source: Regarder les fleurs dans le brouillard.
target: Lost in the mist of time.

source: Reines Licht, lass den Himmel erbeben.
Reisnudeln sind mein absolutes Lieblingsessen! Mit Chili, einem Schuss Essig, ein paar Frühlingszwiebeln ... köstlich! Nächstes Mal, wenn du in Yuezhou bist, lade ich dich ein!
target: Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you!
Join me... in the World of Santu.

source: Relaxa, eu posso seguir as regras.
target: Relax, I can play by the rules.

source: Relájate, también puedo jugar según las reglas.
target: Relax, I can play by the rules.

source: Renn. Ich lösche dich an der Ziellinie.
target: Run. I'll erase you at the finish line.

source: Repentez-vous face à l'appel du silence.
Resolvo disputas em nome do Sentinela.
target: I resolve disputes in the Sentinel's name.

source: Respectez nos règles et ne nous trahissez jamais. Tant que je suis vivant, le nom des Chasseurs fantômes devrait suffire à vous accorder le libre règne sur le continent.
target: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.
Take a breath, I'm right here.

source: Respire un coup, je suis là.
target: Take a breath, I'm right here.

source: Restée ferme dans la danse finale
Resuelvo disputas en nombre del Centinela.
target: I resolve disputes in the Sentinel's name.

source: Resultado obtido... Desculpa, tô a caminho!
target: Calculation results... Sorry, I'm on my way.

source: Resultados del cálculo... perdón, ya voy.
target: Calculation results... Sorry, I'm on my way.

source: Rolinhos de vitelo feitos com carne fresca. Sou um tradicionalista de Septimont quando se trata de sabor. Um pouco de molho picante não tem problema, mas nada de creme azedo estranho. Não seja como os ragunnesi!
target: A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the Ragunnesi!

source: Rover, eu me juntei a você por ordens de minha senhora, e continuarei a com você nos dias que virão... E isso não tem nada a ver com os meus deveres. Fiz este juramento por vontade própria, apenas para você.
target: Rover. I joined your side because of my lady's orders, and I will continue to stay with you for the days to come... It has nothing to do with my duties now. I make this vow of my own volition, just for you.

source: Rover. Ich habe mich aufgrund der Befehle meiner Magistratin deiner Seite angeschlossen und werde auch in der Zukunft bei dir bleiben … Es hat nichts mit meinen derzeitigen Pflichten zu tun. Ich leiste diesen Schwur aus freien Stücken, nur für dich.
target: Rover. I joined your side because of my lady's orders, and I will continue to stay with you for the days to come... It has nothing to do with my duties now. I make this vow of my own volition, just for you.

source: Rédiger un rapport seul, après avoir effectué des recherches, est une expérience satisfaisante. Mes pensées et inspirations éparses se rassemblent pendant cette période, devenant claires et organisées.
target: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.

source: Résultats des calculs… Désolée, je suis en chemin.
target: Calculation results... Sorry, I'm on my way.

source: Sah aus wie normaler Hemmstoff, aber das Zeug fühlt sich ganz anders an.
target: Looked like a standard immunoblocker, but this stuff feels totally different.

source: Sai da frente! Quero dar uma olhada!
target: Outta my way! I want a look!

source: Sais-tu ce qui se trouve sous la base du Littoral noir ? Aalto et les autres ne me laissent jamais m'approcher. Gardent-ils des choses cool et effrayantes là-bas ?
target: Do you know what's under the Black Shores' base? Aalto and the others won't ever let me go near. Are they keeping cool stuff and scary things down there?

source: Saludo de apertura—¡Espíritus malignos, fuera, todo seguro y sano!
target: Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!

source: Saludos, Errante con el que me he encontrado en mi viaje. ¿Para qué viajas? ¿No puedes recordarlo bien? Hmm, no te preocupes. Estoy seguro de que lo redescubrirás en el camino.
target: Greetings, Rover whom I've come across in my journey. What are you travelling for? You can't quite recall? Hmm, no worries. I'm sure you will rediscover it along the way.

source: Saludos, Errante. Te escoltaré por el momento.
target: Greetings, Rover. I will escort you for the time being.

source: Saludos, mi nombre es Danjin. Actualmente estoy patrullando las tierras como una Ranger. Cuéntame sobre cualquier injusticia que hayas encontrado, y me encargaré de ello. ¿No puedes pensar en ninguna? Eso es bueno.
target: Greetings, my name is Danjin. I'm currently patrolling the lands as a ranger. Tell me about any injustice you've encountered, and I'll get it dealt with. You can't think of any? That's good.

source: Salut ! Je suis Aalto, votre courtier en informations. J'ai toutes les informations dont vous avez besoin à des prix équitables. La connaissance des différents endroits est la clé pour rester en tête quand vous êtes en déplacement. Un devis gratuit ?
target: Howdy! I'm Aalto, your go-to information broker. I've got all the info you need at fair prices. Knowledge about different places is key to staying ahead while you're out and about. Interested in a quote?

source: Salut, je m'appelle Lynae. Lynae tout court. Je suis nouvelle à Brandétoile. On est gentil avec la nouvelle, d'accord ?
target: Hey, name's Lynae. Just Lynae. Looks like I'm your new classmate here at Startorch Prep. So... be nice to the new girl, hmm?

source: Salut, je suis Lingyang. Tu as probablement l'habitude de me voir en tant que danseur de lion sur les poteaux, je suppose ? Passons plus de temps ensemble ! J'aimerais que tu te souviennes de mon visage - sans la tête de lion !
target: Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head!

source: Salut, je suis Taoqi, en charge de la défense des frontières au Ministère du Développement. Si tu as besoin de mon aide, envoyez-moi un message à tout moment. Je te répondrai pendant les heures de travail.
target: Hi there, I'm Taoqi, in charge of border defense at the Ministry of Development. If you need my help, shoot me a message any time. I'll get back to you during work hours.

source: Salut, moi c'est Sigrika ! Si tu as besoin d'aide pour déchiffrer les runes ou quoi que ce soit, n'hésite pas !
target: Hi, I'm Sigrika! Want to understand the meaning of runes? Need a hand with something? Then I'm the one to ask!

source: Salutations en entrant en scène - Que tous les maux soient écartés ! Que chaque année soit agréable !
target: Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!

source: Salutations, Nomade que j'ai rencontré lors de mon voyage. Pourquoi voyagez-vous ? Vous ne vous en souvenez pas ? Hmm, ne vous inquiétez pas. Je suis sûr que vous le redécouvrirez en cours de route.
target: Greetings, Rover whom I've come across in my journey. What are you travelling for? You can't quite recall? Hmm, no worries. I'm sure you will rediscover it along the way.

source: Salutations, Nomade. Je vous accompagnerai pour le moment.
target: Greetings, Rover. I will escort you for the time being.

source: Salutations, je m'appelle Danjin. Je patrouille actuellement les terres en tant que ranger. Parlez-moi de toute injustice que vous avez rencontrée, et je m'en occuperai. Vous n'en voyez aucune ? C'est bien.
target: Greetings, my name is Danjin. I'm currently patrolling the lands as a ranger. Tell me about any injustice you've encountered, and I'll get it dealt with. You can't think of any? That's good.

source: Sanhua est toujours calme et silencieuse. En tant que la gardienne, elle reste vigilante et alerte à tout moment. Mais Jinhsi et moi, nous souhaitons toujours qu'elle prenne un repos bien mérité et laisse les autres aider à porter le fardeau.
target: Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

source: Sanhua está sempre comportada e silenciosa. Como guarda-costas, ela permanece vigilante e alerta o tempo todo. Mas tanto Jinhsi quanto eu sempre desejamos que ela tire um merecido descanso e deixe que outros ajudem a carregar o fardo.
target: Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

source: Sanhua ist immer ruhig und still. Als Leibwächterin bleibt sie stets wachsam und aufmerksam. Aber sowohl Jinhsi als auch ich wünschen uns, dass sie sich eine wohlverdiente Pause gönnt und anderen erlaubt, die Last mitzutragen.
target: Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

source: Sanhua siempre está compuesta y en silencio. Como guardaespaldas, permanece vigilante y alerta en todo momento. Pero tanto Jinshi como yo siempre hemos deseado que ella tome un merecido descanso y deje que otros ayuden a llevar la carga.
target: Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

source: Sanhua มักจะสุขุมและเงียบขรึมอยู่เสมอ ในฐานะองครักษ์ประจำตัว เธอจะระแวดระวังและตื่นตัวอยู่เสมอ แต่ทั้ง Jinhsi และฉันต่างก็อยากให้เธอได้พักผ่อนอย่างเต็มที่ และปล่อยให้คนอื่นแบกรับภาระพวกนั้นบ้าง
target: Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

source: Saudação de abertura - Que todos os males sejam afastados! Que cada ano seja agradável!
target: Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!

source: Saudações! Aqui é a Lumi! Precisa enviar alguma correspondência? Estou pronta para ajudar como navegadora profissional da Logística Lollo!
target: Greetings! Lumi here! Need to send some mail? I've got you covered as Lollo Logistics' professional navigator!

source: Saudações, Rover que encontrei em minha jornada. Por que você está viajando? Não consegue se lembrar? Hmm, não se preocupe. Tenho certeza de que redescobrirá ao longo do caminho.
target: Greetings, Rover whom I've come across in my journey. What are you travelling for? You can't quite recall? Hmm, no worries. I'm sure you will rediscover it along the way.

source: Saudações, Rover. Eu vou te acompanhar, por enquanto.
target: Greetings, Rover. I will escort you for the time being.

source: Saudações, meu nome é Danjin. Atualmente estou patrulhando as terras como patrulheira. Conte-me sobre qualquer injustiça que você tenha encontrado e eu cuidarei para você. Não consegue pensar em nenhuma? Isso é bom.
target: Greetings, my name is Danjin. I'm currently patrolling the lands as a ranger. Tell me about any injustice you've encountered, and I'll get it dealt with. You can't think of any? That's good.

source: Saviez-vous que la petite fleur à côté de vous vous aime beaucoup ? Les plantes, toujours honnêtes et sincères, parlent silencieusement. Je peux traduire ce qu'elles disent si vous aimez les comprendre.
target: Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.

source: Savoir se contenter, c'est la clé de la longévité.
target: A contented mind is a perpetual feast.

source: Saí de serviço, é sua vez.
target: I'm off duty, it's your turn.

source: Scharfe Soße des Champions! Diese Soße ist so gut, du würdest mit ihr sogar einen alten Schuh verspeisen.
target: Victor Savor! That sauce is so good, you'll munch an old shoe with it.
Treasure chests! Ahh, the essential RPG experience—

source: Schau mal, meine Sammlung! Hehe... Waaahhh!
Schau, es trägt kleine Früchte! Ein weiteres Wunder, aber die Reise einer Pflanze endet nicht hier.
target: Look, it's bearing tiny fruits! Another miracle, but the journey of a plant doesn't end here.

source: Scheinbar wirkt die Mischung aus wildem Gestikulieren und einem ausdruckslosen Gesicht total witzig. Siehst du? Genau so. Oh, war das gerade ein Lachen von dir? Ich schätze, ich werde einfach so weitermachen.
target: Apparently, the mix of my over-the-top gestures and stoic face is hilarious to people. See? Just like that. Oh, did I actually get a chuckle out of you? Guess I'll keep this style going, then.

source: Scheint ein neuer Hinweis zu sein.
Schh... hörst du das? Das ist das Geräusch des Keimens.
target: Can you hear it? Shh... That's the sound of sprouting.
Sleep, in the whispers of sirens.

source: Schlag die Trommel. Bereit zum Tanzen!
target: Beat the drum. Ready to prance!

source: Schon in Ordnung. Mir geht es gut.

target: Cherish the gift not given lightly.

source: Schön langsam. Wir wollen uns nicht übernehmen.
target: Slow and steady. Let's not bite off more than we can chew.

source: Schön. Schauen wir uns das mal an.
target: Nice. Let's go check it out.

source: Schöne Wesen sind schön... gerade wegen ihrer Vergänglichkeit.
target: Beautiful beings are beautiful... precisely because of their transiency.

source: Se acabó el tiempo de juego...
Se acercan fuerzas oscuras, no bajéis la guardia.
target: Dark forces approach, be on guard.

source: Se ao menos eu estivesse mais perto...
Se baña en la paleta de la naturaleza.
Se contrôler, contrôler sa colère... les flammes brûlantes ne sont pas toujours si brûlantes.
target: With temperance and discipline, my flames will be kept in check.

source: Se faire suivre par les esprits et se faire lier par le Chi obscur… ça a l'air pénible. Mais j'ai fini par m'y habituer. Et maintenant qu'ils obéissent à mes ordres, c'est plus si mal.
target: Bound by Nether Qi, followed by spirits... sounds like a real hassle. But I'm used to it. And since they listen to my commands now, I suppose it's not so bad.

source: Se fosse possível, eu realmente gostaria que pudéssemos continuar amigos por muito, muito tempo. Mas... sei que o tempo tem vontade própria.
target: If possible, I really wish we could all stay friends for a long, long time. But... I know time has a will of its own.

source: Se ha fijado el rumbo. ¡Es hora de zarpar!
target: The course is determined. Time to set sail!

source: Se importa se... eu cair fora daqui?
Se isso não for suficiente para abrir o caminho, então deixe que os rios e montanhas sejam a prova do que estou disposta a apostar.
target: If this isn't enough to pave the way, then let the rivers and mountains be the proof of what I'm willing to wager.

source: Se o perigo surgir, abrigue-se atrás de mim.
target: When danger arises, take cover behind me.

source: Se os Ecos têm essa poção de ressonância também, então... Hã? Espera, eles têm outra coisa? Qual é a fita?
target: If Echoes got this Resonance Potion stuff too, then... Huh? Wait, they get somethin' else? What's the deal?

source: Se quiser, pode ficar pra você.
Se refleja en el agua, se tiñe de azul.
target: Mirrored by water, tinted in blue.

source: Se siente tan bien... Como la tempestad que levanta enormes olas en un océano en calma.
target: Mmm, how exquisite... Like a storm crashing into a still sea, stirring it to life with waves that reach for the sky.

source: Se tenho mantido algum tipo de bebida saudável secreta neste frasco? *risos* É só chá quente comum.
target: Have I been keeping some kind of secret healthy drink in this flask, you ask? *chuckle* It's really just regular hot tea.

source: Se um dia a região fronteiriça não precisar mais de um general, meu desejo terá se realizado.
target: If one day, the borderlands no longer need a general, I suppose my wish will have come true.

source: Se você precisa de ajuda para se exercitar ou manter sua saúde, sinta-se à vontade para vir à minha academia. Recebemos todos os visitantes.
target: Whether you need help with working out or maintaining your health, feel free to come by my gym. We welcome all visitors.

source: Se você se perder, siga a bandeira do Dragão Celeste.
target: Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.

source: Se é um duelo que você quer...
target: If it's a duel you want...

source: Seelen singen im Einklang – Auf den Sieg der Retterin!
target: Souls sing in harmony. To the savior's victory!

source: Según la opinión profesional de la maestra Youhu, ¡ahora soy invencible! ¡Aquellos que no aprecian las antigüedades temblarán ante mí!
target: As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!

source: Sehr gut. Ich werde dir Inspiration geben.
target: Very well. I shall grant you enlightenment.

source: Sei vorsichtig. Ich kann ihn spüren – Aleph-1 … Er war nie wirklich weg.
target: Be careful. I can feel it, Aleph-1... It never really left.

source: Seine Fähigkeiten zu verbessern, ist ein lebenslanges Bestreben. Vielleicht können wir gemeinsam noch mehr erreichen.
target: To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.

source: Seine gute Laune ist fast so beeindruckend wie das außergewöhnliche Talent, das er besitzt. Ich habe ihn noch nie seine Stimme in Wut erheben sehen. Egal wie unmöglich die Aufgabe klingt, er liefert immer ab.
target: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

source: Seit Jahren habe ich keine Niederlage erlebt. Meine Blindheit hat mich nicht abgestumpft. Sie hat meinen Fokus auf den Schwertkampf sogar geschärft. Wenn sich die Gelegenheit ergibt, würde ich mich gerne mit dir duellieren.
target: For all these years, I've never tasted defeat. Being blind hasn't dulled me. In fact, it sharpens my focus on swordplay. If the opportunity arises, I'd welcome a duel with you.

source: Selbst Sterne können vom Himmel fallen …

Selbst in Fesseln tanzt sie elegant – eine wahre Montelli, und doch noch mehr als das. Wohin wird sie ihre Familie führen? Ich bin gespannt, wie sie mir bei unserer nächsten Begegnung gegenübertreten wird.
target: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true Montelli, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.

source: Selbst wenn der Weg kein Ende haben sollte
target: Even Should the Path Have No End

source: Selon l'avis professionnel de la Grande maîtresse Youhu, je suis invincible maintenant ! Ceux qui n'apprécient pas les antiquités trembleront devant moi !
target: As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!

source: Sem pressa. Os impacientes cairão direto no nosso colo.
target: No rush. The impatient ones will fall right into our lap.

source: Sempre gosto de fazer negócios com um Sabujo Fantasma. Eles são diretos e não brincam em serviço.
target: I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.

source: Sempre quis me tornar uma heróina! Uma heróina como Velocista e Fiamma, que dão esperança e coragem a todos!
target: I've always wanted to become a hero! A hero matching Speedster and Fiamma, bringing hope and courage to all!

source: Seres belos são belos... precisamente por sua transitoriedade.
target: Beautiful beings are beautiful... precisely because of their transiency.

source: Será que sou mesmo capaz de lutar contra as forças das trevas?
target: Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness?

source: Será que um dia haverá barba de dragão tããão comprida quanto os bigodes de um dragão de verdade? Ah, eu gostaria tanto de experimentar!
target: Will there ever be Loong Whiskers Crisps that are as loooong as a real loong's whiskers? Aww, I really want to give them a try!

source:
Seu aniversário é hoje? Ah.
...
Bem, se está esperando por um presente ou desejos gentis, então simplesmente espere aqui. Uma longa espera pode ser considerada um presente em si.
target:
Your birthday? Today, you say? Oh.
…
Well, if you're expecting a present or some kind wishes, then simply wait here. A long wait can be considered a gift in itself.

source: Seu bom temperamento é quase tão impressionante quanto o talento excepcional que ele possui. Nunca o vi levantar a voz por raiva contra ninguém. Não importa quão impossível a tarefa pareça, ele sempre a cumpre.
target: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

source: Seu pedido de riqueza foi concedido.
target: Your wish for wealth is granted.

source: Seu retorno trouxe um vislumbre de mudança em minha longa existência. Isso me permite ganhar alguma compreensão de um mundo além do meu alcance.
target: Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach.

source: Shh... Eu saí escondido. Prometa que não vai contar, tá bom?
target: Shh... I sneaked myself out. Promise you won't tell, okay?

source: Shh... Mantém isso entre nós, tá?
target: Shh... Keep this between us, will you?

source: Shh... Me escabullí. Prométeme que no dirás nada, ¿vale?
target: Shh... I sneaked myself out. Promise you won't tell, okay?

source: Shh... Resistir só aumenta sua dor.
target: Shh... Struggling only pains you more.

source: Shh... ¿puedes oírlo? Ese es el sonido de la germinación.
target: Can you hear it? Shh... That's the sound of sprouting.

source: Shhh.... como vocês vieram parar aqui? Ah, desculpa, {PlayerName}, não queria incomodar. Eu só queria fazer uma visita. Não esperava que essa galera viesse junto...
target: Shhh.... how come you're all here? Ah, sorry {PlayerName}, didn't mean to disturb you. I just wanted to pay you a visit. Didn't expect these guys to tag along...

source: Si algún día, las fronteras ya no necesitan a un general, supongo que mi deseo se habrá hecho realidad.
target: If one day, the borderlands no longer need a general, I suppose my wish will have come true.

source: Si bañas las manzanas en veneno mucho tiempo, se vuelven empalagosamente dulces... aunque ni siquiera su brillante capa de azúcar logre disimular el olor a podrido.
target: Apples soaked in poison for too long. They become sickeningly sweet. Even the glossy sugar shell cannot mask the scent of decay beneath.

source: Si c'est un duel que tu veux…
target: If it's a duel you want...

source: Si es posible, me encantaría mantener nuestra amistad durante mucho, mucho tiempo. Pero sé que el tiempo tiene su propia voluntad.
target: If possible, I really wish we could all stay friends for a long, long time. But... I know time has a will of its own.

source: Si esto no es suficiente para allanar el camino, entonces que los ríos y las montañas sean la prueba de lo que estoy dispuesta a poner en juego.
target: If this isn't enough to pave the way, then let the rivers and mountains be the proof of what I'm willing to wager.

source: Si les Échos recevaient eux aussi cette potion de résonance, alors… Hein ? Attends, ils recoivent autre chose ? Comment ça se fait ?
target: If Echoes got this Resonance Potion stuff too, then... Huh? Wait, they get somethin' else? What's the deal?

source: Si lo que quieres es un duelo...
target: If it's a duel you want...

source: Si los Ecos también tienen esta mi*rda de poción de resonancia, entonces... ¿Eh? Espera, ¿tienen algo más? ¿Pero de qué va esto?
target: If Echoes got this Resonance Potion stuff too, then... Huh? Wait, they get somethin' else? What's the deal?

source: Si necesitas ayuda con el entrenamiento o el mantenimiento de tu salud, no dudes en visitar mi gimnasio. Damos la bienvenida a todos los visitantes.
target: Whether you need help with working out or maintaining your health, feel free to come by my gym. We welcome all visitors.

source: Si no te importa, me llevo esto.
target: Don't mind if I take these.

source: Si seulement je pouvais obtenir des Barbes de dragon...
target: Some Loong Whiskers Crisps would be great…

source: Si te encuentras perdido, sigue el estandarte del Qingloong.
target: Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.

source: Si te lo has ganado, es tuyo.
target: You earned it, you keep it.

source: Si tu clignes des yeux, tu le manques.
Si ça ne suffit pas à ouvrir la voie, alors que les rivières et les montagnes témoignent de tout ce que je suis prête à risquer.
target: If this isn't enough to pave the way, then let the rivers and mountains be the proof of what I'm willing to wager.

source: Si ça te plaît, c'est bon.
target: Found what you're looking for? Good.

source: Sie hat es so lange erfolgreich geheim gehalten. Das lässt mich nur noch mehr an mir selbst zweifeln und noch mehr um sie leiden.
target: She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more.

source: Sie hat mich immer als Kollegin gesehen, als Teil der Crew. Aber in unserer gemeinsamen Zeit habe ich mich ihr nie anvertraut. Erst als sie weg war, wurde mir klar … wie viel ich ihr noch sagen wollte.
target: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

source: Sie ist vom Orden der Tiefen. Ich kenne sie nicht besonders gut, aber … Sie ist die erste Akolythin, die den Koffer berühren durfte, ohne dass Pero sie gebissen hat.
target: She's from the Order of the Deep. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first Acolyte to touch the box without getting bitten by Pero.

source: Sie steht Wache, außerhalb aller Gesetze, aller Muster … Aber eine völlige Loslösung von der Welt ist nicht immer gut. Das ist nicht meine Wahrsagerei. Ich kann sie nicht lesen. Aber ich sehe es, klar und deutlich.
target: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

source: Sieg und Niederlage gehören zum Alltag eines Kriegers.
Sieh dir mal meine digitale Tarnung an!
Sieh genau hin, Dumpling … Siehst du? Wirkt doch ziemlich lebensecht, oder?
target: Watch closely, Dumpling... See? Quite lifelike, isn't it?

source: Sieh mal an, wer da ist. Ein seltener Besucher. Zum Glück bin ich mit meiner Arbeit für heute fertig. Hast du Lust, eine Partie Weiqi mit mir zu spielen, wenn du nicht gerade in Eile bist?
target: Ah, look who we have here. A rare visitor. Luckily, I've finished my work for today. Would you like to join me in a game of Weiqi, if you're not in a rush to leave?

source: Siehst du? Ich habe es noch drauf.
target: See? I haven't lost my touch.

source: Siehst du? Ich stehe immer auf der Gewinnerseite – deiner.
target: See? I always choose the winning side—yours.

source: Sieht aus wie eine neue Entdeckung.
Sieht so aus, als hätten die Waagschalen sich zu meinen Gunsten geneigt, hm?
target: Seems the scales tipped my way, hm?

source: Siempre actúas primero ante la injusticia, a pesar de haber perdido todos los recuerdos... Siempre debiste haber sido una persona justa, ¿verdad? Estaría muy preocupado si resultara de otra manera.
target: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.

source: Siempre disfruto haciendo negocios con un Sabueso Fantasma. Mantienen las cosas limpias, son directos y no hacen tonterías.
target: I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.

source: Siempre he querido preparar una poción única con mi alma, para poder infundirla con mis recuerdos y liberar esos sueños hundidos.
target: I've longed to craft a potion like no other. One born of my soul, to free the dreams buried deep below, and let them soar, singing through the waking world.

source: Siempre me vio como una chum, como parte del equipo. Pero en todo el tiempo que estuvimos juntas, nunca me abrí con ella. Cuando se fue, me di cuenta de todo lo que me quedó por decir.
target: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

source: Siempre que me transformo en Fleurdelys para luchar, tengo que estar muy pendiente de todo: de mis modales, del tono de mi voz... Todo tiene que ser sereno y solemne... ¡Ah! Es bastante difícil, ¿sabes? ¡De verdad!
target: ...Whenever I transform into Fleurdelys for battle, I have to constantly remind myself—My manners, my tone... everything has to be composed and solemn... Ah! It's actually really hard, you know? Truly!

source: Siempre voy de un lado para otro, recolectando tesoros, ayudando a mis amigos, confeccionando disfraces y reparando el atrezo... No paro en todo el día, pero ver a todos sonreír hace que valga la pena.
target: I'm always on the go, collecting treasures, helping my friends, making costumes, and repairing stage props... It's a busy routine, but seeing everyone smiling makes it all worth it.

source: Siento que puedo controlar más Materia de Vacío ahora. *Mmm*... Volverse más fuerte siempre es algo bueno, ¿verdad?
target: It feels like I can control more Voidmatter now. Hmm... Getting stronger is always a good thing, right?
Follow my moves, if you can.

source: Siga nossas regras e nunca nos traia. Enquanto eu estiver vivo, o nome “Sabujos Fantasmas” deve causar respeito suficiente para te conceder livre reinado sobre o continente.
target: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.
Follow my moves, if you can.

source: Sigue nuestras reglas y nunca nos traiciones. Mientras esté vivo, el nombre "Sabuesos Fantasmas" debería comandar suficiente respeto para otorgarte libre albedrío en el continente.
target: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.

source: Sim... aí. Um pouco mais de tinta... Perfeito.
target: Yeah... right there. A little more drip... Perfect.

source: Sin prisa. Los impacientes caerán directamente en nuestro regazo.
target: No rush. The impatient ones will fall right into our lap.

source: Sind das … Tränen? I-Ich hätte nie gedacht, dass ich mal selbst einen Blick auf die wahren Namen werfen würde. Sie sind wunderschön, umwerfend … So weit zu kommen und so viel zu sehen … Danke, {PlayerName}.
target: Am I... crying? I-I never imagined I would touch the True Names themselves. They're beautiful, dazzling... To come this far and see so much... Thank you, Senior.

source: Sinto uma aura perigosa na maneira de lutar de Danjin... Estou preocupado que ela carregue um fardo grande demais numa idade tão jovem.
target: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.

source: So ein Upgrade hatte ich noch nie, ob Hardware oder Software. Als würde mein ganzes System surren.
target: Not like any upgrade I've ever had, hardware or soft. It's like... my whole system's hummin'.
As far as the eye can see.

source: So … jetzt kommen wir der Sache schon näher.
Solch mystische Kraft... Wenn sie auf die Tacetit-Forschung angewendet wird, wird unser Fortschritt bemerkenswert sein.
target: Such mystical power... If applied to Tacetite research, our progress will be remarkable.

source: Solche Schönheit … und doch muss auch sie vergehen.
target: Such beauty... so too must it end.

source: Solche köstliche und unwiderstehliche Macht. Nun, jetzt haben wir ein weiteres gemeinsames Geheimnis.
target: Such delightful and irresistible power. Well, now we have another shared secret.

source: Sollen wir einen Blick darauf werfen?
Sollen wir zusammen eine Sightseeing-Tour machen?
Sollten wir nicht alle Lebensmittel schätzen und nichts verschwenden? Oh... Nun, wenn es wirklich schlecht gekocht ist, dann... ähm...
target: Shouldn't we cherish all food and not let any go to waste? Oh... Well, if it's truly badly cooked, then.. uhm...

source: Solltest du dich verlaufen, folge dem Banner von Qingloong.
target: Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.

source: Solo hay diversión a esta altura.
Solo para que lo sepas, aunque cobro poco por tasar antigüedades, ¡pelear tiene otro precio!
target: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!
Let slip the dogs of war!

source: Solía luchar solo con mis llamas, pero ahora tengo estas pistolas. Me aferraré con fuerza a cualquier arma que pueda tener, ¡para poder proteger a todos!
target: I used to fight with nothing more than my flames, but now I have these pistols. I'll hold on tight to whatever weapon I can have, so I can protect everyone!

source: Solía soñar con ir a la Luna. Quería escapar allí y dejarlo todo atrás. Y bueno, ese sueño se hizo realidad... pero no de la forma en que habría querido
target: Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.

source: Solían llamarme Sol Alegre en mi aldea. ¡Pero prefiero Lumi! El sol se pone por la noche, pero yo siempre estoy lista para iluminar el camino de alguien a casa.
target: They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!

source: Somos más o menos de la misma edad, pero Danjin es mucho más alta que yo... ¡La jade que lleva puesta es preciosa! *suspiro*... Es una lástima que no pueda percibir ni una sola vibración de alegría en ella...
target: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...

source: Sonhos e a Cidade dos Sonhos
Sonríe a la cámara. Tres, dos, uno...
target: Smile for the camera... Three, two, one...

source: Sons podem ser pesados. A jade pode ser leve.
target: Sounds could be weighty. Jadeite could be made light.

source: Sorbet, Rasureis, Eiscreme … im Grunde nehmen die sich nichts. Das Höllenfeuer in mir erlischt nie. Kalte Speisen helfen mir, es unter Kontrolle zu halten. Noch besser geht das, wenn sie auch noch ein bisschen süß sind.
target: Sorbet, shaved ice, gelato… they're pretty much the same. The hellfire inside me never dies down. Cold things help keep it in check. But an added bit of sweetness works even better.

source: Sorbet, glace pilée, gelato… Ce sont pratiquement les mêmes choses. Le feu infernal qui brûle en moi ne s'éteint jamais. Le froid m'aide à le maîtriser. Mais un peu de douceur fonctionne encore mieux.
target: Sorbet, shaved ice, gelato… they're pretty much the same. The hellfire inside me never dies down. Cold things help keep it in check. But an added bit of sweetness works even better.

source: Sorbete, granizado, helado... son casi lo mismo. El fuego infernal de mi interior nunca se apaga. Las cosas frías ayudan a mantenerlo bajo control y, si tienen un poco de dulce, aún mejor.
target: Sorbet, shaved ice, gelato… they're pretty much the same. The hellfire inside me never dies down. Cold things help keep it in check. But an added bit of sweetness works even better.

source: Sorria para a câmera... Três, dois, um...
target: Smile for the camera... Three, two, one...

source: Sorvete, raspadinha, gelato... é tudo praticamente a mesma coisa. O fogo do inferno dentro de mim nunca se apaga. Coisas geladas ajudam a mantê-lo sob controle. Mas um toque extra de doçura funciona ainda melhor.
target: Sorbet, shaved ice, gelato… they're pretty much the same. The hellfire inside me never dies down. Cold things help keep it in check. But an added bit of sweetness works even better.

source:
Sou Changli, conselheira de Jinzhou. É um prazer te conhecer, Rover
. Finalmente nos encontramos. Se algum dia precisar de ajuda em Jinzhou, por favor, me avise.
target: I am Changli, Counselor to the Jinzhou Jinzhou. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Rover. We meet at last. Should you ever need any assistance in Jinzhou, please let me know.

source: Sou Jianxin, sucessora de Fengyiquan. Agradeço a hospitalidade. Você se importaria em treinar comigo?
target: I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?

source: Sou Jinhsi, a Magistrada de Jinzhou. Minha função detém grande poder e responsabilidade. Prometo servir meu povo com dedicação e trazer prosperidade para nossa terra.
target: I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. My role holds great power and duty. I vow to serve my people with diligence and bring prosperity to our land.

source: Sou Phoebe, acólita da Ordem. Louvado seja o Sentinela. Que Ele te guie à compaixão e iluminação.
target: I'm Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.

source: Sou mais rápida no meu mecha, sabia?
target: I'm faster in my mech, you know?

source: Sou só eu, ou a lâmpada na minha cauda está mais brilhante do que antes?
target: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?

source: Sous ce joli sourire, y a de l'acier. Rien qu'à l'entendre parler, ça m'inspire… Hé, vous voyez ? Vous êtes un bon prof, en fait !
target: Behind that lovely smile is pure steel. I feel inspired just hearing her voice—Heh, see? You're a better teacher than I am!

source: Sous l'œil brûlant du soleil... Gloire, à genoux devant nous.
target: With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us.

source: Sous les feux de la rampe !
Souvenirs des monts et des vallées
Soy Baizhi, un investigador de la Academia Huaxu. Permíteme presenciar a dónde nos llevará este encuentro.
target: I am Baizhi, a researcher at the Huaxu Academy. Let me witness where this encounter will take us.

source: Soy Changli, consejera de la Magistrada de Jinzhou. Encantada de conocerte, Errante. Por fin nos encontramos. Si alguna vez necesitas ayuda en Jinzhou, házmelo saber.
target: I am Changli, Counselor to the Jinzhou Jinzhou. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Rover. We meet at last. Should you ever need any assistance in Jinzhou, please let me know.

source: Soy Hiyuki, la última Miko de la Sakura Llameante. Si buscas matar a los Trenodianos, mi espada y yo estamos a tu servicio.
target: I am Hiyuki, the last Miko of Flaming Sakura. Should you seek to slay the Threnodians, my blade and I stand at your service.

source: Soy Jianxin, la sucesora de Fengyiquan. Gracias por su hospitalidad. ¿Le importaría hacer un combate de práctica conmigo?
target: I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?

source: Soy Jinhsi, la Magistrada de Jinzhou. Mi cargo conlleva un gran poder y responsabilidad. Prometo servir a mi gente con diligencia y traer prosperidad a nuestra tierra.
target: I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. My role holds great power and duty. I vow to serve my people with diligence and bring prosperity to our land.

source: Soy Mornye, ingeniera del Instituto de Investigación de la Unión Intergaláctica y profesora de la Academia Fuegostelar. Por favor, avísame cuando mi experiencia pueda ser de utilidad.
target: I am Mornye, Research Institute engineer and professor at Startorch Academy. Please, let me know when my expertise can be of service.

source: Soy Phoebe, acólita de la Orden. Alabado sea el Centinela. Que te guíe hacia la compasión y la iluminación.
target: I'm Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.

source: Soy Sanhua, la Guardaespaldas de la Magistrada. Si planeas visitar áreas peligrosas, por favor asegúrate de llevarme contigo. Garantizaré tu seguridad.
target: I am Sanhua, the bodyguard of Magistrate Jinhsi. If you plan to visit dangerous areas, please be sure to bring me along. I will ensure your safety.

source: Soy Yinlin. Mi trabajo... shhh, no se menciona en público.
target: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.

source: Soy Zani. Trabajo para la familia Montelli. ¿Eh? No, no es sombra de ojos, sino la prueba de mi arduo trabajo, una medalla de honor por mi dedicación. ¡Ja! Si sigo diciendo eso, al final me lo creeré hasta yo.
target: I am Zani. I work for the Montelli family. Hmm? Oh, that's not eyeshadow. It's proof of my hard work, a badge of honor for my dedication. Ha, if I keep saying that, I might actually start believing it myself.

source: Soy Zhezhi… hago pinturas por encargo. Um, ¿qué más...? ¡Ah, acepto encargos! Ofrezco precios justos, puedo adaptarme a cualquier estilo que necesites y también hago revisiones. ¡Y nunca falto a una fecha de entrega!
target: I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!

source: Soy la luna que nunca cae, y he venido a reescribir el final.
target: I am the moon that never falls, here to rewrite the ending.

source: Spaghetti Bolognese schmeckt immer, aber in Gesellschaft ist es wirklich köstlich. Vielleicht … schmeckt es beim gemeinsamen Essen einfach besser?
target: Spaghetti Bolognese is great on its own, but it's even better when shared. Maybe... it's the company that makes it taste better?

source: Spiele spielen natürlich! Es gibt so viele coole Spiele an den Schwarzen Küsten. Wollen wir mal zusammen spielen?
target: Playing games, of course! So many cool ones in the Black Shores. Want to co-op sometime?

source: Spürst du es? Die Frequenz des Windes … sie hallt in uns wieder.
target: Can you feel it? The frequency of the wind... it's resonating between us.

source: Squeakie ! Arrête de jouer avec la lettre !
target: Squeakie! Enough playing with the letter!

source: Squeakie! Chega de brincar com a carta!
target: Squeakie! Enough playing with the letter!

source: Squeakie! Hör auf, mit dem Brief zu spielen!
target: Squeakie! Enough playing with the letter!

source: Steh aufrecht vor der ewigen Sonne!
target: Stand tall before the eternal sun!

source: Stell dich mir … voll und ganz.

Sternenflocken sind hübsch, aber es ist eine Qual, sie frisch zu halten. Einmal habe ich eine Tasche voll davon gepackt, um sie in der Wildnis zu genießen, und sie wurden schnell matschig und verloren ihren Knack.
target: Star Flakes are pretty, but they're a pain to keep fresh. I once packed a pouchful of them to enjoy while I was out in the wild, and they quickly turned soggy and lost their crunch.

source: Sternenlicht über den Meeren – Versenge die Leere!
target: Starlight over the seas. Scorch through the Void!

source: Streife durchs Inferno und blicke in den Schnee.
target: Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.

source: Ströme konvergieren von allen Seiten, und ich stehe in ihrer Mitte, in Erwartung der Ankunft des Windes.
target: Streams are converging from all sides, and I stand in their midst, expecting the wind's arrival.

source: Stärke dient nicht nur dem Kampf. Sie findet auch ihren Weg zu denen, die zwischen Zerstörung und Wiederaufbau gefangen sind und sich dennoch dafür entscheiden, die Hand auszustrecken.
target: Strength isn't only for battle. It also finds its way to those who, caught between ruin and recovery, still choose to reach out a hand.

source: Stört es dich, wenn ich das ausleihe?
Su buen temperamento es casi tan impresionante como el talento excepcional que tiene. Nunca lo he visto alzar la voz enojado con nadie. No importa lo imposible que suene la tarea, siempre cumple.
target: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

source: Sua ajuda abriu uma imensidão de potencial para You'tan e eu. É meio estranho para mim ser apresentada a muitas opções, em vez de uma única verdade... mas gosto bastante desta sensação.
target: Your help has opened up a world of potential for You'tan and me. It feels a bit foreign to me to be presented with many options, instead of one single truth... but I rather enjoy this feeling.

source: Sua aventura parece tão divertida! Encore quer muito ir! Promete que me levará, na próxima vez? Juro de dedinho!
target: Your adventure sounds so much fun! Encore really wanna go! Promise you'll take me next time? Pinky swear!

source: Sua confiança... significa muito para mim!
target: Your trust… means so much to me!

source: Sua força de volta para você!
Sua generosidade é tão inabalável como sempre, mas como devo retribuir? Afinal, as coisas mais preciosas geralmente são as que desafiam a definição.
target: Your generosity is as unwavering as ever. But how should I repay you? After all, the most precious things are often those that defy definition.

source: Sua hora de brilhar no palco!
Sua influência... catalisou uma mudança em mim. Esse progresso te agrada?
target: Your influence has... catalyzed a change in me. Does this progress please you?

source: Sua luz me mostrou um mundo que eu nunca tinha visto.
target: Your light has shown me a world I had never seen.

source: Sua postura e confiança são impressionantes. Um caráter tão notável não pode ser construído da noite para o dia. Posso dizer que você já viveu muito mais do que eu.
target: Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.
Your life, is mine to take.
Let's pick up the pace, hm?

source: Suche, Rettung, Transport, Aufklärung, Gruppenkampf... Hunde sind treu und auf vielfältige Weise geschickt. Ich? Ich halte keine Hunde. Es ist zu gefährlich... für die Hunde, meine ich.
target: Search, rescue, transportation, recon, group combat... Dogs are loyal and skilled in many ways. Me? I don't keep dogs. It's too dangerous... for the dogs, that is.

source: Suco de fruta. Fresco, rústico e ácido. A doçura suave permanece... Quer um pouco?
target: Fruit juice. Fresh, raw, and tangy. That gentle sweetness lingers... You want some?

source: Suelta los deseos, y la mente se calma. Limpia los pensamientos, y el alma se aclara.
target: Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.

source: Sueños y la ciudad de los sueños
Suis mes mouvements si tu peux.
target: Follow my moves, if you can.

source: Suivez la bannière du Dragon azur.
target: Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.

source: Sumidade de Xuanfang, Qingxiao, uma buscadora do Caminho. O fluxo interminável do tempo trouxe você de volta para mim. Empunhe sua lâmina e vamos caminhar juntos por este caminho.
target: Xuan Paragon, Qingxiao, a seeker of the Way. Time's endless flow has brought you back to me. Take up your blade, and let us walk this path together.

source: Super! Ich poste ein Bild davon!
Super! Ich werde unser Training aufnehmen und jeden Moment genießen.
target: Awesome! I'll record our training and savor every detail of it.

source: Super ! Je vais poster une photo !
Supongo que el potencial de alguien es como un sobre de gel energético. Crees que está vacío, pero si aprietas, siempre queda un poco...
target: I guess someone's potential is like an Energy Gel Sachet. You think it's empty, but there's always a little more if you squeeze harder...

source: Supongo que está bien volar de vez en cuando.
target: It's okay to fly sometimes, I guess.

source: Supongo que puedes decir que Chixia es una colega más joven mía. Ella encaja naturalmente en la posición de Patrullero. Con tiempo y experiencia, seguramente sobresaldrá en su papel.
target: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

source: Suponho que você pode dizer que Chixia é uma colega mais nova. Ela é naturalmente adequada para a posição de Patrulha. Com tempo e experiência, ela certamente se destacará em seu papel.
target: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

source: Suprimentos de emergência de Huanglong. Têm um sabor pouco melhor que os feitos em outros locais.
target: Huanglong's emergency rations. They taste slightly better than those made elsewhere.

source: Sí, estoy aquí. Por supuesto. Procede según lo planeado. Adiós.
target: ...Yes, I'm here. Of course. Proceed as planned. Bye-bye.

source: Sí, me vendría bien relajarme un poco.
target: Yeah, could use a little unwind.

source: Sí, puedo sentir ese calor... Como los rayos del sol acariciando el mar.
target: I can feel that warmth, just like the caress of sunlight tracing the sea.

source: Sí... Justo ahí. Un poco más... perfecto.
target: Yeah... right there. A little more drip... Perfect.

source: Só palavras não podem retribuir tudo que você fez por mim. Agora, é minha vez de lutar por você. Por acaso, precisa de uma espada inquebrável ou um Escudo que resista a qualquer coisa?
target: Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything?

source: Só para você saber, embora eu cobre pouco por avaliações de antiguidades, lutar tem outro preço!
target: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!

source: Só tem diversão a essa altura.

Süßigkeiten, nehme ich an … Nicht wegen meines feinen Gaumens, sondern wegen der Erinnerungen, die die Süße in mir weckt. Je süßer die Vergangenheit einmal war, desto tiefer schmerzt die Tatsache, dass ich alles verloren habe.
target: Confections, I suppose... Not from any preference of palate. It is simply that sweetness, upon tasting, stirs memories of a bitter kind. The sweeter the past I once held, the more bitter the aftertaste that lingers.

source: T'aimes bien Guts ? Je l'ai moddé moi-même. Il envoie du lourd, ça rigole pas. Avant que je me chrome les bras, le recul m'envoyait valdinguer. C'était super relou.
target: Ya like Guts? My own custom job. Talks the talk, packs a mean punch. Before I chromed up my arms, the recoil would send me flyin'. Total pain in the buns.

source: T'aimes ça ? J'en ai encore, si tu veux.
target: Like it? I've got plenty more of that.

source: T'as déjà été sur la Lune ? Moi oui, mais j'ai payé cher pour y aller… Je me souviens encore parfaitement des émotions qui m'animaient à mon arrivée. Même si David a pas pu m'y emmener, je savais qu'il était là, à mes côtés.
target: You ever been to the Moon? I have, but it cost me a lot... Still remember exactly how I felt when I first arrived. Even though David couldn't take me, I knew we were there together.

source: Ta confiance... compte beaucoup pour moi !
target: Your trust… means so much to me!

source: Ta lumière m'a montré un monde qui m'était inconnu.
target: Your light has shown me a world I had never seen.
Your life, is mine to take.

source: Ta-dada~! Was, du willst einen Bissen? Yum Yum, jetzt bin ich dran!
target: Hmhmm... Aha! What, you want a bite?

source: Tal poder deveria me permitir proteger todas as antiguidades do mundo... Graças a você, não estou mais sozinha... Ai! Não. Que vergonha de dizer isso em voz alta!
target: Such power should allow me to protect all the antiques in the world... Thanks to you, I'm no longer fighting alone... Ack! Nope. This is too embarrassing to say out loud!

source: Tal poder encantador e irresistível. Bem, agora temos outro segredo compartilhado.
target: Such delightful and irresistible power. Well, now we have another shared secret.

source: Tal poder místico... Si se aplica a la investigación de Tacetita, nuestro progreso será notable.
target: Such mystical power... If applied to Tacetite research, our progress will be remarkable.

source: Tal y como lo había previsto.
Talvez um dia, Encore vá para todos os lugares do mundo e seja um herói também. Hehe, mas primeiro, o que teremos para o café da manhã de amanhã?
target: Maybe one day, Encore will go everywhere in the world and be a hero too. Hehe, but first, what's for breakfast tomorrow?

source: Tanta beleza... então também deve acabar.
target: Such beauty... so too must it end.

source: Tanta belleza... así también debe terminar.
target: Such beauty... so too must it end.

source: Taoqi ... Obwohl unsere Ansichten über lockeres Management nicht immer übereinstimmen, kann ich mich dank ihrer effektiven Führung bei der Aufrechterhaltung der Befestigungen von Jinzhou ohne Sorgen auf die Frontlinien konzentrieren.
target: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

source: Taoqi ... แม้ว่าเราจะไม่ลงรอยกันนักในเรื่องมุมมองด้านการบริหารทั่วไป แต่ฉันสามารถโฟกัสกับแนวหน้าได้อย่างเต็มที่ก็เพราะความเป็นผู้นำที่มีประสิทธิภาพของเธอในการดูแลรักษาป้อมปราการของจินโจว
target: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

source: Taoqi es capaz de atravesar montañas de trabajo con facilidad, a pesar de sus frecuentes bostezos. Su eficiencia es verdaderamente notable.
target: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

source: Taoqi est capable de traverser des montagnes de travail avec facilité, malgré ses bâillements fréquents. Son efficacité est vraiment remarquable.
target: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

source: Taoqi schafft es mühelos, Berge von Arbeit zu bewältigen, trotz ihres häufigen Gähnens. Ihre Effizienz ist wirklich bemerkenswert.
target: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

source: Taoqi é capaz de passar por montanhas de trabalho com facilidade, apesar de seus frequentes bocejos. Sua eficiência é verdadeiramente notável.
target: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

source: Taoqi สามารถรับมือกับกองงานปริมาณเท่าภูเขาได้อย่างง่ายดายแม้ว่าจะหาวไปตั้งหลายรอบก็ตาม ประสิทธิภาพในการทำงานของเธอนั้นช่างน่าทึ่งจริงๆ
target: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

source: Taoqi... Aunque nuestras opiniones sobre la gestión laxa no siempre coinciden, puedo concentrarme en el frente sin preocupaciones, gracias a su eficaz liderazgo en el mantenimiento de las fortificaciones de Jinzhou.
target: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

source: Taoqi... Bien que nos points de vue sur la gestion ne soient pas toujours en accord, je peux me concentrer au champs de bataille sans aucun souci grâce à ses stratégies dans la construction des fortifications de Jinzhou.
target: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

source: Taoqi... Embora nossas visões sobre gestão nem sempre se alinhem, consigo focar na linha de frente sem preocupações, graças à sua liderança eficaz na manutenção das fortificações de Jinzhou.
target: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

source: Tauche ein letztes Mal ab – nach Naraka.
target: Take your final dive, into Naraka.
A Thousand Times Has the Moon Fallen
You chooms like this stuff, huh?

source: Te devolveré diez veces el favor.
Te has cruzado con la persona equivocada.
Te has preparado para esto, ¿no es así?
target: You've prepared for this, have you not?

source: Te lo juro, las nuevas bromas y memes del campus evolucionan tan rápido que es imposible mantenerse al día...
target: I swear, the new jokes and memes around campus are evolving faster than I can keep up...

source: Te ofrezco la amargura de alguien que contempla la luna
target: I Offer You the Bitterness of a Moongazer

source: Tem "fantasmas"? Vou acabar com todos eles!
Tem certeza disso? Satisfazer minha teimosia? Só para você saber, se continuarmos assim, podemos... cair em um futuro desconhecido mais assustador que o próprio Caos!
target: Are you sure about this? Indulging my willfulness? Just so you know, if we keep this up, we might... fall into an unknown future scarier than Chaos!
There has to be more. Right?

source: Temos mais ou menos da mesma idade, mas a Danjin é muito mais alta do que eu... A jade que ela usa é tão bonita! Ai, ai... É uma pena eu não conseguir sentir uma única frequência alegre dela...
target: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...

source: Tempo perfeito para uma caminhada hoje... Hmm, talvez não...
target: Perfect weather for a walk today... Hmm, maybe not...

source: Ten cuidado. Puedo sentirlo: Aleph-1... nunca se fue del todo.
target: Be careful. I can feel it, Aleph-1... It never really left.

source: Tengo debilidad por lo dulce. ¡Las cosas dulces siempre me dan más energía!
target: I have a sweet tooth. Sweet things always give me more energy!

source: Tengo la clave para resolver esta pregunta.
target: I have the key to solving this question.

source: Tengo un minuto para partir algunas caras.
target: I can spare a minute to knock some heads around.

source: Tenho muitos amigos agora, mas às vezes, nos meus sonhos, ainda estou sozinho. Minha mãe não está mais comigo e eles dizem que Cosmo e Nébula são apenas meus amigos imaginários... P-pode me abraçar um pouco?
target: I've got lots of friends now, but sometimes in my dreams, I'm still all alone. Mommy's not with me anymore, and they say Cosmos and Cloudy are just my imaginary friends… Erm. C-can you hug me a little?

source: Tenho um tempo livre hoje. Que tal uma caminhada na praia? Talvez a brisa do mar e o pôr do sol no oceano te inspirem!
target: I've got some time today. What would you say to a nice stroll on the beach? Maybe the sea breeze and ocean sunset will inspire you!

source: Testemunhe a verdadeira forma da arte!

target: An error occurred. Please contact Customer Service for assistance
There has to be more. Right?

source: Tiens donc, voilà quelqu'un qui a aussi le sens de l'inspiration.
target: Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.

source: Tiens, des récompenses pour le quiz !
Tiens, tiens, mais qu'est-ce qu'on a là ?
target: Well, well. What do we have here?

source: Tiens, tiens… Je crois que c'est la première fois que je vois un tel record.
target: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.

source: Tiens, un peu de force de vie.
Tiens-toi droit face au soleil éternel !
target: Stand tall before the eternal sun!

source: Tira a mão... do meu tesouro...
Tirem as mãos dos meus amigos.
Tive um ótimo sono. Ugh... hora de trabalhar... Tenho que me levantar... mas... ainda com sono... Só mais uma soneca...
target: Had a great sleep. Ugh... time for work... Gotta get up... but... still 'eepy... Just one more nap...
Beat the drum. Ready to prance!

source: Toda a minha vontade, em um só golpe.
target: All my will, in one strike.
A hunt isn't complete without a prize.

source: Toda mi voluntad, en un solo golpe.
target: All my will, in one strike.

source: Toda vez que vejo a bagunça que aqueles bêbados deixam... Argh, eu só quero jogar toda a bebida alcoólica no mar.
target: Every time I see the mess those drunkards leave behind... Ugh, I just want to dump all the booze into the ocean.

source: Todas as almas convergem. O mundo se rompe.
target: All souls converge. The world ruptures.

source: Todas las almas convergen, el mundo se quiebra.
target: All souls converge. The world ruptures.

source: Todavía nos queda un largo camino por delante. Sigamos adelante.
target: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.

source: Todavía tengo muchos datos de experimentos para procesar...
target: I still have much experiment data to process...

source:
Todo el mundo es un escenario.
PERRI: ¡Perri! ¡Pff!
target:
All the world's a stage.
PERO: Pero! Hmph!

source: Todo inverno, minha cauda vira um ninho de eletricidade estática... É muito irritante quando estou me arrumando...
target: Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...

source: Todo se desvanece en el olvido...
Todos a la vez. No hago horas extra.
target: All of you at once. I don't do overtime.

source: Todos de uma vez. Não faço hora extra.
target: All of you at once. I don't do overtime.

source: Todos estão sãos e salvos? Parece que não pratiquei à toa, então!
target: Everyone's safe and sound? Looks like I didn't practice for nothing, then!

source: Todos los objetivos a la vista.

Toma este telescopio y mira: incluso las nubes más altas parecen lo bastante próximas como para tocarlas, ¿no crees? Con este artilugio, podrás captar todas las emociones del escenario y los «nuevos mundos» que te esperan en el mar.
target: Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea.

source: Toma tu zambullida final, hacia Naraka.
target: Take your final dive, into Naraka.

source: Toma un respiro, estoy a tu lado.
target: Take a breath, I'm right here.

source: Ton désir de richesse est assouvi.
target: Your wish for wealth is granted.

source: Ton influence a… catalysé un changement en moi. Cette évolution te satisfait-elle ?
target: Your influence has... catalyzed a change in me. Does this progress please you?

source: Ton retour a jeté une lueur de changement dans mon existence prolongée. Il me permet de comprendre un peu un monde au-delà de ma portée.
target: Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach.

source: Ton voyage est vraiment intéressant, Encore l'aime beaucoup ! La prochaine fois, tu dois emmener Encore avec toi, d'accord ? Faisons un pacte !
target: Your adventure sounds so much fun! Encore really wanna go! Promise you'll take me next time? Pinky swear!

source: Toque o tambor. Pronto para dançar!
target: Beat the drum. Ready to prance!

source: Tornadomaschinen, dimensionsverzerrende Lampen … Ich habe ganz viele Requisiten für dich.
target: Tornado makers, dimension-warping lamps... I've got all kinds of props if you're interested.

source: Tous en même temps. Je ne fais pas d'heures sup'.
target: All of you at once. I don't do overtime.

source: Tous les défis qu'on a relevés, tous les obstacles qu'on a surmontés, tous les souvenirs qu'on a partagés… Tout ça, c'est ma force aujourd'hui.
target: Every challenge we've faced, every obstacle we've overcome, and every memory we've shared... All of it has become my strength.

source: Tous les regards sur moi ! Ouah !
Tout - des milliers d'années à ce monde immense - est enfermé dans cette petite planche de Weiqi... Je suis heureuse de vous avoir comme adversaire.
target:
Eons of time on this vast land, all encapsulated in a humble game...
I am fortunate to have you as my opponent.

source: Tout ce qui est insipide. Je ne déteste pas, mais ça ne me rappelle pas de bons souvenirs. Ça rend le monde plus terne. Alors ma devise fonctionne pour tout : aie de l'audace. Mets de la couleur et du dynamisme dans ta vie.
target: Anything bland. It's not hate, it's just... a trigger of some bad times. Washes the world out for a minute. So my motto stands, for everything: Go bold. Go bright. Never be boring.

source: Tout le monde doit être en sécurité.
target: Here's to a safe journey ahead.

source: Tout le monde est sain et sauf ? Je n'ai pas pratiqué pour rien, alors !
target: Everyone's safe and sound? Looks like I didn't practice for nothing, then!

source: Tout va bien. Je n'ai rien.
Toute ma détermination dans un seul coup.
target: All my will, in one strike.

source: Toutes les âmes convergent. Le monde se brise.
target: All souls converge. The world ruptures.

source: Tras ahumar o asar la carne, su sabor es como el de... da igual.
target: After meat is smoked or roasted, its taste is similar to... Never mind.

source: Tras esa sonrisa encantadora hay puro acero. Me inspira el mero hecho de escuchar su voz. ¡Je! ¿Ves? ¡Eres mejor profesor que yo!
target: Behind that lovely smile is pure steel. I feel inspired just hearing her voice—Heh, see? You're a better teacher than I am!

source: Trazar nuevas rutas para Logística Lollo requiere un entrenamiento físico constante.
target: To chart new routes for Lollo Logistics, physical training is a must.

source: Traçar novas rotas para a Logística Lollo exige muito treinamento físico.
target: To chart new routes for Lollo Logistics, physical training is a must.
Shh... I sneaked myself out. Promise you won't tell, okay?
Here's to a safe journey ahead.

source: Trotz Störungen, lassen Sie uns den richtigen Weg finden.
target: Amidst disruptions, let's find our way to the right path.

source: Träume und die Stadt der Träume

target: Very well. I shall grant you enlightenment.

source: Tsc, a qualidade... Deixa pra lá.
Tsc... Você não viu nada ainda.
target: Tch… You haven't seen anything yet.
