Tch… You haven't seen anything yet.

source: Tu agis toujours en premier face à l'injustice, malgré la perte de tous tes souvenirs... Tu as toujours été une personne juste, n'est-ce pas ? Je serais très troublé si ce n'était pas le cas.
target: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.

source: Tu aimerais connaître mon passé ? Ha… Si c'est ce que tu veux, je n'ai rien à cacher. Mais peut-être serait-il préférable d'en discuter autour d'une carafe de bon vin.
target: Curious about my past? Heh... if that's what you want, I've no intention to hide. But maybe we should talk over a good pot of wine.

source: Tu aimes Jinzhou ? Et le séjour ? Mon rêve est d'en faire un endroit vraiment sûr et confortable pour vivre, à l'abri de tous les dangers des villes frontalières.
target: How do you like it here in Jinzhou? Enjoying your stay? It is my dream to make it a truly safe and cozy place to live, free from all the border city dangers.
How's that for a magic trick?

source: Tu as de nouveaux coups ? Impressionne-moi.
target: Any new tricks? Do impress me.

source: Tu as des problèmes ? Ils ne sont pas rares ici, au palais de l'éphore. Mais tant que tu seras prêt à te battre, tout connaîtra une fin heureuse. Après tout, les problèmes que l'on peut résoudre ne sont pas de vrais problèmes.
target: Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.

source: Tu as entendu ? Une étoile scintillante vient de tomber !
target: Hear that? A twinkling star just tinkled to the ground!

source: Tu as le diable aux trousses.
Tu as préparé ce moment, n'est-ce pas ?
target: You've prepared for this, have you not?

source: Tu as trouvé quelque chose de bien ?
Tu attends une surprise ? Comme un enfant.
target: Excited for what's inside? Hehe, aren't you adorable.

source: Tu ayuda ha abierto un mundo de posibilidades para You'tan y para mí. Me resulta un poco extraño tener tantas opciones, en lugar de una única verdad... pero me gusta esta sensación.
target: Your help has opened up a world of potential for You'tan and me. It feels a bit foreign to me to be presented with many options, instead of one single truth... but I rather enjoy this feeling.

source: Tu compostura y confianza son impresionantes. Tal carácter notable no puede ser construido de la noche a la mañana. Puedo decir que has experimentado mucho más de lo que yo he experimentado.
target: Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.

source: Tu deseo de riquezas se ha concedido.
target: Your wish for wealth is granted.

source: Tu dois mettre les voiles… Allez…
Tu en es sûr ? T'adonner à ma fantaisie ? Je te préviens, si nous continuons, nous pourrions… faire face à un futur plus effrayant que le Chaos !
target: Are you sure about this? Indulging my willfulness? Just so you know, if we keep this up, we might... fall into an unknown future scarier than Chaos!

source: Tu entends le son clair de ma lame, n'est-ce pas ? C'est le son de ma conviction à percer tes souhaits. Tous tes souhaits.
target: You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.

source: Tu es doué, c'est vrai. Je suis certain que tu gagneras dans des combats à la loyale. Cela dit, tout le monde ne joue pas à la loyale. Faites simplement attention... je ne voudrais pas que tu sois pris au dépourvu.
target: I've seen what you're capable of, so I'm not worried about you in a fair fight. That being said, not everyone plays fair. Just watch your back out there... wouldn't want you to get caught off your game.

source: Tu es en travers de mon chemin.
Tu es entre de bonnes mains.
Tu es toujours aussi généreux. Mais comment te remercier comme il se doit ? Les choses les plus précieuses sont souvent insaisissables.
target: Your generosity is as unwavering as ever. But how should I repay you? After all, the most precious things are often those that defy definition.

source: Tu es très habile. Si l'occasion se présente, comment se mesurer à moi ? J'aime les défis, je ne peux pas me résoudre à ne pas me mesurer à un adversaire fort comme toi !
target: You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!

source: Tu es un excellent professeur ! Tu sais quoi? Squeakie saute plus haut et plus vite grâce à tes conseils !
target: You're an amazing teacher! Didya know? Squeakie's jumping higher and faster after your pointers!

source: Tu ferais bien de courir. Oh ? Tu as déjà filé. Hmph, tant mieux pour toi.
target: Better start running. Oh? You actually got away. Hmph, lucky for you.

source: Tu generosidad es tan inquebrantable como siempre. ¿Cómo podría recompensarte? Después de todo, las cosas más preciosas suelen ser aquellas que desafían su propia definición.
target: Your generosity is as unwavering as ever. But how should I repay you? After all, the most precious things are often those that defy definition.

source: Tu influencia ha... catalizado un cambio en mí. ¿Te complace este progreso?
target: Your influence has... catalyzed a change in me. Does this progress please you?
You earned it, you keep it.

source: Tu la sens ? La fréquence du vent… Elle résonne entre nous deux.
target: Can you feel it? The frequency of the wind... it's resonating between us.

source: Tu luz me ha mostrado un mundo que nunca había visto.
target: Your light has shown me a world I had never seen.

source: Tu m'as beaucoup appris, mais j'ai ajouté quelques touches créatives à ta technique. C'est l'occasion rêvée de les essayer !
target: You taught me well, but I've added a few creative twists to your technique. Now's the perfect time to test it out!

source: Tu me tapes sur le système.
Tu me tapes sur le système…
Tu n'aurais pas dû me mettre en colère.
Tu n'avais pas besoin de faire ça juste pour mon pouvoir.
target: ...You didn't need to do this just for my power.

source: Tu ne cacherais pas quelque chose, par hasard ?
Tu ne me fais même pas une égratignure.
Tu ne parles pas beaucoup, mais tu es si fort au combat. Il y a un bon vieux dicton de Huanglong, « Un chat qui attrape des souris ne miaule pas. » Ça te va parfaitement, n'est-ce pas ?
target: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old Huanglong saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?

source: Tu ne retiens pas tes coups, hein...
Tu ne t'attendais pas à me voir ? Ha ha, ne t'en fais pas. Je t'avais dit qu'on se retrouverait.
target: Surprised to see me? Haha, relax. I told you we'd meet again.

source: Tu oses me tester ? Quelle insolence.
target: You dare test me? The insolence.

source: Tu regreso ha traído un cambio a mi vida, dándome la oportunidad de entender un poco más sobre el mundo que está fuera de mi alcance.
target: Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach.

source: Tu sais ce que ça veut dire, « explosion » ?
Tu vas payer pour mon chrome !

Tu veux essayer ? Comme ça. Tiens.
Regarde-moi cette distance ! Impressionnant !
target:
Give it a try? Like this. Here.
It flew so far! Impressive!

source: Tu veux savoir ce qu'il y a avec ce miroir qu'elle porte ? Oh là là ! C'est un grand, GRAND secret. Pas pour toi !
target: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!
Your life, is mine to take.

source: Tu vois ? Je choisis toujours le camp gagnant... le tien.
target: See? I always choose the winning side—yours.

source: Tu vois ? Je n'ai pas perdu la main.
target: See? I haven't lost my touch.

source: Tudo bem voar às vezes, eu acho.
target: It's okay to fly sometimes, I guess.

source: Tudo bem, já que você fez tanto por mim... Vá em frente, diga-me as invenções mais loucas que você consegue imaginar e eu as realizarei para você.
target: Fine, since you've done this much for me... Go ahead, tell me the wildest inventions you can think of, and watch me make them happen for you.

source: Tudo bem. Faz parte do trabalho, eu acho.
target: Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.

source: Tudo que brilha é ouro, bebê!
Tudo que o sol toca é nosso para defender.
target: All the sun touches is ours to fight for.

source: Tut gar nicht weh, bin okay.
Tut mir leid, das geht nicht …
Tá bom, tá bom... Eu vou ajudar.
Tá bom... Mostre do que é capaz!

target: Alright, where are we off to next?

source: Tá, qual é a primeira coisa na lista de hoje?
target: Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?

source: Tá, um ajuste deve resolver por enquanto.
target: All right, a tune-up should do the trick for now.

source: Tómalo. Ya verás para qué usarlo.
target: Take it. You will find a use for it.

source: Uau! Ei! Peludinhos, abram espaço! Quero dar uma olhada! Membro da Costa Negra, Encore, se apresentando!
target: Woah! Hey! Woolies, make some room! I wanna look, see? ...Black Shores member, Encore, reporting in!

source: Uau! Hehe... Querem me pegar, né, seus ladrões?
target: Woah! Hehe... Wanna catch me huh, you thieves?

source: Uau! Isso é “Magia Rover”!? Ah, não, você não vai a lugar nenhum a menos que me conte seus segredos!
target: Woah! Is this "Rover Magic"!? Oh no you don't, you're not going anywhere unless you tell me your secrets!

source: Uau, então é assim que você fez! Encore está transformando isso em parte da história... Você ouvirá quando tiver tempo.
target: Woah, so that's how you did it! Encore's making it part of the story... You'll hear it when you've got the time.

source: Uau, falando em sinceridade. Vou fazer valer a pena, é claro. Minha névoa estará com você o tempo todo, pode confiar que estarei ao seu lado.
target: Whoa, talk about sincerity. I'll make this worth your while, of course. My mist will be with you at all times, you can trust me to have your back.

source: Uau, que espécie rara! É meu dia de sorte!
target: Wow, such a rare species! It's my lucky day!

source: Uau, que lindo... Ah, é melhor guardar primeiro.
target: Wow, beautiful… Oh, I'd better put them away first.

source: Uau. Não é uma vista e tanto?
Uf, ahora puedo generar más niebla. Gracias, te ofreceré algo extra la próxima vez.
target: Whew—I can make more mist now. Thanks, I'll offer you something extra next time.

source: Uf. Esta vez no es un mímico de los de los cuentos.
target: Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time.
Phew. In the nick of time.

source: Ufa! Desta vez, não é um mímico das histórias.
target: Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time.

source: Ufa, agora posso fazer mais névoa. Obrigado, vou te oferecer algo extra na próxima vez.
target: Whew—I can make more mist now. Thanks, I'll offer you something extra next time.
Phew. In the nick of time.

source: Ufa... Uma longa jornada começa sempre com o primeiro passo.
target: ...Phew, a long journey starts with a single step.

source: Uggghhh... ¡Puedo sentir el poder! ¡Y las llamas subiendo!
target: Huggghhh... I can feel the power! And the flames rising!

source: Ugh, chá puro é tão amargo! Quem gosta disso? Vou derramar na xícara de quem me incomodar da próxima vez quando tiver a chance. Hehe!
target: Ugh, plain tea is so bitter! Who even likes that? I'll just find a chance to dump it in the cup of whoever bothers me next time. Hehe!

source: Ugh, ¡el té es tan amargo! ¿A quién le gusta eso? La próxima vez que alguien me caiga mal, se lo pondré a escondidas en su taza. ¡Jeje!
target: Ugh, plain tea is so bitter! Who even likes that? I'll just find a chance to dump it in the cup of whoever bothers me next time. Hehe!

source: Uh, que brilhante! Deve ser o tesouro de um dragão!
target: Ooh, shiny! It's gotta be a dragon's treasure!

source: Uhuuu! Tô sentindo o efeito bater!
target: Woo! Can feel that juice kickin' in!

source: Um Dia na Vida de um Acólito
target: A Day in the Life of an Acolyte

source: Um bolo de aniversário, claro. Daqueles com montes de frutas frescas e chantilly demais. E velas em cima, com certeza... Por quê? Porque, na verdade, eu nunca tive um antes.
target: A birthday cake, of course. The kind with tons of fresh fruit and way too much whipped cream. And candles on top, for sure... Why? Because I've never actually had one before.

source: Um carneirinho, dois carneirinhos... Três... Hum? Onde eu parei?
target: One sheep, two sheep... Three... Um? Where was I?

source: Um dia, nossa trupe navegará até todos os cantos do mundo, e cada onda ecoará uma história compartilhada — o conto dos Tolos!
target: One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of the Fools!

source: Um dinheiro extra? Não vou recusar.
target: Some pocket money? Won't say no to that.

source: Um genau zu sein, bin ich besser darin, digitale Schlösser zu knacken.
target: Actually, I'm better at popping digital locks.

source: Um golpe de sorte? O destino às vezes pode ser bem generoso.
target: A windfall? Fate can be rather generous sometimes.
One strike, to settle it all.

source: Um guerreiro... deve morrer com honra.

target: A world... of black and white...

source: Um neue Routen für Lollo-Logistik zu kartieren, ist körperliches Training ein Muss.
target: To chart new routes for Lollo Logistics, physical training is a must.

source: Um poder sutil... mas ainda assim, um que exige atenção.
target: A faint power... but still, one that commands attention.

source: Um sonho pro futuro... hm. Nunca pensei que teria direito a um desses. Vamos ver, se eu pudesse apenas ter mais dias como hoje... Sim. Isso basta pra mim.
target: A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.

source: Um sonho? Acho que... garantir que todo mundo tenha uma vida decente? Tô muito ocupada pensando na próxima loucura que vamos fazer!
target: A dream? I guess... just makin' sure everyone gets to live a decent life? I dunno, choom. Too busy thinkin' about the next stunt we're gonna pull!

source:
Um. Dois. Três. Quatro… Um pouco errado, talvez?
Ci-cinco! Não!
target:
One. Two. Three. Four… A bit off, maybe?
Fi-five! No!

source: Uma Estrela-do-Mar animada e um gentil Coelho-marinho... Mas devo admitir que não consigo diferenciá-los.
target: A lively Starfish and a gentle Sea Bunny... But I must admit, I can't tell them apart.

source: Uma Nova História, uma Nova Aventura
target: A New Story, A New Adventure

source: Uma Patrulha de Jinzhou... Hmm, preciso ficar longe dela... Ei, eu não fiz nada de errado! Apenas usei alguns... truques, para recuperar o que pertencia a algumas pessoas. Isso não é crime... certo?
target: A Jinzhou Patroller... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?
An Improvised Afternoon at the Tavern

source: Uma barba de dragão seria ótimo...
target: Some Loong Whiskers Crisps would be great…

source: Uma caçada só termina com um prêmio.
target: A hunt isn't complete without a prize.

source: Uma chance dada é um futuro reescrito.
target: A chance given is a future rewritten.

source: Uma descoberta com algum valor prático.
target: A finding with some practical value.

source: Uma espada afiada é temperada em pedras de amolar, lâminas que se chocam e armaduras despedaçadas, então forjada no fogo da vida. Mesmo que se quebre, deve permanecer afiada.
target: A sharp sword is honed on whetstones, clashing blades, and shattered armor, then tempered in the fire of life. Even if it breaks, it must remain sharp.

source: Uma existência singular. Um propósito vivo. Um ponto de referência... Heh, diante de tudo isso, não é até reconfortante admitir abertamente que ele e eu estamos usando um ao outro para nossos próprios fins?
target: A singular existence. A living purpose. A point of reference... Heh, given all this, isn't it comforting to openly acknowledge that he and I are both using each other for our own ends?

source: Uma expedição que vale a pena.
Uma forma inusitada de ganhar força... valeu.
target: An unusual way to gain strength... thanks.

source: Uma fé inabalável ressoará com almas afins.
target: An unwavering faith will resonate with like-minded souls.

source: Uma lâmina é afiada para atacar.
target: A blade is honed to strike.

source: Uma mente satisfeita é uma celebração perpétua.
target: A contented mind is a perpetual feast.

source: Uma mordida de pimenta e eu começo a queimar da cabeça aos pés. Meu estômago também protesta o dia todo, a noite toda.
target: One bite of chili, and I start burning head to toe. My tummy also protests all day, all night.

source: Uma nova jornada aguarda? Repleta de sons novos, histórias e... memórias fragmentadas.
target: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.

source: Uma nova perspectiva interessante. Obrigado. Agora devo conseguir melhorar ainda mais a saída de energia do meu braço protético.
target: An interesting new perspective. Thank you. Now I should be able to further improve my prosthetic arm's energy output.

source: Uma nova página no meu diário!
target: A new page in my journal!

source: Uma nova viagem nos aguarda? Repleta de sons inéditos, histórias e... memórias fragmentadas.
target: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.

source: Uma organização cheia de loucos. Peguei pesado? Não tira a verdade disso. Pra mim, já deu. Espero nunca mais ter que lidar com eles.
target: An organization full of crazies. Too harsh? Doesn't make it less true. I'm done with them. Really hope I won't have to deal with them ever again.

source: Uma patrulheira enérgica e apaixonada? Sim, ouvi falar dela. Ela tem dedicado seu tempo para proteger os sonhos das crianças em Jinzhou.
target: That energetic and passionate Patroller? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in Jinzhou.

source: Uma recompensa por resolver um enigma.
target: A reward for solving a riddle.

source: Uma vida tão efêmera quanto a primeira neve.
target: A life as fleeting as the first snow.

source: Uma xícara de chá quente é um excelente remédio para músculos doloridos após um treino intenso. É bastante eficaz, você deveria experimentar.
target: A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.

source: Un après-midi improvisé à la taverne
target: An Improvised Afternoon at the Tavern

source: Un autre jour, un autre moi héroïque !
Un bon sommeil, un bon repas et… des amis pour la vie. Pour chaque jour.
target: Good sleep, good food, and... good friends together. Every single day.

source: Un combat digne de ce nom.

target: One strike, to settle it all.

source: Un coup pour mettre un terme à cette histoire.
target: One strike, to settle it all.

source: Un día, nuestra Troupe navegará por todo el mundo, y cada ola será el recuerdo de una historia compartida: ¡la leyenda de los Torpes!
target: One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of the Fools!

source: Un ennemi puissant ? Je suis prêt.
Un esprit libre sur les routes
Un fruto de la civilización humana.
Un gâteau d'anniversaire, bien sûr. Avec des tas de fruits frais et plein de crème chantilly. Et des bougies, évidemment… Pourquoi ? Parce que je n'en ai encore jamais eu.
target: A birthday cake, of course. The kind with tons of fresh fruit and way too much whipped cream. And candles on top, for sure... Why? Because I've never actually had one before.

source: Un hallazgo con cierto valor práctico.
target: A finding with some practical value.

source: Un héros... ne le fera pas...
Un jour dans la vie d'une chasseuse
Un jour, notre troupe naviguera jusqu'aux coins les plus reculés du monde, et chaque vague résonnera d'une histoire partagée ; le conte des Fous !
target: One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of the Fools!

source: Un mero rasguño en mi acero.
target: A mere scratch upon my blade.

source: Un monde… en noir et blanc…
target: A world... of black and white...

source: Un mouton, deux moutons... trois moutons... Eh ? Combien ?
target: One sheep, two sheep... Three... Um? Where was I?

source: Un nouveau voyage nous attend ? Rempli de sons inédits, d'histoires, et... de souvenirs fragmentés.
target: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.

source: Un pastel de cumpleaños, por supuesto. De esos con montones de fruta fresca y demasiada crema batida. Y velas encima, claro... ¿Que por qué? Porque nunca he tenido uno antes.
target: A birthday cake, of course. The kind with tons of fresh fruit and way too much whipped cream. And candles on top, for sure... Why? Because I've never actually had one before.
Let's pick up the pace, hm?

source: Un peu d'argent de poche en plus.
Un peu plus de temps sur scène, peut-être ?
Un poder débil... pero aun así, uno que merece ser escrutado.
target: A faint power... but still, one that commands attention.

source: Un pouvoir faible… mais qui ne peut être ignoré.
target: A faint power... but still, one that commands attention.

source: Un rendimiento aceptable para el esfuerzo invertido.
Un rêve pour l'avenir… Hmm… Jamais je n'ai pensé pouvoir en avoir un. Voyons… Eh bien, si je pouvais vivre d'autres jours comme aujourd'hui, ça me suffirait.
target: A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.

source: Un saltimbocca hecho con carne fresca. Tengo un paladar muy septimontino, así que añadir un poco de salsa picante me parece bien, ¡pero nada de crema agria como los raguneses!
target: A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the Ragunnesi!

source: Un saltimbocca à la viande fraîche. Je préfère les plats traditionnels de Septimont, donc je ne dirais pas non à une pincée de sauce piquante. Mais pas de crème aigre, nous ne sommes pas des Ragunnesi !
target: A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the Ragunnesi!

source: Un sentiment de picotement familier parcourt mon corps... Est-ce votre pouvoir ? Ha ha, il paraît que je dois prendre un peu de temps pour m'adapter.
target: I haven't felt this tingling sensation swimming across my veins in a while... So this is all your doing? *chuckle* Looks like this is going to take some time getting used to.

source: Un sueño para el futuro, esto... nunca pensé en llegar a tener uno. Veamos, si pudiera tener más días como hoy... Sí. Eso me vale.
target: A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.

source: Un tel pouvoir devrait me permettre de protéger toutes les antiquités du monde... Grâce à toi, je ne me bats plus seule... Ah! Non, non, c'est trop embarrassant à dire à voix haute !
target: Such power should allow me to protect all the antiques in the world... Thanks to you, I'm no longer fighting alone... Ack! Nope. This is too embarrassing to say out loud!

source: Un tel savoir-faire... C'est un bon investissement.

target: Well, would you look at that! Easy money.

source:
Un. Deux. Trois. Quatre… C'est pas un peu bancal ?
C-Cinq ! Non !
target:
One. Two. Three. Four… A bit off, maybe?
Fi-five! No!

source: Una Nueva Historia, Una Nueva Aventura
target: A New Story, A New Adventure

source: Una alegre estrella de mar y un suave conejito de mar... pero la verdad es que no puedo distinguirlas.
target: A lively Starfish and a gentle Sea Bunny... But I must admit, I can't tell them apart.

source: Una as forças que são tanto visíveis quanto invisíveis e purifique-se de tudo que é impuro. Só então se pode conhecer a grandiosidade do Tao; é o teste final que todo verdadeiro Taoísta deve enfrentar.
target: Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.

source: Una casa se empieza desde los cimientos.
Una existencia peculiar. Un intenso propósito. Un punto de referencia... Jej, con todo esto, ¿no te parece reconfortante saber abiertamente que nos utilizamos mutuamente para nuestros propios fines?
target: A singular existence. A living purpose. A point of reference... Heh, given all this, isn't it comforting to openly acknowledge that he and I are both using each other for our own ends?

source: Una expedición que vale la pena.
Una fe inquebrantable resonará con almas de ideas afines.
target: An unwavering faith will resonate with like-minded souls.

source: Una forma inusual de ganar fuerza... gracias.
target: An unusual way to gain strength... thanks.

source: Una hoja afilada se forja en la piedra, choca con otras espadas, destroza armaduras y se templa en el fuego de la vida. Aunque se rompa, debe mantenerse afilada.
target: A sharp sword is honed on whetstones, clashing blades, and shattered armor, then tempered in the fire of life. Even if it breaks, it must remain sharp.

source: Una hoja se afila para atacar.
target: A blade is honed to strike.

source: Una mente contenta es un festín perpetuo.
target: A contented mind is a perpetual feast.

source: Una nueva perspectiva interesante. Gracias. Ahora debería poder mejorar aún más la salida de energía de mi brazo protésico.
target: An interesting new perspective. Thank you. Now I should be able to further improve my prosthetic arm's energy output.

source: Una oportunidad dada es un futuro reescrito.
target: A chance given is a future rewritten.

source: Una organización llena de locos. ¿Exagero? No por eso es menos cierto. No quiero tener nada que ver. Realmente espero no tener que lidiar con ellos nunca más.
target: An organization full of crazies. Too harsh? Doesn't make it less true. I'm done with them. Really hope I won't have to deal with them ever again.

source: Una oveja, dos ovejas... Tres... ¿Dónde estaba?
target: One sheep, two sheep... Three... Um? Where was I?

source: Una patrullera... Uhh, mejor mantengo mi distancia... Oye, ¡no he hecho nada malo! Solo usé algunos... trucos para devolver lo que le pertenece a la gente adecuada. Eso no es un crimen... ¿verdad?
target: A Jinzhou Patroller... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?

source: Una recompensa por resolver un acertijo.
target: A reward for solving a riddle.

source: Una taza de té caliente es un excelente remedio para los músculos doloridos después de un entrenamiento intenso. Es bastante efectivo, deberías probarlo.
target: A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.

source: Una vida tan fugaz como la primera nevada.
target: A life as fleeting as the first snow.

source: Unablässig zuschlagen, wieder und wieder … Jeder Kampf schärft meine Klinge. Ihre wahre Stärke liegt nicht im Stahl, sondern im Willen ihres Trägers.
target: Strike relentlessly. Again, and again... Each battle reforges my blade. Its true strength lies not in the steel, but in the will that commands it.

source: Unas Barbas de Dragón serían geniales...
target: Some Loong Whiskers Crisps would be great…
And that was me holding back.

source:
Und jetzt ein Freiwilliger aus dem Publikum …
Soll ich dich runterheben? Na, da du so nett gefragt hast … Hehe.
target:
Now, a volunteer from the audience...
Want me put you down? Well, since you asked nicely… Hehe.

source: Une aubaine ? Le destin joue parfois en notre faveur.
target: A windfall? Fate can be rather generous sometimes.

source: Une bonne histoire a besoin de drame.
Une erreur est survenue. Veuillez contacter le service client
target: An error occurred. Please contact Customer Service for assistance

source: Une existence singulière. Un dessein. Un point de repère... Ha, compte tenu de tout cela, n'est-ce pas réconfortant d'accepter librement que lui et moi, nous nous utilisons mutuellement, chacun à nos propres fins ?
target: A singular existence. A living purpose. A point of reference... Heh, given all this, isn't it comforting to openly acknowledge that he and I are both using each other for our own ends?

source: Une expédition qui en vaut la peine.
Une foi inébranlable résonnera avec des âmes partageant les mêmes idées.
target: An unwavering faith will resonate with like-minded souls.

source: Une fois encore… nous nous séparons.
Une fois que je m'y suis habitué, ce pouvoir est à la fois puissant et doux, il a des points communs avec mon poing de la foudre.
target: Now that I've gotten used to it, this power feels robust and flexible. It does have something in common with my Leihuangquan.

source: Une journée dans la vie d'une acolyte
target: A Day in the Life of an Acolyte

source: Une lame est faite pour frapper.
target: A blade is honed to strike.

source: Une lumière si éclatante... J'espère qu'elle brillera sur chaque ombre et ne laissera aucune obscurité où se cacher.
target: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.

source: Une méthode inhabituelle pour gagner en force… Merci.
target: An unusual way to gain strength... thanks.

source: Une nouvelle chance suffit pour réécrire l'avenir.
target: A chance given is a future rewritten.

source: Une nouvelle page dans mon journal !
target: A new page in my journal!

source: Une nouvelle perspective intéressante. Merci. Maintenant, je devrais pouvoir améliorer davantage la sortie d'énergie de mon bras prothétique.
target: An interesting new perspective. Thank you. Now I should be able to further improve my prosthetic arm's energy output.

source: Une nouvelle ère est sur le point de commencer.
Une organisation de fous. C'est peut-être dur, mais ça n'en est pas moins vrai. Je ne veux plus rien à faire avec eux. J'espère ne jamais y être contrainte.
target: An organization full of crazies. Too harsh? Doesn't make it less true. I'm done with them. Really hope I won't have to deal with them ever again.

source: Une patrouilleuse... Euh, je dois m'éloigner d'elle... Hé, je n'ai rien fait de mal ! J'ai juste utilisé... moyens nécessaires, pour récupérer ce qui appartient aux bonnes personnes. Ce n'est sûrement pas un crime... n'est-ce pas ?
target: A Jinzhou Patroller... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?

source: Une petite récompense, ça motive toujours !
target: Nothing motivates like a little reward.

source: Une puissance délicieuse et irrésistible... À présent, nous partageons un nouveau secret.
target: Such delightful and irresistible power. Well, now we have another shared secret.

source: Une récompense acceptable au vu des efforts.
Une récompense pour avoir résolu une énigme.
target: A reward for solving a riddle.

source: Une simple éraflure sur ma lame.
target: A mere scratch upon my blade.

source: Une vie aussi éphémère que la première neige
target: A life as fleeting as the first snow.

source: Une épée est affûtée par la pierre à aiguiser, le fracas des batailles et les épreuves de la vie. Même brisée, sa lame ne doit jamais perdre son tranchant.
target: A sharp sword is honed on whetstones, clashing blades, and shattered armor, then tempered in the fire of life. Even if it breaks, it must remain sharp.

source: Une étoile de mer vive et un doux lapin de mer... Mais je ne peux pas les distinguer, en fait.
target: A lively Starfish and a gentle Sea Bunny... But I must admit, I can't tell them apart.

source: Unir las fuerzas que se ven y las que no se ven, y purgarse de todo lo que es impuro. Solo entonces se puede conocer la grandeza del Tao; es la prueba final que todo verdadero taoísta debe tomar.
target: Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.

source:
Uno, dos, tres, cuatro... ¿Un poco desacompasado, tal vez?

¡Ci-cinco! ¡No!
target:
One. Two. Three. Four… A bit off, maybe?
Fi-five! No!

source: Unser Kurs steht fest. Setzen wir die Segel!
target: The course is determined. Time to set sail!

source: Unterscheide die Wahrheit von der Fassade.
Unvergessliche Abenteuer? Nun, die haben wir reichlich zu bieten! Wo wollen wir anfangen? Wie wäre es mit einem alten Prozess, der sich über ein Jahrhundert hinzog?
target: Unforgettable adventures? Where to start? How about an ancient trial that spanned over a century?

source: Ups, pass auf meine Dornen auf. Lass dich nicht an den Fingern stechen. Hmm ... So was kann dir ja sowieso nicht passieren.
target: Oops, watch out for my thorns. Don't get your fingers pierced. Hmm... on second thought, not much can harm you anyway.

source: Uuund... Was ist in der Überraschungsbox Nr. 01!?
target: Aaand… What's inside mystery box No. 01!?

source: Vacilante contra el vendaval y la marea
Vaga por el infierno contemplando la nieve.
target: Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.

source: Vague sobre o inferno, contemplando a neve.
target: Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.

source: Vale. Supongo que viene con el trabajo.
target: Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.

source: Valeu aí, tchum! Agora sim, isso foi um baita ajuste!
target: Thanks, choom! Now that's what I call a solid tune-up!

source: Valeu pela ajuda... Tô começando a me acostumar.
target: 'Preciate the assist... I'm startin' to get used to this.
Cherish the gift not given lightly.

source: Vamos Lá, Rumo ao Topo da Torre Arasaka
target: Let's Go, All the Way To the Top of Arasaka Tower

source: Vamos acelerar o passo, que tal?
target: Let's pick up the pace, hm?

source: Vamos alcançar destinos mais distantes juntos.
Vamos chamar de... A Grande Colheita do Cavaleiro.
target: Let's call it... A Knight's Great Harvest.

source: Vamos embora! Que meus poemas iluminem o caminho à sua frente!
target: Off we go! May my poems light the way on your path ahead!

source: Vamos fazer isso de outra maneira.

Vamos lá!
Estrelas, iluminem o amanhã.
target:
Come on!
Stars, light up tomorrow.

Up we go, Pero.
PERO: Haah!

source: Vamos mostrar do que somos capazes.
target: Let's prove our value to each other.

source: Vamos tirar uma para o álbum?
Vamos ver se os ganhos valerão o esforço.
target: Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.

source: Vamos, a la cima de la Torre Arasaka
target: Let's Go, All the Way To the Top of Arasaka Tower

source: Vamos. Me vendría bien otra pareja de baile.
target: Come now. I could use another dancer.

source: Variable Parameter, reale Daten, potenzielle Wahrscheinlichkeiten … Ich werde all das berücksichtigen, um unsere Effizienz zu steigern.
target: Variable parameters, empirical data, potential probabilities... I'll take all of these into consideration to improve our efficiency.
Luck does seem to favor you.

source: Vaya, eso es sinceridad. Haré que esto valga la pena, por supuesto. Mi niebla estará contigo en todo momento, puedes confiar en que te cubriré la espalda.
target: Whoa, talk about sincerity. I'll make this worth your while, of course. My mist will be with you at all times, you can trust me to have your back.

source: Vaya, eso es todo un descubrimiento.
Vaya, hermosos… Oh, mejor los guardo primero.
target: Wow, beautiful… Oh, I'd better put them away first.

source: Vaya, mira quién ha encontrado su propia inspiración.
target: Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.
Well, well. What do we have here?

source: Vaya, vaya... No creo haber visto nunca una puntuación tan alta.
target: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.

source: Vaya, ¡así es como lo hiciste! Encore lo está convirtiendo en parte de la historia... Lo escucharás cuando tengas tiempo.
target: Woah, so that's how you did it! Encore's making it part of the story... You'll hear it when you've got the time.

source: Veamos si las ganancias valdrán el esfuerzo.
target: Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.

source: Ven a buscarme cuando necesites que se haga algo. Ven a buscarme... cuando no lo hagas, también. Solo pasando el rato juntos, escuchando música y disfrutando de algunos dulces... Estaré esperando eso, si estás aquí conmigo.
target: Come find me when you need something made. Come find me... when you don't, too. Just idling by together, listening to music and indulging in some sweets... I'll be looking forward to that, if you're here with me.

source: Ven conmigo y terminemos juntos esta esperada interpretación.
target: Come, let us finish this performance we've all been waiting for. Together.

source: Venha me encontrar quando precisar de algo. E quando não precisar... também. Apenas passar o tempo juntos, ouvir música e desfrutar de alguns doces... Espero ansiosamente por isso, você aqui comigo.
target: Come find me when you need something made. Come find me... when you don't, too. Just idling by together, listening to music and indulging in some sweets... I'll be looking forward to that, if you're here with me.

source: Venha, vamos terminar esta apresentação que todos estávamos esperando. Juntos.
target: Come, let us finish this performance we've all been waiting for. Together.
Come now. I could use another dancer.

source: Ventos frios vindo de baixo... finalmente um pouco de paz.
target: Cold winds from under... finally some peace.

source: Veo llamas frías más allá del borde de la razón. Veo perfección tras el desastre. Veo caos. Veo ilusiones. Veo verdades. Te veo... a ti, quien capturó la luna.
target: I see cold flames beyond the edge of reason. I see perfection rising from the shattered end. I see Chaos. I see illusions. I see truths. I see... you, the one who captured the moon.

source: Veo todo... en blanco y negro...
target: A world... of black and white...

source: Verbrannte Kekse, zerkochte Instantnudeln, Desserts, bei denen jemand Zucker mit Salz verwechselt hat … Wenn sie es für mich gemacht haben, war ich selig.
target: Burnt cookies, soggy instant noodles, desserts where someone confused salt with sugar... If they made it for me, I love it.

source: Vereine die sichtbaren und unsichtbaren Stärken und reinige dich von allem Unreinen. Nur dann kann man die Größe des Tao erkennen; es ist die letzte Prüfung, die jeder wahre Taoist absolvieren muss.
target: Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.
Lost in the mist of time.

source: Verstanden. Ich bin hier, um deinem Willen zu dienen.
target: Understood. I am here to serve your will.

source: Versuch gar nicht erst, mich mit deinem Wissen über Antiquitätenbewertung zu beeindrucken, denn es gibt kaum jemanden, der das besser kann als ich! *schnaubt zufrieden*Was ich mir von einem Freund wünsche, ist einfach Respekt vor antiken Artefakten.
target: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.

source: Versuchst du mich zu verarschen? Nicht in diesem Leben!
Verwelken... ist natürlich für das Leben...
Vi sombras donde la luz no podía llegar. ¿Qué pasaría si el camino en el que tan fervientemente creí no fuera el correcto? Yo... No, no importa. Por favor, no le hagas caso.
target: I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me...

source: Vi sombras onde a luz não conseguia alcançar. E se o caminho em que eu acreditava tão fervorosamente nunca foi o certo? Então... Não, deixa pra lá. Por favor, não ligue para mim...
target: I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me...

source: Viele glauben, dass "Talent" ein Segen ist, ignorieren aber den Fluch, der damit einhergeht: Eines Tages könnte das Schicksal es leise wegnehmen. Nehme dein Talent nicht als selbstverständlich an - nutze es, bevor es zu spät ist.
target: Many believe having "talent" is a blessing, but ignore the curse that comes along: someday fate might take it away, quietly. Don't take your talent for granted—make the most of it, before it's too late.

source: Viele nehmen Mortefi oft als arrogant und unnahbar wahr, aber tatsächlich ist er nicht so schwer zu erreichen. Denk daran, direkt mit ihm zu sein, denn zu versuchen, übermäßig höflich und subtil zu sein, kann nur zu Missverständnissen führen.
target: Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.

source: Viele stolpern ohne Richtung durchs Leben, ohne jemals einen Zweck zu finden. Baizhi gehört zu den seltenen, die ihre Berufung gefunden haben, und sie ist bereit, alles für die Wahrheit, die sie verfolgt, aufzugeben.
target: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

source: Viele tragen Masken, um sich anzupassen. Sie aber nicht. Sie ist immer authentisch, egal wie ihre Vergangenheit war oder welche Rollen sie schon gespielt hat.
target: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.

source: Vielleicht hast du keine Erinnerungen an Macht, aber aus Erinnerungen kann man immer Kraft schöpfen.
target: You may not have memories of power, but you can always draw strength from memories.

source: Vielleicht noch ein wenig mehr Bühnenzeit?
Vielleicht wird Encore eines Tages überall auf der Welt unterwegs sein und auch ein Held sein. Hehe, aber zuerst, was gibt's morgen zum Frühstück?
target: Maybe one day, Encore will go everywhere in the world and be a hero too. Hehe, but first, what's for breakfast tomorrow?

source: Viene de la Orden Abisal. No la conozco muy bien, pero… ella fue la primera acólita en tocar la caja sin que Perri la mordiera.
target: She's from the Order of the Deep. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first Acolyte to touch the box without getting bitten by Pero.

source: Viens me voir quand tu as besoin de quelque chose. Viens me voir... même quand tu n'as pas besoin. Juste à ne rien faire ensemble, à écouter de la musique et à savourer des sucreries... Avec toi, c'est pas mal.
target: Come find me when you need something made. Come find me... when you don't, too. Just idling by together, listening to music and indulging in some sweets... I'll be looking forward to that, if you're here with me.

source: Viens, terminons la performance que nous attendons tous. Ensemble.
target: Come, let us finish this performance we've all been waiting for. Together.

source: Vientos fríos desde abajo. Al fin algo de paz.
target: Cold winds from under... finally some peace.

source: Vingança não é matar sem pensar. Trata-se de identificar a raiz da maldade e atingir onde realmente dói. Agradeço imensamente você ter me ensinado o movimento, tem sido muito útil.
target: Vengeance is not mindless killing. It is about identifying the root of malice, and hitting where it truly hurts. Thank you, the move you've taught me has been very useful.

source: Viu? Eu sempre escolho o lado vencedor — o seu.
target: See? I always choose the winning side—yours.
See? I haven't lost my touch.

source: Viver livre como a névoa e aproveitar a vida enquanto dure. Parece ótimo, né?
target: To live free as the mist and enjoy life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?

source: Vivir libre como la niebla y disfrutar de tu vida mientras dure. Suena maravilloso, ¿no te parece?
target: To live free as the mist and enjoy life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?

source: Vivre libre comme la brume et profiter de la vie tant qu'elle dure. Ça sonne bien, n'est-ce pas ?
target: To live free as the mist and enjoy life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?

source: Você consegue ouvir? Esse é o som da germinação.
target: Can you hear it? Shh... That's the sound of sprouting.

source: Você cruzou com a pessoa errada.
Você está irritando quem está te ensinando!
Você está se referindo à garotinha que sempre é vista ao lado de Aalto? Eu a conheci uma vez. Ela e Aalto se complementam perfeitamente, em termos de personalidade.
target: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.

source: Você fez por merecer. Fica com isso.
target: You earned it, you keep it.

source: Você já deve ter o pagamento em mãos, agora.
target: You should have the payment ready by now.

source: Você já esteve no Teatro de Jinzhou? É um lugar de alegria e risos intermináveis, especialmente quando um espetáculo termina em uma nota feliz. Sempre valorizei essa visão, por isso quero garantir que todos encontrem seu próprio final feliz.
target: Have you been to the Jinzhou Theater? It's a place of endless joy and laughter, especially when a show concludes on a happy note. I've always cherished that sight, which is why I want to ensure everyone finds their own happy ending.

source: Você já foi pra Lua? Eu fui, mas me custou muito... Ainda lembro exatamente como eu me senti quando cheguei lá pela primeira vez. Mesmo que o David não pudesse me levar, eu sabia que estávamos lá juntos.
target: You ever been to the Moon? I have, but it cost me a lot... Still remember exactly how I felt when I first arrived. Even though David couldn't take me, I knew we were there together.

source: Você me ajudou a alcançar um nível de poder antes desconhecido; em troca, vou usá-lo em todo o seu potencial para você.
target: You have helped me gain a previously unknown level of power; in return, I will use this power to its fullest extent for you.

source: Você me ensinou bem, mas eu adicionei alguns toques criativos à sua técnica. Agora é a hora perfeita para testá-la!
target: You taught me well, but I've added a few creative twists to your technique. Now's the perfect time to test it out!

source: Você nunca erra ao levar crianças perdidas para Chixia. Algumas crianças me acham assustador, mas nunca teriam medo dela.
target: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.

source: Você não fala muito, mas é tão forte em batalha. É como diz o bom e velho ditado de Huanglong: "Um gato que pega ratos não mia". Combina perfeitamente com você, não é?
target: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old Huanglong saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?

source: Você não vai escapar de mim.
Você o encontrou, agora é seu.
target: You found it, and it's yours to keep.

source: Você ouve o tinir da minha lâmina, não ouve? É o som da minha convicção de realizar seus desejos. Qualquer um deles.
target: You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.

source: Você pode confiar em mim para manter você em segurança.
target: You can trust me to keep you safe.

source: Você pode não ter lembranças de poder, mas sempre pode extrair força das lembranças.
target: You may not have memories of power, but you can always draw strength from memories.

source: Você sabe o que há embaixo da base da Costa Negra? Aalto e os outros nunca deixam Encore chegar perto. Será que eles estão guardando coisas legais (ou assustadoras) lá embaixo?
target: Do you know what's under the Black Shores' base? Aalto and the others won't ever let me go near. Are they keeping cool stuff and scary things down there?

source: Você sabia que a pequena flor ao seu lado realmente gosta de você? Eu a ouvi falando sobre isso. As plantas falam em uma linguagem silenciosa e sincera. Posso traduzir o que elas dizem para você, se quiser.
target: Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.

source: Você se dá bem com as câmeras!
Você se importa se eu pegar isso?
Você se preparou para isso, não é mesmo?
target: You've prepared for this, have you not?

source: Você sempre age primeiro diante da injustiça, apesar de ter perdido toda a memória... Você deve ter sido uma pessoa justa, certo? Eu ficaria muito preocupado se fosse o contrário.
target: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.

source: Você tem que dar o delta... Vai...
Você vai pagar meu medicânico!ALT: Você vai pagar pelo meu cromo!
Você vai para a barriga dos lanosos!
Você é um lutador experiente, posso perceber. Vamos ter um combate em breve, certo? Lutar é minha paixão e não posso perder a oportunidade de lutar com alguém como você!
target: You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!

source: Você é um professor incrível! Sabia? Squeakie está pulando mais alto e mais rápido depois das suas dicas!
target: You're an amazing teacher! Didya know? Squeakie's jumping higher and faster after your pointers!

source:
Voe alto!
Verdade, alcance o cosmos.
target:
Fly high!
Truth, reach the cosmos.

source: Voilà l'inspiration qui coule à flots !
Voilà une découverte d'un intérêt pratique.
target: A finding with some practical value.

source: Vom Wasser her, ins Wasser hin.
Von den Stromschnellen angehoben, sah ich ein goldenes Leuchten … Deine Weisheit und Anmut sind eine Heilsbotschaft, die ich immer schätzen werde.
target: Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear.

source: Von einem Mond zum anderen, durch endlose Phasen … bis über den messbaren Bereich hinaus.
target: From one moon to another, through endless cycles... until it's beyond measurement.

source: Vor meinen Augen offenbart sich die Bedeutung der Runen. Sie sind nicht länger zweidimensional, sondern strahlen eine unglaubliche Tiefe und Unendlichkeit aus …
target: From something flat to something with great depth, the meaning of the runes unfolds before my eyes. It feels infinite...

source: Votre aide a ouvert un monde de possibilités pour Youtan et moi. C'est un peu étrange pour moi d'avoir de nombreuses options, au lieu d'une seule vérité... mais j'aime bien ce sentiment.
target: Your help has opened up a world of potential for You'tan and me. It feels a bit foreign to me to be presented with many options, instead of one single truth... but I rather enjoy this feeling.

source: Votre découverte, c'est à vous de la gérer.
target: You found it, and it's yours to keep.

source: Votre personnalité est impressionnante. Un tel caractère remarquable ne peut pas être construit en une nuit. Je peux dire que vous avez vécu bien plus que j'imagine.
target: Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.

source: Vou aprender a dominar esse poder o mais rápido que puder...!
target: I'll learn to master this power as quickly as I can...!

source: Vou considerar como taxa de hora extra.
target: I'll take it as my overtime fee.
I'll take good care of you.

source: Vou cumprir, seja uma ordem direta ou qualquer outro desejo que você tenha.
target: I'll fulfill it, be it a direct command or any other wish you have.

source: Vou guardar tudo isso no meu coração para sempre.
target: I'll keep all of this in my heart forever.

source: Vous avez besoin de quelque chose ?
Vous avez mis votre prof en colère !
Vous avez trouvé quelque chose ? Gardez-le comme vous voulez.
target: Found something you like? Keep them as you will.

source: Vous devriez avoir préparé la récompense correspondante.
target: You should have the payment ready by now.

source: Vous m'avez aidé à atteindre un niveau de puissance inconnu auparavant ; en retour, je l'utiliserai à son plein potentiel pour vous.
target: You have helped me gain a previously unknown level of power; in return, I will use this power to its fullest extent for you.

source: Vous n'avez peut-être pas une mémoire prodigieuse, mais vous pouvez toujours puiser de la force dans vos souvenirs.
target: You may not have memories of power, but you can always draw strength from memories.

source: Vous ne pouvez pas vous échapper.
Vous pouvez me faire confiance. Je vais vous protéger.
target: You can trust me to keep you safe.

source: Vous voulez savoir ce qu'il y a dans ma tasse isotherme ? Haha, c'est juste du thé chaud.
target: Have I been keeping some kind of secret healthy drink in this flask, you ask? *chuckle* It's really just regular hot tea.

source: Voy a cortar este punto muerto.
Voy donde el viento me lleve.
Voy más rápida en mi mecha, ¿sabes?
target: I'm faster in my mech, you know?

source: Voyons !Des petits fruits ! C'est un autre miracle, mais le voyage d'une plante ne s'arrête pas là.
target: Look, it's bearing tiny fruits! Another miracle, but the journey of a plant doesn't end here.
Are those little flowers growing inside?

source: Waouh, magnifique… Oh, je ferais mieux de les ranger d'abord.
target: Wow, beautiful… Oh, I'd better put them away first.

source: Waouh ! Héhé... tu veux m'attraper hein, les voleurs !
target: Woah! Hehe... Wanna catch me huh, you thieves?
Is that the best you got?

source: Warst du schon im Jinzhou-Theater? Es ist ein Ort voller Freude und Lachen, besonders wenn eine Vorstellung glücklich endet. Ich habe diesen Anblick immer geliebt, weshalb ich möchte, dass jeder sein eigenes Happy End findet.
target: Have you been to the Jinzhou Theater? It's a place of endless joy and laughter, especially when a show concludes on a happy note. I've always cherished that sight, which is why I want to ensure everyone finds their own happy ending.

source: Warst du schon mal auf dem Mond? Ich schon, aber es hat mich viel gekostet … Ich erinnere mich noch genau an das Gefühl bei meiner Ankunft. Obwohl David mich nicht hinbringen konnte, wusste ich, dass er mit mir dort war.
target: You ever been to the Moon? I have, but it cost me a lot... Still remember exactly how I felt when I first arrived. Even though David couldn't take me, I knew we were there together.

source: Wartet das Tal des Ruhms auf mich?
target: Does the Vale of Glory await me?

source: Warum genießt du das nicht einfach, hm?
Warum zögern, wenn du weißt, was du willst?
target: Why hesitate, if you know what you want?

source: Was denke ich über dich? Dein Lächeln... Es wirkt warm.
target: What do I think of you? Your smile... It looks warm.

source: Was für ein strahlendes Licht … Ich hoffe, es beleuchtet jeden Schatten und lässt kein dunkles Versteck übrig.
target: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.

source: Was haben wir denn hier? Du kannst dich nicht vor mir verstecken!
target: Now, what do we have here? Ya can't hide from me!

source: Was hast du heute so gemacht? Hattest du Spaß? Hast du etwas Cooles gesehen? Los, erzähl! Encore liebt Geschichten! Und die Gefühle, die die Leute teilen... das sind wie Geschichten, die aufeinander folgen!
target: What have you been up to today? Did you have fun? Saw anything cool? C'mon, spill the beans! Encore loves stories! And the feelings people share... they're like one story after another!

source: Was ist das für ein Gesichtsausdruck? Überrascht, mich zu sehen?
target: What's that look on your face? Surprised to see me?
What is it you wish for?

source: Was ist in seiner Kalebasse drin?
Was ist mit diesem Spiegel, den sie trägt, fragst du? Oh mein Gott, oh mein Gott! Das ist ein großes, GROSSES Geheimnis. Nicht für deine Ohren bestimmt!
target: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!

source: Was sie fürchtet, was sie erschreckt
target: What She Fears, What She Dreads

source: Was soll ich damit machen... Hmm... W-whoah! Puh...
target: What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...

source: Was werde ich aus diesem Kampf lernen?
target: What will I learn from this fight?

source: Was wir wollen, finden wir auch.
target: We desire, and so we find.

source: Was, glaubst du, steckt alles in dem „Geheimtrank“ der Familie Fisalia? Ein seltenes, heimlich angebautes Kraut? Verlorene Seelen, gequält durch das verbitterte Geflüster in diesen Hallen? Oder vielleicht das zarte Fleisch junger Mädchen? Hehe …
target: Tell me, what do you suppose goes into the Fisalia family's famed elixir? A rare herb, grown in secret? Tormented souls simmering in unseen cauldrons? Hehe... Or perhaps the delicate flesh of young girls?

source: Wehe, ich komme dabei ins Schwitzen.
target: Tell me there's no sweating involved.

source: Weiter … Gib mir mehr … Noch eine Runde, Krieger! Ich will eine Revanche!
target: More... Get me more... One more round, Warrior! I want a rematch!

source: Weißt du, was unter der Basis der Schwarzen Küsten ist? Aalto und die anderen lassen mich nie in die Nähe kommen. Bewahren sie dort coole und gruselige Dinge auf?
target: Do you know what's under the Black Shores' base? Aalto and the others won't ever let me go near. Are they keeping cool stuff and scary things down there?

source: Weißt du? Die kleine Blume neben dir mag dich wirklich! Ich habe sie darüber sprechen hören. Pflanzen sprechen in einer stillen und aufrichtigen Sprache. Ich kann ihre Sprache für dich übersetzen, wenn du möchtest.
target: Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.

source: Welche Art von Geschichte wird Encore heute hören?
target: What kinda story will Encore hear today?

source: Welche Bedeutung wirst du ihnen verleihen?
target: What significance will you grant them?

source: Wellen steigen – das Urteil schlägt zu!
Wenn Echos auch diesen Resonanz-Trank kriegen, dann … Was? Die kriegen was anderes? Was soll das heißen?
target: If Echoes got this Resonance Potion stuff too, then... Huh? Wait, they get somethin' else? What's the deal?

source: Wenn Gefahr droht, nimm hinter mir Deckung.
target: When danger arises, take cover behind me.

source: Wenn das Glück einmal auf deiner Seite ist, gibt es kein Halten mehr!
target: There's no stopping good luck once it's on your side!

source: Wenn der wahre Name enthüllt wird, leuchtet die Rune auf.
target: When the True Name is unveiled, the rune illuminates.

source: Wenn die Bösewichte nicht vernünftig mit sich reden lassen, lass deine Waffen sprechen! Deshalb habe ich an neuen Laserstrahlmatrizen gearbeitet!
target: When you can't reason with the bad guys, let your weapons do the talking! That's why I've been working on new laser beam arrays!

source: Wenn du Zeit hast, wie wäre es, wenn wir zusammen spazieren gehen? Die Welt sieht ganz anders aus, wenn du kein bestimmtes Ziel im Kopf hast. Möchtest du es ausprobieren?
target: When you have the time, how about we take a walk together? The world is going to look very different when you don't have a particular destination in mind. Want to give it a try?
If it's a duel you want...

source: Wenn du schon so weit gekommen bist, warum kreuzt du nicht die Klingen mit stärkeren Gegnern und testest dein Können?
target: Since you've come this far, why not cross blades with mightier foes and test your mettle?

source: Wenn du zur See fährst, denke immer zuerst daran, deinen Kurs zu bestimmen und dann … mach dich auf alles gefasst!
target: When sailing the seas, always remember to set your course first, and then... adapt to whatever comes your way!

source: Wenn eines Tages die Grenzgebiete keinen General mehr brauchen, nehme ich an, dass mein Wunsch in Erfüllung gegangen ist.
target: If one day, the borderlands no longer need a general, I suppose my wish will have come true.

source: Wenn ich das Chaos sehe, das die Trunkenbolde hinterlassen … Uff, ich würde den Schnaps am liebsten ins Meer kippen.
target: Every time I see the mess those drunkards leave behind... Ugh, I just want to dump all the booze into the ocean.

source: Wenn ich koche, fühlt es sich an, als würden die Aromen nie verschmelzen, als wären die Zutaten und Gewürze im Widerspruch... Bist-bist du daran interessiert, es zu probieren? Ähm, ich muss mehr üben, bevor du es probierst...
target: When I cook, it feels like the flavors never blend, like the ingredients and seasonings are at odds… Are-are you interested in tasting it? Um, I'll have to practice more before you try it…

source: Wenn ich nur näher gewesen wäre …

Wenn man von Baizhi spricht, sie ist nicht der gesprächige Typ. Versteh mich nicht falsch, sie ist keine Eisprinzessin! Sie hat einfach ihre eigenen Wege, Emotionen auszudrücken. Du wirst es verstehen, sobald du genug Zeit mit ihr verbracht hast.
target: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.

source: Wenn möglich würde ich mir wünschen, dass wir alle noch lange Freunde bleiben können. Aber … ich weiß, dass die Zeit ihrem eigenen Lauf folgt.
target: If possible, I really wish we could all stay friends for a long, long time. But... I know time has a will of its own.

source: Wenn selbst das nicht reicht, um den Weg zu ebnen, dann sollen Flüsse und Berge der Beweis dafür sein, wie viel ich zu riskieren bereit bin.
target: If this isn't enough to pave the way, then let the rivers and mountains be the proof of what I'm willing to wager.

source: Wenn wir so von einem Kampf zum nächsten gehen, wirst du da auch manchmal müde? Ich will stärker, klüger und besser werden. Ich will jemand sein, auf den du dich verlassen kannst, deine verlässlichste Kriegerkameradin.
target: As we advance from one battle to the next, do you ever feel tired? I want to become stronger, wiser, and better. I want to be someone who's got your back, to be your... most trusted Fellow Warrior.

source: Wer ist jetzt der gefangene Vogel?
target: Who is the caged bird now?

source: Wer wird diesmal auf der anderen Seite des Brettes sitzen?
target: Who will be sitting on the other side of the board this time?

source: Wer wird mit mir in die Tiefe sinken?
target: Who will sink into the depths with me?

source: Werden die aufziehenden Klänge … schön genug klingen?
target: Will the approaching sounds be... beautiful enough?

source: Whoa, c'est ce qu'on appelle de la sincérité. Je vais te rendre la pareille, bien sûr. Mon brouillard sera toujours avec toi, tu peux me faire confiance.
target: Whoa, talk about sincerity. I'll make this worth your while, of course. My mist will be with you at all times, you can trust me to have your back.
Like sea foam on the shore...

source: Wie das Hütende sagte, werden wir uns hier treffen.
target: As the Sentinel foretold, you and I were meant to cross paths.
How's that for a magic trick?

source: Wie gefällt dir Guts? Hab ich selbst gebaut. Sieht gut aus und knallt ordentlich. Bevor ich meine Arme verchromt hab, hat mich der Rückstoß umgehauen. War echt ätzend.
target: Ya like Guts? My own custom job. Talks the talk, packs a mean punch. Before I chromed up my arms, the recoil would send me flyin'. Total pain in the buns.

source: Wie gefällt es dir hier in Jinzhou? Genießt du deinen Aufenthalt? Es ist mein Traum, es zu einem wirklich sicheren und gemütlichen Ort zum Leben zu machen, frei von allen Gefahren der Grenzstädte.
target: How do you like it here in Jinzhou? Enjoying your stay? It is my dream to make it a truly safe and cozy place to live, free from all the border city dangers.

source: Wie immer bin ich der, den Sie brauchen... Ich kann wirklich nicht gegen Sie gewinnen, oder? Lassen Sie uns das einfach erledigen.
target: As always, I'm the one you need... I really can't win with you, can I? Let's just get this done.

source: Wie toll!, gibst du mir tatsächlich all diese? Gute Entscheidung!
target: Geez, you're actually giving me all of these? Good call!

source: Wie vielen Treffern kannst du standhalten?
target: How many strikes can you survive?

source: Wie wäre es mit einer Melodie, bevor wir aufbrechen?
target: How about a melody before we depart?

source: Wieder einmal … trennen sich unsere Wege.

Willkommen in Jinzhou, geschätzter Gast von weit her. Entschuldige bitte, falls meine Gastfreundschaft nicht perfekt ist; mein Terminplan ist sehr voll. Solltest du etwas Dringendes haben, findest du mich direkt im Rathaus.
target: Welcome to Jinzhou, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall.

source:
Willst du mal probieren? So. Hier.
Es ist so weit geflogen! Beeindruckend!
target:
Give it a try? Like this. Here.
It flew so far! Impressive!

source: Wir haben noch eine lange Reise vor uns. Lass uns weitermachen.
target: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.

source: Wir sind jetzt auf dem richtigen Weg. Der nächste Halt ist … hart Backbord!
target: We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside!

source: Wir sind ungefähr gleich alt, aber Danjin ist viel größer als ich... Der Jadestein, den sie trägt, ist so schön! *Seufz*... Es ist schade, dass ich keine einzige freudige Schwingung davon spüren kann...
target: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...

source: Wird es jemals Drachenbartkuchen geben, die so laaaaang wie die echten Barthaare eines Drachen sind? Oh, ich würde sie wirklich gerne probieren!
target: Will there ever be Loong Whiskers Crisps that are as loooong as a real loong's whiskers? Aww, I really want to give them a try!

source: Wissenschaft ist das Infragestellen der Wahrheit durch das Leben.
target: Science is life's questioning of truth.

source: Wissenschaftliche Forschung ist nur ein Werkzeug. Es ist keine Magie. Die Leute neigen dazu, unrealistische Erwartungen an die Forschung zu haben, und du möchtest nicht einer von ihnen sein.
target: Scientific research is but a tool. It's not magic. People tend to have unrealistic expectations about how research works, and you wouldn't want to be one of them.

source: Wo das wahre Selbst geformt wurde
Wo klare Bäche fließen, da wartet der Frühling.
target: Where clear streams flow, there spring awaits.

source: Wo seid ihr, meine lieben Samen?
target: Where are you, my lovely seeds?

source: Woah ! Hé ! Moumous ! Faites de la place ! Je veux regarder, voyez ? ...Membre du Littoral noir, Encore, à l'appel !
target: Woah! Hey! Woolies, make some room! I wanna look, see? ...Black Shores member, Encore, reporting in!

source: Woah! Hey! Woolies, macht Platz! Mitglied der Schwarzen Küsten, Encore, meldet sich!
target: Woah! Hey! Woolies, make some room! I wanna look, see? ...Black Shores member, Encore, reporting in!

source: Woah! Puh... Du willst mich fangen, huh, ihr Diebe? Träumt weiter!
target: Woah! Hehe... Wanna catch me huh, you thieves?

source: Wohin ich auch gehe, ich schwöre, das Böse zu besiegen, ob es nun im Tageslicht ist oder im Dunkeln versteckt.
target: Wherever I go, I swear to vanquish evil, whether it's out in the daylight or hiding in the dark.

source: Wohin? Ich kann dir den Weg weisen.
target: Where to? I can lead the way for you.

source: Woolies, lasst uns ein Wettrennen machen!
Worte allein können nicht zurückzahlen, was du für mich getan hast. Ich muss jetzt für dich kämpfen. Brauchst du ein unzerstörbares Schwert oder einen Schild, der allem standhält?
target: Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything?

source: Worüber sollte man da wählerisch sein? Ich bin mit jedem Essen zufrieden, solange es meinen Bauch füllt.
target: What's there to be picky about? I'm good with any food, as long as it fills my tummy.

source: Wow! Ist das "Rover Magie"!? Oh nein, du gehst nirgendwo hin, bevor du mir deine Geheimnisse verrätst!
target: Woah! Is this "Rover Magic"!? Oh no you don't, you're not going anywhere unless you tell me your secrets!

source: Wow! Spür richtig, wie das Zeug kickt!
target: Woo! Can feel that juice kickin' in!

source: Wow, also so hast du das gemacht! Encore macht es zu einem Teil der Geschichte... Du wirst es hören, wenn du Zeit hast.
target: Woah, so that's how you did it! Encore's making it part of the story... You'll hear it when you've got the time.

source: Wow, das nenne ich mal Aufrichtigkeit. Ich werde das wert sein, natürlich. Mein Nebel wird jederzeit bei dir sein, du kannst dich auf mich verlassen.
target: Whoa, talk about sincerity. I'll make this worth your while, of course. My mist will be with you at all times, you can trust me to have your back.

source: Wow, so eine seltene Art! Das ist mein Glückstag!
target: Wow, such a rare species! It's my lucky day!

source: Wow, wunderschön… Oh, ich sollte sie besser erst weglegen.
target: Wow, beautiful… Oh, I'd better put them away first.

source: Während aufeinanderfolgender wissenschaftlicher Konferenzen schwindet meine Konzentration und ich brauche Zeit zur Regeneration. Die Gesellschaft von Kollegen ist schön, aber ein bisschen Einsamkeit ist notwendig, damit ich konzentriert bleibe.
target: During back-to-back academic conferences, my focus wanes and I need time to recharge. Being with peers is enjoyable, but a little solitude is necessary for me to stay sharp.

source: Während ich wachse, fühlen sich sogar meine Atemzüge leichter an...
target: As I grow, even my breaths feel lighter...

source: Während ich wenig für Antiquitätenbewertungen verlange, wird ein Kampf einen anderen Preis haben!
target: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!

source: Während meines Studiums in der Akademie wurde mir bewusst, dass ich zur Wahrung der Gerechtigkeit härter arbeiten und mehr als andere opfern muss, um die Schatten zu bezwingen, die sie zu zerstören suchen.
target: During my studies at the seminary, I knew that to uphold justice, I would need to work harder and sacrifice more than others to overcome the shadows that sought to destroy it.

source: Würden diese für deine Bedürfnisse ausreichen? Sag mir, ob du noch etwas brauchst.
target: Would these be enough for your needs? Tell me if there is anything else you want.

source: Y a du vin à l'intérieur ?
Y a nulle part où fuir !
Y aura-t-il un jour des Barbes de dragon aussi longues que des Dragons vrais ? Oh, j'aimerais vraiment les essayer !
target: Will there ever be Loong Whiskers Crisps that are as loooong as a real loong's whiskers? Aww, I really want to give them a try!

source: Y... ¿Qué hay en la caja misteriosa No. 01!?
target: Aaand… What's inside mystery box No. 01!?

source: Ya he recorrido este camino antes.
Ya me he despedido del «yo» enterrado bajo las tierras heladas. Cuando la nieve se derrita... nos encontraremos de nuevo entre las nuevas flores de la primavera.
target: I've already bid farewell to the self buried beneath the frostlands. When the snow thaws... we'll meet again among the new blooms of spring.

source: Ya no voy a ser amable.
Ya que has llegado tan lejos, ¿por qué no cruzar hojas con enemigos más poderosos y poner a prueba tu temple?
target: Since you've come this far, why not cross blades with mightier foes and test your mettle?

source: Ya soy muy fuerte, ¡aún así, gracias!
target: Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!

source: Yangyang est douce et belle, et elle parle bien ! Parfois, elle dit des phrases que je ne comprends pas. C'est bien poétique, n'est-ce pas ?
target: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

source: Yangyang ist so ein Schatz, sogar ihre Worte klingen hübsch! Manchmal verstehe ich allerdings nicht ganz, was sie sagt. Wie nennt man das nochmal? Ah, Gedichte, glaube ich!
target: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

source: Yangyang é um amor, até as palavras dela soam bonitas! Às vezes eu não entendo bem o que ela diz. Como é que chamam mesmo? Ah, poemas, eu acho!
target: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

source: Yangyang น่ะน่ารักสุดๆ ไปเลย ขนาดคำพูดของเธอยังฟังดูเพราะเลย! แต่บางทีฉันก็ไม่ค่อยเข้าใจที่เธอพูดเท่าไรเหมือนกันแฮะ เขาเรียกแบบนั้นว่าอะไรนะ อ้อ กลอนมั้ง!
target: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

source: Yin e Yang... separados para sempre.
Yin und Yang … für immer voneinander getrennt.
Yinlin ? Cet agent infiltré qui s'est infiltré dans mon groupe ? *huff* Du calme. Je ne lui ai pas donné de fil à retordre, à condition qu'elle reste toujours dans son couloir.
target: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.

source: Yinlin สายลับที่แฝงตัวเข้ามาในกลุ่มฉันน่ะเหรอ *หึ* ใจเย็นๆ ฉันไม่ไปหาเรื่องอะไรเธอหรอกนะ ตราบใดที่เธอยังคอยเจียมเนื้อเจียมตัวอยู่น่ะ
target: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.

source: Yinlin, mon identité... Chut, tu ne peux pas la révéler à tout le monde.
target: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.

source: Yinlin? Aquela agente infiltrada que se infiltrou no meu grupo? *huff* Calma aí. Eu não a incomodei, já que ela sempre fica na dela.
target: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.

source: Yinlin? Diese verdeckte Agentin, die in meine Gruppe eingedrungen ist? *huff* Beruhige dich. Ich habe ihr nicht das Leben schwer gemacht, solange sie in ihrer Spur geblieben ist.
target: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.

source: You'tan e eu garantiremos sua segurança.
target: You'tan and I will ensure your safety.

source: You'tan und ich werden für deine Sicherheit sorgen.
target: You'tan and I will ensure your safety.

source: You'tan y yo nos aseguraremos de tu seguridad.
target: You'tan and I will ensure your safety.

source: You'tanและฉันจะรับรองความปลอดภัยให้คุณเอง
target: You'tan and I will ensure your safety.

source: Youhus Pakete kommen immer mit einer Versicherung, voller teurer Antiquitäten. Ich verstehe nicht viel von diesen Sachen, aber an der Art, wie sie sie behandelt, kann man sehen, dass sie ihre Schätze sind.
target: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.
You'tan and I will ensure your safety.

source: Zani es la definición de un adulto como tiene que ser. Trabajar con ella es fácil y cómodo y nunca tengo que preocuparme de que algo salga mal...
target: Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong...

source: Zani est ce qu'on appelle une véritable adulte. C'est toujours un plaisir de travailler avec elle, et je n'ai jamais à craindre que quoi que ce soit tourne mal...
target: Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong...

source: Zani ist die Definition einer richtigen Erwachsenen. Mit ihr zu arbeiten ist so einfach, so angenehm, und ich muss mir nie Sorgen machen, dass etwas schiefgeht …
target: Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong...

source: Zani คือคำจำกัดความของผู้ใหญ่ที่แท้จริง ทำงานกับเธอสะดวกและสบายใจมาก ไม่ต้องกังวลว่าจะมีอะไรผิดพลาด...
target: Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong...

source: Zapstring ... เวทีเป็นของแกแล้ว
Zapstring ตาเราแล้ว
Zapstring ถึงคิวปิดม่านของเราแล้ว!
Zapstring, das ist unser letzter Auftritt!
Zeig mir, was du drauf hast!
Zeit für die Luftaufklärung von Encore!
Zeit für ein Nickerchen … Es war bloß ein Traum.
target: Time for a little nap... It's... It's just a dream...

source: Zeit für eine weitere Nachmittagskonsultation, wie ich sehe. Was beschäftigt dich heute?
target: Time for another afternoon consultation, I see. What's on your mind today?

source: Zeit zu arbeiten? *kichern* Dann ist es vorbei mit dem Faulenzen.
target: Time to work? *chuckle* No more lazing around, then.

source: Zeit, an die Arbeit zu gehen.
target: Time to get back to work.

source:
Zeit, den Leuten einzuheizen.
PERO: Pero! Knurrr!
target:
Time for some crowd work.
PERO: Pero! Rawrrr!

source: Zeit, diese Geschichte zu beenden, all unsere gemeinsamen Abenteuer. Und hier ist der Titel des letzten Kapitels: „Fortsetzung folgt“.
target: Time to end this story, the tale of all our adventures together. And there it is, the title of the final chapter: "To be Continued."

source: Zeit, ein neues Spiel zu beginnen.
target: Time to start a new game.

source: Zeit, ein wenig ICE zu knacken.

target: Time to bring out my A-game.
More paperwork? Let's see... *satisfied smile* All set. Now, what should I have for dinner?

source: Zerstöre die Illusionen, offenbare ihre wahre Gestalt … und binde sie.
target: Mirage into mist, mist into bone... Withdraw.

source: Ziehen wir gemeinsam in den Kampf.
Zu strahlen oder zu sterben? Nur zwei Seiten derselben Medaille.
