target: When you have the time, how about we take a walk together? The world is going to look very different when you don't have a particular destination in mind. Want to give it a try?

source: 不思議だね。文字と音楽が、私たちに力をもたらしてくれるんだ……まるで奇跡のように。
target: Isn't it amazing what miracles words and music can bring?

source: 不思議な力……だけど何故か、親近感がある。
target: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.

source: 不思議な力のはずだが……何故か、親近感がある。
target: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.
I don't... want to disappoint you...
I don't... want to disappoint you...
Tell me there's no sweating involved.

source: 不滅の月が、運命を覆すわ。
target: I am the moon that never falls, here to rewrite the ending.

source: 不用嚼的东西比较好，软绵绵又入口即化的，熬煮几个小时的养生粥很不错呢……帮我“呼呼”地吹凉一点可以吗？
target: I'm all about the easy-to-eat stuff. Give me some creamy, savory porridge any day. Can you help me out with this spoonful? It's a little bit too hot for my tongue.

source: 不用嚼的東西比較好，軟綿綿又入口即化的，熬煮幾個小時的養生粥很不錯呢……幫我「呼呼」地吹涼一點可以嗎？
target: I'm all about the easy-to-eat stuff. Give me some creamy, savory porridge any day. Can you help me out with this spoonful? It's a little bit too hot for my tongue.

source: 不用急，总有按捺不住的敌人会送上门。
target: No rush. The impatient ones will fall right into our lap.

source: 不用急，總有按捺不住的敵人會送上門。
target: No rush. The impatient ones will fall right into our lap.

source: 不用着急嘛，总会解决的。
target: No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time.

source: 不用著急嘛，總會解決的。
target: No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time.
How many strikes can you survive?
How many strikes can you survive?
Take it easy. Do you want one too? Hmm? Haha.
Don't run, keep the dance going!
Don't run, keep the dance going!
A mere scratch upon my blade.
A mere scratch upon my blade.

source: 不錯，看來技術還沒有生疏。
target: Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

source: 不錯，讓我變強了……是不是該想想怎麼答謝你呢？
target: Good. That did make me stronger... Should I start thinking about how to repay you?

source: 不错，看来技术还没有生疏。
target: Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

source: 不错，让我变强了……是不是该想想怎么答谢你呢？
target: Good. That did make me stronger... Should I start thinking about how to repay you?

source: 与えよう、永遠の静寂を。
与植入体和软件的升级不同……这种感觉，还真是奇妙。
target: Not like any upgrade I've ever had, hardware or soft. It's like... my whole system's hummin'.

source: 世事无常，何必用烦恼困住自己，要是不开心的话，随时来找我，保准让你心情好起来，放心，这不是交易，不收费。
target: With everything in this world so unpredictable, why sweat yourself all the time? When you're feeling gloomy, just hit me up. I'll get you straightened out, no strings attached.

source: 世事無常，何必用煩惱困住自己，要是不開心的話，隨時來找我，保準讓你心情好起來，放心，這不是交易，不收費。
target: With everything in this world so unpredictable, why sweat yourself all the time? When you're feeling gloomy, just hit me up. I'll get you straightened out, no strings attached.

source: 世界……似乎变得更加清晰。
target: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.

source: 世界……似乎變得更加清晰。
target: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.

source: 世界が……より鮮明に聞こえた。
target: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.

source: 世界是个舞台，你我都是演员。
target: All the world's a stage, and we are mere players.

source: 世界是個舞台，你我都是演員。
target: All the world's a stage, and we are mere players.

source: 世間只有尚未認知之物，沒有不可認知之物。距離所求真理，我似乎更近了一步。
target: In this world, there are only those things which are not yet known, not those which cannot be known. I seem to be one step closer to the truth I seek.
World's warm breath, in my sight.

source: 世间只有尚未认知之物，没有不可认知之物。距离所求真理，我似乎更近了一步。
target: In this world, there are only those things which are not yet known, not those which cannot be known. I seem to be one step closer to the truth I seek.
World's warm breath, in my sight.

source: 严格来说，炽霞她算是我的后辈吧，她是个比我更适合当巡尉的家伙，只要有足够的经验，她一定会成为一名优秀的巡尉吧。
target: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

source: 中身を知りたい？はは……ただの熱いお茶だ。
target: Have I been keeping some kind of secret healthy drink in this flask, you ask? *chuckle* It's really just regular hot tea.

source: 临行前，不妨听我抚琴一曲。
target: How about a melody before we depart?

source: 丹心照明月，玉影見真彰。
target: May the moonlight attest my steadfast will.

source: 丹心照明月，玉影见真彰。
target: May the moonlight attest my steadfast will.

source: 为了对抗那些无处不在的罪恶……我会和你一起用好这份力量的。
target: I will make good use of this power and fight by your side... We'll confront evil, wherever it lies.

source: 为了能顺利开辟呜呜物流的新航线，体能的特训是必不可少的。
target: To chart new routes for Lollo Logistics, physical training is a must.

source: 为什么植入体的性能会提升？原理是什么？
target: Cyberware benchmarks keep climbin'... What kinda architecture's driving this?
Now presenting, a poem of finale.
For the Stories, She Shall Sing

source: 为积累的理论构建现实映射。请放心，我很擅长这个。
target: Constructing reality mapping for accumulated theories. Rest assured, I'm quite proficient at this.

source: 为领悟生生不息，一次次经历。
target: I wish to comprehend the cycle of life by experiencing it over and over again.

source: 久々に感じた……体中で暴れるこの痺れ……これも、君の力か？少し、慣れる必要があるね。
target: I haven't felt this tingling sensation swimming across my veins in a while... So this is all your doing? *chuckle* Looks like this is going to take some time getting used to.

source: 久經磨礪的劍，往往最為鋒銳。
target: The blade most worn is often the sharpest.

source: 久经磨砺的剑，往往最为锋锐。
target: The blade most worn is often the sharpest.

source: 久违的酥麻感在周身脉络里游走……这就是你的力量？呵呵，看来要花些时间适应了。
target: I haven't felt this tingling sensation swimming across my veins in a while... So this is all your doing? *chuckle* Looks like this is going to take some time getting used to.

source: 久違的酥麻感在周身脈絡裡遊走……這就是你的力量？呵呵，看來要花些時間適應了。
target: I haven't felt this tingling sensation swimming across my veins in a while... So this is all your doing? *chuckle* Looks like this is going to take some time getting used to.

source: 之前去野外收集数据的时候遇到了他，看上去实在是不太能亲近……但他送了我一些花种，都是非常珍稀的品种，真厉害啊。
target: I remember meeting Mr. Calcharo when I was out collecting data in the wild. At first, he didn't seem very approachable... but then he gave me some flower seeds, all super rare species. He's so awesome.

source: 之前去野外收集數據的時候遇到了他，看上去實在是不太能親近……但他送了我一些花種，都是非常珍稀的品種，真厲害啊。
target: I remember meeting Mr. Calcharo when I was out collecting data in the wild. At first, he didn't seem very approachable... but then he gave me some flower seeds, all super rare species. He's so awesome.
Hey, little one... There you go!
Hey, little one... There you go!

source: 也許有一天，安可能走遍世界的每一個角落，還會順帶拯救世界呢！不過在那之前，先想想明天吃什麼早餐吧！
target: Maybe one day, Encore will go everywhere in the world and be a hero too. Hehe, but first, what's for breakfast tomorrow?

source: 也许有一天，安可能走遍世界的每一个角落，还会顺带拯救世界呢！不过在那之前，先想想明天吃什么早餐吧！
target: Maybe one day, Encore will go everywhere in the world and be a hero too. Hehe, but first, what's for breakfast tomorrow?

source: 乱れた記憶よ……形となって！
予想外の収入だね、悪くない。
target: Some pocket money? Won't say no to that.
At First, She Closed Her Eyes
At Last, the Cycle Begins Again

source: 云篆成书，气贯符胆，符画落笔如有神助。
target: Seal script flows, Qi pulses through. Now I write talisman guided from above.
The skylark's song is about to sound.

Time for some crowd work.
PERO: Pero! Rawrrr!

Time for some crowd work.
PERO: Pero! Rawrrr!
Five Thunders have spoken. Demons, perish!
Five Thunders have spoken. Demons, perish!
Five Thunders have spoken. Demons, perish!

source: 人々の営みが豊かに、世界が安泰でありますように。
target: May peace and plenty bless this land for good.

source: 人から話を聞くのが得意な人もいれば、人の心を開かせるのが上手い人もいる。 秧秧はその両方が上手。彼女と一緒にいると堅苦しくならずに、ありのままでいられる。
target: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.

source:
人が軽く感じます。
これは、予想外の体験ですね。
target: My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands.

source: 人であれ、残像であれ、傭兵団の前に立ちはだかる邪魔な存在は、俺が残さず断ち切る。傭兵団を守って、みんなに安住の地を与えることが団長たるものの仕事だ。
target: Humans or Tacet Discords, I'll eradicate any danger to the Ghost Hounds. It is my sole focus to protect my people, and secure any form of momentary respite when I can.

source: 人のポテンシャルって、エネルギーゼリーみたいだよね？空っぽに見えても、絞り出せば出てくるし！
target: I guess someone's potential is like an Energy Gel Sachet. You think it's empty, but there's always a little more if you squeeze harder...

source: 人也好，残象也罢，无论是谁，只要威胁到了佣兵团……我都会将他们全部斩断。保护好佣兵团，为他们寻得片刻安宁之所，是我现在唯一要做的事情。
target: Humans or Tacet Discords, I'll eradicate any danger to the Ghost Hounds. It is my sole focus to protect my people, and secure any form of momentary respite when I can.

source: 人也好，殘象也罷，無論是誰，只要威脅到了傭兵團……我都會將他們全部斬斷。保護好傭兵團，為他們尋得片刻安寧之所，是我現在唯一要做的事情。
target: Humans or Tacet Discords, I'll eradicate any danger to the Ghost Hounds. It is my sole focus to protect my people, and secure any form of momentary respite when I can.

source: 人们向岁主祈愿并不是懦弱，只是找不到出路。我要走到前面去，带领大家找到属于人类自己的道路。
target: People prayed to the Sentinel not out of weakness, but because they had no other recourse. As leader, I will guide my people towards a future where humanity takes control of our own destiny.

source: 人們向歲主祈願並不是懦弱，只是找不到出路。我要走到前面去，帶領大家找到屬於人類自己的道路。
target: People prayed to the Sentinel not out of weakness, but because they had no other recourse. As leader, I will guide my people towards a future where humanity takes control of our own destiny.

source: 人又厉害，话又少。瑝珑有句谚语“会捉鼠的猫不叫”，说的就是你吧！
target: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old Huanglong saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?

source: 人又厲害，話又少。瑝瓏有句諺語「會捉鼠的貓不叫」，說的就是你吧！
target: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old Huanglong saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?

source: 人生は絶え間ない思い出の連続。そして思い出は、繋ぎ合わされた人生そのものよ。
target: Life's a reel of memories. And memories? Life, recut.

source: 人生是不断的回忆，回忆是剪辑的人生。
target: Life's a reel of memories. And memories? Life, recut.

source: 人生是不斷的回憶，回憶是剪輯的人生。
target: Life's a reel of memories. And memories? Life, recut.

source: 仄暗い水底から浮かび上がると、金色の光が目に飛び込んできました。こんなにも大きな恵みと教えを与えてくださるなんて……どうか、私に応えさせてください。あなたの願いは、私を導く福音ですから。
target: Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear.

source: 仇远，只把我当做一把剑就好，至于你要怎么用，我不会多问。
target: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

source: 仇遠と申す。某はただの剣でしかない。使い方はお主に任せよう。多くは問わぬ。
target: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

source: 仇遠，只把我當做一把劍就好，至於你要怎麼用，我不會多問。
target: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

source: 今、こうしてここにいることが、妾の幸せ。
target: The moment at hand... This very moment is the best of our lives.

source: 今、その苦痛に終止符を。
今こそ開幕だ。盛大な歓声と拍手を！キャプテン・ブラントが、君に心から敬意を捧げよう！
target: The curtains pull back and I'm here to hunt for every laugh! Brant, at your service. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

source: 今でこそ副作用は少なくなってますけど、脳内に響くアレフ1の囁きは、もう少し減ると嬉しいですねぇ。
target: Well, the side effects aren't as bad now, but I'd give anything for Aleph-1 to just stop mumbling nonsense in my head.

source: 今なら100人来ても倒せるって、ペロが言ってるよ。
target: Pero said she's feeling like she can take out a hundred foes with one punch!

source: 今のわたし、ナビゲーターとしてけっこう優秀なのでは……？ううん、調子に乗っちゃダメ！まだまだ道は長いんだし、もっと頑張らないと！わたしは、これからも胸を張って歩き続けるよ！
target: So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up!

source: 今の俺はどんな霧にでも化ける。助かるぜ！今回は特別に、何でも答えてやろう。何でも、だ。
target: Now I can switch between any kind of mist as I please. Much appreciated, bud! If you need anything, just ask away. I'll do my best to oblige!

source: 今の私なら、共に歩んでいけるでしょう。
target: Now, I can walk beside you.

source: 今の私の願いは、教え子たちの夢がみんな叶うことよ。
target: My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true.

source: 今までこのような体を満たす力を体感したことがありません…漂泊者さんのおかげなのでしょうか？いままで私のために尽くしてくれたこと、お礼申しあげます、漂泊者さん。
target: I've never felt such strength in me. It's all thanks to you, isn't it? I am forever grateful, Rover, for everything you've done for me.

source: 今令尹、今汐と申します。令尹とは、絶対的な権力と責任を意味します。今州の民が憂いの無い日々を過ごせるよう、力を尽くしましょう。
target: I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. My role holds great power and duty. I vow to serve my people with diligence and bring prosperity to our land.

source: 今令尹の参謀、長離よ。そして、ずっとあなたを探していた者の一人でもある。もし、今州で何か不便があったら何でも言ってね。
target: I am Changli, Counselor to the Jinzhou Jinzhou. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Rover. We meet at last. Should you ever need any assistance in Jinzhou, please let me know.

source: 今令尹，今汐。令尹二字意味着至高无上的职权，也意味着沉重如山的责任。我会尽我所能，让今州的每一个人过好当下的每一天。
target: I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. My role holds great power and duty. I vow to serve my people with diligence and bring prosperity to our land.

source: 今令尹，今汐。令尹二字意味著至高無上的職權，也意味著沉重如山的責任。我會盡我所能，讓今州的每一個人過好當下的每一天。
target: I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. My role holds great power and duty. I vow to serve my people with diligence and bring prosperity to our land.

source: 今回は、私が学生になる番かしら？
target: So it's my turn to be the student this time?

source: 今回は保守的にいったな。次回は、従来の常識を破るようなものを試してみようか。
target: So you have opted for a prudent strategy this time. Next time, maybe we can consider something more unconventional.

source: 今天要給安可看的是什麼故事呢？
target: What kinda story will Encore hear today?

source: 今天要给安可看的是什么故事呢？
target: What kinda story will Encore hear today?

source: 今天要講的故事是……正義的騎士，大戰邪惡的鳴式！騎士卡提希婭，獲勝！
target: Today's story is... the great battle between a righteous knight and the wicked Threnodian! The victor is—Cartethyia the Knight!

source: 今天要讲的故事是……正义的骑士，大战邪恶的鸣式！骑士卡提希娅，获胜！
target: Today's story is... the great battle between a righteous knight and the wicked Threnodian! The victor is—Cartethyia the Knight!

source: 今天，也有好好行侠仗义！
今天，也有好好行俠仗義！
今州の住み心地はどう？いつかこの地域を安定させて、本当に住みやすい街を作り上げる……それが私の夢だから。
target: How do you like it here in Jinzhou? Enjoying your stay? It is my dream to make it a truly safe and cozy place to live, free from all the border city dangers.

source: 今州の龍の小娘か。なんとなくショアキーパーと似てるような気がする。責務のためなら自己犠牲も厭わないところとかね。はあー、私にはわかんないな。なんでそんなことするんだろ？
target: The Loong Maiden of Jinzhou reminds me of the Shorekeeper, the way they're oh-so-devoted to their duties, all the self-sacrifice! I don't understand, why must they burden themselves so much?

source: 今州は豊かな土地、いいものがたくさんありますよ。
target: The lands of Jinzhou are filled with riches.

source: 今州へようこそ。申し訳ございませんが、多忙極める故、急用であれば、辺庭を直接お訪ね下さい。
target: Welcome to Jinzhou, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall.

source:
今州劇場に行ったことはありますか？演劇がハッピーエンドを迎える時……
誰もが笑顔になるその瞬間がとても好きです。
……皆の笑顔……それを守るために、余は死力を尽くします。
target: Have you been to the Jinzhou Theater? It's a place of endless joy and laughter, especially when a show concludes on a happy note. I've always cherished that sight, which is why I want to ensure everyone finds their own happy ending.

source: 今州劇場のヒーローショーは本当にすごいんだよ！特にお正月の時なんかは賑やかで、笑顔が溢れるんだ！
target: The hero plays at Jinzhou Theater are the bee's knees! Especially during New Years, everyone would gather around to enjoy the plays, havin' a whale of a time.

source: 今州地处边塞，天气变化难测，给小咪晾的鱼干没有那么容易保存……唔，我再想想别的法子。
target: Nestled between the borders, Jinzhou is subject to ever-changing weather. Sustaining the dried fish I've been making for Mimi has been a difficult task... Hmm, I suppose a solution will come to me in due time.

source: 今州地大物博，好东西不少呢。
target: The lands of Jinzhou are filled with riches.

source: 今州地大物博，好東西不少呢。
target: The lands of Jinzhou are filled with riches.

source: 今州地處邊塞，天氣變化難測，給小咪晾的魚乾沒有那麼容易保存……唔，我再想想別的法子。
target: Nestled between the borders, Jinzhou is subject to ever-changing weather. Sustaining the dried fish I've been making for Mimi has been a difficult task... Hmm, I suppose a solution will come to me in due time.

source: 今州的龍女和守岸人給我的感覺很相似，都是喜歡為了責任自我奉獻的傢伙。哎，真搞不明白，為什麼她們要顧慮那麼多？
target: The Loong Maiden of Jinzhou reminds me of the Shorekeeper, the way they're oh-so-devoted to their duties, all the self-sacrifice! I don't understand, why must they burden themselves so much?

source: 今州的龙女和守岸人给我的感觉很相似，都是喜欢为了责任自我奉献的家伙。哎，真搞不明白，为什么她们要顾虑那么多？
target: The Loong Maiden of Jinzhou reminds me of the Shorekeeper, the way they're oh-so-devoted to their duties, all the self-sacrifice! I don't understand, why must they burden themselves so much?

source: 今巡尉の熾霞だよ！何か手助けが必要なら、いつでも呼んで！
target: Jinzhou Patroller, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!

source: 今巡尉炽霞，时刻准备着！
今巡尉炽霞，要是遇到什么需要帮忙的事儿，就找我吧！
target: Jinzhou Patroller, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!

source: 今巡尉熾霞、いつでも準備オッケー。
今巡尉熾霞，時刻準備著！
今巡尉熾霞，要是遇到什麼需要幫忙的事，就找我吧！
target: Jinzhou Patroller, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!
Hopefully my patience will pay off this time.

source: 今抱えてる借金……私一人で返すと、一生掛かるみたいです……
target: My family's debt… It'll probably take me my whole life to pay it off by myself…

source: 今日お話するのは……正義の騎士が邪悪な鳴式と戦う物語です！もちろん、最後に勝つのは騎士カルテジアです！
target: Today's story is... the great battle between a righteous knight and the wicked Threnodian! The victor is—Cartethyia the Knight!

source: 今日はちょうど時間があるから、海辺を散歩でもしないか？風を感じながら夕日を眺めるのも……たまにはいいだろう？きっと、インスピレーションも生まれるはずさ。
target: I've got some time today. What would you say to a nice stroll on the beach? Maybe the sea breeze and ocean sunset will inspire you!

source: 今日はどんな宝物を鑑定しに行く？
target: New goodies to see? I'm in!

source: 今日はアンコにどんな物語を見せてくれるの？
target: What kinda story will Encore hear today?

source: 今日はフィールドワーク？ ふふっ、そういうの好きよ～
今日は何をした？楽しいことはあった？全部アンコに教えてね、アンコは物語を聞くのが大好き！人と人との繋がりは、一つ一つの物語から感じるんだ。
target: What have you been up to today? Did you have fun? Saw anything cool? C'mon, spill the beans! Encore loves stories! And the feelings people share... they're like one story after another!

source: 今日は外出にピッタリな気運だね。

target: My luck seems good like always.

source: 今日も今日とて人助け！

target: My luck seems good like always.
My luck seems good like always.

source: 从一个月亮，走向另一个月亮，更迭、更迭……直至尺度不能再被丈量。
target: From one moon to another, through endless cycles... until it's beyond measurement.

source: 从平面到立体，这些符文的含义在我眼前展开，它们是那样的浩瀚……
target: From something flat to something with great depth, the meaning of the runes unfolds before my eyes. It feels infinite...

source: 从没有关于力量的回忆，但我们可以从回忆中汲取力量。
target: You may not have memories of power, but you can always draw strength from memories.

source: 从纷乱的干扰项中，探寻正确的方向。
target: Amidst disruptions, let's find our way to the right path.

source: 仕事かぁ……頑張らなきゃなぁ……
target: Time to work? *chuckle* No more lazing around, then.

source: 他人の目や評価を気にして、本当の自分を隠し、役を演じる人は多い。でも、彼女は違う。これまで何をしてきたか、どんなアイデンティティを持っているかなんて関係なく、本来の自分であり続ける。
target: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.

source: 令人愉悅的、不容拒絕的力量。好吧，現在我們共同擁有的秘密又多了一個。
target: Such delightful and irresistible power. Well, now we have another shared secret.

source: 令人愉悦的、不容拒绝的力量。好吧，现在我们共同拥有的秘密，又多了一个。
target: Such delightful and irresistible power. Well, now we have another shared secret.

source: 令尹の近衛、散華。危険な場所に行くのなら、ぜひ私を同行させて、身の安全を保障する。
target: I am Sanhua, the bodyguard of Magistrate Jinhsi. If you plan to visit dangerous areas, please be sure to bring me along. I will ensure your safety.

source: 令尹近卫，散华。若是要出发去危险的地方，请务必带上我，我会保护您的安全。
target: I am Sanhua, the bodyguard of Magistrate Jinhsi. If you plan to visit dangerous areas, please be sure to bring me along. I will ensure your safety.

source: 令尹近衛，散華。若是要出發去危險的地方，請務必帶我一起去，我會保護您的安全。
target: I am Sanhua, the bodyguard of Magistrate Jinhsi. If you plan to visit dangerous areas, please be sure to bring me along. I will ensure your safety.

source: 以前是火，现在是枪。无论哪种东西，只要能保护大家，我都会紧紧握在手里！
target: I used to fight with nothing more than my flames, but now I have these pistols. I'll hold on tight to whatever weapon I can have, so I can protect everyone!

source: 以前是火，現在是槍。無論哪種東西，只要能保護大家，我都會緊緊握在手裡！
target: I used to fight with nothing more than my flames, but now I have these pistols. I'll hold on tight to whatever weapon I can have, so I can protect everyone!

source: 以另一种方式，延续他们的意志。
以另一種方式，延續他們的意志。

target: In the Name of the Montellis
In the name of the Montellis.
In the Name of the Montellis
In the name of the Montellis.
In the blink of an eye.

source: 任何食物都該被好好對待吧？欸？黑，黑暗料理的話……
target: Shouldn't we cherish all food and not let any go to waste? Oh... Well, if it's truly badly cooked, then.. uhm...

source: 任何食物都该被好好对待吧？欸？黑，黑暗料理的话……
target: Shouldn't we cherish all food and not let any go to waste? Oh... Well, if it's truly badly cooked, then.. uhm...
For all wishes spoken, this vessel I offer.

source: 会有龙须那——么长的龙须酥吗？好想尝尝看啊。
target: Will there ever be Loong Whiskers Crisps that are as loooong as a real loong's whiskers? Aww, I really want to give them a try!

source: 伝えたいこと・その一
伝えたいこと・その二
但愿民康物阜，海晏河清。
target: May peace and plenty bless this land for good.

source: 但愿这抹金色能成为你最趁手的利刃。
target: May this gold become your most reliable blade.

source: 但愿，我们能更接近答案。
target: May this journey bring us closer to the truth.
I know... the dream had to end.
I know... the dream had to end.

source: 但願民康物阜，海晏河清。
target: May peace and plenty bless this land for good.

source: 但願這抹金色能成為你最趁手的利刃。
target: May this gold become your most reliable blade.

source: 但願，我們能更接近答案。
target: May this journey bring us closer to the truth.

source: 体が応えている……聞き取れないほど小さな周波数に。まるで、刃を磨き直す瞬間のように。ああ、いい感じだ。これなら的確に使いやすい。
target: My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm.

source: 体が軽くなったような気がしますね。
体の気が巡って、ツボが活性化したね。これならどんな印でも結べちゃう気がするよ。
target: Body and seal align, spirit gates open wide. My hand mudras now shift in a thousand forms.
I trust you can use it to the full.

source: 何か引っかかったようね。
target: Well, well. What do we have here?

source: 何か見つかったみたい。

target: Anything you need me to deal with?

source: 何が起きたか理解できた？

target: What is it you wish for?

source: 何事も素早く、いい心がけよ。
target: Good. There's no time to waste.
Follow my moves, if you can.

source: 何度も、何度も、何度も剣を振り下ろす。闘争の炎を浴びるごとに、剣は鍛えられていく。剣を剣たらしめるものは、切れ味ではない。剣を握る者の意志なのだ。
target: Strike relentlessly. Again, and again... Each battle reforges my blade. Its true strength lies not in the steel, but in the will that commands it.

source: 余がお手本を見せましょう。
余の歩みは、誰にも止められぬ。
你也有一双抓住灵感的眼睛嘛。
target: Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.

source: 你也有一雙抓住靈感的眼睛嘛。
target: Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.

source: 你也能听到我手中刀刃的鸣响吧？如果你需要，不论何种愿望，我都会为你达成。
target: You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.

source: 你也能聽到我手中刀刃的鳴響吧？如果你需要，不論何種願望，我都會為你達成。
target: You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.

source: 你今天做了些什么，看到什么好玩的有趣的事情了？可都要告诉安可，安可喜欢听故事。人与人之间的情感……就是一个接一个的故事嘛。
target: What have you been up to today? Did you have fun? Saw anything cool? C'mon, spill the beans! Encore loves stories! And the feelings people share... they're like one story after another!

source: 你今天做了些什麼，看到什麼好玩的有趣的事情了？可都要告訴安可，安可喜歡聽故事。人與人之間的情感……就是一個接一個的故事嘛。
target: What have you been up to today? Did you have fun? Saw anything cool? C'mon, spill the beans! Encore loves stories! And the feelings people share... they're like one story after another!

source: 你从远处归来，为漫长的生命留下小小改变。而我透过它们，理解不曾抵达的世界。
target: Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach.

source: 你们这里的人到底是怎么回事……能谈得来的人就算朋友？并肩作过战就肯把后背交给对方？实在难以想象你们去了夜之城的下场会有多惨。
target: Don't really understand the peeps here. One friendly convo makes someone a choom? One fight, and you trust 'em to watch your back? Can't imagine any of you survivin' a day in Night City.

source: 你会喜欢这些吧？那么你收着就好。
target: Found something you like? Keep them as you will.

source: 你們這裡的人到底是怎麼回事……能談得來的人就算朋友？並肩作過戰就肯把後背交給對方？實在難以想像你們去了夜城的下場會有多慘。
target: Don't really understand the peeps here. One friendly convo makes someone a choom? One fight, and you trust 'em to watch your back? Can't imagine any of you survivin' a day in Night City.

source: 你到底是怎么做到的，可要好好告诉安可，不许跑掉！
target: Woah! Is this "Rover Magic"!? Oh no you don't, you're not going anywhere unless you tell me your secrets!

source: 你到底是怎麼做到的，可要好好告訴安可，不許跑掉！
target: Woah! Is this "Rover Magic"!? Oh no you don't, you're not going anywhere unless you tell me your secrets!

source: 你去今州剧院看过吗？每次上演大团圆的戏，大家看了心里满足，就会由衷地笑出来。我喜欢大家笑起来的样子，所以，我想让大家的结局都能圆满。
target: Have you been to the Jinzhou Theater? It's a place of endless joy and laughter, especially when a show concludes on a happy note. I've always cherished that sight, which is why I want to ensure everyone finds their own happy ending.

source: 你去今州劇院看過嗎？ 每次上演大團圓的戲，大家看了心裡滿足，就會由衷地笑出來。 我喜歡大家笑起來的樣子，所以，我想讓大家的結局都能圓滿。
target: Have you been to the Jinzhou Theater? It's a place of endless joy and laughter, especially when a show concludes on a happy note. I've always cherished that sight, which is why I want to ensure everyone finds their own happy ending.

source: 你去过月球吗？我曾经去过，但却付出了难以承受的代价。我仍然清晰地记得刚到月球时的感受。虽然大卫没有带我前往月球，但我们却在那里重逢。
target: You ever been to the Moon? I have, but it cost me a lot... Still remember exactly how I felt when I first arrived. Even though David couldn't take me, I knew we were there together.

source: 你去過月球嗎？我曾經去過，但卻付出了難以承受的代價。我仍然清晰地記得剛到月球時的感受。雖然大衛沒有帶我前往月球，但我們卻在那裡重逢。
target: You ever been to the Moon? I have, but it cost me a lot... Still remember exactly how I felt when I first arrived. Even though David couldn't take me, I knew we were there together.

source: 你好，今日前來，是想鍛煉呢，還是想做調養？當然，光是聊聊天也可以。稍等，我去為你沏一壺茶。
target: Hello there. What will it be for today? Are you here to put in some extra work, or maybe just to loosen up a bit? Of couse, you're welcome for a chat, too. One moment, I'll go make some tea for you.

source: 你好，今日前来，是想锻炼呢，还是想做调养？当然，光是聊聊天也可以。稍等，我去为你沏一壶茶。
target: Hello there. What will it be for today? Are you here to put in some extra work, or maybe just to loosen up a bit? Of couse, you're welcome for a chat, too. One moment, I'll go make some tea for you.

source: 你好，我叫丹瑾，正在游历四方。如果你遇到了什么不平之事，可以告诉我。没有遇到？那最好。
target: Greetings, my name is Danjin. I'm currently patrolling the lands as a ranger. Tell me about any injustice you've encountered, and I'll get it dealt with. You can't think of any? That's good.

source: 你好，我叫丹瑾，正在遊歷四方。如果你遇到了什麼不平之事，可以告訴我。沒有遇到？那最好。
target: Greetings, my name is Danjin. I'm currently patrolling the lands as a ranger. Tell me about any injustice you've encountered, and I'll get it dealt with. You can't think of any? That's good.

source: 你好，我叫淵武，經營一家拳館。店不算大，但每一個客人我都會用心對待。有空的話，歡迎過來坐坐。
target: Hello. I am Yuanwu, and I run a boxing gym. It's not a big place, but we make sure every customer is treated with finesse. You're welcome to visit any time.

source: 你好，我叫渊武，经营一家拳馆。店不算大，但每一个客人我都会用心对待。有空的话，欢迎过来坐坐。
target: Hello. I am Yuanwu, and I run a boxing gym. It's not a big place, but we make sure every customer is treated with finesse. You're welcome to visit any time.

source: 你好，旅途中相遇的漂泊者。你是为什么而旅行的？不记得了？唔，没关系，旅行的意义，一定能从旅途中再次找到。
target: Greetings, Rover whom I've come across in my journey. What are you travelling for? You can't quite recall? Hmm, no worries. I'm sure you will rediscover it along the way.

source: 你好，旅途中相遇的漂泊者。你是為什麼而旅行的？不記得了？唔，沒關係，旅行的意義，一定能從旅途中再次找到。
target: Greetings, Rover whom I've come across in my journey. What are you travelling for? You can't quite recall? Hmm, no worries. I'm sure you will rediscover it along the way.

source: 你将赋予它们什么意义？
target: What significance will you grant them?

source: 你將賦予它們什麼意義？
target: What significance will you grant them?

source: 你应该已经准备好了相应的酬劳。
target: You should have the payment ready by now.

source: 你從遠處歸來，為漫長的生命留下小小改變。而我透過它們，理解不曾抵達的世界。
target: Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach.

source: 你應該已經準備好了相應的酬勞。
target: You should have the payment ready by now.
You've prepared for this, have you not?
You've prepared for this, have you not?

source: 你是不是不記得以前的事了？真可惜，肯定有很多難忘的回憶吧……不過沒關係，新的回憶，我可以和你一起創造！
target: It sucks that you can't remember your past, there must've been a lot of unforgettable memories. But no worries, we can create new ones. You and I, together!

source: 你是不是不记得以前的事了？真可惜，肯定有很多难忘的回忆吧……不过没关系，新的回忆，我可以和你一起创造！
target: It sucks that you can't remember your past, there must've been a lot of unforgettable memories. But no worries, we can create new ones. You and I, together!

source: 你是說跟在秋水身邊那個小女孩？有過一面之緣，她和秋水的確是天衣無縫的搭檔。
target: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.

source: 你是说跟在秋水身边那个小女孩？有过一面之缘，她和秋水的确是天衣无缝的搭档。
target: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.

source: 你會喜歡這些吧？那麼你收著就好。
target: Found something you like? Keep them as you will.
What form do you look for?
What form do you look for?

source: 你的信任，对我来说…非常珍贵！
target: Your trust… means so much to me!

source: 你的信任，對我來說…非常珍貴！
target: Your trust… means so much to me!

source: 你的发现，交由你来处置。
target: You found it, and it's yours to keep.

source: 你的建議和思考方式，讓我想起了曾在稷廷遺址中看到的一些文件。它們的觀點出自某個未知的體系，奇妙而美麗，如同汲取自群星。
target: It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.

source: 你的建议和思考方式，让我想起了曾在稷廷遗址中看到的一些文件。它们的观点出自某个未知的体系，奇妙而美丽，如同汲取自群星。
target: It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.
Your life, is mine to take.

source: 你的慷慨一如往昔，反倒是我，該如何給出相應的回報？無法定義的價值，往往才最昂貴。
target: Your generosity is as unwavering as ever. But how should I repay you? After all, the most precious things are often those that defy definition.

source: 你的慷慨一如往昔，反倒是我，该如何给出相应的回报？无法定义的价值，往往才最昂贵。
target: Your generosity is as unwavering as ever. But how should I repay you? After all, the most precious things are often those that defy definition.

source: 你的旅行真有趣啊，安可好喜欢好喜欢！下次，一定要带着安可一起去哦，来，拉钩钩！
target: Your adventure sounds so much fun! Encore really wanna go! Promise you'll take me next time? Pinky swear!

source: 你的旅行真有趣啊，安可好喜歡好喜歡！下次，一定要帶著安可一起去喔，來，拉鉤鉤！
target: Your adventure sounds so much fun! Encore really wanna go! Promise you'll take me next time? Pinky swear!

source:
你的生日？今天？哦。
……
如果你在期待礼物或者祝福，就在这里继续安心等待吧，漫长的等待也可算是一份礼物。
target:
Your birthday? Today, you say? Oh.
…
Well, if you're expecting a present or some kind wishes, then simply wait here. A long wait can be considered a gift in itself.

source:
你的生日？今天？哦。
……
如果你在期待禮物或者祝福，就在這裡繼續安心等待吧，漫長的等待也可算是一份禮物。
target:
Your birthday? Today, you say? Oh.
…
Well, if you're expecting a present or some kind wishes, then simply wait here. A long wait can be considered a gift in itself.

source: 你的發現，交由你來處置。
target: You found it, and it's yours to keep.
Follow my moves, if you can.
Follow my moves, if you can.

source: 你看，結出了小小的果子！又是一個小小的奇跡呢，但生命不會只停留在這裡喔。
target: Look, it's bearing tiny fruits! Another miracle, but the journey of a plant doesn't end here.

source: 你看，结出了小小的果子！又是一个小小的奇迹呢，但生命不会只停留在这里哦。
target: Look, it's bearing tiny fruits! Another miracle, but the journey of a plant doesn't end here.

source: 你真的好厉害！和你说噢，经过你之前的指导，啾啾都跳得更高更快啦！
target: You're an amazing teacher! Didya know? Squeakie's jumping higher and faster after your pointers!

source: 你真的好厲害！和你說哦，經過你之前的指導，啾啾都跳得更高更快啦！
target: You're an amazing teacher! Didya know? Squeakie's jumping higher and faster after your pointers!

source: 你知道吗，你身边的那束小花很喜欢你哦，我都听到了。植物的语言安静但真诚，我可以把它们说的话讲给你听。
target: Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.

source: 你知道嗎，你身邊的那束小花很喜歡你哦，我都聽到了。植物的語言安靜但真誠，我可以把它們說的話講給你聽。
target: Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.

source: 你知道黑海岸的底下是怎么样的吗？秋水他们根本不让安可过去，那里不会藏着什么宝藏和大怪物吧！
target: Do you know what's under the Black Shores' base? Aalto and the others won't ever let me go near. Are they keeping cool stuff and scary things down there?

source: 你知道黑海岸的底下是怎麼樣的嗎？秋水他們根本不讓安可過去，那裡不會藏著什麼寶藏和大怪物吧！
target: Do you know what's under the Black Shores' base? Aalto and the others won't ever let me go near. Are they keeping cool stuff and scary things down there?

source: 你給我的感覺和古物很像呢……咳咳！我、我是在進行專業的鑑定！你身體裡流淌的頻率，有當下的痕跡，也有一些，像是來自遙遠的時間，很特別……
target: Somehow you've been giving off antique vibes... Ahem! I'm being professional here! Your frequencies! Some of them feel recent, but some feel like they're from ancient times. It's... special...

source: 你给我的感觉和古物很像呢……咳咳！我、我是在进行专业的鉴定！你身体里流淌的频率，有当下的痕迹，也有一些，像是来自遥远的时间，很特别……
target: Somehow you've been giving off antique vibes... Ahem! I'm being professional here! Your frequencies! Some of them feel recent, but some feel like they're from ancient times. It's... special...

source: 你覺得今州這座城怎麼樣？住得舒心嗎？讓它脫離邊塞的危險，成為真正令人安心的宜居城市，是我的夢想呢。
target: How do you like it here in Jinzhou? Enjoying your stay? It is my dream to make it a truly safe and cozy place to live, free from all the border city dangers.

source: 你覺得，翡薩烈家的「秘藥」是由什麼製成的？花園裡秘不外傳的毒草、宅邸中被低語煮沸的靈魂……再加上，少女們如初生羊羔一般純潔的血肉？呵呵呵——
target: Tell me, what do you suppose goes into the Fisalia family's famed elixir? A rare herb, grown in secret? Tormented souls simmering in unseen cauldrons? Hehe... Or perhaps the delicate flesh of young girls?

source: 你觉得今州这座城怎么样？住得舒心吗？让它脱离边塞的危险，成为真正令人安心的宜居城市，是我的梦想呢。
target: How do you like it here in Jinzhou? Enjoying your stay? It is my dream to make it a truly safe and cozy place to live, free from all the border city dangers.

source: 你觉得，翡萨烈家的「秘药」是由什么制成的？花园里秘不外传的毒草、宅邸中被低语煮沸的灵魂……再加上，少女们如初生羊羔一般纯洁的血肉？呵呵呵——
target: Tell me, what do you suppose goes into the Fisalia family's famed elixir? A rare herb, grown in secret? Tormented souls simmering in unseen cauldrons? Hehe... Or perhaps the delicate flesh of young girls?

source: 你說熾霞啊，哼哼，她可是我的競爭對手呢。下次，我可絕對不會再輸給她了……什麼比賽？當然是比——誰幫助的人更多啦。
target: Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!

source: 你說的，是那位臥底吧……呵，放心吧，我並沒有為難她。各為其主的道理，我還是明白的。
target: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.

source: 你说炽霞啊，哼哼，她可是我的竞争对手呢。下次，我可绝对不会再输给她了……什么比赛？当然是比——谁帮助的人更多啦。
target: Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!

source: 你说的，是那位卧底吧……呵，放心吧，我并没有为难她。各为其主的道理，我还是明白的。
target: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.

source: 你身手很好，如有机会，我们切磋一番如何？我喜欢挑战，你这样的强者，不比试比试我不甘心！
target: You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!

source: 你身手很好，如有機會，我們切磋一番如何？我喜歡挑戰，你這樣的強者，不比試比試我不甘心！
target: You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!

source: 你需要力量吗？这样啊……不过，就连我的力量都想借过去用，未免也太危险了。
target: So you just need more power? I see... But to borrow my power? That's far too risky.

source: 你需要力量嗎？這樣啊……不過連我的力量都想借過去用，未免也太危險了。
target: So you just need more power? I see... But to borrow my power? That's far too risky.

Up we go, Pero.
PERO: Haah!

source: 佩洛肚皮空空，灵感快来快来。
target: Pero's tummy is rumbling. Inspiration, don't be shy!

source: 佩洛肚皮空空，靈感快來快來。
target: Pero's tummy is rumbling. Inspiration, don't be shy!

source: 佩洛說，它很開心，它想給你跳一段歡快的舞。
target: Pero said she's feeling good. Get ready for her happy dance!

source: 佩洛說，它很高興自己能成長為今天的樣子，這都要多謝你……咳，對不起，其實，佩洛一直什麼都沒說，這些話，都是洛可可想說的。
target: Pero said she's grateful for how far she's come, thanks to you... Ahem. Sorry, scratch that. Pero never actually said any of that. It's all me, Roccia. Those are the things I've been wanting to tell you.

source: 佩洛說，它更喜歡你了，它感覺自己的力量和信心在膨脹。
target: Pero said she likes you even more now. Seems her strength and confidence are growing fast.

source: 佩洛說，它現在非常強大，可以一拳打倒一百個敵人了。
target: Pero said she's feeling like she can take out a hundred foes with one punch!

source: 佩洛說，它終於有能力保護好所有人了。
target: Pero said she finally has the power to protect everyone she cares about.

source: 佩洛说，它很开心，它想给你跳一段欢快的舞。
target: Pero said she's feeling good. Get ready for her happy dance!

source: 佩洛说，它很高兴自己能成长为今天的样子，这都要多谢你……咳，对不起，其实，佩洛一直什么都没说，这些话，都是洛可可想说的。
target: Pero said she's grateful for how far she's come, thanks to you... Ahem. Sorry, scratch that. Pero never actually said any of that. It's all me, Roccia. Those are the things I've been wanting to tell you.

source: 佩洛说，它更喜欢你了，它感觉自己的力量和信心在膨胀。
target: Pero said she likes you even more now. Seems her strength and confidence are growing fast.

source: 佩洛说，它现在非常强大，可以一拳打倒一百个敌人了。
target: Pero said she's feeling like she can take out a hundred foes with one punch!

source: 佩洛说，它终于有能力保护好所有人了。
target: Pero said she finally has the power to protect everyone she cares about.
No, Pero. That's not for you.
No, Pero. That's not for you.

source: 使い方次第で、ガラクタも宝になる。
使えないほどではありませんが…
使える物は、最大限活用するべきですよ。
使える物はありませんか？

target: Come now. I could use another dancer.

source:
來吧！
群星皎映明日。
target:
Come on!
Stars, light up tomorrow.

source: 來吧，前方就是迫近的風暴！
來吧，讓我們一起，完成這場萬眾期待的演奏。
target: Come, let us finish this performance we've all been waiting for. Together.

source: 來感受一下我的劍法吧？雖然脫胎於你的教導，但我後來又進行了不少個性化改良，現在正是驗證方向的好時候。
target: You taught me well, but I've added a few creative twists to your technique. Now's the perfect time to test it out!
Well, well. What do we have here?
Smile for the camera... Three, two, one...

source: 例えどんな事が起ころうとも……この玉だけは、常に澄み切っています。
target: No matter what happens, no matter what I've been through, this jade pendant will forever stay clear and bright.
A Day in the Life of an Acolyte

source: 信用第一、お客さん至上主義。よろしくな。
target: Credibility in the name, and customer satisfaction is the game.

source:
信頼を受けるということは、責任を負うということ。ふふっ、そうよね。
だから、私と一緒にいる時は、力を抜いちゃっていいのよ？
target: It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me.

source: 修真に焦りは禁物だ。日々怠らずにいれば、自ずと精進するもの。
target: Cultivation takes time. Practice daily, and progress will follow.

source: 修練の道は先が見えぬ。だが、妾ならさらに高みへ至ることも……
target: To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.

source: 修羅の道、心は雪の如く。
target: Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.

source: 修行不必急于一时，持之以恒，便可精进。
target: Cultivation takes time. Practice daily, and progress will follow.

source: 修行不必急於一時，持之以恆，便可精進。
target: Cultivation takes time. Practice daily, and progress will follow.

source: 俺に力を……？お前はそうやっていつも安直に他人を信じるのか？
target: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?

source: 俺の不在中、うちの団員に何か困ったことをされてないか？
target: Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...

source: 俺の手を借りたいとはな……
target: Curious you'd want me to join you in person...

source: 借りを作る気はない。代わりに、必要なサポートを提供するわ。要するに……あんたの背中は私が守るってこと。
target: Not in the biz of owin' favors, so consider my arsenal of tech wizardry at your disposal. In other words... I got your back.

source: 倾注了心意，精心制作的饭菜，一定要抽出时间认真品尝。至于那些粗制滥造的速食……就没有必要浪费咀嚼肌了。
target: It's important to take time savoring meals prepared with devotion and care, but never those shoddily manufactured instant foods; consuming them is only a disservice to my chewing muscles.
It's nice to take a break once in a while.
It's okay to fly sometimes, I guess.
It's nice to take a break once in a while.
It's okay to fly sometimes, I guess.
Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.

source: 傭兵団「幽霊猟犬」の団長、カカロだ。俺たちの仕事について耳にしたことはあるか？なに、心配するな。依頼を完了するまで、雇い主の安全は保証しよう。
target: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.

source: 傾注了心意，精心製作的飯菜，一定要抽出時間認真品嚐。至於那些粗製濫造的速食……就沒有必要浪費咀嚼肌了。
target: It's important to take time savoring meals prepared with devotion and care, but never those shoddily manufactured instant foods; consuming them is only a disservice to my chewing muscles.

source: 像你这样一个人行走在世上，肯定要吃不少哑巴亏吧？下次再遇到那些令你不爽，却又不得不顾及情面的人和事的时候……务必叫上我。
target: As a lone traveler, there must've been times when you were taken advantage of, but couldn't retaliate on the spot. If you ever find yourself in such a situation again... do not hesitate to bring me along.

source: 像你這樣一個人行走在世上，肯定要吃不少啞巴虧吧？下次再遇到那些令你不爽，卻又不得不顧及情面的人和事的時候……務必叫上我。
target: As a lone traveler, there must've been times when you were taken advantage of, but couldn't retaliate on the spot. If you ever find yourself in such a situation again... do not hesitate to bring me along.

source: 像雾一样自由自在，及时行乐，挺好的不是吗？
target: To live free as the mist and enjoy life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?

source: 像霧一樣自由自在，及時行樂，挺好的不是嗎？
target: To live free as the mist and enjoy life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?

source: 僕がいる、心配しないで。
優曇と一緒にできることが、以前よりも多くなった。それに、まだまだ未知の可能性があるようにも感じる……この感覚、嫌いじゃない。
target: Your help has opened up a world of potential for You'tan and me. It feels a bit foreign to me to be presented with many options, instead of one single truth... but I rather enjoy this feeling.

source: 充足を知る事こそ、何よりの幸せ。
target: A contented mind is a perpetual feast.
We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.

source: 先輩、次の週末は空いてる？一緒にビヤートル・ウーズで遊ばない？美味しいトワイライトハニーがいっぱい食べられる場所を知ってるんだ！
target: Hey, are you free next weekend? Want to come with me to Bjartr Woods? I know a secret spot there with lots of Dusk Honeypots!

source: 先顧好這一方天地，有餘裕的話，還想保八方平安吧，哈哈。
target: Well... I just want to maintain the stability I currently enjoy, and maybe keep my hometown safe, if I get the luxury to, haha.

source: 先顾好这一方天地，有余裕的话，还想保八方平安吧，哈哈。
target: Well... I just want to maintain the stability I currently enjoy, and maybe keep my hometown safe, if I get the luxury to, haha.

source: 光の刃よ……災厄を絶って！
target: Blade cleaves the night. Perils, purged in light!

source: 光の結晶よ、恩寵をお与えください。
光譜的顯色變得更加清晰了……！
target: The spectrum I'm seeing got a whole lot clearer...!

source: 光谱的显色变得更加清晰了……！
target: The spectrum I'm seeing got a whole lot clearer...!

source: 光輝的結晶啊，請降下恩典。
光辉的结晶啊，请降下恩典。
克己，制怒……燃烧的烈焰，也不总是那么烫手。
target: With temperance and discipline, my flames will be kept in check.

source: 入り用の品はあったか？

target: Time to start a new game.

source: 內外合修，淨盡無餘，自得玄妙，造道之極。
target: Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.
I should... Give it my all...

source: 全弾装填完了、いつでも撃てる。
八方来財、めでたしめでたし！

target: Join me... in the World of Santu.

source: 共に参りましょう。もっと遠くへ。
共に旅をしてきたこいつが、世界との繋がりを証明してくれる。
target: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
Join me... in the World of Santu.

source: 共鳴力還在拓展……沒關係，我能控制。
target: My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.

source: 共鳴医療科のリューク・ヘルセンだ。キミに呼ばれたのは、きっと何かの縁だろう。ワタシのことは、リュークと呼んでもらおうかな。
target: Dr. Luuk Herssen, from the Resonator Nursing Unit. A rare exception that we meet outside my office. Oh, you can just call me Luuk.

source: 共鳴能力が、また成長を……大丈夫です、この程度なら制御できますから。
target: My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.

source: 共鳴醫療科，陸·赫斯。能被你叫來這裡——算是難得的例外。叫我陸就好。
target: Dr. Luuk Herssen, from the Resonator Nursing Unit. A rare exception that we meet outside my office. Oh, you can just call me Luuk.

source: 共鸣力还在拓展……没关系，我能控制。
target: My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.

source: 共鸣医疗科，陆·赫斯。能被你叫来这里——算是难得的例外。叫我陆就好。
target: Dr. Luuk Herssen, from the Resonator Nursing Unit. A rare exception that we meet outside my office. Oh, you can just call me Luuk.

source: 关于珈德妮娅&罗斯玛丽
其实我没见过几次折枝本人……她的作息有些昼夜颠倒，总是晚上工作，白天睡觉。所以她买的那些颜料和纸，我都是放在门口她指定的位置啦。
target: Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door.

source: 其實我沒見過幾次折枝本人……她的作息有些晝夜顛倒，總是晚上工作，白天睡覺。所以她買的那些顏料和紙，我都是放在門口她指定的位置啦。
target: Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door.
A finding with some practical value.
A finding with some practical value.
A blade is honed to strike.

source: 内に秘めし孤高の少女
内外合修，净尽无余，自得玄妙，造道之极。
target: Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.
Let us walk together once more.

source: 冒涜した裁きを受けよ。
写真でも撮っておきましょうか〜
冠军辣酱，煮鞋底都好吃。
target: Victor Savor! That sauce is so good, you'll munch an old shoe with it.

source: 冠軍辣醬，煮鞋底都好吃。
target: Victor Savor! That sauce is so good, you'll munch an old shoe with it.

source: 冥途の門が開かれてるな……望むところだ。
target: Straight to the underworld... Couldn't have asked for better.
Straight to the underworld... Couldn't have asked for better.
Straight to the underworld... Couldn't have asked for better.

source: 冬は尻尾に静電気が溜まってな……手入れが面倒で仕方ねぇ。
target: Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...

source: 冰鎮後的時蔬水分不易流失，口感鮮甜更甚。如果你也偏好時蔬，可以試試冰鎮香蘇，會是不錯的選擇。
target: Vegetables served cold are less prone to moisture loss, and they have a sweeter taste. I recommend iced Perilla salad if you enjoy vegetables, too.

source: 冰镇后的时蔬水分不易流失，口感鲜甜更甚。如果你也偏好时蔬，可以试试冰镇香苏，会是不错的选择。
target: Vegetables served cold are less prone to moisture loss, and they have a sweeter taste. I recommend iced Perilla salad if you enjoy vegetables, too.

source: 冼碧庄の豆汁かな……幼い頃、母に飲まされたことがあってね。今なら飲もうと思えば飲めるし、大切な想い出なんだけど……やっぱり、歩き始めたばかりの子供には刺激が強すぎるよ。
target: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.

source: 冼碧庄豆汁……小时候，母亲曾用它逗过我一次，哄我喝了半碗。尽管童年回忆很美好，现在再喝也觉得没什么太大问题，但那味道对刚会走路的孩子来说，还是太刺激了。
target: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.

source: 冼碧莊豆汁……小時候，母親曾用它逗過我一次，哄我喝了半碗。 儘管童年回憶很美好，現在再喝也覺得沒什麼太大問題，但那味道對剛會走路的孩子來說，還是太刺激了。
target: Oh, the Sour Soy Milk… When I was a toddler, my mother once convinced me to try it. While most of my childhood memories are joyful, that particular taste was overwhelming for my young palate.

source: 凌陽だよ。被り物を外した今の格好より、獅子舞の杭の上に立つ「獅首」の方が馴染み深いかな？これからは僕のありのままの姿も覚えてね。
target: Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head!

source: 凍てつく刃よ、汚れを払え！

target: It's go time! You'll have my mist for escort.
A hunt isn't complete without a prize.
A hunt isn't complete without a prize.
It's go time! You'll have my mist for escort.

source: 刀の声が聞こえるであろう？そなたの望みとあらば、この刃でいかなる願いも切り開いてみせよう。
target: You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.

source: 刀剑有眼，只要你没做什么亏心事，绯刃就不会把你怎么样。
target: Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad.

source: 刀劍有眼，只要你沒做什麼虧心事，緋刃就不會把你怎麼樣。
target: Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad.

source: 分かってる……いつか、夢は覚める。
target: I know... the dream had to end.

source: 分かりましたよ……協力しますから。

target: Mirage into mist, mist into bone... Withdraw.
Mirage into mist, mist into bone... Withdraw.

source: 刚认识秧秧的时候我很好奇，为什么会有人那么温柔呢？后来我才知道，有底线的温柔，也是一种锐利。
target: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.

source: 初めての感覚ね……もう一度訓練に付き合ってもらえるかしら。
target: Oh? This feeling of power coursing through my veins... It feels different from before. Please, do spar with me for another round.

source: 初次見面，我是琳奈！嗯，只是琳奈。現在和你一樣，是星炬學院的預科新生。那麼……請多指教喔。
target: Hey, name's Lynae. Just Lynae. Looks like I'm your new classmate here at Startorch Prep. So... be nice to the new girl, hmm?

source: 初次见面，我是琳奈！嗯，只是琳奈。现在和你一样，是星炬学院的预科新生。那么……请多指教哦。
target: Hey, name's Lynae. Just Lynae. Looks like I'm your new classmate here at Startorch Prep. So... be nice to the new girl, hmm?

source: 別來無恙，漂泊者。這段時間，由我來擔任您的護衛。
target: Greetings, Rover. I will escort you for the time being.
I can do this all day!
No one picks on Encore's friends!

source: 別擔心，這束光會為你保駕護航！
target: Don't worry, my light's got you!
Don't worry... Just a trick of the eye...

source: 別看他天天報酬來價格去的，其實秋水有時候也會免費幫人！只是為什麼呢......秋水沒告訴安可，只好安可自己去找答案了！
target: Aalto's money this and money that all day, but did you know? Sometimes he helps people for free! He just wouldn't tell me why... Hmph. Then it's up to me to find out!

source: 別看我們大副年紀小，你要是對演劇有什麼疑問，都可以去找她。她不僅僅是我們劇團的大副，更是個了不起的舞台裝置師！
target: Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer!

source: 別走神……這是最絢爛的一刻！
target: Don't blink... you'll miss the best part!
I can do this all day!
No one picks on Encore's friends!

source: 别担心，这束光会为你保驾护航！
target: Don't worry, my light's got you!
Don't worry... Just a trick of the eye...

source: 别来无恙，漂泊者。这段时间，由我来担任您的护卫。
target: Greetings, Rover. I will escort you for the time being.

source: 别看他天天报酬来价格去的，其实秋水有时候也会免费帮人！只是为什么呢......秋水没告诉安可，只好安可自己去找答案了！
target: Aalto's money this and money that all day, but did you know? Sometimes he helps people for free! He just wouldn't tell me why... Hmph. Then it's up to me to find out!

source: 别看我们大副年纪小，你要是对演剧有什么疑问，都可以去找她。她不仅仅是我们剧团的大副，更是个了不起的舞台装置师！
target: Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer!

source: 别走神……这是最绚烂的一刻！
target: Don't blink... you'll miss the best part!
Is this as far as I go…?
The road ahead is unclear. Stay close.
The road ahead is unclear. Stay close.

source: 前輩，下個週末有空嗎？要不要和我一起回浮光林玩？我知道有個地方，有好多好多很好吃的黃昏蜜罐！
target: Hey, are you free next weekend? Want to come with me to Bjartr Woods? I know a secret spot there with lots of Dusk Honeypots!

source: 前辈，下个周末有空吗？要不要和我一起回浮光林玩？我知道有个地方，有好多好多很好吃的黄昏蜜罐！
target: Hey, are you free next weekend? Want to come with me to Bjartr Woods? I know a secret spot there with lots of Dusk Honeypots!
Blade cleaves the night. Perils, purged in light!

source: 剑无成法，因敌变化而制胜……运筹布势亦有相通之处。
target: The sword has no set form, it adapts along with its foes... Likewise, strategies must shift against different opponents.

source: 剛認識秧秧的時候我很好奇，為什麼會有人那麼溫柔呢？後來我才知道，有底線的溫柔，也是一種銳利。
target: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.

source: 剣が、折れてしまうとは……
剣は岩や甲冑、兵器……そして命によって磨かれる。たとえ折れようと、再び研ぎ澄ますまで。
target: A sharp sword is honed on whetstones, clashing blades, and shattered armor, then tempered in the fire of life. Even if it breaks, it must remain sharp.

source: 剣を抜いた以上、後悔などない……
剣を養って千日以上、しかし勝負は一瞬にあり。
target: A blade is honed to strike.

source: 剣術がどんどん上達していますね！
target: My swordsmanship has reached new heights!

source: 剧演到结尾的时候，只要大家高喊安可的名字，幕布就会重新拉开，歌曲就会再次唱响，很厉害吧！这意味着只要你和安可做朋友，故事就绝对不会结束啦！
target: At the end of a show, everybody yells "Encore!" really loud, then the curtains open, and they play another song. That's super cool, right? So... If you're friends with Encore, your story will never come to an end!

source: 剧目已经开场，就让我来掠夺你们的欢笑！布兰特，向你献上最诚挚的敬意！
target: The curtains pull back and I'm here to hunt for every laugh! Brant, at your service. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

source: 剧院的英雄戏可好看啦！特别是过年的时候，大家热热闹闹坐在一块儿看戏，每个人的脸上都带着笑呢。
target: The hero plays at Jinzhou Theater are the bee's knees! Especially during New Years, everyone would gather around to enjoy the plays, havin' a whale of a time.

source: 劇が終わると、みんながアンコールって叫ぶ。そしたら幕が再び開かれる。すごいよね！アンコの名前もアンコールから取ったんだ、だから、アンコとお友達になると、物語は絶対に終わらないんだよ！
target: At the end of a show, everybody yells "Encore!" really loud, then the curtains open, and they play another song. That's super cool, right? So... If you're friends with Encore, your story will never come to an end!

source: 劇団の船は、いつか世界の果てまで旅をするだろう。その時は、全ての潮が同じ物語を語る――「愚者」という名の物語を！
target: One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of the Fools!

source: 劇団の酔っ払いたちが後片付けもせずに伸びてると、未開封の「トゥループストレングス」を全部海に流したくなっちゃう。
target: Every time I see the mess those drunkards leave behind... Ugh, I just want to dump all the booze into the ocean.

source: 劇演到結尾的時候，只要大家高喊安可的名字，幕布就會重新拉開，歌曲就會再次唱響，很厲害吧！這意味著只要你和安可做朋友，故事就絕對不會結束啦！
target: At the end of a show, everybody yells "Encore!" really loud, then the curtains open, and they play another song. That's super cool, right? So... If you're friends with Encore, your story will never come to an end!

source: 劇目已經開場，就讓我來掠奪你們的歡笑！布蘭特，向你獻上最誠摯的敬意！
target: The curtains pull back and I'm here to hunt for every laugh! Brant, at your service. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

source: 劇院的英雄戲可好看啦！特別是過年的時候，大家熱熱鬧鬧坐在一塊兒看戲，每個人的臉上都帶著笑呢。
target: The hero plays at Jinzhou Theater are the bee's knees! Especially during New Years, everyone would gather around to enjoy the plays, havin' a whale of a time.
Blade cleaves the night. Perils, purged in light!

source: 劍無成法，因敵變化而制勝……運籌佈勢亦有相通之處。
target: The sword has no set form, it adapts along with its foes... Likewise, strategies must shift against different opponents.

source: 力が欲しいんですか？ふむ……ですが、私の力を借りようとするなんて……あまりにも危険だとは思いませんかぁ？
target: So you just need more power? I see... But to borrow my power? That's far too risky.

source: 力だけじゃなくて、好きなものを求めてもいいのね。ちゃんと考えてから言いなさい。私は欲しいものを手に入れるまで、あなたからずっと手を離さないわよ。
target: Can I have anything else I want other than power? Think carefully before you answer. Once you say it, I won't stop until I get it.

source: 力とは、殺すためだけに存在するわけではない。壊すか、治すか……迷いながらも手を差し伸べることができる者のためにもあるのさ。
target: Strength isn't only for battle. It also finds its way to those who, caught between ruin and recovery, still choose to reach out a hand.

source:
力を持つ人に責任は付き物、ね……
はぁ……もう仕事したくないよ……
でも、あなたがどうしてもって言うのなら……ちょっとだけ、残業してあげてもいいよ。
target: With more power comes more responsibility... I really don't want more work, but if it's you asking... I can do some overtime. Just a little.

source: 力量並非只屬於廝殺。它也屬於那些被囿於崩壞與治癒之間，仍選擇繼續伸手的人。
target: Strength isn't only for battle. It also finds its way to those who, caught between ruin and recovery, still choose to reach out a hand.

source: 力量如情感、記憶、聯繫一樣，更多更多地顯化……錨定這事，你倒是熟能生巧了啊。
target: My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?

source: 力量如情感、记忆、联系一样，更多更多地显化……锚定这事，你倒是熟能生巧了啊。
target: My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?

source: 力量并非只属于厮杀。它也属于那些被囿于崩坏与治愈之间，仍选择继续伸手的人。
target: Strength isn't only for battle. It also finds its way to those who, caught between ruin and recovery, still choose to reach out a hand.

source: 力量满溢，超出了已知范畴。作为回馈，我会穷极这份由你赋予的未知。
target: You have helped me gain a previously unknown level of power; in return, I will use this power to its fullest extent for you.

source: 力量滿溢，超出了已知範疇。作為回饋，我會窮極這份由你賦予的未知。
target: You have helped me gain a previously unknown level of power; in return, I will use this power to its fullest extent for you.

source: 力量的提升，讓金屬塑性的延展性也隨之提升。漂泊者，你有什麼感興趣的小物件嗎？ 這個因你而出現的新造物，就作為禮物送給你吧。
target: I can now achieve even greater things with Metalmorph. Is there a particular thing you desire? Please let me offer my new creation as a gift. It wouldn't exist without you.

source: 力量的提升，让金属塑性的延展性也随之提升。漂泊者，你有什么感兴趣的小物件吗？这个因你而出现的新造物，就作为礼物送给你吧。
target: I can now achieve even greater things with Metalmorph. Is there a particular thing you desire? Please let me offer my new creation as a gift. It wouldn't exist without you.
This is the answer to our endeavor.
This is the answer to our endeavor.
This is the answer to our endeavor.

source: 勝利のための剣術は、相手によって変化が必要。戦略もまた同じ。
target: The sword has no set form, it adapts along with its foes... Likewise, strategies must shift against different opponents.

source: 勝利の女神は微笑んだ。
勢いが良くなったな、訓練法について詳しいのか？
target: I can sense an improvement in my strength. I suppose you are well-versed in the art of training, too?

source: 医者が必要かな？今なら手を貸せるよ。
target: Need a doctor? I happen to be free.

source: 医者にしては謎が多いけれど、同僚としては確かに頼りになるわ。
target: He's got just a few too many mysteries for a doctor... But as a colleague, his skills speak for themselves. And that's what I trust.

source: 千万小心！吃剩的食物身上会有满满的怨念，它们会跑进你的梦里去……有被安可吓到吗？
target: Ooh… Watch out! The ghosts of food you didn't finish will crawl out of your tummy and give you bad dreams... Boo! Gotcha!

source: 千切り魚と麺のコンビが本当に美味しくてさ。麺を出汁に入れて、千切りにした魚の身を乗せた夢州の名物料理なんだ……いやぁ、ぜひボスにも食べてもらいたいな。
target: Shredded fish noodles are a really tasty one! Put boiled noodles in the broth, then add shredded fish on top. Mmm, so good la! It's a Mengzhou specialty. You must give a bowl a try!
A Thousand Times Has the Moon Fallen

source: 千萬小心！吃剩的食物身上會有滿滿的怨念，它們會跑進你的夢裡去……有被安可嚇到嗎？
target: Ooh… Watch out! The ghosts of food you didn't finish will crawl out of your tummy and give you bad dreams... Boo! Gotcha!

source: 升級的原理我大致搞明白了。你們的世界，還真是有趣。
target: Startin' to understand what's behind these upgrades. Your world sure has its perks.

source: 升级的原理我大致搞明白了。你们的世界，还真是有趣。
target: Startin' to understand what's behind these upgrades. Your world sure has its perks.
An Improvised Afternoon at the Tavern
An Improvised Afternoon at the Tavern

source: 华胥研究员，白芷。让我看看吧，由相遇推导出的必然性。
target: I am Baizhi, a researcher at the Huaxu Academy. Let me witness where this encounter will take us.

source: 华胥研究院安全科，莫特斐。若想改良黑石武器，可以来我的科室。不过，在敲门之前，你最好先想清楚自己的需求合不合理。
target: Mortefi, researcher at Department of Safety, Huaxu Academy. For inquiries about Tacetite weapons, you may visit my lab. Make sure you know what you're talking about, though, before knocking at my door.

source: 单纯靠言语可没办法回报你为我所做的一切。现在，该轮到我为你而战了——你需要无坚不摧的利剑，还是坚不可摧的盾牌？
target: Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything?

source: 卜灵在场，万事都灵的啦。
卜靈在場，萬事都靈的啦。
印象深い冒険を聞きたいのか？いくらでもあるから迷うな……そうだ、まずは百年も続く古い審判の話をしよう。
target: Unforgettable adventures? Where to start? How about an ancient trial that spanned over a century?

source: 危なくなったら、俺の後ろへ。
target: When danger arises, take cover behind me.
Even Should the Path Have No End
Even Should the Path Have No End

source: 即将到来的声音，是否足够美妙……
target: Will the approaching sounds be... beautiful enough?

source: 即將到來的聲音，是否足夠美妙……
target: Will the approaching sounds be... beautiful enough?

source: 原來是這麼回事，安可要把這些好好寫到故事裡……等你什麼時候有空了，安可就念給你聽。
target: Woah, so that's how you did it! Encore's making it part of the story... You'll hear it when you've got the time.

source: 原来是这么回事，安可要把这些好好写到故事里……等你什么时候有空了，安可就念给你听。
target: Woah, so that's how you did it! Encore's making it part of the story... You'll hear it when you've got the time.

source: 厳しい訓練の後に茶を飲むと、その温かさが全身に染み渡り、体の痛みや疲労を解消できる。君も一度やってみるといい。
target: A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.

source: 厳密に言えば、私の後輩になるのか……。熾霞は私よりもよっぽどこの仕事に向いている。十分な経験を積めば、きっと立派な巡尉になれるわ。
target: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

source: 又一笔稳赚不赔的买卖。
又一筆穩賺不賠的買賣。
又是新的旅途吗？新的声音，新的故事，还有……碎片般的记忆。
target: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.

source: 又是新的旅途嗎？新的聲音，新的故事，還有……碎片般的記憶。
target: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.
Who will sink into the depths with me?
Who will sink into the depths with me?

source: 友達は多いほうがいいよね。
反響に耳を傾けるのよ。
収穫はいかがでしたか？
取引成立です……決してあなたを失望させたりしませんよ。
target: New investments, new deals… I promise you won't be disappointed.

source: 受け取っておきますね～

target: You earned it, you keep it.

source: 受け取りなさい、海の囁きを。
target: Sleep, in the whispers of sirens.

source: 受け取るといい。役に立つはずだ。
target: Take it. You will find a use for it.

source: 变成大人了就得每天板着脸了，知道了吗？大人们很辛苦的！
target: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!

source: 变量参数，实证数据，潜在概率……我会把这些都考虑进去，提升我们的行动效率。
target: Variable parameters, empirical data, potential probabilities... I'll take all of these into consideration to improve our efficiency.

source: 口ずさむ、過ぎし日の残響。
口に出さなかった言葉
口に出せなかった言葉
古典に記されたあの人
古物に詳しいかどうかは、友達になるのには関係ない。多少知識があったって、あたしには敵わないしね。ふふん、あたしと仲良くなりたいなら、古物に敬意を払うことだね！
target: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.

source: 只要大家都平平安安的，我这枪就算没白耍。
target: Everyone's safe and sound? Looks like I didn't practice for nothing, then!

source: 只要大家都平平安安的，我這槍就算沒白耍。
target: Everyone's safe and sound? Looks like I didn't practice for nothing, then!

source: 叫我丽贝卡就好。我和露西一样是来自夜之城的边缘行者，今后多指教咯。
target: Name's Rebecca. Edgerunner from Night City, just like Lucy. Look forward to rollin' with ya.

source: 叫我蕾貝卡就好。我和露西一樣是來自夜城的邊緣行者，今後多指教囉。
target: Name's Rebecca. Edgerunner from Night City, just like Lucy. Look forward to rollin' with ya.

source: 可以啊，讓我來給予你啟示。
target: Very well. I shall grant you enlightenment.

source: 可以啊，让我来给予你启示。
target: Very well. I shall grant you enlightenment.

source: 可以的話，我想和大家一起做很久的朋友。但我知道，時間有自己的想法。
target: If possible, I really wish we could all stay friends for a long, long time. But... I know time has a will of its own.

source: 可以的话，我想和大家一起做很久的朋友。但我知道，时间有自己的想法。
target: If possible, I really wish we could all stay friends for a long, long time. But... I know time has a will of its own.
I have the key to solving this question.
It is natural to feel dreadful of the unknown, yet... there are times when the unknown harbors hope, like how I can never know what else this power has to offer.
Please don't worry. I've got it in check.
I should try to smile more, you say? ...Like this? No? ...Maybe like this? Hmm... I may have overdone it. Forget about it.

source: 吃起來麻煩的東西，因為吃起來麻煩……
target: Anything that takes too much work to eat... simply because it's a hassle.

source: 吃起来麻烦的东西，因为吃起来麻烦……
target: Anything that takes too much work to eat... simply because it's a hassle.
Found what you're looking for? Good.

source: 君のような人がこの世界で生きるには、さぞ苦労が絶えないことでしょう。他人を気遣うことに疲れた時は……必ず私を呼んでください。
target: As a lone traveler, there must've been times when you were taken advantage of, but couldn't retaliate on the spot. If you ever find yourself in such a situation again... do not hesitate to bring me along.

source: 君の助言も考え方も、稷廷の遺跡で発見された記録の中で見たことがある。我々とは異なる未知の体系に基づいた……壮麗な星々が紡いだような、実に美しい記録だった。
target: It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.

source: 君の期待に応えたい……もっと頑張らないと！
target: No more slacking off now that you're here to help! I should practice harder.

source: 君はインスピレーションもバッチリだ。
target: Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.

source: 吟霖よ。私の正体は……どうか内密に。
target: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.

source: 吟霖，我的身份……嘘，可不能随便暴露哦。
target: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.

source: 吟霖，我的身份……噓，可不能隨便暴露喔。
target: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.

source: 听今州的朋友们说，莫特斐可以做出很多很多好玩的东西！真厉害啊，要不要拜托他做一个会到处乱跳的羊呢……
target: Friends in Jinzhou told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time…
Hear that? A twinkling star just tinkled to the ground!

source: 启程吧！让我的诗为你照亮前进的道路！
target: Off we go! May my poems light the way on your path ahead!

source: 呜呼！感觉到力量涌了上来！
target: Woo! Can feel that juice kickin' in!

source: 味気ないもの全般かな。食べると昔の嫌な記憶を思い出して、世界が灰色に見えちゃうんだよね……だって、味も人生もカラフルなほうがいいでしょ？
target: Anything bland. It's not hate, it's just... a trigger of some bad times. Washes the world out for a minute. So my motto stands, for everything: Go bold. Go bright. Never be boring.

source: 呵……所以，你是打算……与“恶魔”签订契约吗？
target: Hah... what now? Trying to make a pact with the "devil"?

source: 呵……所以，你是打算……與「惡魔」簽訂契約嗎？
target: Hah... what now? Trying to make a pact with the "devil"?
Hmph... Quite good at hiding, aren't you?

source: 呵……見到我有這麼驚訝嗎？
target: What's that look on your face? Surprised to see me?

source: 呵呵……好，你的野心，比我想像中還要龐大。你給出了令我無法拒絕的籌碼……那麼，我也會回報給你，絕對的忠誠。
target: *amused huff* Impressive, you've got a much bigger ambition than I thought. The offer you made is too enticing to ignore... Very well. I will repay you with my unwavering loyalty.

source: 呵呵……好，你的野心，比我想象中还要庞大。你给出了令我无法拒绝的筹码……那么，我也会回报给你，绝对的忠诚。
target: *amused huff* Impressive, you've got a much bigger ambition than I thought. The offer you made is too enticing to ignore... Very well. I will repay you with my unwavering loyalty.
Oh, is a new match calling?
Oh, is a new match calling?
Any new tricks? Do impress me.
Any new tricks? Do impress me.

source: 呼——造雾变得更容易了。作为交换，送你一份情报如何？
target: Whew—I can make more mist now. Thanks, I'll offer you something extra next time.

source: 呼——造霧變得更容易了。作為交換，送你一份情報如何？
target: Whew—I can make more mist now. Thanks, I'll offer you something extra next time.

source: 呼啊~睡得好舒服，但是……打卡的时间要到了，得去上班……嗯~好困，还是再睡个回笼觉吧……
target: Had a great sleep. Ugh... time for work... Gotta get up... but... still 'eepy... Just one more nap...

source: 呼啊~睡得好舒服，但是……打卡的時間要到了，得去上班……嗯~好困，還是再睡個回籠覺吧……
target: Had a great sleep. Ugh... time for work... Gotta get up... but... still 'eepy... Just one more nap...

source: 呼啊……又到了午后谈心时间，要聊些什么呢？
target: Time for another afternoon consultation, I see. What's on your mind today?

source: 呼啊……又到了午後談心時間，要聊些什麼呢？
target: Time for another afternoon consultation, I see. What's on your mind today?

source: 呼，剑更快了，斩起东西来也会更方便吧。
target: Now that my blade is faster, I should be able to make cleaner cuts.

source: 呼，劍更快了，斬起東西來也會更方便吧。
target: Now that my blade is faster, I should be able to make cleaner cuts.

source: 命の流転を完全に理解できる日まで、何度失敗しようと絶対に諦めはしない。
target: I wish to comprehend the cycle of life by experiencing it over and over again.

source: 命懸けの仕事か？オレに任せとけ。
target: Betting my life? Counting on it.

source: 命灯の中で燃えてる火は、オレの命を分けたもんだ。惜しがることはねぇ。オレは命を燃やすことはあっても、惜しみはしねぇからな。
target: The flame in the Life Lamp is fueled by my life. Don't pity me. I'd sooner burn through my years than save them.

source: 命灯里燃着的火，是从我身上借出去的。不必觉得可惜，我的命自是只烧不省。
target: The flame in the Life Lamp is fueled by my life. Don't pity me. I'd sooner burn through my years than save them.

source: 命燈里燃著的火，是從我身上借出去的。不必覺得可惜，我的命自是只燒不省。
target: The flame in the Life Lamp is fueled by my life. Don't pity me. I'd sooner burn through my years than save them.

source: 命运带你来我面前，而我开出相应的条件……你不会想要拒绝的，对吧？
target: Fate has led you to me, and considering the terms I'm offering… You wouldn't refuse me, would you?

source: 命運帶你來我面前，而我開出相應的條件……你不會想要拒絕的，對吧？
target: Fate has led you to me, and considering the terms I'm offering… You wouldn't refuse me, would you?

source: 和他的天賦一樣讓人印象深刻的，是他那好說話的脾氣。印象中，我還沒見他對誰發過火，不管是怎麼離譜的需求，他都能做到。
target: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

source: 和他的天赋一样让人印象深刻的，是他那好说话的脾气。印象中，我还没见他对谁发过火，不管是怎么离谱的需求，他都能做到。
target: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

source: 和你並肩作戰？這感覺還挺新奇的。
target: Fighting alongside you? Okay, that's new.

source: 和你并肩作战？这感觉还挺新奇的。
target: Fighting alongside you? Okay, that's new.

source: 和坏人讲不通道理的时候，就得火力压制嘛！所以，最近我在研究新的光炮射击阵列。
target: When you can't reason with the bad guys, let your weapons do the talking! That's why I've been working on new laser beam arrays!

source: 和壞人講不通道理的時候，就得火力壓制嘛！所以，最近我在研究新的光炮射擊陣列。
target: When you can't reason with the bad guys, let your weapons do the talking! That's why I've been working on new laser beam arrays!

source: 咦……欸？原來你在這裡呀……摸摸、摸摸……
target: Hm... Eh? Oh, there you are! Who's a good boy...

source: 咦……诶？原来你在这里呀……摸摸、摸摸……
target: Hm... Eh? Oh, there you are! Who's a good boy...

source: 咽下苦难，才能予以拯救……

哇！
嘻嘻，区区掠宝贼也想抓到本大师？
target: Woah! Hehe... Wanna catch me huh, you thieves?

source:
哇！
嘻嘻，區區掠寶賊也想抓到本大師？
target: Woah! Hehe... Wanna catch me huh, you thieves?

source: 哇，誠意十足，放心，我也不會讓你吃虧的。今後霧會一直在你身邊，把周圍交給我吧。
target: Whoa, talk about sincerity. I'll make this worth your while, of course. My mist will be with you at all times, you can trust me to have your back.

source: 哇，诚意十足，放心，我也不会让你吃亏的。今后雾会一直在你身边，把周围交给我吧。
target: Whoa, talk about sincerity. I'll make this worth your while, of course. My mist will be with you at all times, you can trust me to have your back.
Hah... my bones have been itching for this.

source: 哈哈哈，渡海的剑士就该如此！朋友，让我们一起航行到世界的尽头，去挑战世界颠倒的一瞬吧！
target: Haha! Now this is the strength worthy of a true swordsman of the seas! Join me on this voyage to the world's end, my friend! Together, we'll face that fleeting moment when the world turns upside down!

source: 哈哈哈，渡海的劍士就該如此！朋友，讓我們一起航行到世界的盡頭，去挑戰世界顛倒的一瞬吧！
target: Haha! Now this is the strength worthy of a true swordsman of the seas! Join me on this voyage to the world's end, my friend! Together, we'll face that fleeting moment when the world turns upside down!

source: 哈啊……难得的生日好好休息一下，和我一起睡个午觉吧。我这里有最好的睡眠道具，保证能让你享受最棒的安眠。午安，还有生日快乐，呼呼……
target: It's your birthday today. You should take a well-deserved rest. Let's nap together, shall we? I've got the comfiest sleep gear just for you. Sweet dreams, and happy birthday, dear.

source: 哈啊……難得的生日好好休息一下，和我一起睡個午覺吧。我這裡有最好的睡眠道具，保證能讓你享受最棒的安眠。午安，還有生日快樂，呼呼……
target: It's your birthday today. You should take a well-deserved rest. Let's nap together, shall we? I've got the comfiest sleep gear just for you. Sweet dreams, and happy birthday, dear.
Great! That's a new move for me!
Great! That's a new move for me!

source: 哈，是时候舒展舒展筋骨了……嗯，没生疏。
target: Heh. Time to shake off the rust... Good. Still got it.

source: 哈，是時候舒展舒展筋骨了……嗯，沒生疏。
target: Heh. Time to shake off the rust... Good. Still got it.

source: 哎……不过离开几日，办公桌上又积了一层薄灰，好在清洁并非难事，难在坚持。
target: In just a few days, a thin layer of dust has collected on my desk. Cleaning is not a challenge, but consistency is.

source: 哎……不過離開幾日，辦公桌上又積了一層薄灰，好在清潔並非難事，難在堅持。
target: In just a few days, a thin layer of dust has collected on my desk. Cleaning is not a challenge, but consistency is.

source: 哎呀，小心別被我的藤蔓刺穿手指了。不過……是你的話，肯定能避開。
target: Oops, watch out for my thorns. Don't get your fingers pierced. Hmm... on second thought, not much can harm you anyway.

source: 哎呀，小心别被我的藤蔓刺穿手指了。不过……是你的话，肯定能避开。
target: Oops, watch out for my thorns. Don't get your fingers pierced. Hmm... on second thought, not much can harm you anyway.
Take it easy. Do you want one too? Hmm? Haha.

source: 哟——我是情报商人秋水，各种情报应有尽有，明码标价，童叟无欺。出门在外，掌握各地情报就是掌握先机，怎么样？要买一份吗？
target: Howdy! I'm Aalto, your go-to information broker. I've got all the info you need at fair prices. Knowledge about different places is key to staying ahead while you're out and about. Interested in a quote?

source: 哟，老顾客，今天想打听什么？
target: G'day. What does our loyal client wish to inquire about today?

source: 哦？ 這種力量流動的感覺……與以往似有不同，陪我再練一遍，可好？
target: Oh? This feeling of power coursing through my veins... It feels different from before. Please, do spar with me for another round.

source: 哦？你很好奇这个？不是骨笛，是录音机。一些不足挂齿的伪装道具，总是能在关键时刻派上用场。要不下次，也给你准备点什么道具吧。
target: Hmm, curious about what this is? Nope—not a bone flute, it's a tape recorder. Funny little devices like this always come in handy in a pinch. Why don't we get you some next time?

source: 哦？你很好奇這個？不是骨笛，是答錄機。一些不足掛齒的偽裝道具，總是能在關鍵時刻派上用場。要不下次，也給你準備點什麼道具吧。
target: Hmm, curious about what this is? Nope—not a bone flute, it's a tape recorder. Funny little devices like this always come in handy in a pinch. Why don't we get you some next time?

source: 哦？藏了不少有趣的东西啊。
target: Hm? Buried payload. Someone left a present.

source: 哦？藏了不少有趣的東西啊。
target: Hm? Buried payload. Someone left a present.

source: 哦？这种力量流动的感觉……与以往似有不同，陪我再练一遍，可好？
target: Oh? This feeling of power coursing through my veins... It feels different from before. Please, do spar with me for another round.

source: 哦？這是誰家的乖狗狗啊？好乖好乖！你可真是個乖孩子！好狗好狗，拜拜，下次見！
target: Aww, where'd you come from? Who's a good baby?! Yes, you are! You're a good baby! Look how cute he is. Good boy, good boy. Aren't you cute. Buh-bye, see ya 'round!

source: 哪有什么不能吃的？别顾及太多，想吃的时候就吃，这样就没有不喜欢的食物了！
target: For me, any food's fair game. C'mon, don't overthink it! When you're hungry enough, everything tastes amazing!

source: 哪有什麼不能吃的？別顧及太多，想吃的時候就吃，這樣就沒有不喜歡的食物了！
target: For me, any food's fair game. C'mon, don't overthink it! When you're hungry enough, everything tastes amazing!

source: 哼哼，本大师现在对好东西不仅看得准，也护得住咯！
target: Aha! Now I'm up to my eyes in goodies, and I've got the strength to keep 'em safe too!

source: 哼哼，本大師現在對好東西不僅看得準，也護得住咯！
target: Aha! Now I'm up to my eyes in goodies, and I've got the strength to keep 'em safe too!

source: 唐辛子は苦手だね。一口食べるだけで、お腹が燃えるような痛みに襲われるから……
target: One bite of chili, and I start burning head to toe. My tummy also protests all day, all night.
Hmm… That's not it. It's this one.
Hmm… That's not it. It's this one.

source: 唔……丟掉的寶貝在……嗯？嘿，找到了。
target: Hmm… the lost treasure is… somewhere around… ah! Found you, hehe!

source: 唔……丢掉的宝贝在……嗯？嘿，找到了。
target: Hmm… the lost treasure is… somewhere around… ah! Found you, hehe!

source: 唔……你倒是提醒了我，也不知道那些我不愛吃的蔬菜，能不能被「燒烤」拯救回來呀？
target: Hmm... you've got a point there. Would grilled veggies taste any better?

source: 唔……你倒是提醒了我，也不知道那些我不爱吃的蔬菜，能不能被“烧烤”拯救回来呀？
target: Hmm... you've got a point there. Would grilled veggies taste any better?

source: 唔……謝謝，你的心意，我心領了。之後還有什麼需要我做的，會為你提高優先順序的。
target: Hmm... Thank you, I appreciate it. From now on, you'll have priority access to me for any deliverables you need.

source: 唔……谢谢，你的心意，我心领了。之后还有什么需要我做的，会为你提高优先级的。
target: Hmm... Thank you, I appreciate it. From now on, you'll have priority access to me for any deliverables you need.

source: 唔，发现了不错的东西呢。
target: Hmm, this is a nice find.

source: 唔，發現了不錯的東西呢。
target: Hmm, this is a nice find.

source: 唔，这里的东西也不错呢。
唔，這裡的東西也不錯呢。
啊……真棒，繁盛的力量正在躯体中涌动……！
target: Ahh... I love it... The power surging through my veins...!

source: 啊……真棒，繁盛的力量正在軀體中湧動……！
target: Ahh... I love it... The power surging through my veins...!

source: 啊，如此強大的力量……很好，這樣就能保護更多的人了。
target: Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people.

source: 啊，如此强大的力量……很好，这样就能保护更多的人了。
target: Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people.

source: 問我何所懼，問我何所憂
target: What She Fears, What She Dreads

source: 問題の正解が一つしかないのっておかしいよね？箱の中のメェーがみんな優しいだけじゃないみたいに、たまには……めぇあ――！ほら、こんなに鋭い歯を持っていることだってあるんだよ。
target: Isn't weird that there's only one right answer to every question? I mean, even the Woolies in my box aren't all the same. They're not all cute and cuddly. Some may even have pointy teeth! "Baa!" ...You see?

source: 啟程吧！讓我的詩為你照亮前進的道路！
target: Off we go! May my poems light the way on your path ahead!
Tch… You haven't seen anything yet.
Pff... That was server lag. Doesn't count.
Squeakie! Enough playing with the letter!
Squeakie! Enough playing with the letter!

source: 喏，沒忘記指揮棒的手感吧？
target: See? I haven't lost my touch.

source: 喏，没忘记指挥棒的手感吧？
target: See? I haven't lost my touch.

source: 喜欢么？不够的话，我那还有。
target: Like it? I've got plenty more of that.
How's that for a magic trick?

source: 喜欢我这把铁胆吗？我自己改的，威力超大，打人也超疼。在没有改装我的植入体之前，我每次开枪都会被它的后坐力弹飞，用起来还挺麻烦的。
target: Ya like Guts? My own custom job. Talks the talk, packs a mean punch. Before I chromed up my arms, the recoil would send me flyin'. Total pain in the buns.

source: 喜歡嗎？不夠的話，我那還有。
target: Like it? I've got plenty more of that.
How's that for a magic trick?

source: 喜歡我這把鐵膽嗎？我自己改的，威力超大，打人也超疼。在沒有改裝我的植入體之前，我每次開槍都會被它的後座力彈飛，用起來還挺麻煩的。
target: Ya like Guts? My own custom job. Talks the talk, packs a mean punch. Before I chromed up my arms, the recoil would send me flyin'. Total pain in the buns.

source: 喧嘩したいんですかぁ？
單純靠言語可沒辦法回報你為我所做的一切。現在，該輪到我為你而戰了——你需要無堅不摧的利劍，還是堅不可摧的盾牌？
target: Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything?

source: 喲——我是情報商人秋水，各種情報應有盡有，明碼標價，童叟無欺。出門在外，掌握各地情報就是掌握先機，怎麼樣？要買一份嗎？
target: Howdy! I'm Aalto, your go-to information broker. I've got all the info you need at fair prices. Knowledge about different places is key to staying ahead while you're out and about. Interested in a quote?

source: 喲，老顧客，今天想打聽什麼？
target: G'day. What does our loyal client wish to inquire about today?

source: 嗚呼！感覺到力量湧了上來！
target: Woo! Can feel that juice kickin' in!

source: 嗨嗨，你好呀！我是黑海岸的安可！准备好和安可一起玩黑白羊探险了吗？
target: Hee-hee. Hi, there! I'm Encore from the Black Shores! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies?

source: 嗨嗨，你好呀！我是黑海岸的安可！準備好和安可一起玩黑白羊探險了嗎？
target: Hee-hee. Hi, there! I'm Encore from the Black Shores! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies?

source: 嗨，我是西格莉卡！想了解符文的含义？有事情需要帮忙？那找我就好啦！
target: Hi, I'm Sigrika! Want to understand the meaning of runes? Need a hand with something? Then I'm the one to ask!

source: 嗨，我是西格莉卡！想了解符文的含義？有事情需要幫忙？那找我就好啦！
target: Hi, I'm Sigrika! Want to understand the meaning of runes? Need a hand with something? Then I'm the one to ask!

source: 嗬……见到我有这么惊讶吗？
target: What's that look on your face? Surprised to see me?

source: 嗯~一股汹涌的力量搅动着漩涡，让整个大海为之荡漾。
target: Ah... Like a fierce undertow sweeping through the abyss, causing the sea itself to tremble.

source: 嗯~一股洶湧的力量攪動著漩渦，讓整個大海為之盪漾。
target: Ah... Like a fierce undertow sweeping through the abyss, causing the sea itself to tremble.

source: 嗯……像这样，这边也来一点……完美！
target: Yeah... right there. A little more drip... Perfect.

source: 嗯……像這樣，這邊也來一點……完美！
target: Yeah... right there. A little more drip... Perfect.

source: 嗯……可能性的指向，並不唯一。
target: Why hesitate, if you know what you want?

source: 嗯……可能性的指向，并不唯一。
target: Why hesitate, if you know what you want?

source: 嗯……唔……还是搞不懂这痕迹的来源！哎！
target: Hmm... Can't seem to figure out these scratch marks... Ummm... Ugh!

source: 嗯……唔……還是搞不懂這痕跡的來源！哎！
