target: Hmm... Can't seem to figure out these scratch marks... Ummm... Ugh!

source: 嗯……她应该不会成为我的客户，在她眼中，经他人之手获得的情报，远不如亲自验证得出的结论可靠。
target: Hmm… Seems unlikely she'll ever be my client. She's the type of person to trust the conclusions from her own research over information provided by anyone else.

source: 嗯……她應該不會成為我的客戶，在她眼中，經他人之手獲得的情報，遠不如親自驗證得出的結論可靠。
target: Hmm… Seems unlikely she'll ever be my client. She's the type of person to trust the conclusions from her own research over information provided by anyone else.

source:
嗯……对于我来说，无论当下看起来多么困难的事情，比起“烦恼”，更多的是想方设法完成它的目标感。
“烦恼”这种心情，已经很久没有过了。
target: Hmm... When faced with challenges, I am driven by a sense of purpose to find solutions instead of succumbing to worry. The feeling of worry or frustration rarely crosses my mind nowadays.

source: 嗯……對於我來說，無論當下看起來多麼困難的事情，比起「煩惱」，更多的是想方設法完成它的目標感。「煩惱」這種心情，已經很久沒有過了。
target: Hmm... When faced with challenges, I am driven by a sense of purpose to find solutions instead of succumbing to worry. The feeling of worry or frustration rarely crosses my mind nowadays.

source: 嗯……还算干净，没什么坏掉的。
target: Hmm. Just a few scratches. Everything's functional.
I still have much experiment data to process...
I still have much experiment data to process...

source: 嗯……還算乾淨，沒什麼壞掉的。
target: Hmm. Just a few scratches. Everything's functional.
Hmm... That was a rudimentary lock.
Hmm... That was a rudimentary lock.

source: 嗯……？工作效率好像变高了。这样下去可就没法摸鱼了啊……
target: Hmm? Have I become more... productive? How am I supposed to act busy now...

source: 嗯……？工作效率好像變高了。這樣下去可就沒法摸魚了啊……
target: Hmm? Have I become more... productive? How am I supposed to act busy now...
Hmm… what should I paint… Oh…
Hmm… what should I paint… Oh…

source: 嗯，我能感受到，手中的刀刃变得更锋利了。
target: Hm, I feel it now. A sharper edge now rests within my grasp.

source: 嗯，我能感受到，手中的刀刃變得更鋒利了。
target: Hm, I feel it now. A sharper edge now rests within my grasp.

source: 嗯，这工具比以前好用多了~
target: Oh, this gadget has seen some upgrades.

source: 嗯，這工具比以前好用多了~
target: Oh, this gadget has seen some upgrades.

source: 嗯？……是幻听吗？没有鼓声，好不习惯……
target: Hmm? Did I just hear something? It feels off to not hear the drums...

source: 嗯？……是幻聽嗎？沒有鼓聲，好不習慣……
target: Hmm? Did I just hear something? It feels off to not hear the drums...

source: 嗯？你总能给我惊喜，雾气的覆盖范围越来越广了，谢啦！再送你一条价值连城的情报吧。
target: Hmm? You never fail to impress. My mist can reach even further now. Sweet! And that'll be another intel on the house for ya!

source: 嗯？你總能給我驚喜，霧氣的覆蓋範圍越來越廣了，謝啦！再送你一條價值連城的情報吧。
target: Hmm? You never fail to impress. My mist can reach even further now. Sweet! And that'll be another intel on the house for ya!

source: 嗯？呵......是聞到小魚乾的氣味了嗎？
target: Oh? *chuckles*... Did you smell the dried fish I have?

source: 嗯？呵......是闻到小鱼干的气味了吗？
target: Oh? *chuckles*... Did you smell the dried fish I have?
Hmhmm... Aha! What, you want a bite?
Hmhmm... Aha! What, you want a bite?

source: 嗯？有什么新鲜事吗，带上我吧！
target: Hmm? Where are you going? Count me in!

source: 嗯？有什麼新鮮事嗎，帶上我吧！
target: Hmm? Where are you going? Count me in!

source: 嗯？此計頗為激進，青龍也更有凌躍四野之勢，多謝。
target: With your bold plan, my Qingloong has gained more momentum on the battlefield. I appreciate your assistance.

source: 嗯？此计颇为激进，青龙也更有凌跃四野之势，多谢。
target: With your bold plan, my Qingloong has gained more momentum on the battlefield. I appreciate your assistance.

source: 嗷呜——起狮！今年的采青比赛也不能输啊！
target: Awoo—Lion up! Victory is mine at this year's Greens-plucking Tournament!

source: 嗷嗚——起獅！今年的採青比賽也不能輸啊！
target: Awoo—Lion up! Victory is mine at this year's Greens-plucking Tournament!
Galbrena. Ready to join the hunt.

source: 嘉貝莉娜，永火的惡魔，狩魔的獵人，隨你稱呼。我只需要知道，獵物在哪。
target: Galbrena. The Fiend of Ever-burning Flame. The Discord Slayer. Call me what you want. Just point me to the monsters.

source:
嘉貝莉娜：……再來。
奇美拉：痛苦會讓你保持清醒。
target:
Galbrena: ...Again.
Chimera: Pain sharpens your mind.

source:
嘉貝莉娜：……小傷。
奇美拉：沒時間舔舐傷口。
target:
Galbrena: …Just a scratch.
Chimera: No time to lick your wounds.

source:
嘉貝莉娜：……很好。
奇美拉：你的狂怒在躁動。
target:
Galbrena: ...Very well.
Chimera: Your fury begins to stir.

source:
嘉貝莉娜：……無死，無休！
奇美拉：此即……永恆追獵！
target:
Galbrena: ...Till my last breath!
Chimera: This hunt shall never end!

source:
嘉貝莉娜：以惡制惡。
奇美拉：弱肉強食！
target:
Galbrena: Fight fire with fire.
Chimera: Let strength speak!

source:
嘉貝莉娜：以我……步入地獄之門！
奇美拉：永火煉淨！
target:
Galbrena: By my trigger... enter hell's gates!
Chimera: Scorched to ash!

source:
嘉貝莉娜：我來……為你們送葬。
奇美拉：飽餐盛宴！
target:
Galbrena: I've come... to send you to your grave.
Chimera: A fresh feast!

source:
嘉貝莉娜：永火……未燼……
奇美拉：我們……拒絕退散……
target:
Galbrena: The flames... never die...
Chimera: We... will not retreat...

source:
嘉貝莉娜：濁燃惡火。
奇美拉：焚噬殆盡！
target:
Galbrena: Tainted hellfire.
Chimera: Devour them all!

source:
嘉貝莉娜：狩獵……
奇美拉：地久天長……

嘉貝莉娜：穿越死亡……
奇美拉：我們，必將歸來……
target:
Galbrena: Through death...
Chimera: ...We will return.

source:
嘉貝莉娜：起爆。
奇美拉：下地獄吧！
target:
Galbrena: Explode.
Chimera: To hell with you!

source:
嘉貝莉娜：送上門的獵物？
奇美拉：我已飢腸轆轆。
target:
Galbrena: Gift-wrapped prey?
Chimera: Satisfy my hunger.

source:
嘉貝莉娜：這場狩獵，該結束了。
奇美拉：大快朵頤！
target:
Galbrena: The hunt ends here.
Chimera: Time to gorge!

source:
嘉貝莉娜：願我為你指明……
奇美拉：通往地獄之門!
target:
Galbrena: I'll show you...
Chimera: The gates of hell!
Galbrena. Ready to join the hunt.

target:

target:

Chimera: This hunt shall never end!

奇美拉：弱肉强食！

奇美拉：永火炼净！
target:

嘉贝莉娜：愿我为你指明……
奇美拉：通往地狱之门!

嘉贝莉娜：我来……为你们送葬。
奇美拉：饱餐盛宴！
target:
Galbrena: I've come... to send you to your grave.
Chimera: A fresh feast!

source:
嘉贝莉娜：永火……未烬……
奇美拉：我们……拒绝退散……
target:
Galbrena: The flames... never die...
Chimera: We... will not retreat...

嘉贝莉娜：浊燃恶火。
奇美拉：焚噬殆尽！
target:
Galbrena: Tainted hellfire.

嘉贝莉娜：狩猎……
奇美拉：地久天长……

嘉贝莉娜：穿越死亡……
奇美拉：我们，必将归来……
target:
Galbrena: Through death...
Chimera: ...We will return.

嘉贝莉娜：起爆。
奇美拉：下地狱吧！
target:
