嘉贝莉娜：这场狩猎，该结束了。
奇美拉：大快朵颐！
target:
Galbrena: The hunt ends here.
Chimera: Time to gorge!

source:
嘉贝莉娜：送上门的猎物？
奇美拉：我已饥肠辘辘。
target:
Galbrena: Gift-wrapped prey?
Chimera: Satisfy my hunger.
Tch… You haven't seen anything yet.
Pff... That was server lag. Doesn't count.

source: 嘘……你们怎么也在这里呀？啊，{PlayerName}，很抱歉，我是不是打扰到了你的休息？我只是路过想来看看你，没想到这些小家伙们也一起跟过来了……
target: Shhh.... how come you're all here? Ah, sorry {PlayerName}, didn't mean to disturb you. I just wanted to pay you a visit. Didn't expect these guys to tag along...

source: 嘘……我是瞒着师父偷偷跑出来的……
target: Shh... I sneaked myself out. Promise you won't tell, okay?

source: 嘘……有听到吗，这是抽芽的声音呢。
target: Can you hear it? Shh... That's the sound of sprouting.
Shh... Keep this between us, will you?
Shh... Struggling only pains you more.

source: 嘿——浑身起劲儿，状态绝佳！让火苗燃烧得更旺盛一些吧！
target: Huggghhh... I can feel the power! And the flames rising!

source: 嘿——渾身起勁兒，狀態絕佳！讓火苗燃燒得更旺盛一些吧！
target: Huggghhh... I can feel the power! And the flames rising!

source: 噓……你們怎麼也在這裡呀？啊，{PlayerName}，很抱歉，我是不是打擾到你的休息？我只是路過想來看看你，沒想到這些小傢伙們也一起跟過來了……
target: Shhh.... how come you're all here? Ah, sorry {PlayerName}, didn't mean to disturb you. I just wanted to pay you a visit. Didn't expect these guys to tag along...

source: 噓……我是瞞著師父偷偷跑出來的……
target: Shh... I sneaked myself out. Promise you won't tell, okay?

source: 噓……有聽到嗎，這是抽芽的聲音呢。
target: Can you hear it? Shh... That's the sound of sprouting.
Shh... Keep this between us, will you?
Shh... Struggling only pains you more.

source:
嚙まなくても食べられるものが好き。ふわふわで口の中でとろける、お粥がいいな～
「ふ～ふ～」してくれる？
target: I'm all about the easy-to-eat stuff. Give me some creamy, savory porridge any day. Can you help me out with this spoonful? It's a little bit too hot for my tongue.

source: 嚙み切れない物は苦手だ……歯の問題ではない。単に、こう、感触が気持ち悪いんだ。
target: I'm not a big fan of foods that are hard to chew… Oh, it's got nothing to do with my teeth. I'm just not fond of the prickling sensation of stickiness in my mouth.

source: 嚥下苦難，才能予以拯救……
嚴格來說，熾霞她算是我的後輩吧，她是個比我更適合當巡尉的傢伙，只要有足夠的經驗，她一定會成為一名優秀的巡尉吧。
target: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

source: 回应你的致意，我的朋友。
回應你的致意，我的朋友。
因为你的光……让我看到了未曾见过的世界。
target: Your light has shown me a world I had never seen.

source: 因為你的光……讓我看到了未曾見過的世界。
target: Your light has shown me a world I had never seen.

source: 困惑、危険、失敗であなたの心を打とうとした
target: With Uncertainty, With Danger, With Defeat

source: 在一个又一个战场中前进时，你是否也会感到疲惫？我希望自己能够更成熟强大，不断前进。成为你可以交托后背的对象，成为你……最为信赖的搭档。
target: As we advance from one battle to the next, do you ever feel tired? I want to become stronger, wiser, and better. I want to be someone who's got your back, to be your... most trusted Fellow Warrior.

source: 在一個又一個戰場中前進時，你是否也會感到疲憊？我希望自己能夠更成熟強大，不斷前進。成為你可以交託後背的對象，成為你……最為信賴的搭檔。
target: As we advance from one battle to the next, do you ever feel tired? I want to become stronger, wiser, and better. I want to be someone who's got your back, to be your... most trusted Fellow Warrior.

source: 在你身旁，运气似乎也变好了。
target: My luck seems better with you around.

source: 在你身旁，運氣似乎也變好了。
target: My luck seems better with you around.

source: 在大海中航行的时候，第一步是要确定航向，第二步是……随机应变！
target: When sailing the seas, always remember to set your course first, and then... adapt to whatever comes your way!

source: 在大海中航行的時候，第一步是要確定航向，第二步是……隨機應變！
target: When sailing the seas, always remember to set your course first, and then... adapt to whatever comes your way!

source: 在愈发强烈的流息之中，有一个名字……一直在我耳边隐隐盘绕……「祀声之人」……那是指我……还是说……
target: In the surging currents of the Streams, I hear the constant whispering of the name—"Votary of the Voice." Does it refer to me? Or...?

source: 在愈發強烈的流息之中，有一個名字……一直在我耳邊隱隱盤繞……「祀聲之人」……那是指我……還是說……
target: In the surging currents of the Streams, I hear the constant whispering of the name—"Votary of the Voice." Does it refer to me? Or...?

source: 在我手上可沒有虧本買賣。
target: I never miss out on a good deal.

source: 在我手上可没有亏本买卖。
target: I never miss out on a good deal.

source: 在最后一支舞里坚定着
在最後一支舞裡堅定著
在神学院学习时我就知道，如果想要坚守自己的正义，就要付出更多努力与汗水，才能胜过那些意图毁灭正义的幽影。
target: During my studies at the seminary, I knew that to uphold justice, I would need to work harder and sacrifice more than others to overcome the shadows that sought to destroy it.

source: 在神學院學習時我就知道，如果想要堅守自己的正義，就要付出更多努力與汗水，才能勝過那些意圖毀滅正義的幽影。
target: During my studies at the seminary, I knew that to uphold justice, I would need to work harder and sacrifice more than others to overcome the shadows that sought to destroy it.

source: 在賽場訓練結束後，去七丘的浴場泡一會兒。溫暖的水流對舒緩疲勞很有效，搭檔下次也試試看吧？
target: I love going to the Septimont baths after a training session. The warm water does wonders for easing weariness. You should give it a try.

source: 在赛场训练结束后，去七丘的浴场泡一会儿。温暖的水流对舒缓疲劳很有效，搭档下次也试试看吧？
target: I love going to the Septimont baths after a training session. The warm water does wonders for easing weariness. You should give it a try.

source: 在長離老師的指導下，我逐漸明白了很多事情……但是，我卻始終看不透她笑起來的眼睛。
target: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.

source: 在长离老师的指导下，我逐渐明白了很多事情……但是，我却始终看不透她笑起来的眼睛。
target: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.

source: 在阳光和煦的午后找个安静的地方晒太阳，是件非常舒服愉快的事情。睡在温暖的光中，枕在细密的枝叶间，半梦半醒……
target: Napping in the sun on a warm afternoon is so cozy, I just need to find a quiet place. Sleeping in the warmth, nestled among branches and leaves...

source: 在陽光和煦的午後找個安靜的地方曬太陽，是件非常舒服愉快的事情。睡在溫暖的光中，枕在細密的枝葉間，半夢半醒……
target: Napping in the sun on a warm afternoon is so cozy, I just need to find a quiet place. Sleeping in the warmth, nestled among branches and leaves...

source: 報告書を作成しなくては。
target: Ugh, now I have a report to write.
You should have the payment ready by now.

source: 報酬以上を求めるつもりはない。
target: The loot we find is not part of my pay. It's all yours.

source: 塞がれた思考回路が突然明るくなった。それに優曇との共鳴もより強く感じる……私に新たな風を吹かせたのは、あなた？
target: My thoughts are clearing up, and my resonance with You'tan is getting stronger… This is all because of your help, isn't it?

source: 塵も積もれば、と言いますから。
塵世千古，方圓之間……與你棋逢對手，實乃大幸。
target:
Eons of time on this vast land, all encapsulated in a humble game...
I am fortunate to have you as my opponent.
Souls sing in harmony. To the savior's victory!

source: 変数パラメーター、実証データ、潜在的確率……それらを考慮して、効率良く行動しましょう。
target: Variable parameters, empirical data, potential probabilities... I'll take all of these into consideration to improve our efficiency.

source: 変身したら、もっと速く飛べるわ。
target: I'm faster in my mech, you know?

source: 复仇不是一昧的斩杀，而是要看准恶意交错的核心，一剑破之。谢谢，你教我的这招很管用。
target: Vengeance is not mindless killing. It is about identifying the root of malice, and hitting where it truly hurts. Thank you, the move you've taught me has been very useful.

source: 复仇的旅程注定是黑暗而漫长的，就像孤身走一条没有尽头的夜路。幸好有你在，我才不至于那么容易迷失自己。
target: The path of vengeance that I seek is destined to be filled with darkness and peril, like trudging alone through an endless night. Fortunately, with you around, I won't lose myself so easily.

source: 夏の果て、その向こうへ
多くの人々は、「才能」を天からの贈り物と見なしますが、それには「呪い」が伴います。天から与えられたその贈り物を、運命が取り上げてしまうのです。もし君が何かの才能を持っていることに気づいたのなら、決してそれを無駄にしないで……「呪い」が現実となる前に、それを十分に活用してください。
target: Many believe having "talent" is a blessing, but ignore the curse that comes along: someday fate might take it away, quietly. Don't take your talent for granted—make the most of it, before it's too late.

source: 多ければ多いほど、ってね。
多說無益，用行動檢驗結果吧。
target: Talk is cheap. Show me the action.

source: 多謝你的指導，最近我明顯感覺到，不止是武力上的提升，就連處理今州事務都更加游刃有餘了。或許你教我的，不僅是增強力量之法，還有立身處世之道。
target: Thank you for your guidance. I have seen growth in my strength and leadership abilities, and it seems you have taught me more than just swordsmanship; you've taught me valuable life lessons.

source: 多说无益，用行动检验结果吧。
target: Talk is cheap. Show me the action.

source: 多谢你的指导，最近我明显感觉到，不止是武力上的提升，就连处理今州事务都更加游刃有余了。或许你教我的，不仅是增强力量之法，还有立身处世之道。
target: Thank you for your guidance. I have seen growth in my strength and leadership abilities, and it seems you have taught me more than just swordsmanship; you've taught me valuable life lessons.

source: 夜之城是一座笼牢，但另一方面，它也为东躲西藏的我提供了庇护。可就在我渐渐习惯了生活的安逸时，眼前的幸福又全被撕碎，让我重新陷入痛苦……
target: Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.

source: 夜城是一座籠牢，但另一方面，它也為東躲西藏的我提供了庇護。可就在我漸漸習慣了生活的安逸時，眼前的幸福又全被撕碎，讓我重新陷入痛苦……
target: Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.

source: 夜帰の存在に勇気づけられると口にする者は多い。だが、俺にとっての夜帰は、不安の病巣を取り除くためのメスだ。俺か？俺はそのメスを扱う者だ。
target: The Midnight Rangers are a source of solace for many, while I see them as a scalpel, with the duty of eradicating maladies. Me? I am the hand that guides this scalpel, I suppose.

source: 夜帰軍の忌炎だ。民を守るのが責務。お前がここで何か困った時は、俺が全力で助けることを約束する。
target: Jiyan, of the Midnight Rangers. Protecting our lands and people is my solemn duty. Should you encounter any difficulties here, I will do my utmost to help.

source: 夜归军忌炎，守护山河乃职责所在。你游历至此，若遇困难，我定会倾力相助。
target: Jiyan, of the Midnight Rangers. Protecting our lands and people is my solemn duty. Should you encounter any difficulties here, I will do my utmost to help.

source: 夜歸軍忌炎，守護山河乃職責所在。你遊歷至此，若遇困難，我定會傾力相助。
target: Jiyan, of the Midnight Rangers. Protecting our lands and people is my solemn duty. Should you encounter any difficulties here, I will do my utmost to help.

source: 夢を見る者たちと夢を喰らう街
夢州の道士、卜霊だよ。占いだけじゃなくて、お祓いや招福はもちろん、法宝や呪符の扱いまでお任せあれ！
target: Mengzhou Taoist Buling here. Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it!

source: 夢州方士卜靈不僅卜卦靈，驅鬼祈福、測字解籤、法寶符籙……樣樣都靈！
target: Mengzhou Taoist Buling here. Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it!

source: 夢想？呃……讓大家都過上體面的生活？具體我也說不上來，現在我忙著在想接下來整什麼大活呢！
target: A dream? I guess... just makin' sure everyone gets to live a decent life? I dunno, choom. Too busy thinkin' about the next stunt we're gonna pull!

source: 大いなる音、声を持たず……
大きなスーツケースを持って、花火を打ち上げる子ね？楽しそうだわ。遊びに来てくれたら、ここも少しは賑やかになるでしょうね。ふふっ、冗談よ。
target: The little girl with a giant box who plays with fireworks? A fascinating child. I wonder if bringing her into this castle would liven it up a little. Oh relax, I'm only teasing.

source: 大丈夫、わたくしはここよ。
target: Take a breath, I'm right here.

source: 大丈夫です、私に任せてください。
target: Don't worry. Leave it to me.

source: 大人になるといつも難しい顔をしなきゃいけないのかな……大人って大変だね。
target: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!

source: 大切な瞬間は全部、心にしまっておくの。
target: I'll keep all of this in my heart forever.

source: 大家的信賴有時也會變成沉重的負擔呢，我明白這種感覺……所以跟我相處時，可以更放鬆一點兒哦。
target: It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me.

source: 大家的信赖有时也会变成沉重的负担呢，我明白这种感觉……所以跟我相处时，可以更放松一点儿哦。
target: It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me.

source: 大家說，洛可可表演時一臉平靜地做出誇張動作形成的反差，特別容易讓觀眾發笑，就像這樣。欸？你也笑了。嗯，洛可可會把這個風格保持下去的。
target: Apparently, the mix of my over-the-top gestures and stoic face is hilarious to people. See? Just like that. Oh, did I actually get a chuckle out of you? Guess I'll keep this style going, then.

source: 大家說，真正的家人就是可以在一起互幫互助、互相療癒的人。洛可可覺得，能讓我感到溫暖和安全的你，也是家人。
target: People say family is about helping and comforting each other. I feel safe and warm around you... So, maybe you count as family after all?

source: 大家说，洛可可表演时一脸平静地做出夸张动作形成的反差，特别容易让观众发笑，就像这样。诶？你也笑了。嗯，洛可可会把这个风格保持下去的。
target: Apparently, the mix of my over-the-top gestures and stoic face is hilarious to people. See? Just like that. Oh, did I actually get a chuckle out of you? Guess I'll keep this style going, then.

source: 大家说，真正的家人就是可以在一起互帮互助，互相疗愈的人。洛可可觉得，能让我感到温暖和安全的你，也是家人。
target: People say family is about helping and comforting each other. I feel safe and warm around you... So, maybe you count as family after all?
Worry not! Go ahead and open it! This master is here for ya!
Worry not! Go ahead and open it! This master is here for ya!

source: 大概是表情太淡了吧，很多人总说我“难以接近”。其实我并不讨厌谁，只是不知道……应该怎么自然地靠近而已。
target: It's probably my lack of facial expressions. A lot of people think I'm "difficult to approach." It's not that I dislike anyone. I just don't know... how to approach people in a natural way.

source: 大概是表情太淡了吧，很多人總說我「難以接近」。其實我並不討厭誰，只是不知道……應該怎麼自然地靠近而已。
target: It's probably my lack of facial expressions. A lot of people think I'm "difficult to approach." It's not that I dislike anyone. I just don't know... how to approach people in a natural way.

source: 大海是一面鏡子，在它無盡展開的波濤裡，折射著自己的靈魂。
target: The sea is a mirror. It reflects the shape of your soul in its tides.

source: 大海是一面镜子，在它无尽展开的波涛里，折射着自己的灵魂。
target: The sea is a mirror. It reflects the shape of your soul in its tides.

source: 大自然的饋贈，好好收藏喔。
target: It's nature's gift! Let's keep it well.

source: 大自然的馈赠，好好收藏哦。
target: It's nature's gift! Let's keep it well.

source: 大部分早点我都很喜欢。比起夜间喝咖啡熬夜，我更喜欢早起早睡，定量食用早餐能让脑部更快地苏醒。
target: I love all breakfast foods. I prefer to sleep and wake up early instead of staying up late and consuming caffeine. Eating consistent breakfast portions energizes my mind quickly.

source: 大部分早點我都很喜歡。 比起夜間喝咖啡熬夜，我更喜歡早起早睡，定量食用早餐能讓腦部更快地甦醒。
target: I love all breakfast foods. I prefer to sleep and wake up early instead of staying up late and consuming caffeine. Eating consistent breakfast portions energizes my mind quickly.

source: 天命が下った。時は待たぬ。
天地万物、清朗なり。これで呪文の威力が上がるはずだよ！
target: Between heaven and earth, true sounds ring clear. From now on, my spells will hit even harder!

source: 天地万物，本音清朗，今后再出言念咒，威力会大大增强吧！
target: Between heaven and earth, true sounds ring clear. From now on, my spells will hit even harder!

source: 天地萬物，本音清朗，今後再出言念咒，威力會大大增強吧！
target: Between heaven and earth, true sounds ring clear. From now on, my spells will hit even harder!

source:
天工所属で辺境防衛を任されている桃祈よ。いつでも連絡してくれて構わないわ。
返事の方は……勤務中でいいかしら？
target: Hi there, I'm Taoqi, in charge of border defense at the Ministry of Development. If you need my help, shoot me a message any time. I'll get back to you during work hours.

source: 太棒啦！这次特训的过程，我会录下来仔细品味的。
target: Awesome! I'll record our training and savor every detail of it.

source: 太棒啦！這次特訓的過程，我會錄下來仔細品味的。
target: Awesome! I'll record our training and savor every detail of it.

source: 太陽がある限り、道は続く。
target: All the sun touches is ours to fight for.

source: 失敗が気になるのは最初だけ。何度も繰り返すうちに、自然と心配事は消えていくわ。
target: After enough failures, the sting fades, and with it, the burden of worry.

source: 失敗的次數足夠多時，就會失去面對失敗的情感，也就不再擁有煩惱。
target: After enough failures, the sting fades, and with it, the burden of worry.

source: 失败的次数足够多时，就会失去面对失败的情感，也就不再拥有烦恼。
target: After enough failures, the sting fades, and with it, the burden of worry.

source:
奇美拉：如此鮮美的生命氣息……
嘉貝莉娜：放肆。
target:
Chimera: Ah, a fresh delicacy...
Galbrena: Back off.

source:
奇美拉：如此鲜美的生命气息……
嘉贝莉娜：放肆。
target:
Chimera: Ah, a fresh delicacy...
Galbrena: Back off.
Cold winds from under... finally some peace.
Cold winds from under... finally some peace.
Take your final dive, into Naraka.
Take your final dive, into Naraka.

source: 契約書通りに、同盟を結ぶ。この俺が息をしている以上、「幽霊猟犬」の名をもって、この大陸を縦横無尽に通行できると保証する。
target: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.

source: 奖励是最受欢迎的老师~
target: Nothing motivates like a little reward.

source: 她把我当作小队的一员，视我为伙伴，而我却在和她相处的时间里从未敞开过心扉。直到她离去时，我才意识到……我有太多的话没能和她说。
target: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

source: 她把我當作小隊的一員，視我為夥伴，而我卻在和她相處的時間裡從未敞開過心扉。直到她離去時，我才意識到……我有太多的話沒能和她說。
target: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

source: 好きな食べ物？それはもちろん、米粉一択！唐辛子とお酢とネギを入れたら……もう最高！今度越州に行った時、ご馳走するね！
target: Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you!

source: 好き嫌いはダメ！口に入れられるモノがあるだけいいと思え！
target: What's there to be picky about? I'm good with any food, as long as it fills my tummy.
Nice. Let's go check it out.

source: 好了，开始今天的工作吧。
target: Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?
Alright, where are we off to next?
Alright, where are we off to next?

source: 好了，開始今天的工作吧。
target: Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?

source: 好厉害，就像很久以前故事里看到的那样......安可是不是都可以打败恶龙了！
target: This is wicked cool! It's just like in the stories... So Encore can beat up a bad dragon now?! Yay!

source: 好厲害，就像很久以前故事裡看到的那樣......安可是不是都可以打敗惡龍了！
target: This is wicked cool! It's just like in the stories... So Encore can beat up a bad dragon now?! Yay!
Nice. Let's go check it out.

source: 好漂亮的造型…啊，不对，先收好它们吧。
target: Wow, beautiful… Oh, I'd better put them away first.

source: 好漂亮的造型…啊，不對，先收好它們吧。
target: Wow, beautiful… Oh, I'd better put them away first.

source: 好运来临，可是挡不住的喔。
target: There's no stopping good luck once it's on your side!

source: 好運來臨，可是擋不住的喔。
target: There's no stopping good luck once it's on your side!

source: 如今，我有把握，此后绝不会让你被伤及分毫。
target: Now, I am confident to not let you get harmed in the slightest.

source: 如今，我有把握，此後絕不會讓你被傷及分毫。
target: Now, I am confident to not let you get harmed in the slightest.

source: 如果在野外遇到迷惘的孩子，交給熾霞準沒錯。總有孩子會怕我，但沒有孩子會怕她。
target: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.

source: 如果在野外遇到迷惘的孩子，交给炽霞准没错。总有孩子会怕我，但没有孩子会怕她。
target: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.

source: 如果給聲骸也用共鳴促劑，那……蛤？它們要用別的？這是什麼原理啊？
target: If Echoes got this Resonance Potion stuff too, then... Huh? Wait, they get somethin' else? What's the deal?

source: 如果给声骸也用共鸣促剂，那……哈？它们要用别的？这是什么原理啊？
target: If Echoes got this Resonance Potion stuff too, then... Huh? Wait, they get somethin' else? What's the deal?

source: 如行炼狱之上，凝视雪花。
target: Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.

source: 如行煉獄之上，凝視雪花。
target: Roam above the inferno, gazing at the snow.

source: 如遇危险，立即退到我身后。
target: When danger arises, take cover behind me.

source: 如遇危險，立即退到我身後。
target: When danger arises, take cover behind me.

source: 妈妈说过，喝牛奶能让人长高，就像花草也要喝营养液一样？不过牛奶喝起来让人暖乎乎的，大概就是幸福的感觉吧。
target: My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.

source: 妾たちに相応しい実りだ。
妾の策と力、あなたに預けよう。
target: Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.
The Summer Where the Story Began

source: 姿を分かち影を散らし、幻を現と為す……戻れ。
target: Mirage into mist, mist into bone... Withdraw.

source: 媽媽說過，喝牛奶能讓人長高，就像花草也要喝營養液一樣？不過牛奶喝起來讓人暖乎乎的，大概就是幸福的感覺吧。
target: My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.

source: 嫌いな食いもんか……うーん、ないな。あーしは何でも食うぞ！
target: Food I won't eat...? Hmm... Nope, never heard of it!

source: 嫌いな食べ物は特にないし、何でも食べられるわ！まぁ、今の私は食べなくても生きていけるようになっちゃったけど、ふふっ。
target: Nope. As long as it's food, me likey. Though… I don't really need to eat anymore, haha.

source: 子供の頃は暗闇が怖かったけど、いつも「火の英雄」が現れて、それを払ってくれた。今はもうなんてことないよ。だって今のあたしは、火を操れるんだから！
target: I was really scared of the dark when I was little, but "Fiamma" would always arrive in time to drive it away. Now that I'm all grown up, I'm not scared anymore. I can be my own torch!

source: 存在异常，如有疑問請聯絡官方客服
target: An error occurred. Please contact Customer Service for assistance

source: 存在异常，如有疑问请联系官方客服
target: An error occurred. Please contact Customer Service for assistance

source: 孤児院とキャンディーハウス
学園の各部署が掲げる理念には、常に寛容でいるつもりだけれど……なんて言うのかしらね。たまに学食で出る缶詰のメニューには、少し興醒めしちゃうこともあるわ。
target: I like to think I'm quite open-minded about how each department runs things. But, how shall I put this... Sometimes I do feel the cafeteria's canned foods are a bit of a letdown.

source: 它是我与这世界的连结，见证我所经历的一切。
target: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.

source: 它是我與這世界的連結，見證我所經歷的一切。
target: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.

source: 守るのが、私の役目です！
守好規矩，同仇敵愾。只要我還活著，「幽靈獵犬」的名號，便足以允許你橫行大陸。
target: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.

source: 守好规矩，同仇敌忾。只要我还活着，“幽灵猎犬”的名号，便足以允许你横行大陆。
target: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.

source: 守岸人，这个称呼就很好。它表示，某种因你而有的意义和决心。
target: "The Shorekeeper"... This name suits me well enough. It aligns with my purpose and drive: they only exist because of you.

source: 守岸人，這個稱呼就很好。它表示，某種因你而有的意義和決心。
target: "The Shorekeeper"... This name suits me well enough. It aligns with my purpose and drive: they only exist because of you.

source: 安全性能、確認済みです。
安全運転で、よろしくねーっ！
安可……啊，就是那个喜欢讲故事的孩子！呵呵，希望她未来可以成长为能和我愉快玩耍的强者。
target: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.

source: 安可……啊，就是那個喜歡講故事的孩子！呵呵，希望她未來可以成長為能和我愉快玩耍的強者。
target: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.

source: 安可准备了很久呢……要尝一口吗？嘿嘿！
target: Encore spent a long, long time on this! Wanna have a bite? Hehe!

source: 安可準備了很久呢……要嘗一口嗎？嘿嘿！
target: Encore spent a long, long time on this! Wanna have a bite? Hehe!

source: 安心して、ちゃんと分かってるからさ。
target: Relax, I can play by the rules.

source: 安心して、私がついている。
完成一項研究後，獨自撰寫報告的感覺很好。 許多紛雜的想法和靈感，都能隨著這一過程變得清明、有序。
target: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.

source: 完成一项研究后，独自撰写报告的感觉很好。许多纷杂的想法和灵感，都能随着这一过程变得清明、有序。
target: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.

source: 宝探し、劇団の手伝い、ステージの飾り付け、衣装の仕立て、舞台装置の修理……毎日やることがいっぱい。でも、みんなの笑顔を見られるから、これくらいじゃちっとも疲れないよ。
target: I'm always on the go, collecting treasures, helping my friends, making costumes, and repairing stage props... It's a busy routine, but seeing everyone smiling makes it all worth it.

source: 宝探しの勝負といこう！
実は、仕事が大好きなんだ。本当だよ、嘘じゃない……ははっ、つまらない冗談だったな。
target: I love my job! Really. No joke. Was I smiling? No? Then you get the idea.

source: 家裡的債務…只有我一個人的話，估計要還一輩子……
target: My family's debt… It'll probably take me my whole life to pay it off by myself…

source: 家里的债务…只有我一个人的话，估计要还一辈子……
target: My family's debt… It'll probably take me my whole life to pay it off by myself…

source: 富とは積み上げるものです。
寡淡无味的东西。倒也不至于讨厌，只是一吃到就会想起一些不好的回忆，感觉世界都灰暗了一点……不管是口味还是生活，都要缤纷多彩些才好啊。
target: Anything bland. It's not hate, it's just... a trigger of some bad times. Washes the world out for a minute. So my motto stands, for everything: Go bold. Go bright. Never be boring.

source: 寡淡無味的東西。倒也不至於討厭，只是一吃到就會想起一些不好的回憶，感覺世界都灰暗了一點……不管是口味還是生活，都要繽紛多彩些才好啊。
target: Anything bland. It's not hate, it's just... a trigger of some bad times. Washes the world out for a minute. So my motto stands, for everything: Go bold. Go bright. Never be boring.

source: 对于潜入调查员来说，力量只是完成任务的基础，重要的是强韧的精神。
target: For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.

source: 对你的印象？你笑起来……很温暖。
target: What do I think of you? Your smile... It looks warm.

source: 对自身的磨砺从无尽头，或许，我们还能变得更强。
target: To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.

source: 将这滴血，滴在你的手心……如此，“血契”已成。
target: This blood... let it drip into your palm. There. Now our "pact" is sealed.

source: 將這滴血，滴在你的手心……如此，「血契」已成。
target: This blood... let it drip into your palm. There. Now our "pact" is sealed.

source: 對你的印象？你笑起來……很溫暖。
target: What do I think of you? Your smile... It looks warm.

source: 對於潛入調查員來說，力量只是完成任務的基礎，重要的是強韌的精神。
target: For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.

source: 對自身的磨礪從無盡頭，或許，我們還能變得更強。
target: To refine one's skill is a lifelong pursuit. Perhaps we may reach greater heights together.

source: 小心点。我能感觉到祂，阿列夫一……祂一直没有真正地离开。
target: Be careful. I can feel it, Aleph-1... It never really left.

source: 小心點。我能感覺到祂，阿列夫一……祂一直沒有真正地離開。
target: Be careful. I can feel it, Aleph-1... It never really left.

source: 小时候我很怕黑，“火焰英雄”总会及时出现驱散黑暗。后来我就不怕了，毕竟，火把就在我自己手中嘛！
target: I was really scared of the dark when I was little, but "Fiamma" would always arrive in time to drive it away. Now that I'm all grown up, I'm not scared anymore. I can be my own torch!

source: 小時候我很怕黑，「火焰英雄」總會及時出現驅散黑暗。後來我就不怕了，畢竟，火把就在我自己手中嘛！
target: I was really scared of the dark when I was little, but "Fiamma" would always arrive in time to drive it away. Now that I'm all grown up, I'm not scared anymore. I can be my own torch!
Time for a little nap... It's... It's just a dream...
Time for a little nap... It's... It's just a dream...
Let's pick up the pace, hm?
Let's pick up the pace, hm?
Don't mind if I take these.
Don't mind if I take these.

source: 少し……みっともないわね……
少し、うたた寝を……ふぅ。夢、でしたか。
target: Time for a little nap... It's... It's just a dream...

source: 少しでも、お役に立てれば。
少しは、近づけたかしら……

target: I'm off duty, it's your turn.
Let's pick up the pace, hm?
I can spare a minute to knock some heads around.

source: 尘世千古，方圆之间……与你棋逢对手，实乃大幸。
target:
Eons of time on this vast land, all encapsulated in a humble game...
I am fortunate to have you as my opponent.
There is... much to be done...

source: 尤諾，傳聞中誕生於月食之時的天才，能預見正確未來的諭女。好奇的話，就來我身邊吧……不過，我可不保證能給你想要的完滿喔。
target: Iuno, the prodigy born under the lunar eclipse. The Priestess who sees the true future. Curious about what lies ahead? Come to me... But no promises of the perfect ending you seek.

source: 尤诺，传闻中诞生于月食之时的天才，能预见正确未来的谕女。好奇的话，就来我身边吧……不过，我可不保证能给你想要的完满哦。
target: Iuno, the prodigy born under the lunar eclipse. The Priestess who sees the true future. Curious about what lies ahead? Come to me... But no promises of the perfect ending you seek.

source: 就不能往箱子裡放點彈藥什麼的嗎？
target: Ugh, no ammo? Who stocks these things?

source: 就不能往箱子里放点弹药什么的吗？
target: Ugh, no ammo? Who stocks these things?

source: 就像家族的俗語說的那樣，「匕首只有時常磨礪才不會變鈍」。就算只是為了工作考慮，鍛鍊也是必不可少的。
target: As the Montelli saying goes, "A blade only stays sharp if it's regularly honed." Even if it's just for work, exercise is necessary.

source: 就像家族的俗语说的那样，“匕首只有时常磨砺才不会变钝”。就算只是为了工作考虑，锻炼也是必不可少的。
target: As the Montelli saying goes, "A blade only stays sharp if it's regularly honed." Even if it's just for work, exercise is necessary.

source: 就将你的愿望托付与我。
就將你的願望託付與我。

target: I'll take it as my overtime fee.
I'll take it as my overtime fee.
I can spare a minute to knock some heads around.
I can spare a minute to knock some heads around.

source: 就算沒有記憶，遇到不平之事，身體也會先一步行動……你一定是好人吧？如果不是的話，我會很困擾。
target: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.

source: 就算没有记忆，遇到不平之事，身体也会先一步行动……你一定是好人吧？如果不是的话，我会很困扰。
target: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.
Is that the best you got?
Is that the best you got?

source: 尻尾の明かりが強くなったような……
target: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?

source: 尽情锻炼后来上一杯热腾腾的清茶，茶的清新淡雅可以缓解肌肉酸痛。很有效的，你也试试。
target: A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.

source: 届かない場所などありません。
属于骑士的故事开始了！
屬於騎士的故事開始了！
山間をたゆたうは、渚の霞。
target: Beyond lush haze, the rainfall marches.

source: 岁主在上，请允许我代为平息这场纷争。
target: I resolve disputes in the Sentinel's name.

source:
嵐を巻き起こす。
*フーフー*

target: At Last, the Cycle Begins Again

source: 己の人生を欺いて生きる者は多くいるが、白芷のように真理の追究のため、すべてを捧げようとする者は極めて少ない。
target: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

source: 己を、怒りを抑えれば…燃え盛る炎も、手に焼くほど熱くはありません。
target: With temperance and discipline, my flames will be kept in check.

source: 己を知る事、すなわち……うん？
已經這個時間了，還沒到嗎？……哎……
已经这个时间了，还没到吗？……哎……
希望回報能與風險相稱。
target: Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.

source: 希望回报能与风险相称。
target: Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.

source: 希望我所到之处的罪恶通通消失。明里没有，暗里也不许有。
target: Wherever I go, I swear to vanquish evil, whether it's out in the daylight or hiding in the dark.

source: 希望我所到之處的罪惡通通消失。明裡沒有，暗裡也不許有。
target: Wherever I go, I swear to vanquish evil, whether it's out in the daylight or hiding in the dark.

source: 希望现在的我，已经成长到能和你并肩而行了。虽然有个可靠的背影能跟随和依赖是很安心，但我的野心可不止于此~就像你曾经保护我那样，我也会保护你。
target: I hope I'm strong enough to walk beside you now. It's good to have someone to follow and rely on, but I want more than that. Just like you once protected me… it's my turn to protect you.

source: 希望現在的我，已經成長到能和你並肩而行了。雖然有個可靠的背影能跟隨和依賴是很安心，但我的野心可不止於此~就像你曾經保護我那樣，我也會保護你。
target: I hope I'm strong enough to walk beside you now. It's good to have someone to follow and rely on, but I want more than that. Just like you once protected me… it's my turn to protect you.
Anything I can help you with?
Anything I can help you with?

source: 希望这份力量，也能让隧者更长久地保护拉海洛。
target: May this strength help the Exostrider keep watch over Lahai-Roi for ages to come.
Hopefully my patience will pay off this time.

source: 希望這份力量，也能讓隧者更長久地保護拉海洛。
target: May this strength help the Exostrider keep watch over Lahai-Roi for ages to come.
Hopefully my patience will pay off this time.
I'm off duty, it's your turn.
I'm off duty, it's your turn.

source: 平稳的过渡。接下来我们该去哪儿……左满舵！！
target: We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside!

source: 平穩的過渡。接下來我們該去哪……左滿舵！！
target: We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside!

source: 幸運も味方しています。
应行的王道，应得的胜利。

target: This should suffice for a while.

source: 开场见礼——诸邪避散，岁岁平安！
target: Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!

source: 开箱子是角色扮演游戏的必备一环~
target: Treasure chests! Ahh, the essential RPG experience—

source: 弈棋佈勢之道，如同萬物運轉，每時每刻都處於變易之中……嗯，甚是有趣啊。
target: The dynamics of a Weiqi game mirror the complexities of our world, always in a state of constant flux and transformation... Fascinating, isn't it?

source: 弈棋布势之道，如同万物运转，每时每刻都处于变易之中……嗯，甚是有趣啊。
target: The dynamics of a Weiqi game mirror the complexities of our world, always in a state of constant flux and transformation... Fascinating, isn't it?

source: 引くわけにはいきません。
弦はまだ……切れて、いません。
target: There's still time… before the threads snap.

source: 弦は悠久の静寂を紡ぎ、剣は満天の澄明を起こす。
target: On the qin strings do eons sing, eternal peace my blade shall bring.

source: 弦は断たれ、縁も尽きた……
弦凝千古寂，剑起满天清。
target: On the qin strings do eons sing, eternal peace my blade shall bring.

source: 弦凝千古寂，劍起滿天清。
target: On the qin strings do eons sing, eternal peace my blade shall bring.
There's still time… before the threads snap.
There's still time… before the threads snap.

source: 強いが、御しやすい……この力、俺の雷煌拳と中々相性が良いみたいだ。
target: Now that I've gotten used to it, this power feels robust and flexible. It does have something in common with my Leihuangquan.

source: 強いけど、口数は少ない……瑝瓏にこんな諺があるんだ。「鼠をとる猫はやたらに鳴かぬ」……それってあんたにピッタリじゃない？
target: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old Huanglong saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?

source: 強い力がみなぎる第四楽章は、壮絶な戦いの讃歌。激流に乗り、果てなき大地をどこまでも駆け抜け、すべてを洗い流す。
target: The decisive and powerful fourth movement brings forth a rousing battle hymn. Carried by the rapids, it surges across an endless land, sweeping all before it.

source: 強まっていく流れ息のなかに、ひとつの名前が……ずっと耳の奥で、かすかに響き続けています。「声を祀りし者」とは、私のことなのでしょうか。それとも……
target: In the surging currents of the Streams, I hear the constant whispering of the name—"Votary of the Voice." Does it refer to me? Or...?

source: 当然是夹着新鲜水果，涂满了奶油，插着蜡烛的生日蛋糕了……毕竟，我还没吃过呢。
target: A birthday cake, of course. The kind with tons of fresh fruit and way too much whipped cream. And candles on top, for sure... Why? Because I've never actually had one before.

source: 形ある周波数よ、原初へ！
役に立ちそうなものはありますか？
役に立つならいいんですが。
彼の天才ぶりと同じくらい印象的な点は、そのお人好し具合。記憶では彼が怒ったことは一度もなく、どれほど常識外れな要望でも、彼なら満足いく形で応えてくれる。
target: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

source: 彼らの意志は……俺が引き継ぐ。
彼女が歩んできた季節
彼女の剣から、何か良からぬ気が伝わってくる……若いのに、要らぬ重荷を背負っているのは良くないな。
target: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.

source: 彼女の鏡が気になる？……すっごい品なんだけど、言えないかな。うん、今は詳細は言えない！
target: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!

source: 彼女は……お客さんになれない人間だね。他人から聞くより、自ら探しに行くタイプなんだ。
target: Hmm… Seems unlikely she'll ever be my client. She's the type of person to trust the conclusions from her own research over information provided by anyone else.

source: 彼女は長い間、ずっと上手く隠し通していたのね……そのせいで、私は余計に自分を責めてしまうし、胸が痛むわ。
target: She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more.

source: 往く道に、続きがあったとは。妾の身に宿る祈りも……今度こそ、実を結ぶかもしれぬ。
target: The path I walk stretches into the future. The wishes laid upon me… perhaps one day, I can finally make them...
Illusions of the past... Step forward!
Illusions of the past... Step forward!

source: 待つ時間よりも長く感じるもの
待在幽海裡太久了，有時候，也想稍微呼吸一下海面上的新鮮空氣呢。
target: I've spent too much time in the depths of the sea. At times, I wish for a breath of fresh air above the surface.

source: 待在幽海里太久了，有时候，也想稍微呼吸一下海面上的新鲜空气呢。
target: I've spent too much time in the depths of the sea. At times, I wish for a breath of fresh air above the surface.

source: 很多人都会将所谓的“天赋”视作是一种馈赠，却忽略了随之而来的诅咒——也许某天，命运就会将这份礼物悄悄收走。如果你真的发现自己在哪方面拥有天赋的话，可千万不要荒废了……在诅咒应验之前，好好运用它吧。
target: Many believe having "talent" is a blessing, but ignore the curse that comes along: someday fate might take it away, quietly. Don't take your talent for granted—make the most of it, before it's too late.

source: 很多人都會將所謂的「天賦」視作是一種饋贈，卻忽略了隨之而來的詛咒——也許某天，命運就會將這份禮物悄悄收走。如果你真的發現自己在哪方面擁有天賦的話，可千萬不要荒廢了……在詛咒應驗之前，好好運用它吧。
target: Many believe having "talent" is a blessing, but ignore the curse that comes along: someday fate might take it away, quietly. Don't take your talent for granted—make the most of it, before it's too late.

source: 很奇妙吧，文字和音乐带来的力量也是一种奇迹。
target: Isn't it amazing what miracles words and music can bring?

source: 很奇妙吧，文字和音樂帶來的力量也是一種奇跡。
target: Isn't it amazing what miracles words and music can bring?
Good. There's no time to waste.
Good. There's no time to waste.

source: 很暢快呢……就像暴雨灑進沉寂已久的海面，激起波濤萬丈。
target: Mmm, how exquisite... Like a storm crashing into a still sea, stirring it to life with waves that reach for the sky.

source: 很温暖哦，我感受到了……抚摸着平静海面的细碎阳光。
target: I can feel that warmth, just like the caress of sunlight tracing the sea.

source: 很溫暖哦，我感受到了……撫摸著平靜海面的細碎陽光。
target: I can feel that warmth, just like the caress of sunlight tracing the sea.

source: 很畅快呢……就像暴雨洒进沉寂已久的海面，激起波涛万丈。
target: Mmm, how exquisite... Like a storm crashing into a still sea, stirring it to life with waves that reach for the sky.
Ugh, now I have a report to write.
Ugh, now I have a report to write.

source: 從一個月亮，走向另一個月亮，更迭、更迭……直至尺度不能再被丈量。
target: From one moon to another, through endless cycles... until it's beyond measurement.

source: 從平面到立體，這些符文的含義在我眼前展開，它們是那樣的浩瀚……
target: From something flat to something with great depth, the meaning of the runes unfolds before my eyes. It feels infinite...

source: 從沒有關於力量的回憶，但我們可以從回憶中汲取力量。
target: You may not have memories of power, but you can always draw strength from memories.

source: 從紛亂的干擾項中，探尋正確的方向。
target: Amidst disruptions, let's find our way to the right path.

source: 御託は結構です。合理的なオーダーであれば、この手で実現させてやりましょう。
target: Quit the chit-chat. Tell me what you need and I'll make it for you, provided your descriptions are reasonable.

source: 復仇不是一昧的斬殺，而是要看準惡意交錯的核心，一劍破之。謝謝，你教我的這招很管用。
target: Vengeance is not mindless killing. It is about identifying the root of malice, and hitting where it truly hurts. Thank you, the move you've taught me has been very useful.

source: 復仇的旅程註定是黑暗而漫長的，就像孤身走一條沒有盡頭的夜路。幸好有你在，我才不至於那麼容易迷失自己。
target: The path of vengeance that I seek is destined to be filled with darkness and peril, like trudging alone through an endless night. Fortunately, with you around, I won't lose myself so easily.

source:
復讐とは、むやみに斬ることではなく、張り巡らされた悪の根を辿り、破ることです。
ありがとうございます。この技、大事にします。
target: Vengeance is not mindless killing. It is about identifying the root of malice, and hitting where it truly hurts. Thank you, the move you've taught me has been very useful.

source:
復讐の旅は……そうですね。
一人で歩む果てしない夜道と似ています。
でもあなたは……その夜道を照らす、明かりとなってくれました。
target: The path of vengeance that I seek is destined to be filled with darkness and peril, like trudging alone through an endless night. Fortunately, with you around, I won't lose myself so easily.

source: 微弱的力量……不，无法忽视的力量。
target: A faint power... but still, one that commands attention.

source: 微弱的力量……不，無法忽視的力量。
target: A faint power... but still, one that commands attention.

source: 心だけは、墓場にあらず。
心なしか、拳法だけでなく雷光も幾分切れが良くなったかな。これも全部、君のおかげだ。
target: Thanks to your help, my skills have improved and even my thunderbolts are stronger. Owing to your aid, I might be able to get a couple more scoundrels dealt with.

source: 心に曇りなし。一切の無駄を感じぬ。どうやらお主は、剣の極みに達した様子。
target: Clarity within, precision without. You've learned this well.

source: 心の声が届いたのなら、その反響は必ず返ってくる。
target: An unwavering faith will resonate with like-minded souls.

source: 心の湖が、いっそう澄み渡っていく……あなたがそばにいるからこそ、私は憂いなく、自らの迷いと向き合えるのだ。
target: My Heart Lake has grown clearer... With you beside me, I no longer fear the tangled shadows of my own heart.

source: 心を込めて上達を求めていくこと、それを“進”と呼ぶ。
target: Liberation comes from accepting change and transience.

source: 心を込めて手作りした料理……ですね。そういったものは時間をかけてじっくり味わう必要がありますから。ですがその一方、出来の悪いファストフードには、食べる価値すらありませんね。
target: It's important to take time savoring meals prepared with devotion and care, but never those shoddily manufactured instant foods; consuming them is only a disservice to my chewing muscles.

source: 心を込めて法を修練していくこと、それを“精”と呼ぶ。
心中澄澈，剑下无痕，看来你已经领悟这其中的门道了。
target: Clarity within, precision without. You've learned this well.

source: 心中澄澈，劍下無痕，看來你已經領悟這其中的門道了。
target: Clarity within, precision without. You've learned this well.

source:
心拍数と血圧が少し上がった気がする……。
何だか落ち着かないわね。
……やはり少し横になって休むべきよ。
target: My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep.

source: 心湖变得愈发明静……正因有你在身侧，我才能没有后顾之忧地直面心中的执妄。
target: My Heart Lake has grown clearer... With you beside me, I no longer fear the tangled shadows of my own heart.

source: 心湖變得愈發明靜……正因有你在身側，我才能沒有後顧之憂地直面心中的執妄。
target: My Heart Lake has grown clearer... With you beside me, I no longer fear the tangled shadows of my own heart.

source: 心跳加速，血压上升，这股力量让人有点静不下来呢……果然还是先去躺下休息会吧。
target: My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep.

source: 心跳加速，血壓上升，這股力量讓人有點靜不下來呢……果然還是先去躺下休息會吧。
target: My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep.

source: 心配しないで……きっとうまくいく。
target: No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time.
No need to dwell on it.

source: 必要なら持っていって。

target: An unwavering faith will resonate with like-minded souls.
An unwavering faith will resonate with like-minded souls.

source: 怎么会有清茶这么苦的东西啊，反正本大师是吃不得这种苦头的，下次看谁不顺眼，就偷偷灌进他的杯子里吧，嘻嘻~
target: Ugh, plain tea is so bitter! Who even likes that? I'll just find a chance to dump it in the cup of whoever bothers me next time. Hehe!
What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...

source: 怎麼會有清茶這麼苦的東西啊，反正本大師是吃不得這種苦頭的，下次看誰不順眼，就偷偷灌進他的杯子裡吧，嘻嘻~
target: Ugh, plain tea is so bitter! Who even likes that? I'll just find a chance to dump it in the cup of whoever bothers me next time. Hehe!
What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...

source: 思緒豁然開朗，和憂曇的共鳴也更加強烈……這種提升，是因為你的幫忙吧？
target: My thoughts are clearing up, and my resonance with You'tan is getting stronger… This is all because of your help, isn't it?

source: 思绪豁然开朗，和忧昙的共鸣也更加强烈……这种提升，是因为你的帮忙吧？
target: My thoughts are clearing up, and my resonance with You'tan is getting stronger… This is all because of your help, isn't it?

source: 思路变得通透了。等等，我需要把刚才这条思路记录一下……
target: My thoughts feel sharper now... Wait, that could be an interesting concept. I should jot it down.

source: 思路變得通透了。等等，我需要把剛才這條思路記錄一下……
target: My thoughts feel sharper now... Wait, that could be an interesting concept. I should jot it down.

source: 急ぐ必要あるのかしら。
总有一天，剧团会航遍世界的每一个角落。到时候，所有的海潮里都会高唱着一个共同的故事——那个故事的名字，叫做「愚人」!
target: One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of the Fools!
What She Fears, What She Dreads

source: 悄悄和你說，那個經常和秋水交易的奇怪叔叔其實很喜歡小狗！所以在安可的童話裡他是只大狗狗！
target: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!

source: 悄悄和你说，那个经常和秋水交易的奇怪叔叔其实很喜欢小狗！所以在安可的童话里他是只大狗狗！
target: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!

source: 悩み、ね……ほとんどの悩みはお金でなんとかできるけど、ひとつだけ悩んでるわ。妹が大きくなったら、どうすればいいの？はぁ……いつの間にか、私の手を引いてくれなくなったのよ。
target: My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore?

source: 悩みか？総督府に面倒事は付き物だ。しかし、「向き合う勇気」さえあれば、容易に解決できる。ふっ……解決できる問題など、悩みとは呼べぬ。
target: Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.

source: 悪くない……強くなった気がするわ。何かお返しを考えないと。
target: Good. That did make me stronger... Should I start thinking about how to repay you?

source: 悪くない、もらっていこう。
悪くないわ、まだ鈍ってないみたいね。
target: Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

source: 悪くないわね。次の抜き打ちテストのご褒美にでもしようかしら。
悪くねぇな、もらっとこうぜ。
悪くはありません……これも投資ですね。
悪くはない。ここへ来た甲斐があった。

target: Is that the best you can do?

source: 悲しみに満ちた陰鬱な第二楽章。その奥底には、不安と邪悪が潜んでいる。恐ろしいでしょう？振り上げられた短剣が、生と死のベールを引き裂く様は。
target: The shadowed, sorrowful second movement conceals unease and terror. Are you not afraid? It will raise its dagger with force, tearing through the veil between life and death.

source: 想定内です、まだ行けます。
想找秋水？这是他的联络方式……报我的名字，可以打八折。
target: Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.

source: 想找秋水？這是他的聯絡方式……報我的名字，可以打八折。
target: Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.

source: 想知道保温杯里装的养生秘诀？哈哈，真的只是普通的热茶而已啊。
target: Have I been keeping some kind of secret healthy drink in this flask, you ask? *chuckle* It's really just regular hot tea.

source: 想知道保溫杯裡裝的養生秘訣？哈哈，真的只是普通的熱茶而已啊。
target: Have I been keeping some kind of secret healthy drink in this flask, you ask? *chuckle* It's really just regular hot tea.
What is it you wish for?
What is it you wish for?

source: 想要的东西，总会在不经意间冒出来呢。
target: What we want has a way of appearing when least expected.

source: 想要的東西，總會在不經意間冒出來呢。
target: What we want has a way of appearing when least expected.

source: 愉快な、拒むことができない力。二人だけの秘密がまた増えましたね。
target: Such delightful and irresistible power. Well, now we have another shared secret.

source: 意味が落ちれば、ルーンは光り出す。
target: When the True Name is unveiled, the rune illuminates.
Well, would you look at that! Easy money.
Well, would you look at that! Easy money.

source: 愛彌斯，拉貝爾學部的隧者適格者！不過，那都是生前的事了。現在的我，是電子幽靈喔~
target: Aemeath, Synchronist of the Exostrider from Rabelle College. That was me back when I was alive. Now? I'm a digital ghost!

source:
愛彌斯：世界，由我守護！
隧者兵裝：目標記錄。
target:
Aemeath: The world is mine to guard!
Exostrider Armament: Objective logged.

source:
愛彌斯：終曲聚束，射擊！
隧者兵裝：指令確認。
target:
Aemeath: Lightshow of the finale, fire!
Exostrider Armament: Order confirmed.

source:
愛彌斯：英雄的舞台，開幕！
隧者兵裝：射燈完備。
target:
Aemeath: Hero's on, lights up!
Exostrider Armament: Limelights checked.

source: 感じましたか？風の周波数が……あなたと私の間で木霊しています。
target: Can you feel it? The frequency of the wind... it's resonating between us.

source: 感情や記憶、繋がりと同じように、もっと多くの力を顕現させないと……私のこと、上手にアンカーできるようになってきたじゃない。
target: My powers keep manifesting like my emotions, memories, and connections... You've become quite adept at this anchor job, haven't you?

source: 感覺到了嗎？屬於風的頻率……正迴盪在你我的聯結之間。
target: Can you feel it? The frequency of the wind... it's resonating between us.

source: 感覺能調動的虛質變多了一點？嗯……變強總歸是好事情吧？
target: It feels like I can control more Voidmatter now. Hmm... Getting stronger is always a good thing, right?

source: 感觉到了吗？属于风的频率……正回荡在你我的联结之间。
target: Can you feel it? The frequency of the wind... it's resonating between us.

source: 感觉能调动的虚质变多了一点？嗯……变强总归是好事情吧？
target: It feels like I can control more Voidmatter now. Hmm... Getting stronger is always a good thing, right?

source: 愿岁主指引迷失者的归途。
target: May the Sentinel guide those who are lost.
Slow and steady. Let's not bite off more than we can chew.
Slow and steady. Let's not bite off more than we can chew.

source: 應行的王道，應得的勝利。

target: This should suffice for a while.
I'm no stranger to this sensation...

source: 成为英雄！成为和飞羽侠、火焰英雄并列的，能帮大家驱散黑暗和恐惧的英雄！
target: I've always wanted to become a hero! A hero matching Speedster and Fiamma, bringing hope and courage to all!

source: 成為英雄！成為和飛羽俠、火焰英雄並列的，能幫大家驅散黑暗和恐懼的英雄！
target: I've always wanted to become a hero! A hero matching Speedster and Fiamma, bringing hope and courage to all!

source: 成色不錯……看吧，這也是投資的一種呢。
成色不错……看吧，这也是投资的一种呢。
成長……呼吸すらも、何だか気持ちよくなりますね……
target: As I grow, even my breaths feel lighter...

source: 我……哭了？我、我沒想到，我居然真的能觸及語義本身，它們是那樣美、那樣耀眼……我能走到這裡，能看到這麼多……謝謝你，前輩。
target: Am I... crying? I-I never imagined I would touch the True Names themselves. They're beautiful, dazzling... To come this far and see so much... Thank you, Senior.

source: 我……哭了？我、我没想到，我居然真的能触及语义本身，它们是那样美、那样耀眼……我能走到这里，能看到这么多……谢谢你，前辈。
target: Am I... crying? I-I never imagined I would touch the True Names themselves. They're beautiful, dazzling... To come this far and see so much... Thank you, Senior.

source: 我……因为你带给我的东西，变得和以前不一样了。我的成长，会让你觉得开心吗？
target: Your influence has... catalyzed a change in me. Does this progress please you?

source: 我……因為你帶給我的東西，變得和以前不一樣了。我的成長，會讓你覺得開心嗎？
target: Your influence has... catalyzed a change in me. Does this progress please you?

source: 我が友よ、歓声を上げるんだ！
我不在的时候……佣兵团的孩子们没闯什么祸吧。
target: Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...

source: 我不在的時候……傭兵團的孩子們沒闖什麼禍吧。
target: Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...

source: 我不太喜欢吃太大份太多油的食物，比如说牛排之类的……倒不是说这些不好吃，只是吃不完的话，会很浪费，那样可不好……
target: I'm not a big fan of big, greasy dishes—like steaks... It's not that they aren't tasty, I just hate the idea of letting food go to waste if I can't finish it. It doesn't sit right with me...

source: 我不太喜歡吃太大份太多油的食物，比如說牛排之類的……倒不是說這些不好吃，只是吃不完的話，會很浪費，那樣可不好……
target: I'm not a big fan of big, greasy dishes—like steaks... It's not that they aren't tasty, I just hate the idea of letting food go to waste if I can't finish it. It doesn't sit right with me...

source: 我不太擅長吃難嚼的東西……啊，跟牙口沒關係，單純就是不喜歡唇齒間黏黏糊糊的感覺。
target: I'm not a big fan of foods that are hard to chew… Oh, it's got nothing to do with my teeth. I'm just not fond of the prickling sensation of stickiness in my mouth.

source: 我不太擅長戰鬥啦……可以申請偷懶嗎？
target: I'm not much of a fighter... Can I just slack off?

source: 我不太擅长吃难嚼的东西……啊，跟牙口没关系，单纯就是不喜欢唇齿间黏黏糊糊的感觉。
target: I'm not a big fan of foods that are hard to chew… Oh, it's got nothing to do with my teeth. I'm just not fond of the prickling sensation of stickiness in my mouth.

source: 我不太擅长战斗啦……可以申请偷懒吗？
target: I'm not much of a fighter... Can I just slack off?

source: 我不必等待繁星之夜，不必引頸仰望。我已將天空置於頸後、手邊和眼瞼上。
target: I need not wait for a starry night, nor tilt my gaze to seek the sky. For I have placed it at my back, in my hands, and upon my eyelids.

source: 我不必等待繁星之夜，不必引颈仰望。我已将天空置于颈后、手边和眼睑上。
target: I need not wait for a starry night, nor tilt my gaze to seek the sky. For I have placed it at my back, in my hands, and upon my eyelids.

source: 我不想欠你人情。作为交换，我会为你提供所需的一切技术支援。换句话说……我会站在你的背后。
target: Not in the biz of owin' favors, so consider my arsenal of tech wizardry at your disposal. In other words... I got your back.

source: 我不想欠你人情。作為交換，我會為你提供所需的一切技術支援。換句話說……我會站在你的背後。
target: Not in the biz of owin' favors, so consider my arsenal of tech wizardry at your disposal. In other words... I got your back.

source: 我也将归于荣耀之间么？
target: Does the Vale of Glory await me?

source: 我也將歸於榮耀之間嗎？
target: Does the Vale of Glory await me?

source: 我从没感受过这样充盈的力量……是因为你，对吗？谢谢你，漂泊者。谢谢你……为我所做的一切。
target: I've never felt such strength in me. It's all thanks to you, isn't it? I am forever grateful, Rover, for everything you've done for me.

source: 我们之间的配合更默契了。
我们所经历的挑战，我们所迈过的难关，我们所共同分享的回忆，都将成为我的力量。
target: Every challenge we've faced, every obstacle we've overcome, and every memory we've shared... All of it has become my strength.

source: 我会为你斩断一切威胁。
target: I will cut down any threat in your way.

source: 我会尽快熟悉这份力量……！
target: I'll learn to master this power as quickly as I can...!

source: 我会尽我所能，成为大家的慰藉。
target: I will do my best to help everyone.

source: 我会把这些，全都珍藏在心里。
target: I'll keep all of this in my heart forever.

source: 我会消灭，意图毁灭的恶。
target: I destroy all that seeks destruction.
I'll take good care of you.

source: 我們之間的配合更默契了。
我們所經歷的挑戰，我們所邁過的難關，我們所共同分享的回憶，都將成為我的力量。
target: Every challenge we've faced, every obstacle we've overcome, and every memory we've shared... All of it has become my strength.

source: 我做的飯菜…不知道為什麼，菜和調料的味道總是無法融合……你、你好奇是什麼味道嗎？ 那…等我再練習一下再給你品嚐……
target: When I cook, it feels like the flavors never blend, like the ingredients and seasonings are at odds… Are-are you interested in tasting it? Um, I'll have to practice more before you try it…

source: 我做的饭菜…不知道为什么，菜和调料的味道总是无法融合……你、你好奇是什么味道吗？那…等我再练习一下再给你品尝……
target: When I cook, it feels like the flavors never blend, like the ingredients and seasonings are at odds… Are-are you interested in tasting it? Um, I'll have to practice more before you try it…

source: 我发现，和你合作总是很愉快，嗯……那种并非交际的愉快。所以说，不论是谈生意还是增进感情，是你的话，我都非常欢迎。
target: I've come to find a genuine pleasure working with you—truly, I do not say this out of formality. Whether it's business or not, I truly cherish every moment we share.
I'm faster in my mech, you know?

source: 我叫凌阳，比起我摘下狮头后的这幅模样，可能大家更习惯的，还是那位梅花桩上的“狮首”吧？希望相处之后，你能记住这个原原本本的我呀。
target: Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head!

source: 我叫凌陽，比起我摘下獅頭後的這副模樣，可能大家更習慣的，還是那位梅花樁上的「獅首」吧？希望相處之後，你能記住這個原原本本的我呀。
target: Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head!

source: 我可不打算在这耗一整天。
我可不打算在這耗一整天。
我可喜欢米粉！加点辣子，加点醋，加点儿葱花……香得很！下次去越州玩，我请你吃好不好？
target: Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you!

source: 我喜欢你凝视我的样子。原本深邃的幽海倒映在你澄澈的眼眸中，也变得清澈见底、一览无余。和你在一起的时候，我不再是「毒药」，而是我自己。
target: I like the way you look at me. In your eyes, even the darkest depths of the sea are made transparent. With you, I am no longer "The Bane." I am simply myself.

source: 我喜欢和幽灵猎犬打交道。讲规矩，够爽快，能节省不少时间。
target: I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.

source: 我喜欢把收集起来的物品重新改造，制作成舞台道具。它们可以在戏剧中焕发新的生机，虽然看起来不够华丽，但每一个物品背后，都曾拥有非常独特的故事，值得珍惜。
target: I like turning the things I collect into stage props. They might not look fancy at first, but each one has its own special story. On stage, the ordinary becomes extraordinary, and I think that's worth something.

source: 我喜歡你凝視我的樣子。原本深邃的幽海倒映在你澄澈的眼眸中，也變得清澈見底、一覽無餘。和你在一起的時候，我不再是「毒藥」，而是我自己。
target: I like the way you look at me. In your eyes, even the darkest depths of the sea are made transparent. With you, I am no longer "The Bane." I am simply myself.

source: 我喜歡和幽靈獵犬打交道。講規矩，夠爽快，能節省不少時間。
target: I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.

source: 我喜歡把收集起來的物品重新改造，製作成舞台道具。它們可以在戲劇中煥發新的生機，雖然看起來不夠華麗，但每一個物品背後都曾擁有非常獨特的故事，值得珍惜。
target: I like turning the things I collect into stage props. They might not look fancy at first, but each one has its own special story. On stage, the ordinary becomes extraordinary, and I think that's worth something.

source: 我头上的这个？是我们呜呜物流的工卡。有时候手上拿着太多东西，不方便从包里掏出来，干脆就夹在头发上啦。同事一见，立刻就能叫出我的名字，多好！
target: This on my head? It's my employee ID badge. Clipped it to my hair to save myself the fumbling when I'm carrying stuff. Now everyone knows my name in a snap. Perfect!

source: 我对本校各职能部门的理念一直持开放态度，但，怎么说呢……有时候我也会觉得食堂的罐装食品多少有些扫兴了。
target: I like to think I'm quite open-minded about how each department runs things. But, how shall I put this... Sometimes I do feel the cafeteria's canned foods are a bit of a letdown.

source: 我對本校各職能部門的理念一直持開放態度，但，怎麼說呢……有時候我也會覺得食堂的罐裝食品多少有些掃興了。
target: I like to think I'm quite open-minded about how each department runs things. But, how shall I put this... Sometimes I do feel the cafeteria's canned foods are a bit of a letdown.

source: 我已經……與凍土之下的自己訣別。等到雪融時，我們會在嶄新的春天裡重逢。
target: I've already bid farewell to the self buried beneath the frostlands. When the snow thaws... we'll meet again among the new blooms of spring.

source: 我已经……与冻土之下的自己诀别。等到雪融时，我们会在崭新的春天里重逢。
target: I've already bid farewell to the self buried beneath the frostlands. When the snow thaws... we'll meet again among the new blooms of spring.

source: 我已融会贯通，这次异常顺利，多谢！
target: Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!

source: 我已融會貫通，這次異常順利，多謝！
target: Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!

source: 我希望…終有一天，我能用自己全部的時間去畫我真正想畫的，在這個世界上留下真正的我的痕跡。
target: I hope… that one day, I can spend all my time painting what I truly want, leaving a piece of the real me in this world.

source: 我希望…终有一天，我能用自己全部的时间去画我真正想画的，在这个世界上留下真正的我的痕迹。
target: I hope… that one day, I can spend all my time painting what I truly want, leaving a piece of the real me in this world.

source: 我很喜歡米粉！加點辣子，加點醋，加點蔥花……香得很！下次去越州玩，我請你吃好不好？
target: Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you!

source: 我很期待……这场只属于你我的游戏。
target: Hehe... I'm looking forward to our game.

source: 我很期待……這場只屬於你我的遊戲。
target: Hehe... I'm looking forward to our game.

source: 我從沒感受過這樣充盈的力量……是因為你，對嗎？謝謝你，漂泊者。謝謝你……為我所做的一切。
target: I've never felt such strength in me. It's all thanks to you, isn't it? I am forever grateful, Rover, for everything you've done for me.

source: 我想和你一样，成为救世主。
target: I want to be like you—to become the savior.

source: 我想和你一樣，成為救世主。
target: I want to be like you—to become the savior.

source: 我想留在大家身边……从过去，一同迈向明天。
target: I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: 我想留在大家身边……从过去，一同迈向明天。
target: Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: 我想留在大家身邊……從過去，一同邁向明天。
target: I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: 我想留在大家身邊……從過去，一同邁向明天。
target: Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: 我想，我已經從你那得到了最為重要的東西，無限接近於人類的「靈魂」。
target: I believe I have received an invaluable treasure from you... Something infinitely close to what humans call a "soul."

source: 我想，我已经从你那得到了最为重要的东西，无限接近于人类的“灵魂”。
target: I believe I have received an invaluable treasure from you... Something infinitely close to what humans call a "soul."

source: 我是……噔噔噔——灯灯！你有想寄出的邮件吗？呜呜物流领航员灯灯，一定帮你平安送到！
target: Greetings! Lumi here! Need to send some mail? I've got you covered as Lollo Logistics' professional navigator!

source: 我是……噔噔噔——燈燈！你有想寄出的郵件嗎？嗚嗚物流領航員燈燈，一定幫你平安送到！
target: Greetings! Lumi here! Need to send some mail? I've got you covered as Lollo Logistics' professional navigator!

source: 我是否已有足够的力量，去面对那些令我迷茫的阴影？
target: Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness?

source: 我是否已有足夠的力量，去面對那些令我迷茫的陰影？
target: Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness?

source: 我是折枝……是一名委托画师。还、还需要说什么吗？呃…在线求约稿，价格合理、画风不限、按需修改、从不拖欠！
target: I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!

source: 我是折枝……是一名委託畫師。 還、還需要說什麼嗎？ 呃…在線求約稿，價格合理、畫風不限、按需修改、從不拖欠！
target: I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!

source: 我是桃祈，在天工負責邊防事務，有需要可以隨時找我，回復嘛，就請等到工作時間再進行確認吧。
target: Hi there, I'm Taoqi, in charge of border defense at the Ministry of Development. If you need my help, shoot me a message any time. I'll get back to you during work hours.

source: 我是桃祈，在天工负责边防事务，有需要可以随时找我，回复嘛，就请等到工作时间再进行确认吧。
target: Hi there, I'm Taoqi, in charge of border defense at the Ministry of Development. If you need my help, shoot me a message any time. I'll get back to you during work hours.

source: 我是椿，黑海岸的執花。我們已經不是第一次見面了呢~我心愛的……命定之種。
target: Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.

source: 我是椿，黑海岸的执花。我们已经不是第一次见面了呢~我心爱的……命定之种。
target: Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.

source: 我是莫宁，深空联合研究院的工程师，星炬学院的教授。如果你有需要，我会为你留出时间。
target: I am Mornye, Research Institute engineer and professor at Startorch Academy. Please, let me know when my expertise can be of service.

source: 我是莫寧，深空聯合研究院的工程師，星炬學院的教授。如果你有需要，我會為你留出時間。
target: I am Mornye, Research Institute engineer and professor at Startorch Academy. Please, let me know when my expertise can be of service.

source: 我是贊妮，莫塔里家族的雇員。嗯？這可不是眼影哦。這是我努力的證明，是恪盡職守換來的勛章——哈，再這麼說幾次，說不定我自己就信了。
target: I am Zani. I work for the Montelli family. Hmm? Oh, that's not eyeshadow. It's proof of my hard work, a badge of honor for my dedication. Ha, if I keep saying that, I might actually start believing it myself.

source: 我是赞妮，莫塔里家族的雇员。嗯？这可不是眼影哦。这是我努力的证明，是恪尽职守换来的勋章——哈，再这么说几次，说不定我自己就信了。
target: I am Zani. I work for the Montelli family. Hmm? Oh, that's not eyeshadow. It's proof of my hard work, a badge of honor for my dedication. Ha, if I keep saying that, I might actually start believing it myself.

source: 我是長離，今州令尹參事。久仰漂泊者大名，如今終於到了相見的時候，貴客若是在今州遇到什麼不便，請務必告訴我。
target: I am Changli, Counselor to the Jinzhou Jinzhou. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Rover. We meet at last. Should you ever need any assistance in Jinzhou, please let me know.

source: 我是长离，今州令尹参事。久仰漂泊者大名，如今终于到了相见的时候，贵客若是在今州遇到什么不便，请务必告诉我。
target: I am Changli, Counselor to the Jinzhou Jinzhou. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Rover. We meet at last. Should you ever need any assistance in Jinzhou, please let me know.

source: 我是隐海修会的教士，菲比。岁主在上，愿你的旅途永远有爱与光明垂耀。
target: I'm Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.

source: 我是隱海修會的教士，菲比。歲主在上，願你的旅途永遠有愛與光明垂耀。
target: I'm Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.
Actually, I'm better at popping digital locks.
Actually, I'm better at popping digital locks.

source: 我曾經很想去月球，想著逃到那裡就能擺脫過去，離開擔驚受怕的日子過上新的生活。這份理想，最終卻以我不願看到的方式實現……
target: Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.

source: 我曾经很想去月球，想着逃到那里就能摆脱过去，离开担惊受怕的日子过上新的生活。这份理想，最终却以我不愿看到的方式实现……
target: Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.

source: 我最喜欢工作了。真的。你看我像是在开玩笑吗？对吧，一点都不好笑。
target: I love my job! Really. No joke. Was I smiling? No? Then you get the idea.

source: 我最喜歡工作了。真的。你看我像是在開玩笑嗎？對吧，一點都不好笑。
target: I love my job! Really. No joke. Was I smiling? No? Then you get the idea.

source: 我會把這些，全都珍藏在心裡。
target: I'll keep all of this in my heart forever.

source: 我會消滅，意圖毀滅的惡。
target: I destroy all that seeks destruction.

source: 我會為你斬斷一切威脅。
target: I will cut down any threat in your way.
I'll take good care of you.

source: 我會盡快熟悉這份力量……！
target: I'll learn to master this power as quickly as I can...!

source: 我會盡我所能，成為大家的慰藉。
target: I will do my best to help everyone.

source: 我有自己要行的道路……这条道路，黑暗、危险而又漫长，我不希望有任何人参与进来。我不会每时每刻都停留在你的身边，而“恶魔”……通常会索要一个人的“灵魂”作为代价……这份不公平的契约……你，也能接受吗？
target: My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the "devil" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it?

source: 我有自己要行的道路……這條道路，黑暗、危險而又漫長，我不希望有任何人參與進來。我不會每時每刻都停留在你的身邊，而「惡魔」……通常會索要一個人的「靈魂」作為代價……這份不公平的契約……你，也能接受嗎？
target: My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the "devil" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it?

source: 我毕生的愿望就是跟一个人达成共谋。把他们……送回地狱。
target: My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send them straight back to hell.

source: 我沒有特別討厭的食物。比起夜城那些昂貴的有機產品，這裡的食物無論是價格還是口感都無可挑剔，因此我沒有什麼不滿。
target: Hm, can't say there's anything I won't eat. 'Ganic foods in Night City are crazy overpriced, so by comparison this place has it beat in both taste and cost. No complaints here.

source: 我没有特别讨厌的食物。比起夜之城那些昂贵的有机产品，这里的食物无论是价格还是口感都无可挑剔，因此我没有什么不满。
target: Hm, can't say there's anything I won't eat. 'Ganic foods in Night City are crazy overpriced, so by comparison this place has it beat in both taste and cost. No complaints here.

source: 我现在感觉每个声骸都挺酷的，要我从中做出取舍真的好难啊……我说你们就不能给终端弄个什么全声骸一起上的功能吗？直接从单挑变成群殴，感觉还挺酷的！
target: I'm thinkin' all these Echoes are way too cool. Pickin' just one's killin' me! Can't you rig the Terminal to deploy all the Echoes you want at once? Turn a one-on-one into a full-on swarm. Now that'd be preem!

source: 我现在的梦想，就是希望我学生的梦想都能实现。
target: My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true.

source: 我现在的状态比连休七天还要好，多谢你的支援。
target: I feel so good right now, I'd say even better than when I just took a seven-day leave. Thank you for your help, Rover.

source: 我現在感覺每個聲骸都挺酷的，要我從中做出取捨真的好難啊……我說你們就不能給終端弄個什麼全聲骸一起上的功能嗎？直接從單挑變成群毆，感覺還挺酷的！
target: I'm thinkin' all these Echoes are way too cool. Pickin' just one's killin' me! Can't you rig the Terminal to deploy all the Echoes you want at once? Turn a one-on-one into a full-on swarm. Now that'd be preem!

source: 我現在的夢想，就是希望我學生的夢想都能實現。
target: My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true.

source: 我現在的狀態比連休七天還要好，多謝你的支援。
target: I feel so good right now, I'd say even better than when I just took a seven-day leave. Thank you for your help, Rover.

source: 我畢生的願望就是跟一個人達成共謀。把他們……送回地獄。
target: My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send them straight back to hell.

source: 我發現，和你合作總是很愉快，嗯……那種並非交際的愉快。所以說，不論是談生意還是增進感情，是你的話，我都非常歡迎。
target: I've come to find a genuine pleasure working with you—truly, I do not say this out of formality. Whether it's business or not, I truly cherish every moment we share.
My swordsmanship has reached new heights!
My swordsmanship has reached new heights!

source: 我的盾牌可沒那麼脆弱。
target: My shield can withstand more than that.

source: 我的盾牌可没那么脆弱。
target: My shield can withstand more than that.

source: 我的表情看起來太興奮了？……但這是事實，現在的我，就是這麼想繼續和你比試下去……
target: Do I look overexcited? Because in truth, I am. All I want is to keep sparring with you.

source: 我的表情看起来太兴奋了？……但这是事实，现在的我，就是这么想继续和你比试下去……
target: Do I look overexcited? Because in truth, I am. All I want is to keep sparring with you.

source: 我的过去？哎……你若是真的想听，倒也无妨，只是要是说起来的话，还得一炉好酒才行。
target: Curious about my past? Heh... if that's what you want, I've no intention to hide. But maybe we should talk over a good pot of wine.

source: 我的過去？哎……你若是真的想聽，倒也無妨，只是要是說起來的話，還得一爐好酒才行。
target: Curious about my past? Heh... if that's what you want, I've no intention to hide. But maybe we should talk over a good pot of wine.

source: 我看到了……光輝下埋藏著的陰影。若曾經深信不疑的，其實並非正確的道路，那麼……不，沒什麼，請不要在意……
target: I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me...

source: 我看到了……光辉下埋藏着的阴影。若曾经深信不疑的，其实并非正确的道路，那么……不，没什么，请不要在意……
target: I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me...

source: 我看見超脫限度的冷焰，看見傾覆之後的完滿，我看到混沌、看到虛妄、看到現實，看到……你，捕獲了月亮。
target: I see cold flames beyond the edge of reason. I see perfection rising from the shattered end. I see Chaos. I see illusions. I see truths. I see... you, the one who captured the moon.

source: 我看见超脱限度的冷焰，看见倾覆之后的完满，我看到混沌、看到虚妄、看到现实，看到……你，捕获了月亮。
target: I see cold flames beyond the edge of reason. I see perfection rising from the shattered end. I see Chaos. I see illusions. I see truths. I see... you, the one who captured the moon.

source: 我真的很喜欢飞行雪绒的歌！但她上次突然开歌友会的时候，我正在冰原考察……要、要是还有机会的话，我一定要去她的歌友会看看！
target: I really, really love Fleet Snowfluff's songs! But the last time she held a fan meeting, I was out on a frostlands field study... I-I hope I'll get another chance to attend! I would love to see her!

source: 我真的很喜歡飛行雪絨的歌！但她上次突然開歌友會的時候，我正在冰原考察……要、要是還有機會的話，我一定要去她的歌友會看看！
target: I really, really love Fleet Snowfluff's songs! But the last time she held a fan meeting, I was out on a frostlands field study... I-I hope I'll get another chance to attend! I would love to see her!

source: 我睡着了？呼啊~因为有你在旁边，总感觉比平时更让人安心。你也不要那么拼命了，再熬夜下去可能会有脱发之类的小烦恼哦。
target: Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss.

source: 我睡著了？呼啊~因為有你在旁邊，總感覺比平時更讓人安心。你也不要那麼拼命了，再熬夜下去可能會有脫髮之類的小煩惱哦。
target: Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss.

source: 我給你，一個望月之人的悲哀
target: I Offer You the Bitterness of a Moongazer

source: 我给你，一个望月之人的悲哀
target: I Offer You the Bitterness of a Moongazer

source: 我能感受到，自身未來的道路仍在不斷延伸，那些寄與我身的祈求，或許真能……
target: The path I walk stretches into the future. The wishes laid upon me… perhaps one day, I can finally make them...

source: 我能感受到，自身未来的道路仍在不断延伸，那些寄与我身的祈求，或许真能……
target: The path I walk stretches into the future. The wishes laid upon me… perhaps one day, I can finally make them...

source: 我能隐隐约约感觉到，你和我一样，都有想要守护的东西……是那种，一步都不能退让，用尽一切办法都要守护的东西。
target: I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes.

source: 我能隱隱約約感覺到，你和我一樣，都有想要守護的東西……是那種，一步都不能退讓，用盡一切辦法都要守護的東西。
target: I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes.

source: 我虽与桃祈对宽松式管理有不同的看法，但今州的驻防工事由她负责，我在前线便无后顾之忧。
target: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

source: 我要的並非一方富庶。我要的是物暢其流，人暢其所，我要此地燈火長明，歲歲不熄。
target: I want wealth that knows no border. I want goods to find their way, people to find their place. I want the warm light of every home burning, always burning, forever.

source: 我要的并非一方富庶。我要的是物畅其流，人畅其所，我要此地灯火长明，岁岁不熄。
target: I want wealth that knows no border. I want goods to find their way, people to find their place. I want the warm light of every home burning, always burning, forever.

source: 我討厭吃生的東西！特別是那種擺好盤的切片肉類。
target: I hate eating anything raw! Especially that fancy sliced meat on a platter.

source: 我記得是這一條？……真好啊。
target: I believe it's this one? ...How nice.

source: 我試圖，用困惑、危險、失敗來打動你
target: With Uncertainty, With Danger, With Defeat

source: 我讀到更多……原來一直糾結的，是這麼一回事。
target: I can see more now... So that's what was troubling me all along.
I'm faster in my mech, you know?

source: 我讨厌吃生的东西！特别是那种摆好盘的切片肉类。
target: I hate eating anything raw! Especially that fancy sliced meat on a platter.

source: 我记得是这一条？……真好啊。
target: I believe it's this one? ...How nice.

source: 我试图，用困惑、危险、失败来打动你
target: With Uncertainty, With Danger, With Defeat

source: 我读到更多……原来一直纠结的，是这么一回事。
target: I can see more now... So that's what was troubling me all along.
And that was me holding back.

source: 我还需要更多的时间去了解、熟悉这陌生的世界。
target: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.
And that was me holding back.

source: 我還需要更多的時間去了解、熟悉這陌生的世界。
target: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.

source: 我雖與桃祈對寬鬆式管理有不同的看法，但今州的駐防工事由她負責，我在前線便無後顧之憂。
target: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

source: 我頭上的這個？是我們嗚嗚物流的工卡。有時候手上拿著太多東西，不方便從包裡掏出來，乾脆就夾在頭髮上啦。同事一見，立刻就能叫出我的名字，多好！
target: This on my head? It's my employee ID badge. Clipped it to my hair to save myself the fumbling when I'm carrying stuff. Now everyone knows my name in a snap. Perfect!

source: 战士，应有尊严地迎接死。

target: The battlefield is dynamic. Do not let your guard down.

source: 战斗…我一直不太擅长……不过，我已经明白了你对我的期待，现在的我，无论面对什么样的敌人，都不会轻易打退堂鼓了！
target: Fighting… has never been my strong suit. But, I understand what you're asking of me. I won't give up easily, no matter who or what I'm up against!

source:
戦いに夢中になり過ぎると、手加減ができなくなります……
あなたは、怖がったりしませんよね？
target: Sometimes I get a little carried away in battles... I didn't startle you, did I?

source: 戦いは苦手なんですよ……見てるだけでもいいですかぁ？
target: I'm not much of a fighter... Can I just slack off?

source: 戦いを経ることで、剣は研ぎ澄まされていく。
target: The blade most worn is often the sharpest.

source: 戦利品としては、悪くない。
戦士として、尊厳ある死を……
戦況は常に変化している、油断は禁物だ。
target: The battlefield is dynamic. Do not let your guard down.

source: 戦闘は……昔から苦手で……でも、あなたが期待してくれるなら、私はどんな敵からも逃げません！
target: Fighting… has never been my strong suit. But, I understand what you're asking of me. I won't give up easily, no matter who or what I'm up against!

source: 戰士，應有尊嚴地迎接死。

target: The battlefield is dynamic. Do not let your guard down.

source: 戰鬥…我一直不太擅長……不過，我已經明白了你對我的期待，現在的我，無論面對什麼樣的敵人，都不會輕易打退堂鼓了！
target: Fighting… has never been my strong suit. But, I understand what you're asking of me. I won't give up easily, no matter who or what I'm up against!

source: 戴着镣铐，依然能从心而舞——一个无比标准的莫塔里，却又不仅仅是「莫塔里」。她的选择会将「家族」引向何方？呵呵，不免有些期待，今后的她又会以何种姿态……站在我的面前呢？
target: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true Montelli, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.

source: 戴著鐐銬，依然能從心而舞——一個無比標準的莫塔里，卻又不僅僅是「莫塔里」。她的選擇會將「家族」引向何方？呵呵，不免有些期待，今後的她又會以何種姿態……站在我的面前呢？
target: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true Montelli, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.
We desire, and so we find.

source: 手工、剪裁，還有一些……計算。嗯，其實我還稱得上擅長這些。
target: Handcrafting, tailoring, plus... mathematics. Yes, I'd say I'm quite good at these.

source: 手工，剪裁，还有一些……计算。嗯，其实我还称得上擅长这些。
target: Handcrafting, tailoring, plus... mathematics. Yes, I'd say I'm quite good at these.

source: 手短に決着をつけよう。
手芸と裁縫、それと……計算ですかね。得意と言えるほどのものは、これだけです。
target: Handcrafting, tailoring, plus... mathematics. Yes, I'd say I'm quite good at these.

source: 手足に枷を嵌められても、ダンスを踊り続ける――そんな、いかにもモンテリらしい人ね。けど、ただのモンテリで終わるとは思えない。彼女の選択は、ファミリーをどんな方向に導いていくのかしら……ふふっ、成長してわたくしの前に現れる日が、今から楽しみだわ。
target: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true Montelli, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.

source: 打たれ強いじゃねぇか……
打游戏啊，黑海岸里有好多游戏卡带呢。有时间的话，我们联机？
target: Playing games, of course! So many cool ones in the Black Shores. Want to co-op sometime?

source: 打電動啊，黑海岸裡有好多遊戲卡帶呢。有時間的話，我們連線？
target: Playing games, of course! So many cool ones in the Black Shores. Want to co-op sometime?

source: 扼守不入，万象之外……可脱身出世未必是好事。这不是卜算的结果。我算不到她，但看得到啊。
target: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

source: 扼守不入，萬象之外……可脫身出世未必是好事。這不是卜算的結果。我算不到她，但看得到啊。
target: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

source: 把我从实验室里叫出来……可别让我太扫兴了。
target: Dragging me out of my lab for this...*Yawn* You better have a good reason.

source: 把我從實驗室裡叫出來……可別讓我太掃興了。
target: Dragging me out of my lab for this...*Yawn* You better have a good reason.

source: 把最危险的地方留给我。
把最危險的地方留給我。
折枝さんとはあんまり直接会ったことないんだよね。何でも、夜型人間だから、いつも夜に働いて昼に寝るような生活をしてるんだって。そのせいか、折枝さんに配達する絵の具とか紙は、いつも置き配指定になってるね。

source: 星炬學院校長，洛瑟菈。今天，你又會帶給我什麼驚喜呢？
target: Lucilla, President of Startorch Academy. What surprises do you have in store for me today?
Starlight over the seas. Scorch through the Void!
Starlight over the seas. Scorch through the Void!

source: 是今巡尉，我可得躲着点……诶别误会啊我可没干过坏事，遇到来路不正的藏品，略施小计让人归还什么的，不算坑蒙拐骗吧！不算……吧？
target: A Jinzhou Patroller... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?

source: 是今巡尉，我可得躲著點……欸別誤會啊我可沒做過壞事，遇到來路不正的藏品，略施小計讓人歸還什麼的，不算坑蒙拐騙吧！不算……吧？
target: A Jinzhou Patroller... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?
You chooms like this stuff, huh?
Does anything here catch your interest?
Does anything here catch your interest?
You chooms like this stuff, huh?
Just like the treasure chests from the stories!
Just like the treasure chests from the stories!

source: 是要一起玩探险游戏了吗！
是要一起玩探險遊戲了嗎！
是那位充满活力与热情的巡尉吧？她一直在默默守护今州孩子们的梦想。
target: That energetic and passionate Patroller? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in Jinzhou.

source: 是那位充滿活力與熱情的巡尉吧？她一直在默默守護今州孩子們的夢想。
target: That energetic and passionate Patroller? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in Jinzhou.

source: 時には捨て石も必要よ。
時間が足りないことかな。配達、新ルートの開拓、友達とのお喋り、手帳への書き込み……わたしがもう何人か必要だ……
target: There's never enough time! Delivering packages, planning new routes, catching up with friends, keeping my journal... Oh I wish I could be in a million places at once！

source: 時間總是不夠用，愁死人哦。要送貨，要探新路線，要和朋友聊天，要寫手帳……要是燈燈我能分裂成好多好多個就好了——
target: There's never enough time! Delivering packages, planning new routes, catching up with friends, keeping my journal... Oh I wish I could be in a million places at once！

source: 晴れた午後、日溜まりの中で寝るとすごくいい気分になる。暖かい日差しと柔らかい葉っぱに包まれて、まどろむ感じが好き……
target: Napping in the sun on a warm afternoon is so cozy, I just need to find a quiet place. Sleeping in the warmth, nestled among branches and leaves...

source: 晶体似乎更亮了一些。我感觉得到，与你无异的温度，正顺着你的掌心传到我的胸口。
target: My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest.

source: 晶體似乎更亮了一些。我感覺得到，與你無異的溫度，正順著你的掌心傳到我的胸口。
target: My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest.

source:
暇でしたら、一緒に出掛けませんか？目的もなくふらふらと歩いてみれば、
世界の見方も変わるかもしれません。ね、どうですか？
target: When you have the time, how about we take a walk together? The world is going to look very different when you don't have a particular destination in mind. Want to give it a try?

source: 更なる力……俺たちはどんな波風にも動じない！全速力で進むぞ！
target: More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead!

source: 更多东西被纳入可重塑的范畴，你的付出，很有成效。
target: Now, my Forte can reshape even more. Your labour has truly borne fruit.

source: 更多東西被納入可重塑的範疇，你的付出，很有成效。
target: Now, my Forte can reshape even more. Your labour has truly borne fruit.

source: 更多的力量……我们将无惧风浪！走，我们开足马力！
target: More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead!

source: 更多的力量……我們將無懼風浪！走，我們加足馬力！
target: More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead!

source: 最も危険な場所は、某が引き受ける。
最初のショアキーパー
最後のショアキーパー
最後のステップ、決意は固く
最後まで……守れなかった……
最近学院里的新梗越来越搞不懂了……
target: I swear, the new jokes and memes around campus are evolving faster than I can keep up...

source: 最近學院裡的新梗越來越搞不懂了……
target: I swear, the new jokes and memes around campus are evolving faster than I can keep up...

source: 會有龍鬚那——麼長的龍鬚酥嗎？好想嚐嚐看啊。
target: Will there ever be Loong Whiskers Crisps that are as loooong as a real loong's whiskers? Aww, I really want to give them a try!

source: 月を眺める人の悲しみをあげたい
target: I Offer You the Bitterness of a Moongazer

source: 月光を受けたこの玉は、全ての悪を照らし出す。
target: May the moonlight attest my steadfast will.

source: 有了你的帮助……我就更不能松懈了！一定要更加勤奋练习才行。
target: No more slacking off now that you're here to help! I should practice harder.

source: 有了你的幫助……我就更不能鬆懈了！一定要更加勤奮練習才行。
target: No more slacking off now that you're here to help! I should practice harder.

source: 有了这些，我们就能收获一个华丽的开场！来吧，把风帆拉紧！
target: With this, the stage is set for a grand opening. Come on, trim the sails!

source: 有了這些，我們就能收獲一個華麗的開場！來吧，把風帆拉緊！
target: With this, the stage is set for a grand opening. Come on, trim the sails!

source: 有人回帖了？嗯？什么？不相信我的话！唉，真固执……
target: Someone commented on my post? Hmm? What?! Don't believe me? Ah, so stubborn...

source: 有人回帖了？嗯？什麼？不相信我的話？！唉，真固執……
target: Someone commented on my post? Hmm? What?! Don't believe me? Ah, so stubborn...

source: 有人說，故事的傳唱者最終也會成為故事的一部分。
