target: Some say, the storyteller will end up being part of the story as well.

source: 有人说，故事的传唱者最终也会成为故事的一部分。
target: Some say, the storyteller will end up being part of the story as well.

source: 有什么想祈福的吗，我可以为你代劳……嗯，你的心愿会实现的。
target: May I pray for anything specific for you? It would be my honor… I'm sure your wishes will come true.

source: 有什么能用的可以收起来，以备不时之需。
有什麼想祈福的嗎，我可以為你代勞……嗯，你的心願會實現的。
target: May I pray for anything specific for you? It would be my honor… I'm sure your wishes will come true.

source: 有什麼能用的可以收起來，以備不時之需。
有你在身旁，我便可尽情挥剑……就算绯色暂时遮蔽了我的视线，你也会帮我拂拭干净的吧？
target: With you by my side, I can fight without worry... Even if the crimson haze momentarily clouds my sight, you'll be there to help me break free from it, right?

source: 有你在身旁，我便可盡情揮劍……就算緋色暫時遮蔽了我的視線，你也會幫我拂拭乾淨的吧？
target: With you by my side, I can fight without worry... Even if the crimson haze momentarily clouds my sight, you'll be there to help me break free from it, right?
Now, what do we have here? Ya can't hide from me!
Now, what do we have here? Ya can't hide from me!

source: 有很多人費盡心思讓自己鑽進一個會讓他人滿意的殼子裡，而她不是。無論她之前是個怎樣的人，有什麼有意思的身分，現在的她只在扮演自己。
target: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.

source: 有很多人费尽心思让自己钻进一个会让他人满意的壳子里，而她不是。无论她之前是个怎样的人，有什么有意思的身份，现在的她只在扮演自己。
target: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.
Anything you need me to deal with?
Anything you need me to deal with?

source: 有时太过投入，下手失了轻重……没吓着你吧？
target: Sometimes I get a little carried away in battles... I didn't startle you, did I?

source: 有時太過投入，下手失了輕重……沒嚇著你吧？
target: Sometimes I get a little carried away in battles... I didn't startle you, did I?

source: 有最初的流浪騎士走向自由處
target: The Wandering Knight Marches To Freedom

source: 有最初的流浪骑士走向自由处
target: The Wandering Knight Marches To Freedom

source: 有的人善于倾听，有的人善于开解，秧秧则两者兼备。和她相处，你用不着拘谨，只需要做你自己就好。
target: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.

source: 有的人善於傾聽，有的人善於開解，秧秧則兩者兼備。和她相處，你用不著拘謹，只需要做你自己就好。
target: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.
Can't we just talk this out?
Can't we just talk this out?

source: 有酒味的东西。为什么？……不知道，总觉得那味道让人……不舒服。
target: I don't like boozy stuff. Why? ...I don't know. It just makes me... uncomfortable.

source: 有酒味的東西。為什麼？……不知道，總覺得那味道讓人……不舒服。
target: I don't like boozy stuff. Why? ...I don't know. It just makes me... uncomfortable.

source: 有需求的話，隨時可以來找我，沒有需求……也可以。只是單純的聽聽音樂，吃些甜點……如果是和你一起的話，感覺也不錯。
target: Come find me when you need something made. Come find me... when you don't, too. Just idling by together, listening to music and indulging in some sweets... I'll be looking forward to that, if you're here with me.

source: 有需求的话，随时可以来找我，没有需求……也可以。只是单纯的听听音乐，吃些甜点……如果是和你一起的话，感觉也不错。
target: Come find me when you need something made. Come find me... when you don't, too. Just idling by together, listening to music and indulging in some sweets... I'll be looking forward to that, if you're here with me.

source: 服が汚れるところだったじゃない……
朝日に煌めく霜の如く！
期待惊喜吗？像小孩子一样。
target: Excited for what's inside? Hehe, aren't you adorable.

source: 期待驚喜嗎？像小孩子一樣。
target: Excited for what's inside? Hehe, aren't you adorable.

source: 未来に通ずる道を作れないなら、山河を心の賭け金にするわ。
target: If this isn't enough to pave the way, then let the rivers and mountains be the proof of what I'm willing to wager.
Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.
Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.

source: 本に記されていないこと
本大师交朋友从来不在乎对方懂不懂鉴宝，反正很难比我厉害啦，哼哼~只要能对古物心存敬畏就好。
target: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.

source: 本大师心情不错，陪你走一趟吧~
target: Alright, I'll humor you for a bit, since I'm feeling good today!
Luck is on MY side! Hehe... Waaahhh!

source: 本大師交朋友從來不在乎對方懂不懂鑑寶，反正很難比我厲害啦，哼哼~只要能對古物心存敬畏就好。
target: Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.

source: 本大師心情不錯，陪你走一趟吧~
target: Alright, I'll humor you for a bit, since I'm feeling good today!
Luck is on MY side! Hehe... Waaahhh!

source: 本当に大丈夫なの？私のワガママを許し続けてるせいで、このままじゃ……あなたも一緒に混沌より恐ろしい未知の場所に落ちるかもしれないわよ！
target: Are you sure about this? Indulging my willfulness? Just so you know, if we keep this up, we might... fall into an unknown future scarier than Chaos!
Time to bring out my A-game.

source: 朽叶千咲，星炬工学学部，战术开发学科群，共鸣能力偏向结构解析……抱歉，好像还不是这么正式的氛围。
target: Kuchiba Chisa. Tactical Development Program, Department of Engineering, Startorch Academy. Forte Specialization: structural dissection... Apologies, this might not be the time for formalities.

source: 朽葉千咲、スタートーチ学園工学部、戦術開発学科群所属です。共鳴能力は、構造の解析が得意で……すみません、少し堅苦しかったみたいですね。
target: Kuchiba Chisa. Tactical Development Program, Department of Engineering, Startorch Academy. Forte Specialization: structural dissection... Apologies, this might not be the time for formalities.

source: 朽葉千咲，星炬工學學部，戰術開發學科群，共鳴能力偏向結構解析……抱歉，好像還不是這麼正式的氛圍。
target: Kuchiba Chisa. Tactical Development Program, Department of Engineering, Startorch Academy. Forte Specialization: structural dissection... Apologies, this might not be the time for formalities.

source: 村ではよく「太陽ちゃん」って呼ばれてたけど、やっぱり「灯灯」の方いいな。太陽はいつか山の向こうに沈んじゃうけど、「灯り」なら夜だって照らせるからね！
target: They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!

source: 村裡人總叫我小太陽，但我覺得當燈燈就很好。太陽總會落山，但夜晚想點一盞燈時，隨時都可以！
target: They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!

source: 村里人总叫我小太阳，但我觉得当灯灯就很好。太阳总会落山，但夜晚想点一盏灯时，随时都可以！
target: They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!

source: 来たるべき時に備えよう。

target: Come now. I could use another dancer.

source:
来吧！
群星皎映明日。
target:
Come on!
Stars, light up tomorrow.

source: 来吧，前方就是迫近的风暴！
来吧，让我们一起，完成这场万众期待的演奏。
target: Come, let us finish this performance we've all been waiting for. Together.

source: 来感受一下我的剑法吧？虽然脱胎于你的教导，但我后来又进行了不少个性化改良，现在正是验证方向的好时候。
target: You taught me well, but I've added a few creative twists to your technique. Now's the perfect time to test it out!
Well, well. What do we have here?
Smile for the camera... Three, two, one...

source: 果壳中，我们测算着宇宙。你的新猜想，也让我听听看吧。
target: As truthseekers, we gauge the universe from within a nutshell. I'd love to hear your insights.

source: 果断而有力的第四乐章降下酣畅淋漓的战斗颂歌，在激流的承托下，在广阔无垠的土地上，永远奔腾向前，荡涤一切。
target: The decisive and powerful fourth movement brings forth a rousing battle hymn. Carried by the rapids, it surges across an endless land, sweeping all before it.

source: 果斷而有力的第四樂章降下酣暢淋漓的戰鬥頌歌，在激流的承托下，在廣闊無垠的土地上，永遠奔騰向前，蕩滌一切。
target: The decisive and powerful fourth movement brings forth a rousing battle hymn. Carried by the rapids, it surges across an endless land, sweeping all before it.

source: 果殼中，我們測算著宇宙。 你的新猜想，也讓我聽聽看吧。
target: As truthseekers, we gauge the universe from within a nutshell. I'd love to hear your insights.

source: 果汁~飽滿果實生榨出的新鮮汁液，嚐起來清潤柔和，會在舌尖留下一絲淡淡的回甘……你也想嚐嚐看嗎？
target: Fruit juice. Fresh, raw, and tangy. That gentle sweetness lingers... You want some?

source: 果汁~饱满果实生榨出的新鲜汁液，尝起来清润柔和，会在舌尖留下一丝淡淡的回甘……你也想尝尝看吗？
target: Fruit juice. Fresh, raw, and tangy. That gentle sweetness lingers... You want some?

source: 果然人的潛能和能量補充膠一樣，看似已經空了，但擠一擠總還是有的……
target: I guess someone's potential is like an Energy Gel Sachet. You think it's empty, but there's always a little more if you squeeze harder...

source: 果然人的潜能和能量补充胶一样，看似已经空了，但挤一挤总还是有的……
target: I guess someone's potential is like an Energy Gel Sachet. You think it's empty, but there's always a little more if you squeeze harder...

source: 果然少不了安可呢！出发！
target: Knew it! You can't do without Encore! Off we go!

source: 果然少不了安可呢！出發！
target: Knew it! You can't do without Encore! Off we go!

source: 果然，还是不能没有我吧？
target: Oh. What will you do without me?

source: 果然，還是不能沒有我吧？
target: Oh. What will you do without me?

source: 枯れてもなお、咲き乱れるわ。
某の過去が気になるのか？ふっ……話すのは構わぬが、語り尽くすには一晩を明かせるくらい良い酒が要るぞ。
target: Curious about my past? Heh... if that's what you want, I've no intention to hide. But maybe we should talk over a good pot of wine.

source: 栄光をセブン・ヒルズに。

桁外れの存在、生ける「到達点」
……ふふっ。承知のうえでお互いに利用するほうが、むしろ安心できる……そうでしょう？
target: A singular existence. A living purpose. A point of reference... Heh, given all this, isn't it comforting to openly acknowledge that he and I are both using each other for our own ends?

source: 桃祈の緩い管理について俺は是非を問うつもりはないが、今州の辺境防衛を彼女に任せたことで、俺は前線に専念できるようになった。
target: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

source: 桃祈呀，她总是一边打着哈欠，一边飞速处理完一大堆工作……那种效率，连我都自叹不如。
target: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

source: 桃祈呀，她總是一邊打著哈欠，一邊飛速處理完一大堆工作……那種效率，連我都自歎不如。
target: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

source: 案ずるな、気を練り直すまでだ。
target: Worry not... Just need a moment.

source: 梦州方士卜灵不仅卜卦灵，驱鬼祈福，测字解签，法宝符箓……样样都灵！
target: Mengzhou Taoist Buling here. Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it!

source: 梦想？呃……让大家都过上体面的生活？具体我也说不上来，现在我忙着在想接下来整什么大活呢！
target: A dream? I guess... just makin' sure everyone gets to live a decent life? I dunno, choom. Too busy thinkin' about the next stunt we're gonna pull!

source: 棚からなんとか……ああ、悪くない！
target: Well, would you look at that! Easy money.

source: 植物だって、生きてるんです！
検算しなくては……すみません、すぐに行きます。
target: Calculation results... Sorry, I'm on my way.

source: 楽しそうな場所に行こうか！
構わないわ、どうせ同じよ。
構造が……はっきりと見えました。
構造は複雑になりましたが、前よりもはっきりと見えています。
target: The structure is more complex, but also... more distinctly identifiable.

source: 機体がパワーアップしたわ～

target: Who will be sitting on the other side of the board this time?

source: 欢迎来到今州，远道而来的贵客。事务繁忙，招待不周之处还请见谅。若有什么要紧事，可以直接来边庭找我。
target: Welcome to Jinzhou, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall.

source: 欧泊的色泽越发耀眼……原来，比起已成型的珠宝，你更享受亲手打磨的过程。
target: The opal shines even more brightly… It seems you find greater pleasure in the crafting process itself than in the finished gems.

source: 欲を無くせば、心は自然と静まる。心が静まれば、人は自然と悟りを開く。
target: Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.

source: 欸、欸！羊咩快讓讓，讓安可看看，哎呀！嗨嗨，黑海岸安可，前來報到囉！
target: Woah! Hey! Woolies, make some room! I wanna look, see? ...Black Shores member, Encore, reporting in!

source: 欸，都是給我的嗎？你很有眼光嘛！
target: Geez, you're actually giving me all of these? Good call!

source: 歌声は、心の奥から放つ共鳴です。無垢で偽りのない気持ちを伝えてくれます。
target: Songs are resonating thoughts from the bottom of our hearts. They represent a person's truest feelings.

source: 歌声，是从心底迸发出的共鸣，它会传递最真挚的心情。
target: Songs are resonating thoughts from the bottom of our hearts. They represent a person's truest feelings.

source: 歌聲，是從心底迸發出的共鳴，它會傳遞最真摯的心情。
target: Songs are resonating thoughts from the bottom of our hearts. They represent a person's truest feelings.

source: 歐泊的色澤越發耀眼……原來，比起已成型的珠寶，你更享受親手打磨的過程。
target: The opal shines even more brightly… It seems you find greater pleasure in the crafting process itself than in the finished gems.

source: 歡迎來到今州，遠道而來的貴客。事務繁忙，招待不周之處還請見諒。若有什麼要緊事，可以直接來邊庭找我。
target: Welcome to Jinzhou, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall.

source: 正义伙伴炽霞，回应呼唤前来！
target: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?

source: 正好今天有时间，一起去海滩散散步吧。吹吹海风，看看日落……怎么样？相信会有些新灵感！
target: I've got some time today. What would you say to a nice stroll on the beach? Maybe the sea breeze and ocean sunset will inspire you!

source: 正好今天有時間，一起去海灘散散步吧。吹吹海風，看看日落……怎麼樣？相信會有些新靈感！
target: I've got some time today. What would you say to a nice stroll on the beach? Maybe the sea breeze and ocean sunset will inspire you!

source: 正如岁主所说，你我会在此相遇。
target: As the Sentinel foretold, you and I were meant to cross paths.

source: 正如歲主所說，你我會在此相遇。
target: As the Sentinel foretold, you and I were meant to cross paths.

source: 正義の味方、熾霞！ここに参上！
target: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?

source: 正義夥伴熾霞，回應呼喚前來！
target: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?
A life as fleeting as the first snow.
A life as fleeting as the first snow.

source: 此为奇招，你的眼光果然独到，为我提供了新的视野。
target: Remarkable strategy. Your insight provides me with unique and refreshing perspectives that I have not considered before.
Your wish for wealth is granted.
My lamp guides no living souls.

source: 此為奇招，你的眼光果然獨到，為我提供了新的視野。
target: Remarkable strategy. Your insight provides me with unique and refreshing perspectives that I have not considered before.
Your wish for wealth is granted.
My lamp guides no living souls.

source: 此間當下，便是最好的時光了。
target: The moment at hand... This very moment is the best of our lives.

source: 此间当下，便是最好的时光了。
target: The moment at hand... This very moment is the best of our lives.

source: 歲主在上，請允許我代為平息這場紛爭。
target: I resolve disputes in the Sentinel's name.

source: 歳主に頼るということは、決して軟弱な行いではありません。暗中を迷っていれば、人知の及ばぬものに頼りたがる、というのも至極当然のこと。だから、余はその暗がりを照らし、人類を未来へと導きたいのです。
target: People prayed to the Sentinel not out of weakness, but because they had no other recourse. As leader, I will guide my people towards a future where humanity takes control of our own destiny.

source: 歳主よ、どうかお許しを……この争いは、私が止めます。
target: I resolve disputes in the Sentinel's name.

source: 死の弦が鳴いていますね。

target: Let slip the dogs of war!

source: 残星組織と「あの存在」について
残星組織の組織長について
残業代として受け取っておこう。
target: I'll take it as my overtime fee.
Let slip the dogs of war!
Let slip the dogs of war!

source: 殻がある食べ物かな？だって剥くの面倒だし……。
target: Hmm... food that requires peeling, I guess. Why? It's too much hassle.

source: 毎日ちゃんと眠って、美味しいものを食べて……それから、友達と一緒に過ごすことくらいですね。
target: Good sleep, good food, and... good friends together. Every single day.
Here's to a safe journey ahead.
Here's to a safe journey ahead.

source: 每到冬日，尾巴总是容易起静电……打理起来可麻烦啦……
target: Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...

source: 每到冬日，尾巴總是容易起靜電……打理起來可麻煩啦……
target: Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...

source: 每天都能睡个好觉，吃到美味的东西，还有就是……和朋友们在一起。
target: Good sleep, good food, and... good friends together. Every single day.

source: 每天都能睡個好覺，吃到美味的東西，還有就是……和朋友們在一起。
target: Good sleep, good food, and... good friends together. Every single day.

source: 每次看到剧团里醉倒的家伙留下一片狼藉，洛可可就想把剩下几箱没开封的剧团烈度全部倒进海里。
target: Every time I see the mess those drunkards leave behind... Ugh, I just want to dump all the booze into the ocean.

source: 每次看到劇團裡醉倒的傢伙留下一片狼藉，洛可可就想把剩下幾箱沒開封的劇團烈度全部倒進海裡。
target: Every time I see the mess those drunkards leave behind... Ugh, I just want to dump all the booze into the ocean.

source: 每次看到熟悉的雷光一閃，我就知道，這次清剿行動會輕鬆不少。說來慚愧，至少見過十次這種雷光後，才獲悉吟霖的大名。
target:
The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze.
Though, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so.

source: 每次看到熟悉的雷光一闪，我就知道，这次清剿行动会轻松不少。说来惭愧，至少见过十次这种雷光后，才获悉吟霖的大名。
target:
The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze.
Though, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so.

source: 毒よ、深淵を飲み込みなさい。
毒薬に浸かって、嫌になるほど甘くなったリンゴね。いくらキャラメルと一緒に食べても、あの腐った匂いはどうにもならないのよ。
target: Apples soaked in poison for too long. They become sickeningly sweet. Even the glossy sugar shell cannot mask the scent of decay beneath.

source: 民のために掲げる灯火
气势确有提升，想来你对练兵之道也颇有研究？
target: I can sense an improvement in my strength. I suppose you are well-versed in the art of training, too?

source: 気に入ったの？足りなければ、私のところにもあるわ。
target: Like it? I've got plenty more of that.

source: 気に入った物でもあったか？
target: Found what you're looking for? Good.

source: 気をつけてください、感じます……アレフ1は、完全に消えたわけではありません。
target: Be careful. I can feel it, Aleph-1... It never really left.

source: 気分転換にいいかもね。
target: Yeah, could use a little unwind.

source: 気韻生動（きいんせいどう）。
氣勢確有提升，想來你對練兵之道也頗有研究？
target: I can sense an improvement in my strength. I suppose you are well-versed in the art of training, too?

source: 水と雲、清く瑠璃の如く。
target: Mirrored by water, tinted in blue.

source: 水声……我听见了。不只是溪流抑或雨落，而是更深的……从万物深处里渗出的共鸣，唤醒山涧，唤醒江河。
target: The sound of water... I hear it. Not from the streams, or the falling rain, but from somewhere far deeper. A resonance that seeps from the core of every living thing, waking the hills, waking the waters, one by one.

source: 水聲……我聽見了。不只是溪流抑或雨落，而是更深的……從萬物深處裡滲出的共鳴，喚醒山澗，喚醒江河。
target: The sound of water... I hear it. Not from the streams, or the falling rain, but from somewhere far deeper. A resonance that seeps from the core of every living thing, waking the hills, waking the waters, one by one.

source: 永不坠落的月亮，为颠覆终局而来。
target: I am the moon that never falls, here to rewrite the ending.

source: 永不墜落的月亮，為顛覆終局而來。
target: I am the moon that never falls, here to rewrite the ending.

source: 決して、終幕にはさせない……
target: This is far from the finale…

source: 決して別れではありません……
決闘をしたいのですね？
target: If it's a duel you want...
Make sure no one sees it.

source: 沒想到對力量的控制還能有所精進，既承了你如此重的師恩，我也應該報答你才是，所以……你有什麼願望？
target: I never thought I could further refine my abilities. Your guidance has been invaluable, and I ought to help you in some way in return. So… Anything I can do for you?
Couldn't live up to... those expectations...

source: 沒有什麼天生如此。身為今令尹，必須不斷精進自己。
target: No one is born good at anything. As the Magistrate of Jinzhou, I must constantly learn and improve.

source: 沒有加太多「調料」的食物。我幾乎已經快忘記食物本來的味道了。
target: Food, stripped of extravagant "seasonings." I can scarcely recall the natural taste of most foods.

source: 沒有特別討厭吃的，百無禁忌！不過，我現在已經不需要吃東西了，哈哈。
target: Nope. As long as it's food, me likey. Though… I don't really need to eat anymore, haha.
Don't worry. Leave it to me.

source: 沒關係，讓風浪再高一點！
沙德威斯坦開啟的故事

target: Make sure no one sees it.
Don't worry. Leave it to me.

source: 没关系，让风浪再高一点！
没想到对力量的控制还能有所精进，既承了你如此重的师恩，我也应该报答你才是，所以……你有什么愿望？
target: I never thought I could further refine my abilities. Your guidance has been invaluable, and I ought to help you in some way in return. So… Anything I can do for you?
Couldn't live up to... those expectations...

source: 没有什么天生如此。身为今令尹，必须不断精进自己。
target: No one is born good at anything. As the Magistrate of Jinzhou, I must constantly learn and improve.

source: 没有加太多“调料”的食物。我几乎已经快忘记食物本来的味道了。
target: Food, stripped of extravagant "seasonings." I can scarcely recall the natural taste of most foods.

source: 没有特别讨厌吃的，百无禁忌！不过，我现在已经不需要吃东西了，哈哈。
target: Nope. As long as it's food, me likey. Though… I don't really need to eat anymore, haha.

source: 油断してはならぬ、妾の後ろに立つのだ。
油断するな、下がっておれ。
油炸食品聞起來確實很香，但考慮到它們對健康帶來的負影響，還是儘量不吃為好。
target: Though fried foods can be delicious, it's best to enjoy them in moderation, due to their potential health risks.

source: 油炸食品闻起来确实很香，但考虑到它们对健康带来的负影响，还是尽量不吃为好。
target: Though fried foods can be delicious, it's best to enjoy them in moderation, due to their potential health risks.

source: 沿途的任何細節，都有可能成為情報。
target: Any detail along the way could become valuable intel.

source: 沿途的任何细节，都有可能成为情报。
target: Any detail along the way could become valuable intel.

source: 沿途的風景、有趣的人和好玩兒的事，我都會記到隨身的旅行手帳上。有些東西寫不出來，就畫成圖畫。這樣的手帳本，從我加入嗚嗚物流以來，已經有很多很多本了~
target: I jot down all the interesting sights, people, and events in my travel journal. If words don't cut it, I sketch it out. I've filled up so many journals since joining Lollo Logistics!

source: 沿途的风景、有趣的人和好玩儿的事，我都会记到随身的旅行手账上。有些东西写不出来，就画成图画。这样的手账本，从我加入呜呜物流以来，已经有很多很多本了~
target: I jot down all the interesting sights, people, and events in my travel journal. If words don't cut it, I sketch it out. I've filled up so many journals since joining Lollo Logistics!

source: 泡沫のように消えましょう……
target: Like sea foam on the shore...

source: 波が運んできた恵みだ。
活気と情熱に満ちたあの巡尉のことか？彼女はいつも今州の子供たちの夢を、密かに守ってくれている。
target: That energetic and passionate Patroller? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in Jinzhou.

source: 流れ息が……止まり、ました……
流れ息がより強烈になりました…果たして何を伝えたかったのでしょうか？
target: The Streams are getting louder. What do they have to tell me?

source: 流れ息が四方から集って来ます。私はその中心で、風が舞い上がる時を待ちましょう。
target: Streams are converging from all sides, and I stand in their midst, expecting the wind's arrival.

source: 流れ息が警告しています——気をつけてください！
流れ息を頼りにここまで来ました。……これからの旅は、共に参りましょう。
target: The Streams have guided me to you. I have a feeling we'll be companions for many moons to come.

source: 流息从四周聚集，而我站在中心，等待着起风的时机。
target: Streams are converging from all sides, and I stand in their midst, expecting the wind's arrival.

source: 流息從四周聚集，而我站在中心，等待著起風的時機。
target: Streams are converging from all sides, and I stand in their midst, expecting the wind's arrival.

source: 流息指引我们相遇……我有预感，我们会成为彼此的旅伴。
target: The Streams have guided me to you. I have a feeling we'll be companions for many moons to come.

source: 流息指引我們相遇……我有預感，我們會成為彼此的旅伴。
target: The Streams have guided me to you. I have a feeling we'll be companions for many moons to come.

source: 流息越发强烈，它……想告诉我什么呢？
target: The Streams are getting louder. What do they have to tell me?

source: 流息越發強烈，它……想告訴我什麼呢？
target: The Streams are getting louder. What do they have to tell me?

source: 流風冠冕，已沒入汪洋。你，就是呼喚這把劍的人嗎？
target: The crown of winds... has been engulfed by the sea. Tell me, are you the one who summoned this blade?

source: 流风冠冕，已没入汪洋。你，就是呼唤这把剑的人吗？
target: The crown of winds... has been engulfed by the sea. Tell me, are you the one who summoned this blade?

source: 浑身燃起了热烈又温暖的火焰，一股温和的力量充盈全身……这就是你的力量吗！
target: I've become a Human Torch! I am flame! With this power, I can now protect everyone, including someone as strong as you!

source: 浓雾薄雾变换自如，真是帮大忙啦！这次想知道什么尽管问，我一定知无不言。
target: Now I can switch between any kind of mist as I please. Much appreciated, bud! If you need anything, just ask away. I'll do my best to oblige!
A life as fleeting as the first snow.

source: 浮云若朝露，过眼即空明。
浮雲若朝露，過眼即空明。
海から訪れ、海へ去っていく。
海とは、鏡のようなもの。どこまでも広がる波に映るのは、己の魂よ。
target: The sea is a mirror. It reflects the shape of your soul in its tides.

source: 消えなさい。記憶の果てへ。
target: Run. I'll erase you at the finish line.

source: 深海で過ごしていると、たまには外の空気が吸いたくなるのよね。
target: I've spent too much time in the depths of the sea. At times, I wish for a breath of fresh air above the surface.

source: 深海にいざないましょう。
清流往复处，自有春山可望。
target: Where clear streams flow, there spring awaits.

source: 清流往復處，自有春山可望。
target: Where clear streams flow, there spring awaits.

source: 温暖的笑容里带着决心，只是听到她的声音都感觉自己被鼓舞了——嗯，你比我会当老师！
target: Behind that lovely smile is pure steel. I feel inspired just hearing her voice—Heh, see? You're a better teacher than I am!

source: 温馨而伤感的第一乐章隐藏在暗夜中，孤独、寂寞。现在，那些难以忘怀的、幽灵般的低声哭泣却渐渐停了下来。
target: The warm yet bittersweet first movement is hidden in the dark night, alone and forlorn. Now, those haunting, ghostly cries have begun to fade away.

source: 渾身燃起了熱烈又溫暖的火焰，一股溫和的力量充盈全身……這就是你的力量嗎！
target: I've become a Human Torch! I am flame! With this power, I can now protect everyone, including someone as strong as you!

source: 準備運動は済ませた！いつでも行ける！
溫暖的笑容裡帶著決心，只是聽到她的聲音都感覺自己被鼓舞了——嗯，你比我會當老師！
target: Behind that lovely smile is pure steel. I feel inspired just hearing her voice—Heh, see? You're a better teacher than I am!

source: 溫馨而傷感的第一樂章隱藏在暗夜中，孤獨、寂寞。現在，那些難以忘懷的、幽靈般的低聲哭泣卻漸漸停了下來。
target: The warm yet bittersweet first movement is hidden in the dark night, alone and forlorn. Now, those haunting, ghostly cries have begun to fade away.

source: 滅びを目論む悪は、私が倒す！
target: I destroy all that seeks destruction.

source: 滑らかだわ。まるで静かな海に襲い来る嵐のような高波ね。
target: Mmm, how exquisite... Like a storm crashing into a still sea, stirring it to life with waves that reach for the sky.

source: 漂泊者、久方振りね。これからしばらくの間、護衛役を担当させてもらうわ。
target: Greetings, Rover. I will escort you for the time being.

source:
漂泊者さん、お誕生日おめでとうございます！
これは、歳主の髭くらい長～い龍髭パイです。
誕生日で長い物を食べると長寿になれますよ。どうか、早めに召し上がってくださいね。
target: Happy Birthday, Rover! I made these Loong Whiskers Crisps to be as long as those of our great Sentinel. They say eating something long on your birthday makes you live long and prosper. Enjoy!

source: 漂泊者の旅は楽しいね、アンコそういうの大好き！次も、絶対アンコを連れていくんだよ。はい、指切りげんまん！
target: Your adventure sounds so much fun! Encore really wanna go! Promise you'll take me next time? Pinky swear!

source: 漂泊者の護衛という令尹の命令はすでに完了した……。これからの同行は、誰からの指示でもない、私自身の意思で決めたあなたとの約束。こんな約束をしたのは、あなただけよ。
target: Rover. I joined your side because of my lady's orders, and I will continue to stay with you for the days to come... It has nothing to do with my duties now. I make this vow of my own volition, just for you.

source: 漂泊者，我曾受命于今令尹来到你的身边，今后，我也将一直伴你左右……与命令无关，这是我对你做出的，只属于你的承诺。
target: Rover. I joined your side because of my lady's orders, and I will continue to stay with you for the days to come... It has nothing to do with my duties now. I make this vow of my own volition, just for you.

source: 漂泊者，我曾受命於今令尹來到你的身邊，今後，我也將一直伴你左右……與命令無關，這是我對你做出的，只屬於你的承諾。
target: Rover. I joined your side because of my lady's orders, and I will continue to stay with you for the days to come... It has nothing to do with my duties now. I make this vow of my own volition, just for you.

source: 漂泊者，生日快乐！这份龙须酥，我特意做得像岁主的胡子那么长。据说在生日这天吃了长长的东西，就会长命百岁，快吃吧。
target: Happy Birthday, Rover! I made these Loong Whiskers Crisps to be as long as those of our great Sentinel. They say eating something long on your birthday makes you live long and prosper. Enjoy!

source: 漂泊者，生日快樂！這份龍鬚酥，我特意做得像歲主的鬍子那麼長。據說在生日這天吃了長長的東西，就會長命百歲，快吃吧。
target: Happy Birthday, Rover! I made these Loong Whiskers Crisps to be as long as those of our great Sentinel. They say eating something long on your birthday makes you live long and prosper. Enjoy!

source: 潜入捜査員にとって、強さは任務を完遂するための基礎。その上で求められるのが強靭な精神。
target: For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.

source: 潰さないように気をつけないと。
澄み渡る響き、淀みを漱がん。
濃霧薄霧變換自如，真是幫大忙啦！這次想知道什麼儘管問，我一定知無不言。
target: Now I can switch between any kind of mist as I please. Much appreciated, bud! If you need anything, just ask away. I'll do my best to oblige!

source: 火がもっとあったかく、きれいになった気がするの！この力で人助けできたら……。
target: The fire's getting warmer and prettier! Can we share it with other people? Encore wanna be a helper!

source: 火焰更温暖、更漂亮了！如果能用这个力量帮助到别人的话……
target: The fire's getting warmer and prettier! Can we share it with other people? Encore wanna be a helper!

source: 火焰更溫暖、更漂亮了！如果能用這個力量幫助到別人的話……
target: The fire's getting warmer and prettier! Can we share it with other people? Encore wanna be a helper!

source: 灯灯尾巴上的灯，好像变得更亮了？
target: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?

source: 灯灯我好早前就听说过你！从哪里？很多地方都有我们呜呜物流的驿站，消息可灵通啦~大家送货的时候也会聊新鲜事，你可是今州最热门话题的主人翁！
target: Hey, I've been hearing about you for ages! How? Lollo Logistics has stations everywhere, so news travels fast! And, in case you don't know, you're the talk of Jinzhou!

source: 灵魂的轮廓……更加清晰了。
target: The souls... They look clearer to me.
May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.
May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.

source: 炁印交輝，靈竅通明，這下指掌掐訣可做到真正的千變萬化了。
target: Body and seal align, spirit gates open wide. My hand mudras now shift in a thousand forms.

source: 炁印交辉，灵窍通明，这下指掌掐诀可做到真正的千变万化了。
target: Body and seal align, spirit gates open wide. My hand mudras now shift in a thousand forms.

source: 為了對抗那些無處不在的罪惡……我會和你一起用好這份力量的。
target: I will make good use of this power and fight by your side... We'll confront evil, wherever it lies.

source: 為了能順利開闢嗚嗚物流的新航線，體能的特訓是必不可少的。
target: To chart new routes for Lollo Logistics, physical training is a must.

source: 為什麼植入體的性能會提升？原理是什麼？
target: Cyberware benchmarks keep climbin'... What kinda architecture's driving this?
Now presenting, a poem of finale.
For the Stories, She Shall Sing

source: 為積累的理論構建現實映射。請放心，我很擅長這個。
target: Constructing reality mapping for accumulated theories. Rest assured, I'm quite proficient at this.

source: 為領悟生生不息，一次次經歷。
target: I wish to comprehend the cycle of life by experiencing it over and over again.

source: 炽霞姐姐是安可的好朋友，她人很好的哦！你要是迷路了就去找她，她不怕加班的。
target: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.

source: 炽霞姐姐给我吃过一勺冠军辣酱……居、居然有这么辣的品种，到底是什么，现在想想都……啊，维里奈冒烟了。
target: Miss Chixia once fed me a spoonful of her Victor Savor... I-I couldn't believe how spicy it was! What kind of pepper was that? Ow, my mouth still burns just thinking about it.
All the sun touches is ours to fight for.
All the sun touches is ours to fight for.

source: 烤糊的餅乾、泡軟的杯麵、把糖和鹽搞混的小甜品……他們送我的我都喜歡~
target: Burnt cookies, soggy instant noodles, desserts where someone confused salt with sugar... If they made it for me, I love it.

source: 烤糊的饼干、泡软的杯面、把糖和盐搞混的小甜品……他们送我的我都喜欢~
target: Burnt cookies, soggy instant noodles, desserts where someone confused salt with sugar... If they made it for me, I love it.

source: 烦恼吗……大部分烦恼都可以靠钱解决啦，唯有一件事：妹妹长大了怎么办？唉，你说，她怎么就不需要我牵着了呢？
target: My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore?

source: 烦恼？在总督宫，麻烦从不少见，但只要“敢战”，一切自会迎刃而解。呵呵，能解决的烦恼，算不上什么烦恼。
target: Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.

source: 热身结束，随时可以上场！

target: Worry not... Just need a moment.

source: 無情に見えれど、情は確かに在る
無論是鍛煉身體，還是調息養生，有需要都可以來找我。
target: Whether you need help with working out or maintaining your health, feel free to come by my gym. We welcome all visitors.

source: 無論發生什麼事，無論遭受什麼事，這塊玉佩都會永遠清澈透亮。
target: No matter what happens, no matter what I've been through, this jade pendant will forever stay clear and bright.

source: 無論通往何處，這一戰，我會全力以赴。
target: No matter where this leads… This battle, I'm all in.

source: 無限のループから始まる

target: No need to dwell on it.

source: 焦げたクッキーに、伸びきったカップ麺。それと、砂糖と塩を間違えたデザート……教え子たちがくれたものなら、なんだって好きよ～
target: Burnt cookies, soggy instant noodles, desserts where someone confused salt with sugar... If they made it for me, I love it.

source: 焦らないで。ゆっくり待てば、敵は自ずと現れる。
target: No rush. The impatient ones will fall right into our lap.

source: 焦らないで。欲張っても消化しきれないわよ。
target: Slow and steady. Let's not bite off more than we can chew.

source: 煌くか、死ぬか……この道は2つに1つ。
target: To shine or to die? Merely two sides of the same coin.

source: 照这个势头下去，很快就能成为闻名今州……哦不，闻名整个瑝珑的大英雄了吧？
target: At this rate, the entire Jinzhou City... No wait. The entirety of Huanglong shall be known to the heroic Chixia's name!

source: 照這個勢頭下去，很快就能成為聞名今州……哦不，聞名整個瑝瓏的大英雄了吧？
target: At this rate, the entire Jinzhou City... No wait. The entirety of Huanglong shall be known to the heroic Chixia's name!

source: 煩惱嗎……大部分煩惱都可以靠錢解決啦，唯有一件事：妹妹長大了怎麼辦？唉，你說，她怎麼就不需要我牽著了呢？
target: My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore?

source: 煩惱？在總督宮，麻煩從不少見，但只要「敢戰」，一切自會迎刃而解。呵呵，能解決的煩惱，算不上什麼煩惱。
target: Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.
I'm no stranger to this sensation...
I'm no stranger to this sensation...

source: 熱は…まだ残っています…
熱身結束，隨時可以上場！
熾霞姉ちゃんはアンコのお友達だよ！まあ、たまにアンコに厳しい時もあるけど、いい人なんだ。もし道がわからなかったら、熾霞姉ちゃんに聞くといいよ。残業とか気にしなさそうだもん。
target: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.

source: 熾霞姐姐是安可的好朋友，她人很好的哦！你要是迷路了就去找她，她不怕加班的。
target: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.

source: 熾霞姐姐給我吃過一勺冠軍辣醬……居、居然有這麼辣的品種，到底是什麼，現在想想都……啊，維里奈冒煙了。
target: Miss Chixia once fed me a spoonful of her Victor Savor... I-I couldn't believe how spicy it was! What kind of pepper was that? Ow, my mouth still burns just thinking about it.

source: 熾霞？フフ……彼女はなかなかのやり手だね。でも次は絶対負けないぞ！……なんの試合かって？そりゃもちろん、制限時間内でどれだけ人助けできるか、の試合だよ！
target: Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!

source: 燃え盛る太陽よ、見ているが良い。やがて栄光は、余とお主の前にひれ伏すだろう。
target: With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us.

source: 燈燈尾巴上的燈，好像變得更亮了？
target: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?

source: 燈燈我好早前就聽說過你！從哪裡？很多地方都有我們嗚嗚物流的驛站，消息可靈通啦~大家送貨的時候也會聊新鮮事，你可是今州最熱門話題的主人翁！
target: Hey, I've been hearing about you for ages! How? Lollo Logistics has stations everywhere, so news travels fast! And, in case you don't know, you're the talk of Jinzhou!

source: 燻製肉の味は、ちょっと……いえ、何でもないわ。
target: After meat is smoked or roasted, its taste is similar to... Never mind.

source: 爱弥斯，拉贝尔学部的隧者适格者！不过，那都是生前的事了。现在的我，是电子幽灵哦~
target: Aemeath, Synchronist of the Exostrider from Rabelle College. That was me back when I was alive. Now? I'm a digital ghost!

source:
爱弥斯：世界，由我守护！
隧者兵装：目标记录。
target:
Aemeath: The world is mine to guard!
Exostrider Armament: Objective logged.

source:
爱弥斯：终曲聚束，射击！
隧者兵装：指令确认。
target:
Aemeath: Lightshow of the finale, fire!
Exostrider Armament: Order confirmed.

source:
爱弥斯：英雄的舞台，开幕！
隧者兵装：射灯完备。
target:
Aemeath: Hero's on, lights up!
Exostrider Armament: Limelights checked.
Sounds could be weighty. Jadeite could be made light.
Sounds could be weighty. Jadeite could be made light.

source: 牙を研げ。戦いに備えろ。
牛乳を飲めば体が育つと、母さんが言ってました。植物に養分が必要なのと同じですね。
target: My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.
I trust you can use it to the full.

source: 物理キーより電子キーを解除するほうが得意なの。
target: Actually, I'm better at popping digital locks.
I trust you can use it to the full.

source: 物語…まだ終わってない…
物語で宝物はお約束です！
target: Just like the treasure chests from the stories!

source: 物語に出てくるような「宝箱のお化け」ではなかったね。
target: Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time.
For the Stories, She Shall Sing

source: 物語は、まだ終わらない……
特に接点はないけど、言動を見るに、なかなかセンスのある人だね！うちの店に来てくれたら歓迎するよ。
target: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!

source: 特別討厭的食物……好像沒有。我可不是什麼挑食的傢伙！
target: Food I won't eat...? Hmm... Nope, never heard of it!

source: 特别讨厌的食物……好像没有。我可不是什么挑食的家伙！
target: Food I won't eat...? Hmm... Nope, never heard of it!

source: 特殊的日子……生日快乐。有什么烦心的人或事吗？今天我都可以以优惠价，帮你……“解决"。
target: Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.

source: 特殊的日子……生日快樂。有什麼煩心的人或事嗎？今天我都可以以優惠價，幫你……「解決」。
target: Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.

source: 状況を飲み込めてないみたいね。
狙った獲物は逃がさねぇ！
狩りに出た以上、手ぶらでは帰れぬ。
target: A hunt isn't complete without a prize.

source: 狩りの手は止まらない。
独りでいるのが、好きです。
獅子舞の開演だ！諸悪退散、諸願成就！
target: Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!

source: 獎勵是最受歡迎的老師~
target: Nothing motivates like a little reward.
The lovely smell of all my prey...

source: 率军统兵，并非易事。有时我也会对自己的决定感到怀疑。今后若是有你在侧，我也会感到安心一些。
target: Commanding an army is not a simple task, and sometimes I find myself questioning my own decisions. Going forward, with you staying by my side, I should feel more at ease.

source: 率軍統兵，並非易事。有時我也會對自己的決定感到懷疑。今後若是有你在側，我也會感到安心一些。
target: Commanding an army is not a simple task, and sometimes I find myself questioning my own decisions. Going forward, with you staying by my side, I should feel more at ease.

source: 玉石砕く調べ、天地舞う剣。
玛格烈特餐馆永远是工作之余的最佳选择。再没有什么东西会比玛格烈特小姐亲手制作的热腾腾的披萨，更能抚慰加班后空空如也的心灵和胃了。
target: My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work.

source: 现在出现在你面前的是完全体的丽贝卡！下次出门打架躲我后面，我罩着你！
target: Check the specs! Got yourself a fully-loaded Rebecca now! Next fight, just cozy up by me. I got your back!

source:
现在是即兴发挥咯。
*佩洛！佩洛！*
现在的我，算是一名优秀的领航员了吗？呼……不行不行，不能得意！还要更努力才行！路还很长，灯灯我会挺起胸膛，一直走下去。
target: So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up!

source: 现在，我们画下一个起点……
target: Now, time to mark the next starting point...

source: 现在，我能和你并肩而行了。
target: Now, I can walk beside you.

source: 珍しく陰の気をあまり感じねぇな。
target: Barely any Nether Qi. Tch. Lucky find.
Cherish the gift not given lightly.

source: 珍惜好旅途中每一份收獲。
珍惜好旅途中每一份收穫。
珍惜好旅途中每一份收获。

target: Cherish the gift not given lightly.

source: 現在出現在你面前的是完全體的蕾貝卡！下次出門打架躲我後面，我罩著你！
target: Check the specs! Got yourself a fully-loaded Rebecca now! Next fight, just cozy up by me. I got your back!

source:
現在是即興發揮囉。
*佩洛！佩洛！*
現在的我，算是一名優秀的領航員了嗎？呼……不行不行，不能得意！還要更努力才行！路還很長，燈燈我會挺起胸膛，一直走下去。
target: So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up!

source: 現在，我們畫下一個起點……
target: Now, time to mark the next starting point...

source: 現在，我能和你並肩而行了。
target: Now, I can walk beside you.

source: 現実に基づき、理論を構築……安心してください、私の得意分野ですので。
target: Constructing reality mapping for accumulated theories. Rest assured, I'm quite proficient at this.

source: 現実をハッキング完了。
理想かぁ……あたしが理想を語るなんて面白いよね。う～ん……そうだ、これからも今日みたいな毎日を送れるなら、それで充分じゃないかな。
target: A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.

source: 理想啊……真不可思議，我居然也能談論這些了……讓我想想，嗯——未來的每一天都能像今天這樣，就夠了吧？
target: A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.

source: 理想啊……真不可思议，我居然也能谈论这些了……让我想想，嗯——未来的每一天都能像今天这样，就够了吧？
target: A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.

source: 琳奈前輩經常就像風一樣來，風一樣去。在她走過的地方，總會留下一些絢麗的色彩。那些色彩是她留下的謎題，而她臉上的笑容就是謎底。
target: Lynae always comes and goes like the wind. Wherever she passes, she leaves behind these dazzling colors. Those colors are her riddles, and the smile on her face? That's always the answer.

source: 琳奈前辈经常就像风一样来，风一样去。在她走过的地方，总会留下一些绚丽的色彩。那些色彩是她留下的谜题，而她脸上的笑容就是谜底。
target: Lynae always comes and goes like the wind. Wherever she passes, she leaves behind these dazzling colors. Those colors are her riddles, and the smile on her face? That's always the answer.

source: 瑝珑生产的应急罐头，比其他地方生产的要好吃一些。
target: Huanglong's emergency rations. They taste slightly better than those made elsewhere.

source: 瑝瓏生產的應急罐頭，比其他地方生產的要好吃一些。
target: Huanglong's emergency rations. They taste slightly better than those made elsewhere.

source: 瑝瓏産の缶詰は、他のところのと比べて味が幾分ましだ。
target: Huanglong's emergency rations. They taste slightly better than those made elsewhere.

source: 瑞狮团表演狮子舞的那个，是叫凌阳吧？他的吉祥话朗朗上口，和我的诗一样，颇有风骨。
target: That liondancer... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!

source: 瑞獅團表演獅子舞的那個，是叫凌陽吧？他的吉祥話朗朗上口，和我的詩一樣，頗有風骨。
target: That liondancer... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!

source: 瑪格烈特餐館永遠是工作之餘的最佳選擇。再沒有什麼東西會比瑪格烈特小姐親手製作的熱騰騰的披薩，更能撫慰加班後空空如也的心靈和胃了。
target: My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work.

source: 璀璨或是死亡？两者本就一体。
target: To shine or to die? Merely two sides of the same coin.

source: 璀璨或是死亡？兩者本就一體。
target: To shine or to die? Merely two sides of the same coin.

source: 甘いものは好きです。食べると、力がみなぎります。
target: I have a sweet tooth. Sweet things always give me more energy!

source: 甘味だ……決して、妾が薄味を好むからではない。ただ、甘いものを口にすると、かつての苦い記憶が呼び起こされるのだ。幸せだった日々が甘かったからこそ……失った時の痛みは深いであろう。
target: Confections, I suppose... Not from any preference of palate. It is simply that sweetness, upon tasting, stirs memories of a bitter kind. The sweeter the past I once held, the more bitter the aftertaste that lingers.

source: 甜食吧……倒不是因为我偏好口味清淡，只是每次吃甜食时，总会想起些苦涩的回忆。曾体会过的东西越是甜蜜，失去时便越是酸涩。
target: Confections, I suppose... Not from any preference of palate. It is simply that sweetness, upon tasting, stirs memories of a bitter kind. The sweeter the past I once held, the more bitter the aftertaste that lingers.

source: 甜食吧……倒不是因為我偏好口味清淡，只是每次吃甜食時，總會想起些苦澀的回憶。曾體會過的東西越是甜蜜，失去時便越是酸澀。
target: Confections, I suppose... Not from any preference of palate. It is simply that sweetness, upon tasting, stirs memories of a bitter kind. The sweeter the past I once held, the more bitter the aftertaste that lingers.

source: 生きることよりも大事なもの
生き生きとした明るい第三楽章は、幻想的なスケルツォのようね。たとえ虚偽と不安の上に成り立っていたとしても、音符は踊り続けている。
target: The bright and lively third movement carries the whimsical air of fantasy. Even suspended above falsehood and unease, it compels the notes to keep dancing forward.

source: 生と死の狭間に縋って。
生は朝露、死は秋葉の如し。
生日快乐！喏，这是我亲手做的冒菜，特意加了好多好多冠军辣酱哦。赶紧趁热吃了，别怕辣嘛，辣才好啊，红红火火！
target: Happy Birthday! Try this, I made this bow of Maocai all by myself, with extra Victor Savor added just for you. Eat up while it's still steamin'! Don't worry about the spiciness, it's a good omen!

source: 生日快乐，我的朋友！今天有什么安排，要不要给自己放个假，一起去出海玩一玩？来，握紧舵盘。今天你做船长，我们一起朝着最远的天边出发！
target: Happy birthday, my dear friend! Got any plans today? How about slipping away with me for a little adventure? I'll even let you take the helm. Here, hold on tight—together, we'll sail into the far horizon!

source: 生日快樂！喏，這是我親手做的冒菜，特意加了好多好多冠軍辣醬哦。趕緊趁熱吃了，別怕辣嘛，辣才好啊，紅紅火火！
target: Happy Birthday! Try this, I made this bow of Maocai all by myself, with extra Victor Savor added just for you. Eat up while it's still steamin'! Don't worry about the spiciness, it's a good omen!

source: 生日快樂，我的朋友！今天有什麼安排？要不要給自己放個假，一起去出海玩一玩？來，握緊舵盤。今天你做船長，我們一起朝著最遠的天邊出發！
target: Happy birthday, my dear friend! Got any plans today? How about slipping away with me for a little adventure? I'll even let you take the helm. Here, hold on tight—together, we'll sail into the far horizon!

source: 生死は決まっています。
生物は苦手です！特に、生肉の盛り合わせはちょっと……
target: I hate eating anything raw! Especially that fancy sliced meat on a platter.

source: 生者の引導は渡さねぇ！
生者の道を照らす灯りはねぇ。
target: My lamp guides no living souls.

source: 生長，這時候呼吸都變得輕盈……
target: As I grow, even my breaths feel lighter...

source: 生长，这时候呼吸都变得轻盈……
target: As I grow, even my breaths feel lighter...

source: 用があれば、いつでも私を訪ねてください。用がなくても、別に構いませんよ。ただ訳もなく、クラシックを聞いて、甘い物を食べる……君と一緒なら、そんな他愛もない時間も楽しめるはずです。
target: Come find me when you need something made. Come find me... when you don't, too. Just idling by together, listening to music and indulging in some sweets... I'll be looking forward to that, if you're here with me.

source: 用心するのだ、妖魔の気配がする。
用新鮮的肉烹飪出的沙丁布卡~我是比較老派的七丘口味，這道菜可以添加適量的辣椒，但不要學拉古那人加奇怪的酸味醬啊！
target: A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the Ragunnesi!

source: 用新鲜的肉烹饪出的沙丁布卡~我是比较老派的七丘口味，这道菜可以添加适量的辣椒，但不要学拉古那人加奇怪的酸味酱啊！
target: A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the Ragunnesi!

source: 用自己的灵魂熬制一锅独一无二的秘药，让那些深埋海底的幻想从过去的时光里飞出来，在现实中自由翱翔，欢快歌唱。
target: I've longed to craft a potion like no other. One born of my soul, to free the dreams buried deep below, and let them soar, singing through the waking world.

source: 用自己的靈魂熬製一鍋獨一無二的秘藥，讓那些深埋海底的幻想從過去的時光裡飛出來，在現實中自由翱翔，歡快歌唱。
target: I've longed to craft a potion like no other. One born of my soul, to free the dreams buried deep below, and let them soar, singing through the waking world.

source: 画竜点睛（がりょうてんせい）。
當然是夾著新鮮水果，塗滿了奶油，插著蠟燭的生日蛋糕了……畢竟，我還沒吃過呢。
target: A birthday cake, of course. The kind with tons of fresh fruit and way too much whipped cream. And candles on top, for sure... Why? Because I've never actually had one before.

source: 痛くないわ、ゴーストだもの。
発つ前に、一曲聞いてくれないだろうか。
target: How about a melody before we depart?

source: 白研究员的包裹都好重好重！好像都是书？厚厚的，一大摞一大摞的寄过来，还有一些奇奇怪怪的东西，说是新的实验材料什么的……
target: Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes...

source: 白研究員的包裹都好重好重！好像都是書？厚厚的，一大摞一大摞地寄過來，還有一些奇奇怪怪的東西，說是新的實驗材料什麼的……
target: Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes...

source: 白芷さんの荷物はいっつも重い！大体は本なんだけど、量が多すぎるよ。それに、新しい実験材料みたいな何かが混じってることもあるし……
target: Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes...

source: 白芷のそばにいるあの変わった反響生物……「優曇」だっけ？僕と同じなのかなって思ったんだけど……まあ、結局ただの勘違いだったね……。
target: The Remnant Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called You'tan, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was…

source: 白芷啊，她不太愛說話……但請不要誤會，她絕對不是冷冰冰的人！你多和她相處就會明白，她有她自己表達熱情的方式。
target: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.

source: 白芷啊，她不太爱说话……但请不要误会，她绝对不是冷冰冰的人！你多和她相处就会明白，她有她自己表达热情的方式。
target: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.

source: 白芷身边那只奇特的回音生物……我记得，是叫忧昙吧？我曾把它当做了和我一样的存在，还以为自己找到了同类。可惜……只是一场误会罢了。
target: The Remnant Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called You'tan, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was…

source: 白芷身邊那隻奇特的回音生物……我記得，是叫憂曇吧？我曾把它當做了和我一樣的存在，還以為自己找到了同類。可惜……只是一場誤會罷了。
target: The Remnant Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called You'tan, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was…

source: 百聞は一見に如かず、だね。
百鬼帰ると、浮世は塵に。
target: All souls converge. The world ruptures.
All souls converge. The world ruptures.
All souls converge. The world ruptures.

source: 皆さんを、守らなくては……
皆と一緒に居たい……これからも。
target: I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: 皆と一緒に居たい……これからも。
target: Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

source: 盛放——呼……感覺自己都有些緊張，真漂亮呢！
target: Now is the time to bloom... I didn't realize I was holding my breath. Look. It's so beautiful!

source: 盛放——呼……感觉自己都有些紧张，真漂亮呢！
target: Now is the time to bloom... I didn't realize I was holding my breath. Look. It's so beautiful!

source: 盡情鍛煉後來上一杯熱騰騰的清茶，茶的清新淡雅可以緩解肌肉酸痛。很有效的，你也試試。
target: A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.

source: 目に見える悪も、見えない邪も、全て絶え、滅びますように……
target: Wherever I go, I swear to vanquish evil, whether it's out in the daylight or hiding in the dark.

source: 目の前が明るくなってきたように感じる。この光が、すべての闇を照らしてくれるように祈ろう。
target: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.

source: 目の前に広がる、果てしない海……旅は、まだまだ終わらない。
target: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

source: 目をそらしちゃダメよ。

target: At First, She Closed Her Eyes

source: 目覚まし時計が……ふぅ、仕事の時間だ。
target: Is that the alarm... Alright, time to work.

source: 相手にとって不足なし。
相手の名はなんと言う？某が片付ける。
target: Name the target. I'll take care of the rest.

source: 相棒、あたしの力が必要か？
相棒が戦ってるのに、見てるだけじゃいられねぇだろ！
相棒は戦いを繰り返しても疲れた様子を見せねぇな？あたしも強くなって、前に進みてぇんだ。それで、相棒の背中を任せてもらう……あんたにとって、一番頼もしい相棒になってみせるぜ。
target: As we advance from one battle to the next, do you ever feel tired? I want to become stronger, wiser, and better. I want to be someone who's got your back, to be your... most trusted Fellow Warrior.

source: 相里……いつか、私はヤツを超え、最高の発明品を作り出す！
target: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!
Seems the scales tipped my way, hm?

source: 看吧？我总会选择正确的站边，你的那边。
target: See? I always choose the winning side—yours.

source: 看吧？我總會選擇正確的站邊，你的那邊。
target: See? I always choose the winning side—yours.

source: 看好了哦，水饺……如何？栩栩如生。
target: Watch closely, Dumpling... See? Quite lifelike, isn't it?

source: 看好了喔，水餃……如何？栩栩如生。
target: Watch closely, Dumpling... See? Quite lifelike, isn't it?
As far as the eye can see.
As far as the eye can see.
Seems the scales tipped my way, hm?

source: 真の姿、ここに顕現する。
真吃惊啊……那么高的分数，我还是第一次见。
target: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.

source: 真吃驚啊……那麼高的分數，我還是第一次見。
target: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.

source: 真是的……工作还没搞定呢……
target: No… I've still got work to do...

source: 真是的……工作還沒搞定呢……
target: No… I've still got work to do...

source: 真的沒問題嗎？你在縱容我的任性，繼續下去的話，說不定……會一起墜入比混沌更可怕的未知喔！
target: Are you sure about this? Indulging my willfulness? Just so you know, if we keep this up, we might... fall into an unknown future scarier than Chaos!

source: 真的没问题吗？你在纵容我的任性，继续下去的话，说不定……会一起坠入比混沌更可怕的未知哦！
target: Are you sure about this? Indulging my willfulness? Just so you know, if we keep this up, we might... fall into an unknown future scarier than Chaos!
The lovely smell of all my prey...
The lovely smell of all my prey...

source: 真面目にやりましょうか……
眼光不錯，和我交易不會吃虧。
target: Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.

source: 眼光不错，和我交易不会吃亏。
target: Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.

source: 眼前に広がるは、闇のみ。
眼前的光如此炽烈，希望它能照亮每一处阴影，让黑暗无所遁形。
target: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.

source: 眼前的光如此熾烈，希望它能照亮每一處陰影，讓黑暗無所遁形。
target: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.
For all wishes spoken, this vessel I offer.

source: 着実な進歩だ。次の進路は……よし、取り舵いっぱい！
target: We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside!
In the blink of an eye.
In the blink of an eye.

source:
知っていますか？あなたの後ろにいる子は「あなたが好き」と言っているのですよ。
私は植物の嘘偽りない言葉を聞くことができます。
また今度植物たちのこと、もっと教えてあげますね？
target: Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.
A contented mind is a perpetual feast.
A contented mind is a perpetual feast.
A chance given is a future rewritten.
A chance given is a future rewritten.
I'll repay your trust... in another life.
I'll repay your trust... in another life.

source: 砂糖もミルクも入っていないエスプレッソは、眠気覚ましにちょうどいい。ファミリーの間では、好きな人も多いよ。けど私は、仕事で苦い思いをしているのに、あえて飲み物でも苦みを味わう必要はないと思っているから、甘いほうが好きだね。
target: Employees of the Montelli family swear by espresso—straight, no sugar or milk—to keep themselves energized. But as for me, work is already hard enough... I'd rather treat myself to something sweet.

source: 研究の後に一人でレポートを書くことかな。雑多な考えや新しい発見が、整然とまとまっていくのが楽しいんだ。
target: Writing a report alone, after completing research, is satisfying. My scattered thoughts and inspirations come together during this time, becoming clear and organized.

source: 研究院の効率の悪さは、寒霜亀をも凌ぐ勢いですね。そろそろ私の申請が通る頃合いでしょうか…… 君に関して、まだ多くの疑問が残っています。研究が必要ですね……
target: The Academy is working as fast as a Hoartoise. So many mysteries about you remain unanswered, yet my research proposals are still pending approval.

source: 研究院的效率都快赶得上寒霜陆龟了，我的立项申请也该审批下来了吧……你身上还有太多的疑点需要研究……
target: The Academy is working as fast as a Hoartoise. So many mysteries about you remain unanswered, yet my research proposals are still pending approval.

source: 研究院的效率都快趕得上寒霜陸龜了，我的立項申請也該審批下來了吧……你身上還有太多的疑點需要研究……
target: The Academy is working as fast as a Hoartoise. So many mysteries about you remain unanswered, yet my research proposals are still pending approval.
Bang. The white has been dyed red.
Bang. The white has been dyed red.

source: 碁はこの世と同じ、一瞬一瞬が変化の真っ只中にある……面白いと思わない？
target: The dynamics of a Weiqi game mirror the complexities of our world, always in a state of constant flux and transformation... Fascinating, isn't it?

source: 確か、好きでしたよね？あなたにあげます。
確かこれだったかしら？……懐かしいわ。
target: I believe it's this one? ...How nice.

source: 確かこれは……はっ！……ひぃぃ！
target: What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...

source: 確かにあいつは話すのがうまい。でも、私が求めてる強さはそういうのじゃない。小賢しい手口はあんまり好きじゃないからね。
target: Aalto's a master at mind games. It's hard to get under his skin! He's not strong enough to pique my interest though. That guy relies on trickery too much for my liking.

source: 磨剑要用顽石，用甲胄，用刀剑，用生命，哪怕折断碎裂……剑也必须锋利。
target: A sharp sword is honed on whetstones, clashing blades, and shattered armor, then tempered in the fire of life. Even if it breaks, it must remain sharp.

source: 磨劍要用頑石，用甲冑，用刀劍，用生命，哪怕折斷碎裂……劍也必須鋒利。
target: A sharp sword is honed on whetstones, clashing blades, and shattered armor, then tempered in the fire of life. Even if it breaks, it must remain sharp.
Your wish for wealth is granted.

source: 祈りですか？……余が必ずや応えましょう。
target: May I pray for anything specific for you? It would be my honor… I'm sure your wishes will come true.

source: 祝你生日快乐，祝你生日快乐......以前生日的时候，妈妈就会给安可唱生日歌！现在安可把这首歌也唱给你听，就祝你可以拥抱自己的新的生活吧！
target: ♪Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you...♪ Mommy used to sing this birthday song on Encore's birthdays! Now, Encore is singing it just for you. Here's to a new, happy life!

source: 祝你生日快乐，祝你生日快乐，祝你生日快乐，祝你生日快乐……！这一次，这首歌，也一如既往地，献给你。
target: Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... As always, this song is specially for you.

source: 祝你生日快樂，祝你生日快樂......以前生日的時候，媽媽就會給安可唱生日歌！現在安可把這首歌也唱給你聽，就祝你可以擁抱自己新的生活吧！
target: ♪Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you...♪ Mommy used to sing this birthday song on Encore's birthdays! Now, Encore is singing it just for you. Here's to a new, happy life!

source: 祝你生日快樂，祝你生日快樂，祝你生日快樂，祝你生日快樂……！這一次，這首歌，也一如既往地獻給你。
target: Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... As always, this song is specially for you.

source: 神学校で私は知りました。もし自分の正義を貫きたいのなら、強大な闇にも蠢く影にも負けないような努力が必要なのだと。
target: During my studies at the seminary, I knew that to uphold justice, I would need to work harder and sacrifice more than others to overcome the shadows that sought to destroy it.

source: 神采斐然，气韵自成。这份从容不迫的气度不是一朝一夕可以练就的。我能感觉到，你所经历的，远比我多得多。
target: Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.

source: 神采斐然，氣韻自成。這份從容不迫的氣度不是一朝一夕可以練就的。我能感覺到，你所經歷的，遠比我多得多。
target: Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.
Sacred bones rot. Heavens drown in dark.
Sacred bones rot. Heavens drown in dark.

source: 私からあまり離れないように。
target: Please don't stay too far away from me.

source: 私が作る料理……なぜか微妙な味になるんです……え、た、食べてみたいんですか？……わ、わかりました。でも、もう少し練習してからで……
target: When I cook, it feels like the flavors never blend, like the ingredients and seasonings are at odds… Are-are you interested in tasting it? Um, I'll have to practice more before you try it…

source: 私たちはみんな、世界を舞台に踊る役者に過ぎない。
target: All the world's a stage, and we are mere players.

source: 私でないとダメ？そうですか…本当に手を焼く人ですね…では、出発しましょう。
target: As always, I'm the one you need... I really can't win with you, can I? Let's just get this done.

source: 私と優曇の力で、皆を守る。
target: You'tan and I will ensure your safety.

source: 私と演奏を？本気かしら？
私には、私の進むべき道がある……この長くて暗い危険な道に、誰かを巻き込む気はない。いつまでも一緒にいられるとは限らん。それに「悪魔」は、人の「魂」を代償として喰らう……そんな不公平な契約だとしても……お前は結ぶのか？
target: My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the "devil" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it?

source: 私に付いてきてください。
私の全てを受けなさい……
私の剣、受けてみる？あなたに教わったところから、自分なりに改良したわ。今の力、確かめさせてもらえないかな？
target: You taught me well, but I've added a few creative twists to your technique. Now's the perfect time to test it out!

source: 私の旅路は、ここまでのようね……
target: This path... I'll walk no further.

source: 私の認知を上回る力がみなぎってくる。あなたは未知を与えてくれた。だから私は、余すことなくその未知を解き明かしてみせる。
target: You have helped me gain a previously unknown level of power; in return, I will use this power to its fullest extent for you.

source: 私は…これ以上引かない。
私はエイメス、ラベル学部のエクソストライダー適格者よ！まぁ、それは生きてた頃の話で、今はデジタルゴーストだけど。
target: Aemeath, Synchronist of the Exostrider from Rabelle College. That was me back when I was alive. Now? I'm a digital ghost!

source: 私はザンニー、モンテリファミリーの職員を勤めている。ん？これはアイシャドーじゃなくて、努力の証、一生懸命仕事を頑張ってきた勲章だ――なんて、冗談を繰り返していたら、いつか本当にそう思い込んでしまいそうだよ。
target: I am Zani. I work for the Montelli family. Hmm? Oh, that's not eyeshadow. It's proof of my hard work, a badge of honor for my dedication. Ha, if I keep saying that, I might actually start believing it myself.

source: 私はユーノ。月食と共に生まれた天才にして、正しい未来を見通す諭しの女よ。気になることがあったら、私のところに来なさい……ただし、望む答えが得られる保証はないけど。
target: Iuno, the prodigy born under the lunar eclipse. The Priestess who sees the true future. Curious about what lies ahead? Come to me... But no promises of the perfect ending you seek.

source: 私はルーシー。エッジランナー、専門はハッキングよ。仕事を頼むだけなら、これで充分でしょ？
target: Lucy. When I was takin' gigs as an edgerunner, my specialty was netrunning. If this is just biz, that's all you need to know.

source: 私は別に、この地の富を求めてるわけじゃないわ。貨物をスムーズに運輸できて、人々が自由に出かけられる。そして、先の世代も安住できるような町にしていきたいと思ってるの。
target: I want wealth that knows no border. I want goods to find their way, people to find their place. I want the warm light of every home burning, always burning, forever.

source: 私は見てしまいました……輝きの下に隠された影を。もし、かつて信じていたものが、正しい道ではなかったとしたら……いえ、何でもありません。気にしないでください……
target: I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me...

source: 私は隠海教団の侍祭、フィービーです。歳主の名において、あなたの旅路が愛と光に満ち溢れるよう、お祈りします。
target: I'm Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.

source: 私を待つ人が、いるんです……
私を見て驚きましたかぁ？ふふっ、そんなに緊張しないでください。また会えるって言いましたよねぇ？
target: Surprised to see me? Haha, relax. I told you we'd meet again.

source: 科学とは、命あるものによる真理への問いかけだ。
target: Science is life's questioning of truth.

source: 科学只是工具，不是魔法。你可别像某些人一样，对科学产生什么不切实际的幻想。
target: Scientific research is but a tool. It's not magic. People tend to have unrealistic expectations about how research works, and you wouldn't want to be one of them.

source: 科学技術は単なるツールであり、魔法ではありません。君も一部の人たちのように、科学に対して非現実的な幻想を抱かないでくださいね。
target: Scientific research is but a tool. It's not magic. People tend to have unrealistic expectations about how research works, and you wouldn't want to be one of them.

source: 科学，是生命对真理的诘问。
target: Science is life's questioning of truth.

source: 科學只是工具，不是魔法。你可別像某些人一樣，對科學產生什麼不切實際的幻想。
target: Scientific research is but a tool. It's not magic. People tend to have unrealistic expectations about how research works, and you wouldn't want to be one of them.

source: 科學，是生命對真理的詰問。
target: Science is life's questioning of truth.

source:
秧秧さんの第一印象は、「軟弱な人」でした。
でも……あのような芯のある優しさは、何よりも鋭い刃となりえます。
target: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.

source: 秧秧は優しくて美人で、声もうっとりするぐらい素敵なんだ！ただ、たまにあたしにはよくわからない、綺麗なフレーズを口にするんだよね。詩、みたいな感じ？
target: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

source: 秧秧又温柔又漂亮，说的话也很好听！就是有时候她会说一些我听不懂的漂亮句子，叫什么来着，诗？
target: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

source: 秧秧又溫柔又漂亮，說的話也很好聽！就是有時候她會說一些我聽不懂的漂亮句子，叫什麼來著，詩？
target: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

source: 穂波に来て二月目の悪夢
空に浮かぶ雲のように……ゆったりと……
target: Sometimes I pretend I was a cloud in the sky... Just drifting by as a soft and fluffy pile, without any worry.

source: 立て続けに学術会議に参加すると、集中力が落ちる。交流自体は嫌いじゃないけど、独りの時間がないっていうのはね……。
target: During back-to-back academic conferences, my focus wanes and I need time to recharge. Being with peers is enjoyable, but a little solitude is necessary for me to stay sharp.

source: 竜巻生成機や空間転移ライト……ほかにも役立つ道具がいっぱい。
target: Tornado makers, dimension-warping lamps... I've got all kinds of props if you're interested.
Curious you'd want me to join you in person...
Curious you'd want me to join you in person...

source:
笑って！
炎よ、世界に爪痕を。

笑吧！
流火燃痕天地。

target: The runes will be our guide.
The runes will be our guide.

source: 符籙を書く筆は、まるで神様の助けを得たように。
target: Seal script flows, Qi pulses through. Now I write talisman guided from above.
Chapter II: Adrift in Wind and Snow
Chapter III: Dream of No Return
Chapter IV: River, Moon, and Farewell

source: 第一楽章は、温かくも感傷的よ。闇夜の中に潜む孤独感。あの忘れがたい亡霊のようなすすり泣きは、次第に止んでいく。
target: The warm yet bittersweet first movement is hidden in the dark night, alone and forlorn. Now, those haunting, ghostly cries have begun to fade away.
Chapter III: Dream of No Return
Chapter III: Dream of No Return
Chapter II: Adrift in Wind and Snow
Chapter II: Adrift in Wind and Snow
Chapter IV: River, Moon, and Farewell
Don't let your jaws drop yet! Hehe... Waaahhh!
Don't let your jaws drop yet! Hehe... Waaahhh!
May this journey bring us closer to the truth.

source: 答えは必ず見つけ出してみせる。
算了，就先調整成這樣吧。
target: All right, a tune-up should do the trick for now.

source: 算了，就先调整成这样吧。
target: All right, a tune-up should do the trick for now.
Yeah, could use a little unwind.

source: 算了，打發一下時間好了。
target: Yeah, could use a little unwind.
Are those little flowers growing inside?
Are those little flowers growing inside?
Who is the caged bird now?

source: 精密、優雅、そして調和。これが古典音楽と科学の間にある共通点…類似的な美しさです。
target: Precision, elegance, and harmony... These are the beautiful parallels between classical music and science.

source: 精密，优雅，和谐，这即是古典乐与科学之间……相似的美感。
target: Precision, elegance, and harmony... These are the beautiful parallels between classical music and science.

source: 精密，優雅，和諧，這即是古典樂與科學之間……相似的美感。
target: Precision, elegance, and harmony... These are the beautiful parallels between classical music and science.
Liberation comes from accepting change and transience.
Liberation comes from accepting change and transience.

source: 糊弄一生的人很多，像白芷这样为追求真理甘愿付出一切的人却少之又少。
target: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

source: 糊弄一生的人很多，像白芷這樣為追求真理甘願付出一切的人卻少之又少。
target: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

source: 紅醋栗的味道……只有它在我腦海中留下了印象。又酸又澀？我倒是覺得還好。或許是吃習慣了……
target: The taste of redcurrants... the only thing that has left an impression on me. Its sour and bitter taste, perhaps? I find it quite tolerable actually. Maybe I've simply grown used to it...

source: 素早く片付けましょう。まだ実験が終わっていませんので。
target: Make this quick. I have experiments underway.

source: 素晴らしい幕開けの知らせだ！さあ、帆を上げよう！
target: With this, the stage is set for a grand opening. Come on, trim the sails!

source: 終点に至るプレリュード。
終着点が、これほど静かとは。
終着点のない旅だとしても
target: Even Should the Path Have No End

source: 組隊？也可以，雖然我習慣了單打獨鬥。
target: So we're teaming up? Fine, though I'm more used to fighting alone.

source: 結晶が明るくなっている。そう、あなたの体温が、こうして手のひらから、私の胸元に伝わってくる。
target: My crystal seems to glow brighter. I sense your warmth on my skin, flowing from your touch, reaching deep inside my chest.

source: 結構更複雜了，但也——能辨識得更為明晰。
target: The structure is more complex, but also... more distinctly identifiable.

source: 給你這個望遠鏡，來，透過它看看……再高的雲都變得觸手可及，怎麼樣，是不是很棒？觀劇時有了它，你不會錯過舞台上的任何一處驚喜；而出海時帶上它，你就能發現大海上的每一塊「新大陸」了！
target: Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea.

source: 給我一個名字，剩下的事，我來做。
target: Name the target. I'll take care of the rest.

source: 給我力量……？你一直都是這麼容易信任別人的嗎？
target: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?

source: 經我鑑定，我現在所向披靡無人能敵！顫抖吧，那群不珍惜古物的傢伙——
target: As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!

source: 綺麗……あ、仕舞っておきますね……！
target: Wow, beautiful… Oh, I'd better put them away first.

source: 綺麗な金色の魂の持ち主だ。品性と人間性の高さも尊敬に値する。
target: Jianxin... her soul has a beautiful golden hue, and she is a person of respectable character.

source: 緋刃凝久而不散，身體竟也如此輕盈……原來揮劍並不是那麼沉重的事。
target: My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands.

source: 緋雪……最後の桜灼の巫女だ。鳴式を討つためとあらば……この刀、そなたに捧げよう。
target: I am Hiyuki, the last Miko of Flaming Sakura. Should you seek to slay the Threnodians, my blade and I stand at your service.

source: 緋雪，最後的灼櫻巫女，若是為了討伐鳴式，我與手中的刀，便都可為你所用。
target: I am Hiyuki, the last Miko of Flaming Sakura. Should you seek to slay the Threnodians, my blade and I stand at your service.

source: 總有一天，劇團會航遍世界的每一個角落。到時候，所有的海潮裡都會高唱著一個共同的故事——那個故事的名字，叫做「愚人」!
target: One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of the Fools!

source: 红醋栗的味道……只有它在我脑海中留下了印象。又酸又涩？我倒是觉得还好。或许是吃习惯了……
target: The taste of redcurrants... the only thing that has left an impression on me. Its sour and bitter taste, perhaps? I find it quite tolerable actually. Maybe I've simply grown used to it...

source: 组队？也可以，虽然我习惯了单打独斗。
target: So we're teaming up? Fine, though I'm more used to fighting alone.

source: 经我鉴定，我现在所向披靡无人能敌！颤抖吧，那群不珍惜古物的家伙——
target: As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!

source: 结构更复杂了，但也——能辨识得更为明晰。
target: The structure is more complex, but also... more distinctly identifiable.

source: 给你这个望远镜，来，透过它看看……再高的云都变得触手可及，怎么样，是不是很棒？观剧时有了它，你不会错过舞台上的任何一处惊喜；而出海时带上它，你就能发现大海上的每一块「新大陆」了！
target: Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea.

source: 给我一个名字，剩下的事，我来做。
target: Name the target. I'll take care of the rest.

source: 给我力量……？你一直都是这么容易信任别人的吗？
target: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?

source: 绯刃凝久而不散，身体竟也如此轻盈……原来挥剑并不是那么沉重的事。
target: My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands.

source: 绯雪，最后的灼樱巫女，若是为了讨伐鸣式，我与手中的刀，便都可为你所用。
target: I am Hiyuki, the last Miko of Flaming Sakura. Should you seek to slay the Threnodians, my blade and I stand at your service.

source: 罪深き者よ、これが結末だ。
美丽的事物之所以美丽……正是因为它终究会消逝。
target: Beautiful beings are beautiful... precisely because of their transiency.

source: 美麗的事物之所以美麗……正是因為它終究會消逝。
target: Beautiful beings are beautiful... precisely because of their transiency.

source: 群星静默，直至找到它们的路。
target: The stars rest in silence, awaiting their fated journey.

source: 群星靜默，直至找到它們的路。
target: The stars rest in silence, awaiting their fated journey.

source: 群青、オレンジ、レモンイエロー、フレッシュグリーン……ねぇ、次は何色かな？
target: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?

source: 群青、炽橙、明黄、新绿……猜猜看，接下来的色彩会是什么？
target: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?

source: 群青、熾橙、明黃、新綠……猜猜看，接下來的色彩會是什麼？
target: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?

source: 翡萨烈现任家主，「毒药」坎特蕾拉。是「毒」，还是「药」，取决于你的用法哦……嘘，不用说出口，当你进入我的海域，周身浮现的波纹，已经将一切都告诉了我。
target: The current head of Fisalia, Cantarella, the Bane. Whether I am the Bane of the wicked or the pure is yours to decide. Shh, no need to answer. The moment you arrived, the ripples that surrounded you told me all I needed to know.

source: 翡薩烈現任家主，「毒藥」坎特蕾拉。是「毒」，還是「藥」，取決於你的用法喔……噓，不用說出口，當你進入我的海域，周身浮現的波紋，已經將一切都告訴了我。
target: The current head of Fisalia, Cantarella, the Bane. Whether I am the Bane of the wicked or the pure is yours to decide. Shh, no need to answer. The moment you arrived, the ripples that surrounded you told me all I needed to know.

source: 老板，今天想咨询什么项目？
target: Boss, what matter do you seek answers for today?

source: 老闆，今天想諮詢什麼項目？
target: Boss, what matter do you seek answers for today?

source: 聖なる響きよ、悪を祓え！

target: With every meeting... comes the inevitable parting. Let's not dwell on it.
With every meeting... comes the inevitable parting. Let's not dwell on it.

source: 聞こえたわ……水の音、せせらぎや雨の音じゃなくて、もっと深い……万物の奥底から滲み出る共鳴、谷川を呼び起こす音。
target: The sound of water... I hear it. Not from the streams, or the falling rain, but from somewhere far deeper. A resonance that seeps from the core of every living thing, waking the hills, waking the waters, one by one.

source: 聞こえますか？しぃ……芽吹きの音です。
target: Can you hear it? Shh... That's the sound of sprouting.
Souls sing in harmony. To the savior's victory!

source: 聴こえたかい？それは、星が大地に落ちる音さ！
target: Hear that? A twinkling star just tinkled to the ground!

source: 聽今州的朋友們說，莫特斐可以做出很多很多好玩的東西！真厲害啊，要不要拜託他做一個會到處亂跳的羊呢……
target: Friends in Jinzhou told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time…
Hear that? A twinkling star just tinkled to the ground!

source: 肉經過煙燻火烤之後，味道有點像……沒什麼。
target: After meat is smoked or roasted, its taste is similar to... Never mind.

source: 肉经过烟熏火烤之后，味道有点像……没什么。
target: After meat is smoked or roasted, its taste is similar to... Never mind.

source: 肉酱烩面好吃，大家围在一起吃的时候它会变得更加好吃，或许……饭就是要大家一起吃才香？
target: Spaghetti Bolognese is great on its own, but it's even better when shared. Maybe... it's the company that makes it taste better?

source: 肉醬燴麵好吃，大家圍在一起吃的時候它會變得更加好吃，或許……飯就是要大家一起吃才香？
target: Spaghetti Bolognese is great on its own, but it's even better when shared. Maybe... it's the company that makes it taste better?

source: 背徳者よ、自らの滅亡を受け入れろ。
胸を張れ！太陽の輝きに！
target: Stand tall before the eternal sun!

source: 能从丹瑾的剑招中感受到一股肃杀的剑气……有点担心这孩子背负了什么太过沉重的东西。
target: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.

source: 能和忧昙做到的事，变得更多了。非唯一的可能性……原来我并不抗拒这样的感受。
target: Your help has opened up a world of potential for You'tan and me. It feels a bit foreign to me to be presented with many options, instead of one single truth... but I rather enjoy this feeling.

source: 能和憂曇做到的事，變得更多了。非唯一的可能性……原來我並不抗拒這樣的感受。
target: Your help has opened up a world of potential for You'tan and me. It feels a bit foreign to me to be presented with many options, instead of one single truth... but I rather enjoy this feeling.

source: 能够更好地操控悬丝了，这都是你的功劳。
target: I have finer control over Zapstring now. It's all credit to you.

source: 能够认识我这等鉴宝大师，你很走运嘛！手头有什么稀奇宝贝，速速呈上来~
target: Huh, you're lucky to have come across me—the undisputed master of antique appraisal! Now, what do we have here? Hand over your goodies and I'll take a look!

source: 能夠更好地操控懸絲了，這都是你的功勞。
target: I have finer control over Zapstring now. It's all credit to you.

source: 能夠認識我這等鑑寶大師，你很走運嘛！手頭有什麼稀奇寶貝，速速呈上來~
target: Huh, you're lucky to have come across me—the undisputed master of antique appraisal! Now, what do we have here? Hand over your goodies and I'll take a look!
Some Loong Whiskers Crisps would be great…

source: 能從丹瑾的劍招中感受到一股肅殺的劍氣……有點擔心這孩子背負了什麼太過沉重的東西。
target: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.
Can I trade these for desserts?
Can I trade these for desserts?

source: 能量更迭，像机杼上的丝线。我看见，你引导它们在我体内连缀，成为全新的部分。
target: The energy within me gathers and evolves... like delicate threads on a loom, meticulously woven by your hands into a new part of my being.

source: 能量更迭，像機杼上的絲線。我看見，你引導它們在我體內連綴，成為全新的部分。
target: The energy within me gathers and evolves... like delicate threads on a loom, meticulously woven by your hands into a new part of my being.

source: 能量飲料算嗎？深潛需要消耗大量的體力和腦力，而它又能及時且高效地填補這些缺失……我離開冰浴後總會喝上一瓶，也算是養成習慣了。
target: Do energy drinks count? A deep dive into the Net saps you fast, in body and mind. Glug down one of those, it's a fast and efficient refuel. Got in the habit of crackin' one open after every ice bath.

source: 能量饮料算吗？深潜需要消耗大量的体力和脑力，而它又能及时且高效的填补这些缺失……我离开冰浴后总会喝上一瓶，也算是养成习惯了。
target: Do energy drinks count? A deep dive into the Net saps you fast, in body and mind. Glug down one of those, it's a fast and efficient refuel. Got in the habit of crackin' one open after every ice bath.
Some Loong Whiskers Crisps would be great…

source: 脅威となるものは、すべて断ち切ってあげる。
target: I will cut down any threat in your way.

source: 臨行前，不妨聽我撫琴一曲。
target: How about a melody before we depart?

source: 自らを惑わす影に立ち向かえるほどの力が、私にあるのでしょうか？
target: Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness?

source: 自分の力で、唯一無二の秘薬を作ることね。海の底に埋もれた幻想を束縛から解いて、誰もが自由に駆け回り、楽しく歌えるようにしてあげたいわ。
target: I've longed to craft a potion like no other. One born of my soul, to free the dreams buried deep below, and let them soar, singing through the waking world.

source: 自分の力は、所詮……いや、これもうまく使えば……
target: A faint power... but still, one that commands attention.

source: 自分を越え、始まりと終わりを迎え……未来を変える、その瞬間まで。
target: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.

source: 自水中上升之后，我看到了金色的光芒……你给予我如此深重的恩典与教诲，也请允许我予以回应……你的愿望，亦是指引着我的福音。
target: Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear.

source: 自水中上升之後，我看到了金色的光芒……你給予我如此深重的恩典與教誨，也請允許我予以回應……你的願望，亦是指引著我的福音。
target: Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear.

source: 自然の贈り物ですね。大事にしましょう？
target: It's nature's gift! Let's keep it well.

source: 自由を求める放浪騎士
target: The Wandering Knight Marches To Freedom
Stand tall before the eternal sun!
Stand tall before the eternal sun!

source: 與植入體和軟體的升級不同……這種感覺，還真是奇妙。
target: Not like any upgrade I've ever had, hardware or soft. It's like... my whole system's hummin'.

source: 舞い散る桜よ、すべて妾のもとに。
target: May the sakura incinerate. Burn this self away.

All the world's a stage.
PERO: Pero! Hmph!

All the world's a stage.
PERO: Pero! Hmph!
The course is determined. Time to set sail!
The course is determined. Time to set sail!

source: 航海の第一歩は、進路を決めること。そこから先は、臨機応変だ！
target: When sailing the seas, always remember to set your course first, and then... adapt to whatever comes your way!

source: 航路に異常なし、出航の時間だ！
target: The course is determined. Time to set sail!

source: 花の養分にしてあげる！
芽生え……それは命の始まりです。本当の奇跡は、これからですよ？
target: Sprouting marks the inception of a plant's journey, a tiny miracle in motion.

source: 苍翎会飞过天际，飞过旷野，它会抵达前人未至的沧海彼岸，会架起一道……连接万音的桥梁。
target: These wings will soar across the skies and the wilds, reach shores no one has set foot on before... and build a bridge that channels all voices of the world.

source: 若是感到迷茫，就跟上青龍的旌旗。
target: Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.

source: 若是感到迷茫，就跟上青龙的旌旗。
target: Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.

source: 若是有日，关外不再需要一位将军，我的愿望便是实现了吧。
target: If one day, the borderlands no longer need a general, I suppose my wish will have come true.

source: 若是有日，關外不再需要一位將軍，我的願望便是實現了吧。
target: If one day, the borderlands no longer need a general, I suppose my wish will have come true.

source: 若这还不够铺平前路，那就以这万里河山，来为我的心作注。
target: If this isn't enough to pave the way, then let the rivers and mountains be the proof of what I'm willing to wager.

source: 若這還不夠鋪平前路，那就以這萬里河山，來為我的心作注。
target: If this isn't enough to pave the way, then let the rivers and mountains be the proof of what I'm willing to wager.

source: 苦労した甲斐がありましたね。
苦手な食べ物は……特にありませんね。強いて言うなら……食卓に一人きりだと、どんなご馳走でも少し味気なく感じてしまう……ような気がします。
target: Food I dislike? Hm... I'm not a picky eater. But when it comes down to it... eating alone makes the heartiest meal taste bland.

source: 英雄の物語は、吟遊詩人が語り継いでいくものさ。でも、そこに喝采や花束は必要ない。なぜなら私は、ただの語り部に過ぎないからね。はじめまして、伝説の大英雄さん。私のことはシャコンヌと呼んでほしい。
target: Bards are the couriers of heroes' tales. No need for applause or flowers. I'm just a storyteller like any other. Nice to meet you, great hero. You can call me Ciaccona.

source: 英雄的故事将被吟游诗人一直传唱下去，不必为我喝彩和献上鲜花，我不过是传唱者的普通一员，初次见面，传闻中的大英雄，你可以叫我夏空。
target: Bards are the couriers of heroes' tales. No need for applause or flowers. I'm just a storyteller like any other. Nice to meet you, great hero. You can call me Ciaccona.

source: 英雄的故事將被吟遊詩人一直傳唱下去，不必為我喝彩和獻上鮮花，我不過是傳唱者的普通一員。初次見面，傳聞中的大英雄，你可以叫我夏空。
target: Bards are the couriers of heroes' tales. No need for applause or flowers. I'm just a storyteller like any other. Nice to meet you, great hero. You can call me Ciaccona.

source: 華胥研究員，白芷。讓我看看吧，由相遇推導出的必然性。
target: I am Baizhi, a researcher at the Huaxu Academy. Let me witness where this encounter will take us.

source: 華胥研究院安全科，莫特斐。若想改良黑石武器，可以來我的科室。不過，在敲門之前，你最好先想清楚自己的需求合不合理。
target: Mortefi, researcher at Department of Safety, Huaxu Academy. For inquiries about Tacetite weapons, you may visit my lab. Make sure you know what you're talking about, though, before knocking at my door.

source: 華胥研究院安全課のモルトフィーです。黒石武器の改良をご所望であれば、私のオフィスに来てください。ただし、ドアをノックする前に、その依頼が合理的かどうか、しっかり考えてくださいね。
target: Mortefi, researcher at Department of Safety, Huaxu Academy. For inquiries about Tacetite weapons, you may visit my lab. Make sure you know what you're talking about, though, before knocking at my door.

source: 華胥研究院所属、白芷よ。この出会いの意味を見せてもらいましょう。
target: I am Baizhi, a researcher at the Huaxu Academy. Let me witness where this encounter will take us.

source: 萌芽，这是生命的起点，从这一刻起，就可以期待一个奇迹。
target: Sprouting marks the inception of a plant's journey, a tiny miracle in motion.

source: 萌芽，這是生命的起點，從這一刻起，就可以期待一個奇跡。
target: Sprouting marks the inception of a plant's journey, a tiny miracle in motion.
All my will, in one strike.

source: 萬頃琉璃鏡，一色水雲清。
target: Mirrored by water, tinted in blue.

source: 葱茏烟渚外，空濛山雨行。
target: Beyond lush haze, the rainfall marches.

source: 蒼い翼は、空を、荒野を越え……誰もたどり着いたことのない、海の彼方まで飛んでいくでしょう。そして、いつか架けるのです――あまねく音を繋ぐ、ひとつの橋を。
