target: These wings will soar across the skies and the wilds, reach shores no one has set foot on before... and build a bridge that channels all voices of the world.

source: 蒼翎會飛過天際，飛過曠野，它會抵達前人未至的滄海彼岸，會架起一道……連接萬音的橋梁。
target: These wings will soar across the skies and the wilds, reach shores no one has set foot on before... and build a bridge that channels all voices of the world.

source: 蔥蘢煙渚外，空濛山雨行。
target: Beyond lush haze, the rainfall marches.

source: 蕴藏潜力的种子在哪里？
target: Where are you, my lovely seeds?

source: 薄々と感じていました。あなたも、守りたい物がありますね。それこそ一歩たりとも引けない、死力を尽せるほどの何かが……
target: I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes.

source: 薄っぺらいファイアウォールね。
蘊藏潛力的種子在哪裡？
target: Where are you, my lovely seeds?

source: 虚無さえ断ち切ります！
虽然作为医生来说他身上的谜团多了点，但作为同事他的能力是值得信赖的。
target: He's got just a few too many mysteries for a doctor... But as a colleague, his skills speak for themselves. And that's what I trust.

source: 虽然安可有很多朋友，但还是会做只有安可一个人的梦。妈妈不在身边，黑咩白咩都是安可的幻想……不好意思，可以给安可一个拥抱吗？
target: I've got lots of friends now, but sometimes in my dreams, I'm still all alone. Mommy's not with me anymore, and they say Cosmos and Cloudy are just my imaginary friends… Erm. C-can you hug me a little?

source: 虽然年纪相仿，却比我高上一头，她那个玉佩，苍翠欲滴，还怪好看的！只可惜，我从中感受到的频率，都是不圆满的……
target: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...

source: 虽然总想着为大家做到更多更多，但超出承受的限度……反而会给自己、给无法回馈的他人造成困扰吧？
target: I want to do as much as I can for everyone in need, but if I take on more than I can handle... I guess it would only trouble those on the receiving end of my help, and burden me further.

source: 虽然我已经很强了，但还是谢谢啦！
target: Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!

source: 虽然我见识过你的本事，不担心你会倒在堂堂正正的战斗之中……但是，这个世界上除了我之外，还有很多不按常理出牌的人，记得要小心不要在阴沟里翻船哦~
target: I've seen what you're capable of, so I'm not worried about you in a fair fight. That being said, not everyone plays fair. Just watch your back out there... wouldn't want you to get caught off your game.

source: 虽然接触不多，但从他的言谈举止，可以看出是很有品位的人呢！希望他哪天能来照顾照顾我的鉴宝生意。
target: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!

source: 虽然现在不会有那么强的副作用，但阿列夫一要是能少在我脑子里嘀咕些听不懂的就好了。
target: Well, the side effects aren't as bad now, but I'd give anything for Aleph-1 to just stop mumbling nonsense in my head.

source: 虽然看样子有点像抑制剂，但作用上却完全不同啊。
target: Looked like a standard immunoblocker, but this stuff feels totally different.

source: 虽说“师不必贤于弟子”，但终究是我获益多，你获益少。徒儿，我该如何补偿你？
target: They say a master need not outshine their student. Even so, I've learned far more from you than I ever taught. Tell me, my disciple... how shall I make it up to you?

source: 虽说本大师鉴宝是良心价，但出场费可不一定哦。
target: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!

source: 衆生の願い、この身に宿さん。
target: For all wishes spoken, this vessel I offer.

source:
行く先で敵を討ち滅ぼす雷光を見つけた時は、少し気が楽になります。
……お恥ずかしながら、「吟霖」というのも、ずっと後になってから知った名前ですね。
target:
The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze.
Though, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so.

source: 行こう。霧はいつも、君の傍にある。
target: It's go time! You'll have my mist for escort.

source: 行こうな、てっぺんまで
target: Let's Go, All the Way To the Top of Arasaka Tower
Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.
Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.

source: 被毒药腌渍过头的、甜到发腻的苹果。亮晶晶的糖壳包裹不住枯萎腐烂的味道。
target: Apples soaked in poison for too long. They become sickeningly sweet. Even the glossy sugar shell cannot mask the scent of decay beneath.

source: 被毒藥醃漬過頭的、甜到發膩的蘋果。亮晶晶的糖殼包裹不住枯萎腐爛的味道。
target: Apples soaked in poison for too long. They become sickeningly sweet. Even the glossy sugar shell cannot mask the scent of decay beneath.
I should... Give it my all...

source: 要不要和人家來玩一場？我保證，會讓你看到比之前幾次更有趣的招式，更強大的力量！
target: Hey, care to join me for another round? I'll show you a whole bunch of new tricks and powers, promise!

source: 要不要和人家来玩一场？我保证，会让你看到比之前几次更有趣的招式，更强大的力量！
target: Hey, care to join me for another round? I'll show you a whole bunch of new tricks and powers, promise!

source: 要來壺紫絨絲花汁嗎？可以舒緩疲憊，安撫你緊繃的神經……別總是那麼操勞，幫助別人的同時，也要照顧好自己喔。
target: Can I mix you a jug of Violaca juice? It soothes nerves and eases fatigue. You must learn to relax. You can't help others if you don't take care of yourself, you know.

source: 要去哪裡呢？我可以帶路。
target: Where to? I can lead the way for you.

source: 要去哪里呢？我可以带路。
target: Where to? I can lead the way for you.
New goodies to see? I'm in!
New goodies to see? I'm in!
If it's a duel you want...

source: 要是能像天空中的流云就好了，没有任何烦恼。
target: Sometimes I pretend I was a cloud in the sky... Just drifting by as a soft and fluffy pile, without any worry.

source: 要是能像天空中的流雲就好了，沒有任何煩惱。
target: Sometimes I pretend I was a cloud in the sky... Just drifting by as a soft and fluffy pile, without any worry.

source: 要来壶紫绒丝花汁吗？可以舒缓疲惫，安抚你紧绷的神经……别总是那么操劳，帮助别人的同时，也要照顾好自己哦。
target: Can I mix you a jug of Violaca juice? It soothes nerves and eases fatigue. You must learn to relax. You can't help others if you don't take care of yourself, you know.
If it's a duel you want...
Betting my life? Counting on it.
Betting my life? Counting on it.

source: 見えざる者にだけ見える物
見た目はただの抑制剤っぽいけど、効果は全然違うんだな。
target: Looked like a standard immunoblocker, but this stuff feels totally different.

source: 見つけたのはあなた。私はとやかく言わないわ。
target: You found it, and it's yours to keep.

source: 見つけに行こう。まだ見ぬ世界へ。

target: Don't blink... you'll miss the best part!

source: 見て！小さな実ができました！でも……奇跡はまだ終わりません。
target: Look, it's bearing tiny fruits! Another miracle, but the journey of a plant doesn't end here.

source: 見に行かないのかしら？

target: Lost in the mist of time.

source: 見到我很意外嗎？哈哈，別緊張嘛，我說過我們會再見面的。
target: Surprised to see me? Haha, relax. I told you we'd meet again.

source: 見聞を広めるのも大事なことです。
視界をオーバーライド。
覚悟はできておろうな？
target: You've prepared for this, have you not?

source: 见到我很意外吗？哈哈，别紧张嘛，我说过我们会再见面的。
target: Surprised to see me? Haha, relax. I told you we'd meet again.

source: 言葉だけでは、感謝の気持ちを伝えきれない。だから私は、あなたのために戦う――強力な剣と強固な盾、どっちが必要かな？
target: Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything?
Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.

source: 訓練後にセブン・ヒルズの温かいお湯に浸かることだな。アレは疲労回復によく効くぜ。相棒も試してみないか？
target: I love going to the Septimont baths after a training session. The warm water does wonders for easing weariness. You should give it a try.

source: 記憶よ、形を変えなさい！

記憶を失っても、人のために全力を尽くす……
そんな方は良い人に違いありません。どうやら……あなたを切ることが無さそうです。
target: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.
A new page in my journal!

source: 許多人說夜歸就是關外的一顆定心丸。在我眼中，夜歸更像是一把手術刀，職責便是清除病灶。你問我是什麼？我想是執刀之人吧。
target: The Midnight Rangers are a source of solace for many, while I see them as a scalpel, with the duty of eradicating maladies. Me? I am the hand that guides this scalpel, I suppose.
You dare test me? The insolence.

source: 試練はまだまだ続きます。

試試看？像這樣——喏。
飛得很遠喔，厲害！
target:
Give it a try? Like this. Here.
It flew so far! Impressive!

source: 詩のインスピレーションが湧いてきた！

target: The poems will be sung again…

source: 詭計も戦争に不可欠だ。
話の通じない相手には、力で理解してもらうしかないもの。だから、最近は新しいビームの撃ち方を研究中よ。
target: When you can't reason with the bad guys, let your weapons do the talking! That's why I've been working on new laser beam arrays!
Time to get back to work.

source: 該給這篇故事寫上結尾了，寫給你我旅途中經歷的一切，最終章的標題就叫——未完待續。
target: Time to end this story, the tale of all our adventures together. And there it is, the title of the final chapter: "To be Continued."
Time to bring out my A-game.

source: 誉れはモンテリと共に。
誕生日……特別な日だ。おめでとう。悩み事があれば、今日に限り、特別価格で「解決」してやってもいい。
target: Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.

source: 誕生日おめでとう、我が友よ！今日の予定は空いているか？たまには息抜きも大切だ。よし、海に行こうじゃないか。舵は任せたぞ、キャプテン。水平線の彼方へ向かって、いざ出発だ！
target: Happy birthday, my dear friend! Got any plans today? How about slipping away with me for a little adventure? I'll even let you take the helm. Here, hold on tight—together, we'll sail into the far horizon!

source: 誕生日おめでとう！これ、あたしが作ったごった煮！特別に「王者ラージャン」増し増しにしたよ。熱いうちに食べて、辛さを味わってほしいな！辛い物が一番美味しいからね！
target: Happy Birthday! Try this, I made this bow of Maocai all by myself, with extra Victor Savor added just for you. Eat up while it's still steamin'! Don't worry about the spiciness, it's a good omen!

source:
誕生日？……そう、あなたの。
……
プレゼントや祝福が欲しいなら、ずっと待ち続けるといいわ。待っている時間も、プレゼントと言うでしょう。
target:
Your birthday? Today, you say? Oh.
…
Well, if you're expecting a present or some kind wishes, then simply wait here. A long wait can be considered a gift in itself.

source: 語義落下的時候，符文就會亮起來。
target: When the True Name is unveiled, the rune illuminates.

source: 誠信為本，顧客至上，多多惠顧喔。
target: Credibility in the name, and customer satisfaction is the game.

source: 誰かの物語が存在するな。
誰が近づいていいって？
誰も見てませんし、大丈夫ですよぉ。
target: Make sure no one sees it.
Who is the caged bird now?
Please don't stay too far away from me.
Sleep, in the whispers of sirens.

source: 請烈陽見證，榮耀終將為你我俯首。
target: With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us.

source: 謎の答えはすぐ近くだよ。
謎解きなら、わたしに任せて。

target: A reward for solving a riddle.

source: 謝謝你的協助……我漸漸開始習慣了。
target: 'Preciate the assist... I'm startin' to get used to this.

source: 謝謝你的善意啦！我能明顯感覺到自己變強了！
target: Thanks, choom! Now that's what I call a solid tune-up!

source: 謝謝你，我會讓從你這裡得到的光輝照亮更多的人。
target: Thanks to you, my light will shine upon those in need.

source: 護衛の役目なら、安心して私に任せなさい。
target: You can trust me to keep you safe.

source: 護衛的職責，放心交給我吧。
target: You can trust me to keep you safe.

source: 變成大人了就得每天板著臉了，知道了嗎？大人們很辛苦的！
target: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!

source: 變量參數，實證數據，潛在機率……我會把這些都考慮進去，提升我們的行動效率。
target: Variable parameters, empirical data, potential probabilities... I'll take all of these into consideration to improve our efficiency.
Outta my way! I want a look!

source: 讓我印象深刻的冒險？那可太多了，你要聽哪一個？要不然，這回我們就從一次古老的、持續了百年的審判開始講起吧。
target: Unforgettable adventures? Where to start? How about an ancient trial that spanned over a century?

source: 讓我猜猜裡面有什麼好東西。
target: Aaand… What's inside mystery box No. 01!?

source: 讓我看看……嗯，今天也有好好生長呢。
target: Wow, such a rare species! It's my lucky day!

source: 讓我算算這裡的氣運如何，嗯……哦？唉……哈，我就知道！
target: Let me check the feng shui here… hmm… oh? Ah... Ha! I knew it!

source: 讓這巨浪更高一點！有了你的力量，這浪花不過是表演的小小助興！
target: With your strength, this massive wave is just a splash in our show! Bring it on!
Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.
Outta my way! I want a look!

source: 让我印象深刻的冒险？那可太多了，你要听哪一个？要不然，这回我们就从一次古老的持续了百年的审判开始讲起吧。
target: Unforgettable adventures? Where to start? How about an ancient trial that spanned over a century?

source: 让我猜猜里面有什么好东西。
target: Aaand… What's inside mystery box No. 01!?

source: 让我看看……嗯，今天也有好好生长呢。
target: Wow, such a rare species! It's my lucky day!

source: 让我算算这里的气运如何，嗯……哦？唉……哈，我就知道！
target: Let me check the feng shui here… hmm… oh? Ah... Ha! I knew it!

source: 让这巨浪更高一点！有了你的力量，这浪花不过是表演的小小助兴！
target: With your strength, this massive wave is just a splash in our show! Bring it on!
A new page in my journal!

source: 许多人说夜归就是关外的一颗定心丸。在我眼中，夜归更像是一把手术刀，职责便是清除病灶。你问我是什么？我想是执刀之人吧。
target: The Midnight Rangers are a source of solace for many, while I see them as a scalpel, with the duty of eradicating maladies. Me? I am the hand that guides this scalpel, I suppose.
You dare test me? The insolence.

source:
试试看？像这样——喏。
飞得很远哦，厉害！
target:
Give it a try? Like this. Here.
It flew so far! Impressive!
The poems will be sung again…

source: 诚信为本，顾客至上，多多惠顾哦。
target: Credibility in the name, and customer satisfaction is the game.
Time to get back to work.

source: 该给这篇故事写上结尾了，写给你我旅途中经历的一切，最终章的标题就叫——未完待续。
target: Time to end this story, the tale of all our adventures together. And there it is, the title of the final chapter: "To be Continued."
Time to bring out my A-game.

source: 语义落下的时候，符文就会亮起来。
target: When the True Name is unveiled, the rune illuminates.

source: 诶、诶！羊咩快让让，让安可看看，诶呀！嗨嗨，黑海岸安可，前来报到咯！
target: Woah! Hey! Woolies, make some room! I wanna look, see? ...Black Shores member, Encore, reporting in!

source: 诶，都是给我的吗？你很有眼光嘛！
target: Geez, you're actually giving me all of these? Good call!
Please don't stay too far away from me.
Sleep, in the whispers of sirens.

source: 请烈阳见证，荣耀终将为你我俯首。
target: With the blazing sun as witness... Glory, bow before us.
Who is the caged bird now?

source: 谢谢你的协助……我渐渐开始习惯了。
target: 'Preciate the assist... I'm startin' to get used to this.

source: 谢谢你的善意啦！我能明显感觉到自己变强了！
target: Thanks, choom! Now that's what I call a solid tune-up!

source: 谢谢你，我会让从你这里得到的光辉，照亮更多的人。
target: Thanks to you, my light will shine upon those in need.

source: 賑やかな営みが、すべてこの目に。
target: World's warm breath, in my sight.

source: 贊妮是洛可可心中大人應該有的樣子，和她合作好輕鬆、好愉快、好有安全感，完全不用擔心出意外……
target: Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong...

source: 赞妮是洛可可心中大人应该有的样子，和她合作好轻松、好愉快、好有安全感，完全不用担心出意外……
target: Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong...

source: 赤い髪の、あの派遣の事か？しつこいクライアントに対応する独自の術があるとか……うちの迷惑客にも、一度試したいものだね。
target: The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.

source: 赤が黒に染まっていく……
赤く燃える鳥は、いつか森へと帰る
走吧，去拿下属于我们的胜利。
走吧，去拿下屬於我們的勝利。
走吧，去登上荒坂塔的頂端
target: Let's Go, All the Way To the Top of Arasaka Tower

source: 走吧，去登上荒坂塔的顶端
target: Let's Go, All the Way To the Top of Arasaka Tower

source: 越过我，越过原初和终焉，直至……改写未来。
target: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.

source: 越过风雨，向美好献上颂歌…此时此刻，是云雀离天空最近的时候。
target: I dedicate my song to brilliance, braving the raging storm. The skylark in me has never soared higher into the heavens.

source: 越過我，越過原初和終焉，直至……改寫未來。
target: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.

source: 越過風雨，向美好獻上頌歌…此時此刻，是雲雀離天空最近的時候。
target: I dedicate my song to brilliance, braving the raging storm. The skylark in me has never soared higher into the heavens.

source: 足りねぇ、まだ足りねぇ……もっかいだ、相棒！勝負してくれ！
target: More... Get me more... One more round, Warrior! I want a rematch!

source: 跑吧，跑吧……欸？你真跑掉啦？哼，算你運氣好。
target: Better start running. Oh? You actually got away. Hmph, lucky for you.

source: 跑吧，跑吧……诶？你真跑掉啦？哼，算你运气好。
target: Better start running. Oh? You actually got away. Hmph, lucky for you.

source: 路途还很遥远，继续前进吧。
target: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.

source: 路途還很遙遠，繼續前進吧。
target: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.

source: 踏罡合度，步轉陰陽，地脈天罡的氣機流轉已皆在我身！
target: I walk the star steps, from Yin to Yang. The pulse of earth and the breath of heaven are now with me.

source: 踏罡合度，步转阴阳，地脉天罡的气机流转已皆在我身！
target: I walk the star steps, from Yin to Yang. The pulse of earth and the breath of heaven are now with me.

source: 身体中で優しくて暖かい炎が燃え上がるのを感じる……これが、あんたの力なのか？
target: I've become a Human Torch! I am flame! With this power, I can now protect everyone, including someone as strong as you!

source: 身体在回应……以细微得几乎听不见的频率，就像刀锋被重新打磨的那一瞬。嗯，状态不错，精准，且如臂使指。
target: My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm.

source: 身體在回應……以細微得幾乎聽不見的頻率，就像刀鋒被重新打磨的那一瞬。嗯，狀態不錯，精準，且如臂使指。
target: My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm.

source: 躯体中蕴藏的力量，曾让我感到恐惧。如果被它吞噬，我将成为怎样可怖的怪物？……这些噩梦，因你在身侧而逐渐消失。
target: The power within me once terrified me. I wondered how monstrous I'd become if it consumed me... But such terrors have started to fade, with you by my side.

source: 軀體中蘊藏的力量，曾讓我感到恐懼。如果被它吞噬，我將成為怎樣可怖的怪物？……這些噩夢，因你在身側而逐漸消失。
target: The power within me once terrified me. I wondered how monstrous I'd become if it consumed me... But such terrors have started to fade, with you by my side.

source: 軍を率いる事は決して容易いことではない。俺も自分の決断を疑うことがあった。でも、これからはお前が傍にいてくれる。それだけで心強い。
target: Commanding an army is not a simple task, and sometimes I find myself questioning my own decisions. Going forward, with you staying by my side, I should feel more at ease.

source: 輕飄飄、慢悠悠…你會飄向哪裡?
target: Buoyant and languid... where will the wind take you?

source: 轻飘飘、慢悠悠…你会飘向哪里?
target: Buoyant and languid... where will the wind take you?

source: 迅雷よ、幽鬼を討ち滅ぼせ！

target: Luck does seem to favor you.

source: 还不能停下……正因目睹过故土的沉沦，我才更为清楚，唯有烈阳长照天际，黑暗才能无所遁形。
target: I will not stop here... My hometown's fall revealed the truth: only with the everblazing sun can darkness have nowhere to hide.
There has to be more. Right?

source: 还有这种提升力量的途径……多谢。
target: An unusual way to gain strength... thanks.

source: 还能有这么棒的提升……再多教教我吧！
target: Didn't think I could get this big of an upgrade... Don't hold back on me now!

source: 这一次，我和忧昙会护大家周全。
target: You'tan and I will ensure your safety.
This path... I'll walk no further.

source: 这一章，就叫《骑士的大丰收》吧？
target: Let's call it... A Knight's Great Harvest.
That... I'll mark on my ledger.

source: 这下有力气继续赶稿了。
target: Now I've got the energy to work on my commissions.

source: 这世间烟火……终是没看尽。
target: The world's sweet noise... I wanted more.

source: 这个人偶叫做悬丝，虽然本身其实是人偶制作师练习制作时候用的大路货，但被我改造成适合战斗的样子。虽然已经很旧了，但却是用得最顺手的。
target: This puppet? I call it Zapstring. It used to be a basic puppet made by some novice, but I've revamped it for battle. It hasn't let me down yet, despite its wear and tear.

source: 这个相片盒是爸爸送给我的礼物，我原本以为它早已和那艘商船一起沉入大海，但它又回到了我的手中，这对于我来说……是不敢再奢望更多的奇迹了。
target: This locket was a gift from my father. I always thought it had sunk with that merchant ship, but here it is again in my hands. This itself is already a miracle... I cannot ask for more.

source: 这个箱子是百宝箱，也是休息室，里面很宽敞。除了保存收集到的宝贝，洛可可还在里面做了很多有趣的东西。我想邀请你进去参观。佩洛开门，佩洛开门。
target: Pero's box is more than just a treasure trove. It's my private lounge as well. It's bigger than you might think, and I've stashed all my nifty gadgets inside. Would you like a tour? Knock, knock—open up, Pero.

source: 这些东西……能派上用场吧。
这些够用吗？要是还缺什么，跟我说。
target: Would these be enough for your needs? Tell me if there is anything else you want.

source: 这份力量，定能守护下更多愿望。
target: With this strength, I shall safeguard more wishes.

source: 这十几年来，我还未尝一败。双眼失明不会影响我的剑术，反倒是让我能将一切都倾注在一把剑上……真想和你比上一比。
target: For all these years, I've never tasted defeat. Being blind hasn't dulled me. In fact, it sharpens my focus on swordplay. If the opportunity arises, I'd welcome a duel with you.

source: 这双眼睛……既是奇迹，也是诅咒。如果有可能摆脱……不，没有这样的可能。如果必定终身与它如影相随，那么我就压制它一生，将它变成为己所用的武器。
target: This vision... is both a miracle and a curse. If I could ever get rid of it… No, there is no such possibility. If I must endure it for life, then I will turn it into a weapon for my use.

source: 这可不是在偷懒呀，只是稍微地充充电……诶~不相信吗，如果被你怀疑的话，姐姐会伤心的哦。
target: I wasn't slacking off, really. I just needed to recharge a little... Aww, you don't believe me? Don't say that. I'll be so hurt.
Is that the best you can do?
Karma has caught up to me...

source: 这并非偶然，也不是什么巧合所致。死局已出现裂口，这次……仍然并肩而战吧。
target: This wasn't by chance, nor was it coincidental. The deadlock has cracked. We'll fight alongside each other... just like before.
This sword... shall not be shattered!

source: 这把剑，将循你的意志而动。
target: This sword shall follow your will.

source: 这把长枪……凝聚了万千夜归将士的信念，给予了我再度启程的力量。平定纷乱，抵御外忧，即是这长枪的意义。
target: This spear was modeled after the weapon of Captain Beiwang, bearing the significance of quelling chaos and warding off external threats.

source: 这是……摇曳着波光的海面上，遥远的晴空。
target: The sparkling sea knows no bounds.

source: 这是……最后的华彩。你赋予了它改变，真是出人意料……既然如此，不如坐下来，听我把这首完整的曲子演奏完成。这次有时间了吗？
target: This is... the final flourish. You've given it an unexpected change... Since that's the case, why not sit and listen as I play the full composition to its end? Do you have time now?
A reward for solving a riddle.
Hehe... How do you like this flower?

source: 这条手链是过去你送给我的礼物。用处……我想应该是为了监测我的频率状态，如果我在某处出了什么问题，你就能顺着信号找到我。很方便吧？但这么多年过去，它早就损坏了呢……
target: This bracelet was a gift from you. I remember it's meant to monitor my frequency. Then in case I'm in trouble, you can find me. Convenient, right? It's been broken for years now, though...
Can I keep going like this?

source: 这次一定能开出好东西！
target: Ohhh... please have something good this time!

source: 这次你似乎选择了保守之策，下次可以试着打破常规。
target: So you have opted for a prudent strategy this time. Next time, maybe we can consider something more unconventional.

source: 这次可不是故事里的“宝箱怪”。
target: Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time.
Phew. In the nick of time.
Hmm. What's it gonna be this time?
Who will be sitting on the other side of the board this time?

source: 这次轮到我当学生了吗？
target: So it's my turn to be the student this time?

source: 这种程度的力量，应该能守护好古物的价值了……多亏有你，吾道不孤……啊啊啊有点肉麻，说不出口啦！
target: Such power should allow me to protect all the antiques in the world... Thanks to you, I'm no longer fighting alone... Ack! Nope. This is too embarrassing to say out loud!

source: 这缕剑意已将你我的身心相连，既然承了你的恩惠，今后便让我反哺于你吧。
target: This Sword Intent has bound us together. Let this strength stay with you, in return for all you have given me.

source: 这股力量虽有些不可思议，却让我感到十分的安心。
target: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.

source: 这股神奇的力量……如果能用在黑石相关的研究上，进展肯定能快不少……
target: Such mystical power... If applied to Tacetite research, our progress will be remarkable.
Such beauty... so too must it end.
This is far from the finale…
This ensemble... rather interesting, I must say.

target: During back-to-back academic conferences, my focus wanes and I need time to recharge. Being with peers is enjoyable, but a little solitude is necessary for me to stay sharp.

退屈な相手ね……消えなさい！
适应之后，这股力量又强大又柔顺，倒是和雷煌拳有共通之处。

Run. I'll erase you at the finish line.

source: 這雙眼睛……既是奇跡，也是詛咒。如果有可能擺脫……不，沒有這樣的可能。如果必定終身與它如影相隨，那麼我就壓制它一生，將它變成為己所用的武器。
target: This vision... is both a miracle and a curse. If I could ever get rid of it… No, there is no such possibility. If I must endure it for life, then I will turn it into a weapon for my use.

source: 通してはくれないのね……
速やかに片付けましょう。
速战速决吧，我的实验还没做完呢。
target: Make this quick. I have experiments underway.

source: 速戰速決吧，我的實驗還沒做完呢。
target: Make this quick. I have experiments underway.

source: 連續參加數場耗時過長的學術會議後，注意力總有些渙散。 我並不抗拒和同行者們相處，但……還是需要片刻獨處緩衝。
target: During back-to-back academic conferences, my focus wanes and I need time to recharge. Being with peers is enjoyable, but a little solitude is necessary for me to stay sharp.

source: 進むのだ、さらに遠くへ！
進む道がはっきりと見えた。

target: Luck does seem to favor you.

source: 運命が仕組んだこの出会いで、わたくしはこうしてオファーを提示しました。断ることなどできますまい。
target: Fate has led you to me, and considering the terms I'm offering… You wouldn't refuse me, would you?
There is... much to be done...
Luck does seem to favor you.

source: 過去の幻よ……現れなさい！
target: Illusions of the past... Step forward!

source: 道がどこへ通じていようと、この一戦に全力をかけます。
target: No matter where this leads… This battle, I'm all in.

source: 道すがらの風景とか、出会った面白い人とか記録するために、いつも旅行手帳を持ち歩いてるんだ。文章にできなければ、絵を描いてみたりなんかもしてるよ。ただ、そうやって色々と記録してるせいか、ブブ物流に入ってから、何冊使い切ったかわかんないんだよね……
target: I jot down all the interesting sights, people, and events in my travel journal. If words don't cut it, I sketch it out. I've filled up so many journals since joining Lollo Logistics!

source: 道を見つけるまで、星々は黙したまま。
target: The stars rest in silence, awaiting their fated journey.

source: 道間違えちゃったかも……
遠くの地から帰還を果たしたあなたは、命あるものに新風を吹き込んだ。私はそれを通じて、かつて理解できなかった境地に辿り着いた。
target: Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach.

source: 遠慮せずもらっておきなさい。
遣其欲而心自静，澄其心而神自清。
target: Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.

source: 遣其欲而心自靜，澄其心而神自清。
target: Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.

source: 適應之後，這股力量又強大又柔順，倒是和雷煌拳有共通之處。
target: Now that I've gotten used to it, this power feels robust and flexible. It does have something in common with my Leihuangquan.

source: 選擇與長夜同行，我從未後悔。
target: I have never regretted braving the long night.

source: 還不能停下……正因目睹過故土的沉淪，我才更為清楚，唯有烈陽長照天際，黑暗才能無所遁形。
target: I will not stop here... My hometown's fall revealed the truth: only with the everblazing sun can darkness have nowhere to hide.
There has to be more. Right?

source: 還有這種提升力量的途徑……多謝。
target: An unusual way to gain strength... thanks.

source: 還能有這麼棒的提升……再多教教我吧！
target: Didn't think I could get this big of an upgrade... Don't hold back on me now!

source: 那个叫相里要的家伙……迟早有一天，我会超越他，创造出更伟大的发明！
target: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!

source: 那个小女孩，是叫秧秧吧？有时我能听见她在小声哼唱……她的歌声，有着让人心情平静的神奇能力。
target: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.

source: 那个小道士还蛮有趣的。虽然她现在身上有不少无聊的人情味，但那种属于山林间兽类的纯粹和野性，总是会不经意间显露出来哦。
target: That girl, the Taoist? She's a fun one to watch. She may seem to follow human society's boring norms, but her untamed spirit still shines through every now and then.

source: 那么，让我们向彼此展现价值吧。
target: Let's prove our value to each other.

source: 那位紅頭髮的外籍研究員？聽說他有一套對付古怪甲方的方法，其實……有時候挺想拜託他幫我打發下那種難纏的客戶。
target: The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.

source: 那位红头发的外籍研究员？听说他有一套对付古怪甲方的方法，其实……有时候挺想拜托他帮我打发下那种难缠的客户。
target: The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.

source: 那個叫相里要的傢伙……遲早有一天，我會超越他，創造出更偉大的發明！
target: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!

source: 那個小女孩，是叫秧秧吧？有時我能聽見她在小聲哼唱……她的歌聲，有著讓人心情平靜的神奇能力。
target: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.

source: 那個小道士還蠻有趣的。雖然她現在身上有不少無聊的人情味，但那種屬於山林間獸類的純粹和野性，總是會不經意間顯露出來。
target: That girl, the Taoist? She's a fun one to watch. She may seem to follow human society's boring norms, but her untamed spirit still shines through every now and then.

source: 那面鏡子嗎……啊咧咧那可不得了！不可說，不可說呀！
target: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!

source: 那面镜子吗……啊咧咧那可不得了！不可说，不可说呀！
target: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!

source: 那麼，讓我們向彼此展現價值吧。
target: Let's prove our value to each other.
Please have them. I hope they will prove useful.
Please have them. I hope they will prove useful.

source: 酒の味がするもの全般。よくわかんないけど、なんか……気持ち悪い。
target: I don't like boozy stuff. Why? ...I don't know. It just makes me... uncomfortable.
The loot we find is not part of my pay. It's all yours.
The loot we find is not part of my pay. It's all yours.

source: 釉瑚ちゃんが荷物を送る時は毎回必ず保険を掛けるんだよね。きっとすごく高いんだろうな……わたしは骨董品についてあんまり詳しくないけど、釉瑚ちゃんのあの顔つきを見るに、やっぱりよっぽど大事なものってことなんだろうね。
target: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.

source: 釉瑚每次寄的东西好像都很值钱，都要上保价。嗯……灯灯我也不太懂古玩啦，但她特别严肃认真的样子，我想肯定是对她来说很珍贵、很爱惜的东西吧。
target: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.

source: 釉瑚每次寄的東西好像都很值錢，都要上保價。嗯……燈燈我也不太懂古玩啦，但她特別嚴肅認真的樣子，我想肯定是對她來說很珍貴、很愛惜的東西吧。
target: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.

source: 野外調査ですか？わかりました！
野外調研？維里奈明白了。
野外调研？维里奈明白了。

量が多くて脂っこい食べ物は苦手です……ステーキとか。
味の問題というわけではなく……私、小食なので。苦手なものでも食べ残しは良くないです……。
target: I'm not a big fan of big, greasy dishes—like steaks... It's not that they aren't tasty, I just hate the idea of letting food go to waste if I can't finish it. It doesn't sit right with me...
Phew. In the nick of time.

source: 鉛玉のフルコースだぜ！
鉴宝如破迷魂阵，细观岁月辨伪真，鉴宝大师釉瑚是也！
target: Time may deceive, but wisdom takes hold. Here comes Master Youhu, the great antique appraiser!

source: 鎮玄司騎、清宵だ。ただの修真者に過ぎない。長き歳月を経て再会したのも何かの縁。共に剣を携え、歩むとしよう。
target: Xuan Paragon, Qingxiao, a seeker of the Way. Time's endless flow has brought you back to me. Take up your blade, and let us walk this path together.

source: 鎮玄司騎，清宵，一介修行之人。歲月迢迢，既在此間重逢，便攜劍同行吧。
target: Xuan Paragon, Qingxiao, a seeker of the Way. Time's endless flow has brought you back to me. Take up your blade, and let us walk this path together.

source: 鑑定とは、すべての謎を解き明かし、その真贋を見極めるプロの技！そう、あたしは古物鑑定士の釉瑚！あらゆる古物を愛する者だよ！
target: Time may deceive, but wisdom takes hold. Here comes Master Youhu, the great antique appraiser!

source: 鑑定料はお安くしとくけど、戦闘は別料金ね！
target: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!

source: 鑑寶如破迷魂陣，細觀歲月辨偽真，鑑寶大師釉瑚是也！
target: Time may deceive, but wisdom takes hold. Here comes Master Youhu, the great antique appraiser!

source: 镇玄司骑，清宵，一介修行之人。岁月迢迢，既在此间重逢，便携剑同行吧。
target: Xuan Paragon, Qingxiao, a seeker of the Way. Time's endless flow has brought you back to me. Take up your blade, and let us walk this path together.

source: 長き夜と共に歩む、それが俺の生き方だ。
target: I have never regretted braving the long night.

source: 長久以來她一直掩飾得很好——這更讓我自責，也更讓我心疼。
target: She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more.

source: 長旅で疲れたのかい？それなら、座ってゆっくり休もう。今日はどんな詩や音楽がお望みかな？英雄の叙事詩？それとも、笑いに満ちた平凡な田舎の暮らし？
target: You must be exhausted from your long journey. Well, time to sit down, take a break, and enjoy some poetry and music. What do you have in mind today? A heroic epic, or a simple jolly tale of rural life?

source: 長途跋涉後也累了吧？那就坐下來好好休息一下吧。今天你想聽怎樣的詩和音樂？是那英雄的史詩，還是那鄉間充滿著笑語的平凡生活。
target: You must be exhausted from your long journey. Well, time to sit down, take a break, and enjoy some poetry and music. What do you have in mind today? A heroic epic, or a simple jolly tale of rural life?

source: 長離先生の教えで、これまで多くの人を見てきましたが、先生の笑顔の奥にあるものだけは、どうしても見抜けませんでした。
target: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.

source: 长久以来她一直掩饰得很好——这更让我自责，也更让我心疼。
target: She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more.

source: 长途跋涉后也累了吧？那就坐下来好好休息一下吧。今天你想听怎样的诗和音乐？是那英雄的史诗，还是那乡间充满着笑语的平凡生活。
target: You must be exhausted from your long journey. Well, time to sit down, take a break, and enjoy some poetry and music. What do you have in mind today? A heroic epic, or a simple jolly tale of rural life?

source: 閃閃發光……這是巨龍的寶藏！
target: Ooh, shiny! It's gotta be a dragon's treasure!

source: 開場見禮——諸邪避散，歲歲平安！
target: Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!

source: 開演、アドリブで行くよ。
開箱子是角色扮演遊戲的必備一環~
target: Treasure chests! Ahh, the essential RPG experience—

source: 開花……うん！少し緊張しましたけど、立派に咲いて良かったです！
target: Now is the time to bloom... I didn't realize I was holding my breath. Look. It's so beautiful!

source: 閒話就免了。只要需求合理，給我，我幫你實現。
target: Quit the chit-chat. Tell me what you need and I'll make it for you, provided your descriptions are reasonable.

source: 闇に動く影は皆、滅ぼさん。
關於珈德妮婭&羅斯瑪麗
闪闪发光……这是巨龙的宝藏！
target: Ooh, shiny! It's gotta be a dragon's treasure!

source: 问我何所惧，问我何所忧
target: What She Fears, What She Dreads

source: 闲话就免了。只要需求合理，给我，我帮你实现。
target: Quit the chit-chat. Tell me what you need and I'll make it for you, provided your descriptions are reasonable.

source: 闹钟响了……？好吧，工作时间到。
target: Is that the alarm... Alright, time to work.

source: 防事的新需求吗……呼啊，得好好打起精神来了。
target: More paperwork? Let's see... *satisfied smile* All set. Now, what should I have for dinner?

source: 防事的新需求嗎……呼啊，得好好打起精神來了。
target: More paperwork? Let's see... *satisfied smile* All set. Now, what should I have for dinner?

source: 防事科の仕事かぁ……ふぁ～仕方ないな……
target: More paperwork? Let's see... *satisfied smile* All set. Now, what should I have for dinner?

source: 防犯カメラのマスターテープ
阴暗、悲戚的第二乐章深藏着不安与险恶。不害怕吗，它将有力地举起匕首，刺破生与死的面纱。
target: The shadowed, sorrowful second movement conceals unease and terror. Are you not afraid? It will raise its dagger with force, tearing through the veil between life and death.
Barely any Nether Qi. Tch. Lucky find.

source: 阴炁缠身众鬼随行，听着确实是桩烦人事，但熟悉后，觉得这样也不错。反正如今都已供我驱使了。
target: Bound by Nether Qi, followed by spirits... sounds like a real hassle. But I'm used to it. And since they listen to my commands now, I suppose it's not so bad.
Spirits kneel at my feet. Illusory dread can't take hold of me.

source: 陆止于此，海始于斯，我们的旅途还远未结束。
target: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

source: 限界を超えた冷たい炎、災厄を味わった世界、混沌、虚無、現実……そして、月を捕まえる、あなたの姿を見た。
target: I see cold flames beyond the edge of reason. I see perfection rising from the shattered end. I see Chaos. I see illusions. I see truths. I see... you, the one who captured the moon.

source: 限界プロトコルを有効化！
除了力量，其他我喜欢的也可以吗？想清楚再答哦，一旦你说出口，在得到之前……我都不会罢休了。
target: Can I have anything else I want other than power? Think carefully before you answer. Once you say it, I won't stop until I get it.

source: 除了力量，其他我喜歡的也可以嗎？想清楚再答喔，一旦你說出口，在得到之前……我都不會罷休了。
target: Can I have anything else I want other than power? Think carefully before you answer. Once you say it, I won't stop until I get it.

source: 陰の気に纏われ、お化けと常にいるのは確かに面倒に聞こえるかもしれねぇ。だが慣れてきたら、これも悪くねぇって思えてきたんだ。どうせ全部、従えてるしな。
target: Bound by Nether Qi, followed by spirits... sounds like a real hassle. But I'm used to it. And since they listen to my commands now, I suppose it's not so bad.

source: 陰暗、悲戚的第二樂章深藏著不安與險惡。不害怕嗎，它將有力地舉起匕首，刺破生與死的面紗。
target: The shadowed, sorrowful second movement conceals unease and terror. Are you not afraid? It will raise its dagger with force, tearing through the veil between life and death.
Barely any Nether Qi. Tch. Lucky find.

source: 陰炁纏身眾鬼隨行，聽著確實是樁煩人事，但熟悉後，覺得這樣也不錯。反正如今都已供我驅使了。
target: Bound by Nether Qi, followed by spirits... sounds like a real hassle. But I'm used to it. And since they listen to my commands now, I suppose it's not so bad.

source: 陰鬼を従える身だ、虚妄程度じゃ動じねぇ。
target: Spirits kneel at my feet. Illusory dread can't take hold of me.
Spirits kneel at my feet. Illusory dread can't take hold of me.

source: 陸止於此，海始於斯，我們的旅途還遠未結束。
target: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.
Like sea foam on the shore...

source: 隐海修会的人，洛可可不熟。但，她是第一个轻轻敲完箱子，佩洛没有一口咬上去的教士。
target: She's from the Order of the Deep. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first Acolyte to touch the box without getting bitten by Pero.

source: 隠海教団の人たちはあまり知らない。でもフィービーは、スーツケースをノックしてもペロが噛み付かなかった初めての聖職者。
target: She's from the Order of the Deep. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first Acolyte to touch the box without getting bitten by Pero.

source: 隧者兵装：主系统待重启。
target: Exostrider Armament: Main system to be rebooted.

source:
隧者兵装：光翼模式展开。
爱弥斯：此夜星海澈明！
target:
Exostrider Armament: Lightwings activated.
Aemeath: Stars shine tonight!

source: 隧者兵装：动力源较低，请注意。
target: Exostrider Armament: Warning, insufficient power supply.

source: 隧者兵装：发现敌对目标。
隧者兵装：射击蓄能完成。
隧者兵装：机体构筑完成。

隧者兵装：机体限制解除。
爱弥斯：救世之刻已至！
target:
Exostrider Armament: Body limit unlocked.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source: 隧者兵装：机甲模式，解除。
隧者兵装：瞄准系统失灵。

隧者兵装：自检开始。
爱弥斯：状态良好~
target:
Exostrider Armament: Running self-diagnosis.
Aemeath: Mm, all systems green.

source:
隧者兵装：集束射击锁定。
爱弥斯：救世之刻已至！
target:
Exostrider Armament: Cluster cannon ready.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source: 隧者兵裝：主系統待重啟。
target: Exostrider Armament: Main system to be rebooted.

source:
隧者兵裝：光翼模式展開。
愛彌斯：此夜星海澈明！
target:
Exostrider Armament: Lightwings activated.
Aemeath: Stars shine tonight!

source: 隧者兵裝：動力源較低，請注意。
target: Exostrider Armament: Warning, insufficient power supply.

source: 隧者兵裝：射擊蓄能完成。
隧者兵裝：機甲模式，解除。
隧者兵裝：機體構築完成。

隧者兵裝：機體限制解除。
愛彌斯：救世之刻已至！
target:
Exostrider Armament: Body limit unlocked.
Aemeath: The savior rises!

source: 隧者兵裝：發現敵對目標。
隧者兵裝：瞄準系統失靈。

隧者兵裝：自檢開始。
愛彌斯：狀態良好~
target:
Exostrider Armament: Running self-diagnosis.
Aemeath: Mm, all systems green.

source:
隧者兵裝：集束射擊鎖定。
愛彌斯：救世之刻已至！
target:
Exostrider Armament: Cluster cannon ready.
Aemeath: The savior rises!
Like sea foam on the shore...

source: 隱海修會的人，洛可可不熟。但，她是第一個輕輕敲完箱子，佩洛沒有一口咬上去的教士。
target: She's from the Order of the Deep. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first Acolyte to touch the box without getting bitten by Pero.

source: 难得你有闲暇来我这里，我正巧处理完事务，若是不急着走，便来与我手谈一局吧？
target: Ah, look who we have here. A rare visitor. Luckily, I've finished my work for today. Would you like to join me in a game of Weiqi, if you're not in a rush to leave?

source: 集めた道具を舞台で使えるように改造するのが好き。ガラクタも劇のなかでは大事なマクガフィンとして生まれ変わる。見た目は地味でも、一つひとつに物語があるから、どれも大切にするべき。
target: I like turning the things I collect into stage props. They might not look fancy at first, but each one has its own special story. On stage, the ordinary becomes extraordinary, and I think that's worth something.

source: 雖然作為醫生來說他身上的謎團多了點，但作為同事他的能力是值得信賴的。
target: He's got just a few too many mysteries for a doctor... But as a colleague, his skills speak for themselves. And that's what I trust.

source: 雖然安可有很多朋友，但還是會做只有安可一個人的夢。媽媽不在身邊，黑咩白咩都是安可的幻想……不好意思，可以給安可一個擁抱嗎？
target: I've got lots of friends now, but sometimes in my dreams, I'm still all alone. Mommy's not with me anymore, and they say Cosmos and Cloudy are just my imaginary friends… Erm. C-can you hug me a little?

source: 雖然年紀相仿，卻比我高上一頭，她那個玉佩，蒼翠欲滴，還怪好看的！只可惜，我從中感受到的頻率，都是不圓滿的……
target: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...

source: 雖然我已經很強了，但還是謝謝啦！
target: Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!

source: 雖然我見識過你的本事，不擔心你會倒在堂堂正正的戰鬥之中……但是，這個世界上除了我之外，還有很多不按常理出牌的人，記得要小心不要在陰溝裡翻船哦~
target: I've seen what you're capable of, so I'm not worried about you in a fair fight. That being said, not everyone plays fair. Just watch your back out there... wouldn't want you to get caught off your game.

source: 雖然接觸不多，但從他的言談舉止，可以看出是很有品味的人呢！希望他哪天能來照顧照顧我的鑑寶生意。
target: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!

source: 雖然現在不會有那麼強的副作用，但阿列夫一要是能少在我腦子裡嘀咕些聽不懂的就好了。
target: Well, the side effects aren't as bad now, but I'd give anything for Aleph-1 to just stop mumbling nonsense in my head.

source: 雖然看樣子有點像抑制劑，但作用上卻完全不同啊。
target: Looked like a standard immunoblocker, but this stuff feels totally different.

source: 雖然總想著為大家做到更多更多，但超出承受的限度……反而會給自己、給無法回饋的他人造成困擾吧？
target: I want to do as much as I can for everyone in need, but if I take on more than I can handle... I guess it would only trouble those on the receiving end of my help, and burden me further.

source: 雖說「師不必賢於弟子」，但終究是我獲益多，你獲益少。徒兒，我該如何補償你？
target: They say a master need not outshine their student. Even so, I've learned far more from you than I ever taught. Tell me, my disciple... how shall I make it up to you?

source: 雖說本大師鑑寶是良心價，但出場費可不一定喔。
target: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!

source: 難得你有閒暇來我這裡，我正巧處理完事務，若是不急著走，便來與我手談一局吧？
target: Ah, look who we have here. A rare visitor. Luckily, I've finished my work for today. Would you like to join me in a game of Weiqi, if you're not in a rush to leave?

source: 雨風を乗り越え、素晴らしきものに讃歌を…これが、雲雀が最も空に近い時です。
target: I dedicate my song to brilliance, braving the raging storm. The skylark in me has never soared higher into the heavens.

source: 雪は、いつか溶けてしまう。
雪はいずれ、解けゆく定め……
雪糕、刨冰、冰淇淋，都差不多。我的体内“恶火”常燃，冰冷的东西，能够帮助我压制它们……若是再带有一些甜味，更好。
target: Sorbet, shaved ice, gelato… they're pretty much the same. The hellfire inside me never dies down. Cold things help keep it in check. But an added bit of sweetness works even better.

source: 雪糕、刨冰、冰淇淋，都差不多。我的體內「惡火」常燃，冰冷的東西，能夠幫助我壓制它們……若是再帶有一些甜味，更好。
target: Sorbet, shaved ice, gelato… they're pretty much the same. The hellfire inside me never dies down. Cold things help keep it in check. But an added bit of sweetness works even better.

source: 雲篆成書，氣貫符膽，符畫落筆如有神助。
target: Seal script flows, Qi pulses through. Now I write talisman guided from above.
The skylark's song is about to sound.
The skylark's song is about to sound.

source: 雷鎚よ、化け物を滅せよ！

target: Lost in the mist of time.

source: 需要剝殼的東西？因為很麻煩啊……
target: Hmm... food that requires peeling, I guess. Why? It's too much hassle.

source: 需要剥壳的东西？因为很麻烦啊……
target: Hmm... food that requires peeling, I guess. Why? It's too much hassle.

source: 需要医生么？正好我有空。
target: Need a doctor? I happen to be free.

source: 需要醫生嗎？正好我有空。
target: Need a doctor? I happen to be free.

source: 霧のように自由に、思いのまま楽しく——これでよくない？
target: To live free as the mist and enjoy life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?
Lost in the mist of time.

source: 露帕，七丘的角斗士。别在意那些目光，搭档——让我们尽情享受胜利吧！
target: Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!

source: 露帕，七丘的角鬥士。別在意那些目光，搭檔——讓我們盡情享受勝利吧！
target: Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!

source: 露西。我会执行一些边缘行者的任务，负责骇入相关的工作。如果只是单纯的委托，知道这些信息就足够了。
target: Lucy. When I was takin' gigs as an edgerunner, my specialty was netrunning. If this is just biz, that's all you need to know.

source: 露西。我會執行一些邊緣行者的任務，負責駭入相關的工作。如果只是單純的委託，知道這些資訊就足夠了。
target: Lucy. When I was takin' gigs as an edgerunner, my specialty was netrunning. If this is just biz, that's all you need to know.

source: 靈魂的輪廓……更加清晰了。
target: The souls... They look clearer to me.

source: 青春を謳歌する者たち
非我不可……？真是拿你沒辦法……出發吧。
target: As always, I'm the one you need... I really can't win with you, can I? Let's just get this done.

source: 非我不可……？真是拿你没办法……出发吧。
target: As always, I'm the one you need... I really can't win with you, can I? Let's just get this done.

source: 面白いコンチェルトね。
面白い発想だね、その方向から義手を改善してみるよ。
target: An interesting new perspective. Thank you. Now I should be able to further improve my prosthetic arm's energy output.

source: 面識はある。この年頃で植物の習性と庭造りに精通しているとは……勤勉な子なのだろう。
target: I met her once. A prodigy in the field of botany at such a young age... Impressive.

source: 音、重き日もあれば……玉、軽き日もあり。
target: Sounds could be weighty. Jadeite could be made light.

source: 音骸にも共鳴強化剤を使えばいいんじゃ……はぁ？あいつらには別のもんが必要？どういう仕組みなんだ？
target: If Echoes got this Resonance Potion stuff too, then... Huh? Wait, they get somethin' else? What's the deal?

source: 頭がスッキリしました…少々お待ちを、今の閃きをメモしないと…
target: My thoughts feel sharper now... Wait, that could be an interesting concept. I should jot it down.

source: 頭が痛くなってきましたねぇ……
頼りないお姉さんで……ごめんね……
願えば手に入るものよ。
target: We desire, and so we find.

source: 願歲主指引迷失者的歸途。
target: May the Sentinel guide those who are lost.

source: 風が…止んでいるみたい…
風が便りを運んできました。
風の導きに従いましょう。

風を纏う冠は、すでに大海原に沈んだ。
この剣を呼び覚ましたのは、あなたですか？
この剣を呼び覚ましたのは、あなたなのか？
target: The crown of winds... has been engulfed by the sea. Tell me, are you the one who summoned this blade?

source: 風儀拳の使い手、鑑心。……よろしければ、組み手をお願いできるか？
target: I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?

source: 風儀拳傳人鑒心，多有叨擾。不知可否與你切磋武藝？
target: I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?

source: 风仪拳传人鉴心，多有叨扰。不知可否与你切磋武艺？
target: I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?

source:
飛んで！
理よ、宇宙に風を。
target:
Fly high!
Truth, reach the cosmos.

source:
飛吧！
真理疾馳寰宇。
target:
Fly high!
Truth, reach the cosmos.

source:
飞吧！
真理疾驰寰宇。
target:
Fly high!
Truth, reach the cosmos.

source: 食べづらい物ですね。やはり、面倒ですから……
target: Anything that takes too much work to eat... simply because it's a hassle.

source: 食べられない物はない。あれこれ考えず、そこにある物を食べるだけだ。気づいたら、嫌いな食べ物なんてなくなっていたな。
target: For me, any food's fair game. C'mon, don't overthink it! When you're hungry enough, everything tastes amazing!

source: 食べ残しは怨念となって、夢の中に現れる……。どう？怖かった？
target: Ooh… Watch out! The ghosts of food you didn't finish will crawl out of your tummy and give you bad dreams... Boo! Gotcha!

source: 食べ物は大切に扱うべきでしょう？え？「闇の料理」といわれるほどの謎料理なら…
target: Shouldn't we cherish all food and not let any go to waste? Oh... Well, if it's truly badly cooked, then.. uhm...
A blade is honed to strike.

source: 首を長くして、星空を待つ必要はないのです。すでに私の手の中にありますから。
target: I need not wait for a starry night, nor tilt my gaze to seek the sky. For I have placed it at my back, in my hands, and upon my eyelids.

source: 騎士のライバルが現れました！
騎士の勘が囁いています……あそこです！
target: My knightly instinct says... this way!

source: 騎士の物語、いよいよ新章開幕です！
騎士的直覺告訴我，在那邊！
target: My knightly instinct says... this way!

source: 驗算結果……抱歉，我這就來。
target: Calculation results... Sorry, I'm on my way.

source: 驚いた……こんなハイスコア、初めて見たわ。
target: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.
Don't let your jaws drop yet! Hehe... Waaahhh!

source: 验算结果……抱歉，我这就来。
target: Calculation results... Sorry, I'm on my way.

source: 骑士的直觉告诉我，在那边！
target: My knightly instinct says... this way!

source: 高波よ、天地を切り開け！
髪につけてるこれ？ブブ物流の社員証だよ。忙しい時なんか、鞄からいちいち取り出すのも面倒だし、髪についてた方が手っ取り早いかなって！こうしてれば、同僚たちもわたしがいるって一目で気づいてくれるしね。どう、便利でしょ？
target: This on my head? It's my employee ID badge. Clipped it to my hair to save myself the fumbling when I'm carrying stuff. Now everyone knows my name in a snap. Perfect!

source: 鬧鐘響了……？好吧，工作時間到。
target: Is that the alarm... Alright, time to work.

source: 鬼神に問うことなかれ。
鬼神朽ちれば、黄泉来たれり。
target: Sacred bones rot. Heavens drown in dark.
Souls sing in harmony. To the savior's victory!

source: 魂の輪郭が…よりはっきり見える。
target: The souls... They look clearer to me.

source: 魚絲麵味道老鮮了，燒好的麵放在高湯裡，再加上魚絲做澆頭，嘖嘖……夢州特色美食，你一定要嚐嚐。
target: Shredded fish noodles are a really tasty one! Put boiled noodles in the broth, then add shredded fish on top. Mmm, so good la! It's a Mengzhou specialty. You must give a bowl a try!

source: 鱼丝面味道老灵了，烧好的面放在高汤里，再加上鱼丝做浇头，啧啧……梦州特色美食，你一定要尝尝。
target: Shredded fish noodles are a really tasty one! Put boiled noodles in the broth, then add shredded fish on top. Mmm, so good la! It's a Mengzhou specialty. You must give a bowl a try!

source: 黄泉に行けども悔いなし。
黄泉路とは絶路……帰る術なし。
target: Take your final dive, into Naraka.

source: 黑咩和白咩是妈妈留给安可的礼物，也是安可最珍贵的朋友！它们会告诉安可很多事情，不坏不坏的哦。
target: Cosmos and Cloudy are presents from mommy. They're my best buddies! Don't worry, they're nice Woolies, they tell me lots and lots of stories!

source: 黑咩和白咩是媽媽留給安可的禮物，也是安可最珍貴的朋友！它們會告訴安可很多事情，不壞不壞的哦。
target: Cosmos and Cloudy are presents from mommy. They're my best buddies! Don't worry, they're nice Woolies, they tell me lots and lots of stories!
A world... of black and white...

source: 黒メェも白メェも、ママがアンコにくれたプレゼント、アンコの大事なお友達だよ！メェたちはアンコにいろいろ教えてくれたの、いい子たちだよ。
target: Cosmos and Cloudy are presents from mommy. They're my best buddies! Don't worry, they're nice Woolies, they tell me lots and lots of stories!
Beat the drum. Ready to prance!

source: 鼓の音は、まだ止んでない……
龍の髭くらい長～い龍髭パイがあるのなら、一度食べてみたいです。
target: Will there ever be Loong Whiskers Crisps that are as loooong as a real loong's whiskers? Aww, I really want to give them a try!

source: 龍髭パイが入ってたらいいのに……
target: Some Loong Whiskers Crisps would be great…
It's nice to take a break once in a while.
It's okay to fly sometimes, I guess.

source: 가능하다면, 여러분이랑 아주 오래오래 친구가 되고 싶어요. 하지만 저도 알아요, 시간은 자기만의 생각이 있다는 걸...
target: If possible, I really wish we could all stay friends for a long, long time. But... I know time has a will of its own.

source: 가르쳐 주셔서 감사합니다. 최근에는 전투 뿐만 아니라, 금주 업무 처리도 더 여유로워졌다는 것이 확실히 느껴져요. 어쩌면 방랑자는 힘을 키우는 방법뿐만이 아니라, 세상을 살아가는 방법도 가르쳐준 게 아닐까 싶네요
target: Thank you for your guidance. I have seen growth in my strength and leadership abilities, and it seems you have taught me more than just swordsmanship; you've taught me valuable life lessons.

source: 가문에 이런 말이 있죠. 「비수는 항상 갈아야 무뎌지지 않는다」. 단순업무를 위해서라도 꾸준한 운동은 필수예요
target: As the Montelli saying goes, "A blade only stays sharp if it's regularly honed." Even if it's just for work, exercise is necessary.

source: 가자! 시로 모두의 앞길을 밝혀 줄게!
target: Off we go! May my poems light the way on your path ahead!
Let's Go, All the Way To the Top of Arasaka Tower
Join me... in the World of Santu.
Nothing motivates like a little reward.
You've prepared for this, have you not?

source: 갈 길이 아직 멀었으니 걸음을 멈추지 마세요!
target: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.
Galbrena. Ready to join the hunt.

source: 갈브레나. 영원한 불꽃의 악마이자, 데빌 헌터지. 마음대로 불러. 난 사냥감의 위치만 알고 싶을 뿐이야
target: Galbrena. The Fiend of Ever-burning Flame. The Discord Slayer. Call me what you want. Just point me to the monsters.

source:
갈브레나: ... 별 거 아냐
키메라: 상처를 살필 시간은 없다
target:
Galbrena: …Just a scratch.
Chimera: No time to lick your wounds.

source:
갈브레나: ... 제법인데
키메라: 네 광기가 요동치는군
target:
Galbrena: ...Very well.
Chimera: Your fury begins to stir.

source:
갈브레나: ... 죽을 때까지... 멈추지 않아!
키메라: 이거야말로... 영원한 사냥이지!
target:
Galbrena: ...Till my last breath!
Chimera: This hunt shall never end!

source:
갈브레나: ... 한 번 더
키메라: 고통은 너를 깨어 있게 하지
target:
Galbrena: ...Again.
Chimera: Pain sharpens your mind.

source:
갈브레나: 가자... 지옥의 입구로!
키메라: 불로 씻어주마!
target:
Galbrena: By my trigger... enter hell's gates!
Chimera: Scorched to ash!

source:
갈브레나: 너에게 안내하지...
키메라: 지옥의 입구를!
target:
Galbrena: I'll show you...
Chimera: The gates of hell!

source:
갈브레나: 더러운 불꽃
키메라: 전부 없애버려!
target:
Galbrena: Tainted hellfire.
Chimera: Devour them all!

source:
갈브레나: 불꽃은... 꺼지지 않아...
키메라: 우리는... 물러서지 않아...
target:
Galbrena: The flames... never die...
Chimera: We... will not retreat...

source:
갈브레나: 악은 악으로
키메라: 약한 놈은 먹이로!
target:
Galbrena: Fight fire with fire.
Chimera: Let strength speak!

source:
갈브레나: 이 사냥을... 끝낼 때다
키메라: 포식하겠군!
target:
Galbrena: The hunt ends here.
Chimera: Time to gorge!

source:
갈브레나: 이제... 장례를 시작한다
키메라: 성대한 만찬이군!
target:
Galbrena: I've come... to send you to your grave.
Chimera: A fresh feast!

source:
갈브레나: 제 발로 찾아온 사냥감이군
키메라: 마침 배고프던 참이었다
target:
Galbrena: Gift-wrapped prey?
Chimera: Satisfy my hunger.

source:
갈브레나: 죽음을 넘어...
키메라: 우리는... 반드시 돌아올 거다...
target:
Galbrena: Through death...
Chimera: ...We will return.

Galbrena: Explode.
Chimera: To hell with you!
I swear, the new jokes and memes around campus are evolving faster than I can keep up...

source: 감정 결과, 이 몸은 이제 천하무적이다! 꼭꼭 숨어라, 골동품 귀한 줄 모르는 놈들아!
target: As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!

source: 감정 비용은 싸게 해 주지만, 출장비는... 흐흠, 글쎄다!
target: Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!

source: 거대한 파도여, 더 높게 일어나라! 네가 준 힘만 있다면, 이 물보라도 공연의 사소한 갈채에 불과해!
target: With your strength, this massive wave is just a splash in our show! Bring it on!

source: 거츠가 마음에 들어? 내가 직접 개조한 건데, 위력이 장난 아니라, 맞으면 작살나거든. 임플란트 개조 전에는 쏠 때마다 반동에 튕겨 나가서 쓰기 꽤 버거웠어...
target: Ya like Guts? My own custom job. Talks the talk, packs a mean punch. Before I chromed up my arms, the recoil would send me flyin'. Total pain in the buns.
Like sea foam on the shore...
Don't worry... Just a trick of the eye...
Relax, I can play by the rules.
No need to dwell on it.

source: 걱정 마세요! 이 빛으로, 책임지고 인도할게요!
target: Don't worry, my light's got you!

source: 걱정 마세요, 전 항상 여기 있으니까

target: Calculation results... Sorry, I'm on my way.
My swordsmanship has reached new heights!

source: 검을 갈 때는 거친 돌로, 갑옷으로, 다른 검으로, 그리고 목숨으로 갈아야 한다. 부러지고 부서질지라도... 검은 반드시 날카로워야 하니까
target: A sharp sword is honed on whetstones, clashing blades, and shattered armor, then tempered in the fire of life. Even if it breaks, it must remain sharp.

source: 검을 휘두르고, 휘두르고, 또 휘두른다... 분쟁의 단련을 겪을 때마다 검의 의미도 새로워져. 검이 무엇인지 진정으로 결정 내리는 건 그 날카로움이 아니라, 검을 가진 자의 의지거든
target: Strike relentlessly. Again, and again... Each battle reforges my blade. Its true strength lies not in the steel, but in the will that commands it.
Is that the best you got?

source: 겨울이 되면 항상 꼬리에 정전기가 일어난단 말이지... 손질하는데 귀찮아 죽겠어
target: Every winter, my tail becomes a hive of static... Very annoying when I'm grooming...
If it's a duel you want...

source: 경쾌하면서도 활발한 제3악장에는 환상 속 즐거운 분위기가 담겨 있어. 허무한 불안함 위에 붕 떠 있지만, 끝까지 연주할 수 있는 의지만큼은 남아 있네
target: The bright and lively third movement carries the whimsical air of fantasy. Even suspended above falsehood and unease, it compels the notes to keep dancing forward.

source: 고기가 불에 탈 때의 냄새는 마치... 아무것도 아니야
target: After meat is smoked or roasted, its taste is similar to... Never mind.

source: 고르긴 뭘 골라! 먹을 수 있으면 장땡이야!
target: What's there to be picky about? I'm good with any food, as long as it fills my tummy.

source: 고마워, 친구! 확실히 강해진 게 느껴져!
target: Thanks, choom! Now that's what I call a solid tune-up!

source: 고마워... {PlayerName} 덕분에 나도 이제 많은 사람들을 위해 빛날 수 있는 존재가 됐어
target: Thanks to you, my light will shine upon those in need.

source: 고민이라... 대부분의 고민은 돈으로 해결할 수 있긴 한데, 딱 하나 예외가 있네. 여동생이 다 커버리면 어쩌지? 하는 거. 어휴, 네 생각엔 양양이 왜 이젠 내 손을 잡고 다니려 하지 않는 것 같아?
target: My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore?

source: 고민이라...장관부에서 꽤나 귀찮은 일들이 많이 생기긴 하지만, 전부 「싸움」으로 손쉽게 해결될 수 있단 말이지. 하, 해결할 수 있는 고민은 고민이 아니잖아?
target: Trouble? At the Ephor's Palace, it's not uncommon to encounter challenges, but as long as one is willing to "fight," everything will resolve in time. Heh, troubles that can be overcome aren't real troubles.
You earned it, you keep it.

source: 고요의 바다에 너무 오래 있었어. 가끔은 바다 위의 신선한 공기를 마시고 싶어
target: I've spent too much time in the depths of the sea. At times, I wish for a breath of fresh air above the surface.

source: 공명 보건실의 루크 · 헤르센이야. 네가 날 여기로 부르다니—— 참 드문 일인데. 그냥 루크라고 부르면 돼
target: Dr. Luuk Herssen, from the Resonator Nursing Unit. A rare exception that we meet outside my office. Oh, you can just call me Luuk.

source: 공명 어빌리티가 계속 뻗어나가고 있네요... 괜찮아요, 제어할 수 있어요
target: My Resonance energy continues to expand... Don't worry, I can control it.

source: 과감하면서도 힘이 넘치는 제4악장은 시원한 전투의 찬가를 내리지. 격렬한 흐름이 드넓은 땅에 끝없이 달려들어 모든 걸 씻어낼 거야
target: The decisive and powerful fourth movement brings forth a rousing battle hymn. Carried by the rapids, it surges across an endless land, sweeping all before it.
Illusions of the past... Step forward!

source: 과학은 도구일 뿐... 마법이 아니다. 너도 어떤 이들처럼 과학에 대해 비현실적인 환상까지는 하지 않았으면 좋겠네!
target: Scientific research is but a tool. It's not magic. People tend to have unrealistic expectations about how research works, and you wouldn't want to be one of them.
Science is life's questioning of truth.
Does anything here catch your interest?
Take a breath, I'm right here.
Worry not... Just need a moment.
Don't worry. Leave it to me.

source: 구원. 그냥 한 자루 검이라고 생각해 줘. 어떻게 사용할지는 네가 정하면 돼. 토는 달지 않겠다
target: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

source: 구조는 더 복잡해졌지만... 더 명확히 식별할 수 있게 됐어요
target: The structure is more complex, but also... more distinctly identifiable.

source: 군대를 지휘한다는 건 쉬운 일이 아니네. 사실 가끔은 자신의 결정에 대한 의심을 품을 때가 있지. 하지만 방랑자가 옆에 있으니 조금은 안심해도 될 것 같군
target: Commanding an army is not a simple task, and sometimes I find myself questioning my own decisions. Going forward, with you staying by my side, I should feel more at ease.

source: 권법이 많이 발전했을 뿐만 아니라 천둥도 더욱 빛났군! 자네 덕분이야! 이 상태라면 이 구역의 안전을 더 돌볼 수 있을 것 같네!
target: Thanks to your help, my skills have improved and even my thunderbolts are stronger. Owing to your aid, I might be able to get a couple more scoundrels dealt with.

source: 규칙을 준수하고, 공동의 적에 대한 적개심을 불태운다. 내가 살아있는 한, 유령사냥단이라는 이름은 네가 대륙을 횡단할 수 있게 해주기에 충분할 거다
target: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.

source: 규칙이 없는 칼날은, 적에 따라 변화하며 승리를 거머쥐죠... 바둑판 위에 진을 치는 것과도 비슷한 거예요
target: The sword has no set form, it adapts along with its foes... Likewise, strategies must shift against different opponents.

source: 그 거울 말야...? 으악, 그 대단한 걸! 난 말 못 해, 말 못 한다고!
target: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!
I believe it's this one? ...How nice.

source: 그 빨간 머리 외국인 연구원 말이지? 진상 클라이언트를 퇴치하는 데 일가견이 있다고 들었는데... 그래서 가끔 진상을 대할 때 모르테피한테 부탁하고 싶을 때가 있어!
target: The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.

source: 그 상리요라는 녀석은... 조만간 나는 그를 뛰어넘어 더 위대한 발명품을 만들어 낼 거야!
target: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!

source: 그 소녀, 양양이라고 했던가? 때때로 나는 그녀가 작게 흥얼거리는 소리를 들을 때가 있지... 그녀의 노랫소리는 마음을 차분하게 하는 신기한 능력을 가지고 있는 거 같아
target: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.

source: 그 수행자, 꽤 재미있는 애야. 지금은 그 지루한 인간다운 모습이 좀 있지만, 산짐승 같은 순수함과 야성이 자신도 모르게 드러나곤 한다니까
target: That girl, the Taoist? She's a fun one to watch. She may seem to follow human society's boring norms, but her untamed spirit still shines through every now and then.

source:
그 어떤 방해에도 흔들리지 않고 마음의 청정함을 지켜내야만, 속세를 초월할 수 있느니... 근데 있지, 속세를 벗어나는 게 꼭 좋다고만 할 수는 없어.
이건 점괘로 본 게 아니야. 그 사람한테는 점괘가 통하지 않지만, 나한테는 다 보이거든
target: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

source: 그거 아세요? 제가 방금 들은 건데, 옆에 있는 꽃송이가 방랑자를 많이 좋아한대요. 식물의 언어는 조용하지만, 진실이 담겨있죠. 궁금하면 무슨 말을 하는지 방랑자한테 말해 드릴게요
target: Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.

source: 그늘이랑 구름이는 엄마가 앙코한테 남겨준 선물이자 앙코의 가장 소중한 친구들이야! 나쁜 애들 아니야. 항상 앙코한테 많은 걸 알려준다고!
target: Cosmos and Cloudy are presents from mommy. They're my best buddies! Don't worry, they're nice Woolies, they tell me lots and lots of stories!
I Offer You the Bitterness of a Moongazer
I can spare a minute to knock some heads around.

source: 그럼 이제, 강한 녀석들을 찾아 한바탕 싸워보지 않겠나? 새로 벼린 칼날이 얼마나 날카로운지 시험해 봐
target: Since you've come this far, why not cross blades with mightier foes and test your mettle?

source:
그럼 이제, 행운의 관객을 골라볼까...
너를 내려놔 달라고? 그래, 그렇게 원한다면~ 후후!
target:
Now, a volunteer from the audience...
Want me put you down? Well, since you asked nicely… Hehe.
Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?
Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.

source: 그림을 그릴 기운이 나는 것 같아요
target: Now I've got the energy to work on my commissions.

source: 그의 천부적인 재능만큼 인상적인 것은 그의 친절한 말투에요. 저는 아직 그가 누구에게 화를 내는 것을 본 적이 없어요. 아무리 터무니 없는 요구를 해도 해낼 수 있다는 인상을 받았죠
target: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

source: 극장에서 하는 영웅극은 정말 최고야! 특히 황룡 명절에 다들 모여 떠들썩한 분위기에서 연극을 보고 있으면 모두의 얼굴에 행복한 웃음꽃이 핀다고! 상상만 해도 너무 좋아
target: The hero plays at Jinzhou Theater are the bee's knees! Especially during New Years, everyone would gather around to enjoy the plays, havin' a whale of a time.

source: 금을 멈추니 고요해지고, 검을 뽑으니 세상이 평온해지네
target: On the qin strings do eons sing, eternal peace my blade shall bring.

source: 금주 순찰관 치샤 출동! 도움이 필요하면 언제든 치샤를 호출하라구!
target: Jinzhou Patroller, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!

source: 금주 순찰관 치샤, 항상 대기 중!
금주 영윤, 금희입니다. 영윤이라는 단어는 가장 높은 직권을 의미하지만, 무거운 책임감도 함께 가져다주죠. 제가 할 수 있는 한 최선을 다해 금주의 모든 사람들이 잘 살 수 있도록 노력하겠습니다
target: I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. My role holds great power and duty. I vow to serve my people with diligence and bring prosperity to our land.

source: 금주 친구들이 그러는데, 모르테피는 재미있는 장난감을 만들 줄 안대! 정말 멋질 것 같지 않아? 음... 막 뛰어다니는 양을 만들어 달라고 부탁해 볼까?
target: Friends in Jinzhou told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time…

source: 금주는 국경 외곽에 위치하여 날씨 변화를 예측하기 어렵지... 고양이들에게 줄 건어물의 보관이 쉽지 않군... 음, 다른 방법을 생각해 봐야겠네!
target: Nestled between the borders, Jinzhou is subject to ever-changing weather. Sustaining the dried fish I've been making for Mimi has been a difficult task... Hmm, I suppose a solution will come to me in due time.
The lands of Jinzhou are filled with riches.

source: 금주의 용녀는 파수인이랑 비슷한 것 같아. 둘 다 무거운 책임을 위해 자기 자신도 기꺼이 바치는 바보들이지. 휴, 왜 그렇게 걱정거리가 많은지 알 수가 없단 말야
target: The Loong Maiden of Jinzhou reminds me of the Shorekeeper, the way they're oh-so-devoted to their duties, all the self-sacrifice! I don't understand, why must they burden themselves so much?

source: 금주의 참사관, 장리라고 합니다. 드디어 방랑자를 만나게 되어 진심으로 반가운 마음입니다. 금주에서 도움이 필요한 일이 생기면 언제든 말씀하세요
target: I am Changli, Counselor to the Jinzhou Jinzhou. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Rover. We meet at last. Should you ever need any assistance in Jinzhou, please let me know.

source: 급할 거 없어. 시간이 모든 걸 해결해 줄 거야
target: No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time.

source: 기나긴 밤과 동행하길 선택한 것에, 후회란 없다
target: I have never regretted braving the long night.

source: 기나긴 학술회의에 연달아 참가한 후에는 항상 주의력이 떨어질 수밖에 없어요. 그럴 땐 사람들과 같이 있는 것도 나쁘지 않지만... 그래도 잠깐 혼자 재충전할 시간도 필요해요
target: During back-to-back academic conferences, my focus wanes and I need time to recharge. Being with peers is enjoyable, but a little solitude is necessary for me to stay sharp.
Your wish for wealth is granted.

source: 기도하고 싶은 게 있나요? 대신 기도해 드릴게요... 네, 소원은 이뤄질 거예요
target: May I pray for anything specific for you? It would be my honor… I'm sure your wishes will come true.

source: 기분이 좋으니까 특별히 같이 가 줄게!
target: Alright, I'll humor you for a bit, since I'm feeling good today!
My knightly instinct says... this way!

source: 기세가 확실히 올랐군! 병사 훈련에 관해 연구한적 있었나?
target: I can sense an improvement in my strength. I suppose you are well-versed in the art of training, too?

source: 기억에 남는 모험이라... 너무 많은데, 뭐부터 들을래? 이번에는 백 년 동안 이어진 재판부터 시작할까?
target: Unforgettable adventures? Where to start? How about an ancient trial that spanned over a century?
Run. I'll erase you at the finish line.

source: 기억이 없더라도, 불공평한 일을 당하면 몸이 먼저 움직이게 돼있죠... 당신은 분명 좋은 사람이겠죠? 그렇지 않다면 제가 매우 곤란할 거 같은데...
target: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.

source: 깊은 바다 수도회에 대해서 로코코는 아는 게 많이 없지만... 페비는 상자에 노크를 하고도 펠로한테 물리지 않은 첫 번째 성직자예요
target: She's from the Order of the Deep. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first Acolyte to touch the box without getting bitten by Pero.

source: 깊은 바다 수도회의 성직자 페비라고 해. 네 여정에 영원한 사랑과 따스한 햇빛만 가득하길 수호신께서 축복해 주실 거야
target: I'm Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.

source: 깜빡 잠들었네. 하암... 방랑자 옆에 있으니까 너무 편했나 봐. 그러니까 방랑자, 너도 그렇게 계속 긴장하고만 있을 필요 없어. 밤을 너무 많이 새우면 몸에 안 좋거든
target: Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss.
Don't let your jaws drop yet! Hehe... Waaahhh!

source: 껍질을 벗겨 먹는 음식은 좀 그래... 엄청 귀찮으니까...
target: Hmm... food that requires peeling, I guess. Why? It's too much hassle.

source: 꼬리에 있는 등불이 전보다 더 밝아진 것 같지 않나요?
target: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?

source: 꽃이 활짝 피었어요! 후... 저까지 긴장했네요. 어때요? 정말 예쁘지 않나요?
target: Now is the time to bloom... I didn't realize I was holding my breath. Look. It's so beautiful!
Nice. Let's go check it out.

source: 꿈? 음... 모두가 사람답게 사는 거? 잘 모르겠네. 당장은 이다음 무슨 일을 꾸밀지 고민하는 게 먼저거든!
target: A dream? I guess... just makin' sure everyone gets to live a decent life? I dunno, choom. Too busy thinkin' about the next stunt we're gonna pull!

source: 꿈이라... 내가 이런 얘기를 할 수 있는 날이 오다니 참 신기하네. 글쎄다, 음... 앞으로 매일매일이 딱 오늘만 같았으면 좋겠어. 그거면 충분하지 않을까?
target: A dream for the future... huh. Never thought I'd get to have one of those. Let's see, if I could just have more days like today... Yeah. That's enough for me.
There's still time… before the threads snap.
Even Should the Path Have No End

source: 나 같은 보물 감정 마스터를 알게 되다니, 운이 좋구나! 가지고 있는 희귀한 보물이 있다면 빨리 줘 봐~!
target: Huh, you're lucky to have come across me—the undisputed master of antique appraisal! Now, what do we have here? Hand over your goodies and I'll take a look!

source: 나 복링이 있는 한 만사형통할 거야
나 아니면 안 된다고? 정말 어쩔 수 없군... 그래 출발하지!
target: As always, I'm the one you need... I really can't win with you, can I? Let's just get this done.

source: 나는 무너지지 않을 거야. 난 폭설 속 지지대이자, 수술대의 가장 뜨거운 등불이니까. 나는 불타고 있지만... 이 손에서 메스를 놓는 일은 절대 없어
target: I won't break. I am the bone that endures blizzards, the white-hot lamp over a surgical table. I burn, but my scalpel never falters.

source: 나는 비록 도기의 루즈한 관리 방식에 대해 다른 견해를 가지고 있지만, 금주의 방어는 그녀가 책임지고 있으니 나는 전선에서 걱정없이 전투할 수 있게 해주지!
target: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

source: 나는 카멜리아. 검은 해안의 흑화집사야. 우리 이미 만난 적 있지? 내가 사랑하는... 운명의 씨앗
target: Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.

source: 나는 한계를 넘은 차가운 불을 봤고, 뒤집힌 완전함을 봤어. 혼돈과 허무함, 현실. 그리고... 달을 움켜쥔 네 모습까지도
target: I see cold flames beyond the edge of reason. I see perfection rising from the shattered end. I see Chaos. I see illusions. I see truths. I see... you, the one who captured the moon.
Outta my way! I want a look!

source: 나도 알아... 꿈에선 언젠가 깨야만 한다는 걸
target: I know... the dream had to end.

source: 나도 이제... 과거의 그림자를 마주할 만큼 충분한 힘을 갖게 된 걸까?
target: Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness?

source: 나도... 영광의 골짜기로 갈 수 있을까...?
target: Does the Vale of Glory await me?
Take your final dive, into Naraka.

source: 나랑 같이 놀고 싶지 않아? 전보다 훨씬 더 재밌는 방법으로, 더 강한 힘을 보여줄게! 날 믿어봐!
target: Hey, care to join me for another round? I'll show you a whole bunch of new tricks and powers, promise!

source: 나를 넘어서, 시작과 종말... 그 너머의... 미래를... 새롭게 쓸 때까지
target: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.

source: 나를 알아봐 준 은혜는, 나를 다시 태어나게 해 준 은혜와도 같다
target: A chance given is a future rewritten.
Not bad. It's good to shake off the rust.

source: 나쁜 녀석들이랑 말이 안 통할 땐, 화력으로 제압하는 게 답이죠! 그래서 요즘 새 광자포 사격 배열을 연구 중이에요
target: When you can't reason with the bad guys, let your weapons do the talking! That's why I've been working on new laser beam arrays!
What She Fears, What She Dreads

source: 나이는 나랑 비슷한데, 나보다 머리 하나는 더 크더라? 그리고, 그 투명하고 반짝거리는 청록색 옥패... 예쁘긴 해! 근데, 거기서 느껴지는 주파수가 영 불안하단 말이지...
target: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...

source: 나이트 시티는 감옥이지만, 다른 한편으로는 숨어 지내던 나에게 피난처이기도 했어. 하지만 막상 이 안락한 일상에 익숙해지니, 눈앞의 행복은 산산조각 나버리고, 난 다시 고통 속으로 떨어지고 말았어...
target: Night City's a cage, yes... But as I fled my past, it kept me hidden, kept me safe. And just when I started gettin' comfortable, it was all ripped away... Right back to square one.

source: 나한테 힘을 준다고...? 넌 항상 이렇게 쉽게 다른 사람을 믿어 온건가?
target: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?

source: 나한테는 가야만 하는 길이 있어... 어둡고 위험한 데다가, 멀고도 험난한 길이야. 그래서 난 누구도 이 길에 끌어들이고 싶지 않아. 난 항상 네 곁에 있어 주지도 못하는 데다가, 「데빌」은... 계약의 대가로 그 사람의 「영혼」을 요구하거든... 이렇게 불공평한 계약을... 넌, 받아들일 준비가 돼 있어?
target: My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the "devil" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it?

source: 난 「유령사냥단」하고 같이 일하는 게 좋아! 철저한 규칙 준수, 시원시원한 스타일, 같이 일하면 시간을 많이 아낄 수 있거든!
target: I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.

source: 난 네가 나를 바라보는 모습이 좋아. 원래 깊었던 고요의 바다도 네 맑은 눈동자에 반사되면, 바닥이 한눈에 보일 정도로 맑아지니까. 너랑 함께 있을 때면, 난 더 이상 「독약」이 아닌, 나 자신으로 있을 수 있어
target: I like the way you look at me. In your eyes, even the darkest depths of the sea are made transparent. With you, I am no longer "The Bane." I am simply myself.

source: 난 레베카. 루시처럼 나이트 시티에서 온 엣지러너야. 앞으로 잘 부탁해
target: Name's Rebecca. Edgerunner from Night City, just like Lucy. Look forward to rollin' with ya.

source: 난 봤어. 빛 아래 숨겨진 어둠을... 지금까지 쭉 의심치 않고 믿어왔던 것이 사실 올바른 길이 아닐 지도 모른다면, 그럼 난... 아, 아무것도 아니야. 신경 쓰지 않아도 돼
target: I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me...

source: 난 싸움은 잘 못하는데... 설렁설렁 해도 될까?
target: I'm not much of a fighter... Can I just slack off?

source: 난 씹기 힘든 음식을 잘 못 먹는다네... 치아와는 상관이 없네! 단순히 입술과 치아 사이에 끈적끈적한 느낌이 싫을 뿐이라네!
target: I'm not a big fan of foods that are hard to chew… Oh, it's got nothing to do with my teeth. I'm just not fond of the prickling sensation of stickiness in my mouth.

source: 난 유노, 월식이 일어날 때 태어난 천재이자 더없이 정확한 미래를 엿볼 수 있는 예언자이기도 해. 궁금한 게 있으면 나한테 찾아와. 물론, 네가 원하는 것을 전부 채워줄 수 있다고 보장할 수는 없지만
target: Iuno, the prodigy born under the lunar eclipse. The Priestess who sees the true future. Curious about what lies ahead? Come to me... But no promises of the perfect ending you seek.

source: 난 이미 네 능력을 봤으니까 공정한 싸움에선 네가 질 거라고 생각하지 않지만... 이 세상에는 나 말고도 상식이 통하지 않는 사람들이 많아. 그러니까 항상 여러 가지 상황에 관해 판단을 내리는 게 좋을 거야
target: I've seen what you're capable of, so I'm not worried about you in a fair fight. That being said, not everyone plays fair. Just watch your back out there... wouldn't want you to get caught off your game.

source: 난 이미 언 땅 아래의 나와 결별했어. 눈이 녹으면... 우린 새로운 봄날에 다시 만날 거야
target: I've already bid farewell to the self buried beneath the frostlands. When the snow thaws... we'll meet again among the new blooms of spring.

source: 난 이미 충분히 강하지만... 그래도 뭐, 고마워!
target: Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!

source: 날 것으로 먹는 건 다 싫어! 특히 얇게 썰어서 보란 듯이 접시에 담아놓은 생고기는 질색이야
target: I hate eating anything raw! Especially that fancy sliced meat on a platter.
A mere scratch upon my blade.

source: 날 봐서 놀랐어? 하하, 긴장하지 마. 다시 만날 거라고 했잖아
target: Surprised to see me? Haha, relax. I told you we'd meet again.

source: 날 실험실에서 불러내다니... (하암) 내 기분을 망치지 말게!
target: Dragging me out of my lab for this...*Yawn* You better have a good reason.

Fly high!
Truth, reach the cosmos.

source: 남들은 모르테피가 도도하고 자만하여 소통하기 어렵다고 느끼지만, 사실 그와 함께 지내는 것이 생각보다 복잡하진 않아 그저 어떤 일이든 솔직하게 말하면 된다. 너무 돌려서 말하게 된다면 오해만 늘어날 뿐이지!
target: Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.
An Improvised Afternoon at the Tavern

source: 내 과거? 음... 정말 알고 싶다면, 말해 줄 순 있다. 다만, 이야기를 시작하려면 좋은 술이 필요할 것 같군
target: Curious about my past? Heh... if that's what you want, I've no intention to hide. But maybe we should talk over a good pot of wine.
My shield can withstand more than that.

source: 내 영혼으로 세상에 단 하나뿐인 비약을 만들 거야. 바닷속 깊이 파묻힌 환상이 과거의 시간에서 날아와 현실을 자유롭게 날아다니며 즐겁게 노래하게 해야지
target: I've longed to craft a potion like no other. One born of my soul, to free the dreams buried deep below, and let them soar, singing through the waking world.

source: 내 이름은 음림, 신분은... 쉿, 함부로 말할 수 없지
target: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.

source: 내 평생의 소원은 누군가와 함께 공모에 성공하는 것, 그리고 그들을... 지옥으로 돌려보내는 거야
target: My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send them straight back to hell.

source: 내가 바라는 건 어느 한 곳의 풍요로움이 아니야. 내가 바라는 건 물자가 막힘없이 유통되고 사람들이 저마다의 자리를 찾아가는 것, 그리고 이곳의 등불이 영원히 꺼지지 않고 밝게 빛나는 거야
target: I want wealth that knows no border. I want goods to find their way, people to find their place. I want the warm light of every home burning, always burning, forever.

source: 내가 없을 때... 용병단 녀석들이 사고를 치지는 않았겠지.
target: Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...
I'll take good care of you.

source: 내가 총을 든 이유는, 모두의 안전을 지키기 위해서야!
target: Everyone's safe and sound? Looks like I didn't practice for nothing, then!
Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.

source: 내적과 외적 수양을 향상시켜 인간의 모든 욕망 앞에 맞서며 심오한 이치를 깨달아 도의 극치에 도달하는 게 바로 저의 목표예요
target: Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.
Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.

source: 너랑 같이 싸워야 된다고? 좀 새로운 느낌이네
target: Fighting alongside you? Okay, that's new.

source: 너무 기름진 음식은 좋아하지 않아요. 예를 들면 스테이크라든지... 맛이 없다는 건 아니지만, 다 먹지 못하면 낭비하게 되고, 낭비하면 천벌을 받으니까요...
target: I'm not a big fan of big, greasy dishes—like steaks... It's not that they aren't tasty, I just hate the idea of letting food go to waste if I can't finish it. It doesn't sit right with me...

source: 너무 순조로운데요! 바로 완벽하게 이해했어요. 감사합니다!
target: Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!

source: 너처럼 혼자 세상을 다니면 분명 많은 손해를 볼 게 뻔하지. 다음에 또 너를 기분 나쁘게 하는 것들을 만나거나 일이 잘 풀리지 않을 때가 온다면... 나를 불러!
target: As a lone traveler, there must've been times when you were taken advantage of, but couldn't retaliate on the spot. If you ever find yourself in such a situation again... do not hesitate to bring me along.

source: 널 위한 시와 마지막 한 곡이야!
target: Now presenting, a poem of finale.
Follow my moves, if you can.
Your life, is mine to take.
You chooms like this stuff, huh?

source: 노랫소리는 마음속에서 터져 나오는 공명이에요. 그것이야 말로 가장 진솔한 마음을 전달하죠
target: Songs are resonating thoughts from the bottom of our hearts. They represent a person's truest feelings.
This is the answer to our endeavor.

source: 놀라운걸. 이렇게 높은 점수는 처음 봐
target: Well, well... Don't think I've ever seen a score that high.
Who is the caged bird now?

source: 눈꽃이 아름다운 이유는... 지는 때가 있기 때문이에요
target: Beautiful beings are beautiful... precisely because of their transiency.

source: 눈앞의 뜨겁고 눈부신 빛으로 모든 그림자를 밝히고, 더 이상 어둠을 숨길 곳이 없었으면 좋겠네요
target: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.

source: 느껴져요. 아직도 끝없이 펼쳐져 있는 제 미래의 길이. 절 향해 기도한 그 수많은 소원들도, 어쩌면 정말로...
target: The path I walk stretches into the future. The wishes laid upon me… perhaps one day, I can finally make them...

source: 느껴지시나요? 바람의 주파수가, 당신과 제 사이에서 맴돌고 있어요
target: Can you feel it? The frequency of the wind... it's resonating between us.

source: 늘 설지 옆에 붙어 다니는 그 신기한 울림 생물... 우담이라고 하던 것 같던데 맞나? 난 우담이 내 동족인 줄 알고 기뻐했는데... 안타깝게도... 그냥 내 오해였더라고
target: The Remnant Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called You'tan, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was…
Let us walk together once more.

source: 단 음식일까요... 딱히 담백한 맛을 고집해서 그런 건 아니에요. 그저 단것을 먹을 때마다, 자꾸만 쓴 기억들이 떠올라서요. 한때 맛보았던 것이 달콤하면 달콤할수록, 그것을 잃었을 때의 감각은 더욱 시리고 아린 법이니까요
target: Confections, I suppose... Not from any preference of palate. It is simply that sweetness, upon tasting, stirs memories of a bitter kind. The sweeter the past I once held, the more bitter the aftertaste that lingers.

source: 단근의 검술에는 스산한 검기가 느껴진다네... 이 아이가 뭔가 너무 무거운 짐을 짊어진 것이 아닌가 걱정이 될 뿐이네!
target: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.

source: 달에 가는 게 내 꿈이었어. 그곳으로 도망친다면, 과거를 떨쳐버리고, 공포에 떨던 날들을 뒤로한 채 새로운 삶을 살 수 있을 거라고 믿었지. 하지만 그 꿈은 내가 가장 바라지 않는 방식으로 이뤄지고 말았어...
target: Used to dream of going to the Moon. Escape there, I thought, and I could leave everything behind. That dream came true... just not in any way I would've ever wanted.

source: 달에 가본 적 있어? 난 가봤어. 하지만 감당하기 힘든 대가를 치렀지. 달에 처음 도착했을 때 느낌이 지금도 선명해. 데이비드는 나를 달에 데려가지는 못했지만, 우린 거기 함께 있었어
target: You ever been to the Moon? I have, but it cost me a lot... Still remember exactly how I felt when I first arrived. Even though David couldn't take me, I knew we were there together.

source: 달이 이 모양에서 저 모양으로, 끊임없이 바뀌고 또 바뀌고 있어... 우리의 능력으로 더 이상 헤아릴 수 없을 때까지
target: From one moon to another, through endless cycles... until it's beyond measurement.

source: 달콤한 거라면 전부 좋아해요. 단 걸 먹으면, 뭘 하든 힘이 나거든요!
target: I have a sweet tooth. Sweet things always give me more energy!

source: 당신 곁에 찾아온~ 유. 령. 이랍니다~
당신에게 보답하려면 단순히 말만으로는 부족하겠네요. 이젠 제가 직접 나서죠. 뭐가 필요하신가요? 무엇이든 벨 수 있는 검? 아니면 무엇이든 막을 수 있는 방패?
target: Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything?

source: 당신을 위해 모든 위험을 제거할 거예요!
target: I will cut down any threat in your way.

source: 당신의 곁에 있으니 운이 좋아진 것 같아요
target: My luck seems better with you around.

source: 당신의 조언과 사고방식은 직정 유적지의 문서들을 떠올리게 하네요. 미지의 체계에서 비롯된, 신비롭고 아름다운 관점이죠. 마치 반짝이는 뭇별처럼요
target: It's interesting. Your feedback reminds me of the texts I found in the Court of Savantae Ruins. Their ideology is fascinating and enigmatic, almost as if it came from the stars in outer space.

source: 당신이 곁에 있으면, 나는 마음껏 검을 휘두를 수 있어요... 붉은빛이 저의 시야를 가린다면 저를 도와 깨끗이 닦아주실 거죠?
target: With you by my side, I can fight without worry... Even if the crimson haze momentarily clouds my sight, you'll be there to help me break free from it, right?

source: 당신이 먼 곳에서 돌아와, 기나긴 삶에 남긴 작은 변화는... 제가 도달하지 못한 세계를 이해하는 원천이 돼요
target: Your return has cast a glimmer of change into my prolonged existence. It allows me to gain some understanding of a world beyond my reach.
You found it, and it's yours to keep.

source: 당신한테도 제 손에 쥔 칼날의 울림이 들리시나요? 바라시는 게 있다면, 어떤 소원이든 반드시 이루어 드릴게요
target: You hear the ring of my blade, do you not? It is the sound of my conviction to see through your wishes. Any of them.

source: 당연히 게임이지. 검은 해안에는 게임 카트리지가 엄청 많거든. 나중에 시간 되면 같이 할래?
target: Playing games, of course! So many cool ones in the Black Shores. Want to co-op sometime?

source: 당연히 신선한 고기로 만든 살팀보카지! 난 일곱 언덕의 전통 음식이 좋아. 고추라면 조금 넣어도 좋지만... 라군나 사람처럼 시큼한 소스를 넣는 건 용서 못 해!
target: A Saltimbocca made with fresh meat. I'm a Septimont traditionalist by palate, so a pinch of hot sauce is okay, but no weird sour cream. Don't be like the Ragunnesi!

source: 당연히 신선한 과일이 들어가고, 크림이 잔뜩 발린 채 촛불이 꽂혀 있는 생일 케이크지... 아직 한 번도 먹어본 적은 없지만
target: A birthday cake, of course. The kind with tons of fresh fruit and way too much whipped cream. And candles on top, for sure... Why? Because I've never actually had one before.

source: 대단해! 이번 특훈은 녹화해 놨어. 나중에 천천히 보면서 공부할 거야
target: Awesome! I'll record our training and savor every detail of it.

source: 더 많은 것을 읽은 후 깨닫게 됐어요... 그동안 계속 고민하고 있던 것이, 바로 이런 거였군요
target: I can see more now... So that's what was troubling me all along.

source: 더 많은 힘을 가진 사람은 그만큼 더 많은 책임을 져야 한다는 말이 있지. 하아... 더 많은 업무는 사양이지만, 방랑자가 원한다면 야근이야 좀 더 뛰어도 괜찮을 것 같아
target: With more power comes more responsibility... I really don't want more work, but if it's you asking... I can do some overtime. Just a little.
As far as the eye can see.

source: 도기는 항상 하품을 하면서도 많은 일을 빠르게 처리하는데... 그 효율은 저도 배우고 싶어져요
target: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

source: 도망가, 도망가라니까... 어? 진짜 도망갔네? 흠, 운이 좋은걸
